info.description: Quantum Corp. engages in the manufacture of computer storage devices. It provides solutions for storing and protecting information in physical, virtual, and cloud environments. Its products and services include Myriad All-Flash File and Object, StorNext File System Unified Surveillance Platform, ActiveScale Object Storage, DXi Backup Appliances, Scalar Tape Storage, CatDV Media Asset Management, and Cloud-Based Analytics. The company was founded by Joel N. Harrison and James M. McCoy in 1980 and is headquartered in Centennial, CO.
info.description_zh: Quantum Corp. 從事電腦儲存設備的製造。它提供了在實體、虛擬和雲端環境中儲存和保護資訊的解決方案。其產品和服務包括 Myriad 全快閃檔案和物件、StorNext 檔案系統統一監控平台、ActiveScale 物件儲存、DXi 備份設備、標量磁帶儲存、CatDV 媒體資產管理和基於雲端的分析。該公司由 Joel N. Harrison 和 James M. McCoy 於 1980 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州森特尼爾。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long RIVN Daily ETF seeks daily investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the performance of the common stock of Rivian Automotive, Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. The fund aims to generate 2 times the daily performances of the underlying stock for a single day. A "single day" is defined as being calculated "from the close of regular trading on one trading day to the close on the next trading day."
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long RIVN Daily ETF 尋求 Rivian Automotive, Inc. 普通股績效每日百分比變動 2 倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票每日百分比變化 2 倍 (200%) 的結果。該基金的目標是單日產生標的股票日表現兩倍的收益。 「單日」的定義是「從一個交易日常規交易收盤起至下一交易日收盤止」計算。

info.description: SunCar Technology Group, Inc. engages in the provision of automotive after-sales service and insurance intermediation service through its subsidiaries in the People's Republic of China. The company was founded on August 6, 2021 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: SunCar Technology Group, Inc.透過其位於中華人民共和國的子公司提供汽車售後服務和保險中介服務。公司成立於2021年8月6日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: 10X Genomics, Inc. is a life science technology company, which engages in building products to interrogate, understand and master biology. Its integrated solutions include single cell transcriptomics, single cell genomics, single cell epigenomes, linked-reads genomics and spatial transcriptomics. The company's products include Single Cell Gene Expression, Immune Profiling, ATAC, and Genome. The company was founded by Serge Saxonov, Ben Hindson and Kevin D. Ness on July 2, 2012 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, CA.
info.description_zh: 10X Genomics, Inc. 是一家生命科學技術公司，致力於建構用於探究、理解和掌握生物學的產品。其綜合解決方案包括單細胞轉錄組學、單細胞基因組學、單細胞表觀基因組、連結讀取基因組學和空間轉錄組學。該公司的產品包括單細胞基因表現、免疫分析、ATAC 和基因組。該公司由 Serge Saxonov、Ben Hindson 和 Kevin D. Ness 於 2012 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州普萊森頓。

info.description: Aptiv Plc engages in the designs, develops and manufactures software and hardware solutions. It operates through the Signal and Power Solutions, and Advanced Safety and User Experience segments. It also operates through the following geographical segments: North America; Europe, Middle East, and Africa; Asia Pacific; and South America. The company was founded on May 19, 2011 and is headquartered in Schaffhausen, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: Aptiv Plc 從事設計、開發和製造軟體和硬體解決方案。它透過訊號和電源解決方案以及高級安全和用戶體驗部門運作。它也透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美；歐洲、中東和非洲；亞太地區；和南美洲。公司成立於2011年5月19日，總部位於瑞士沙夫豪森。

info.description: Orangekloud Technology, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in providing information technology consulting services. Its digital transformation projects include the sales and consulting of Microsoft Dynamics ERP software licenses. It operates through the Packaged Software Solutions, and No-Code Platform and Mobile Application segments. The Packaged Software Solutions segment refers to packaged software and custom software solutions. The No-Code Platform and Mobile Application focuses on providing a rapid development environment through a No-Code platform. The company was founded by Kian Hwa Goh, Lay Hua Lung and Kim Chwee Chew on May 12, 2023 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Orangekloud Technology, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事提供資訊科技諮詢服務。其數位轉型專案包括 Microsoft Dynamics ERP 軟體授權的銷售和諮詢。它透過打包軟體解決方案、無代碼平台和行動應用程式部門運作。打包軟體解決方案部分是指打包軟體和客製化軟體解決方案。無程式碼平台和行動應用程式專注於透過無程式碼平台提供快速開發環境。該公司由 Kian Hwa Goh、Lay Hua Lung 和 Kim Chwee Chew 於 2023 年 5 月 12 日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Rivian Automotive, Inc. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of category-defining electric vehicles and accessories. It operates through following segments: Automotive, Software and Services. The company was founded by Robert J. Scaringe in June 2009 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Rivian Automotive, Inc. 從事定義類別的電動車及配件的設計、開發和製造。它透過以下部門運作：汽車部門、軟體部門和服務部門。該公司由 Robert J. Scaringe 於 2009 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: REalloys, Inc. is engaged in the rebuilding of domestic supply chain resilience for rare earth elements and magnets. It is involved in recycling, mining, oxide production, metallization, alloying, and magnet manufacturing. The company was founded on October 4, 2011 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: REalloys, Inc. 致力於重建稀土元素和磁鐵的國內供應鏈彈性。它涉及回收、採礦、氧化物生產、金屬化、合金化和磁鐵製造。該公司成立於2011年10月4日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: trivago NV is a holding company, which engages in the provision of a global hotel and accommodation search platform. It also offers marketing tools and services for advertisers. It operates through the following segments: Americas, Developed Europe, and Rest of World. The Americas segment consists of Argentina, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Columbia, Ecuador, Mexico, Peru, the United States, and Uruguay. The Developed Europe segment includes Austria, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom. The Rest of the World segment represents all other countries such as Australia, Japan, India, New Zealand, Russia, and Turkey. The company was founded by Rolf T.J. Schromgens, Peter Vinnemeier, and Stephan Stubner in 2005 and is headquartered in Dusseldorf, Germany.
info.description_zh: trivago NV 是一家控股公司，提供全球飯店和住宿搜尋平台。它也為廣告商提供行銷工具和服務。它透過以下部門運作：美洲、已開發歐洲和世界其他地區。美洲部分包括阿根廷、巴西、加拿大、智利、哥倫比亞、厄瓜多、墨西哥、秘魯、美國和烏拉圭。歐洲已開發地區包括奧地利、比利時、丹麥、芬蘭、法國、德國、愛爾蘭、義大利、荷蘭、挪威、葡萄牙、西班牙、瑞典、瑞士和英國。世界其他地區部分代表所有其他國家，例如澳洲、日本、印度、紐西蘭、俄羅斯和土耳其。該公司由 Rolf T.J. 創立。 Schromgens、Peter Vinnemeier 和 Stephan Stubner 於 2005 年成立，總部位於德國杜塞爾多夫。

info.description: MGM Resorts International is a holding company, which engages in the ownership and operations of casino resorts. The firm's casino resorts offer gaming, hotel, convention, dining, entertainment, retail, and other resort amenities. It operates through the following business segments: Las Vegas Strip Resorts, Regional Operations, MGM China, and MGM Digital. The Las Vegas Strip Resorts segment operates the following casino resorts: Bellagio, MGM Grand Las Vegas, Mandalay Bay, The Mirage, Luxor, New York-New, Excalibur, Park MGM, and Circus Las Vegas. The Regional Operations segment consists of the following casino resorts: MGM Grand Detroit in Detroit, Michigan, Beau Rivage in Biloxi, Mississippi, Gold Strike Tunica in Tunica, Mississippi, Borgata in Atlantic City, New Jersey, MGM National Harbor in Prince George's County, Maryland, and MGM Springfield in Springfield, Massachusetts. The MGM China segment includes MGM Macau and MGM Cotai. The MGM Digital segment focuses on the online gaming portfolio, which consists primarily of Leo Vegas, which is headquartered in Sweden and Malta. The company was founded by Kerkor Kerkorian on January 29, 1986 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: 米高梅國際酒店集團是一家控股公司，從事賭場度假村的所有權和營運。該公司的賭場度假村提供博彩、酒店、會議、餐飲、娛樂、零售和其他度假村設施。它透過以下業務部門運營：拉斯維加斯大道度假村、區域運營、米高梅中國和米高梅數字。 Las Vegas Strip Resorts部門經營以下賭場度假村：Bellagio、MGM Grand Las Vegas、Mandalay Bay、The Mirage、Luxor、New York-New、Excalibur、Park MGM和Circus Las Vegas。區域營運部門包括以下賭場度假村：密西根州底特律的MGM Grand Detroit、密西西比州比洛克西的Beau Rivage、密西西比州圖尼卡的Gold Strike Tunica、新澤西州大西洋城的Borgata、馬裡蘭州喬治王子縣的MGM National Harbor和馬薩諸塞州斯普林菲爾德的MGM Springfield。美高梅中國分部包括澳門美高梅及路氹美高梅。 MGM Digital 部門專注於線上遊戲產品組合，主要由總部位於瑞典和馬耳他的 Leo Vegas 組成。該公司由 Kerkor Kerkorian 於 1986 年 1 月 29 日創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Axe Compute, Inc. engages in the provision of graphics processing unit compute capacity for artificial intelligence and other complex computing workloads. It operates through the following segments: Compute Services and Treasury Management segment, and Drug Discovery Services segment. The Compute Services and Treasury Management segment provides services that include access to GPU compute capacity and manage the ATH Treasury Strategy. The Drug Discovery Services segment provides services that include the application of AI, creation of specific 3D culture models used in drug development. The company was founded by Lawrence W. Gadbaw, Peter L. Morawetz, and Jeffrey K. Drogue on April 23, 2002 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: Axe Compute, Inc. 致力於為人工智慧和其他複雜運算工作負載提供圖形處理單元運算能力。它透過以下部門運作：計算服務和財務管理部門以及藥物發現服務部門。運算服務和財務管理部門提供的服務包括存取 GPU 運算能力和管理 ATH 財務策略。藥物發現服務部門提供的服務包括人工智慧的應用、藥物開發中使用的特定 3D 文化模型的創建。該公司由 Lawrence W. Gadbaw、Peter L. Morawetz 和 Jeffrey K. Drogue 於 2002 年 4 月 23 日創立，總部位於賓州匹茲堡。

info.description: ChipMOS Technologies, Inc. provides total semiconductor testing and packaging solutions to fabless companies, integrated device manufacturers (IDM) and foundries. It operates through the segment Testing, Assembly, Crystal Display and other Flat-Panel Display Driver Semiconductors (LCDD), Bumping, and Others. The company was founded on July 28, 1997 and is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: ChipMOS Technologies, Inc. 為無晶圓廠公司、整合元件製造商 (IDM) 和代工廠提供全面的半導體測試和封裝解決方案。該公司透過測試、組裝、晶體顯示器和其他平板顯示器驅動器半導體 (LCDD)、凸點等部門進行營運。公司成立於1997年7月28日，總部位於台灣新竹。

info.description: Enovix Corp. engages in the design and development of silicon-anode lithium-ion batteries. The firm's proprietary 3D cell architecture increases energy density and maintains a high cycle life. It is also developing its 3D cell technology and production process for the electric vehicle and energy storage markets to help enable utilization of renewable energy. The company was founded by Mr. Harrold Jones Rust, III, Ashok Lahiri, and Murali Ramasubramanian in November 2006 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Enovix Corp.從事矽陽極鋰離子電池的設計與開發。該公司專有的 3D 電池架構提高了能量密度並保持了較高的循環壽命。它還正在為電動車和儲能市場開發 3D 電池技術和生產工藝，以幫助實現再生能源的利用。該公司由 Harrold Jones Rust, III 先生、Ashok Lahiri 和 Murali Ramasubramanian 先生於 2006 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Lunai Bioworks, Inc. is a pre-clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of genetically modified cellular and immune-therapy technologies used for the treatment of infectious diseases and cancer. Its pipeline consists of ENOB-HV-01, ENOB- HV-11, ENOB-HV-12, ENOB-DB-01, ENOB-DC-01, ENOB-DC-11, and ENOB-DC-21. The company was founded by Rene Sindlev and Serhat Gumrukcu on January 18, 2011 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Lunai Bioworks, Inc.是一家臨床前階段生物技術公司，致力於開發用於治療傳染病和癌症的基因改造細胞和免疫治療技術。其管道包括ENOB-HV-01、ENOB-HV-11、ENOB-HV-12、ENOB-DB-01、ENOB-DC-01、ENOB-DC-11和ENOB-DC-21。該公司由 Rene Sindlev 和 Serhat Gumrukcu 於 2011 年 1 月 18 日創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: TripAdvisor, Inc. is an online travel company, which owns and operates a portfolio of online travel brands. It operates through the following segments: Experiences, Hotels and Other, and TheFork. The Experiences segment includes both Viator and Tripadvisor points of sale. The Hotel and Other segment manages the hotel and restaurant guidance platform. The TheFork segment provides an online marketplace that enables diners to discover and book online reservations. The company was founded by Nicholas Shanny and Stephen Kaufer in February 2000 and is headquartered in Needham, MA.

info.description: CDW Corp. engages in the provision of information technology solutions to small, medium, and large business, government, education, and healthcare customers. It operates through the following segments: Corporate, Small Business, Public, and Other. The Corporate segment serves US private sector business customers with more than 250 employees. The Small Business segment focuses on the US private sector business customers with up to 250 employees. The Public segment includes government agencies and education and healthcare institutions. The Other segment focuses on CDW UK and Canada. The company was founded by Michael P. Krasny in 1984 and is headquartered in Vernon Hills, IL.
info.description_zh: CDW Corp. 致力於為小型、中型和大型企業、政府、教育和醫療保健客戶提供資訊科技解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：企業部門、小型企業部門、公共部門和其他部門。企業部門為美國私人企業客戶提供服務，擁有 250 多名員工。小型企業部門專注於擁有最多 250 名員工的美國私人企業客戶。公共部門包括政府機構以及教育和醫療機構。其他部分則重點關注 CDW 英國和加拿大。該公司由 Michael P. Krasny 於 1984 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州弗農希爾斯。

info.description: FactSet Research Systems Inc. (the Company or FactSet) is a global financial digital platform and enterprise solutions provider with open and flexible technologies that aims to supercharge financial intelligence. Since inception, global financial professionals have utilized the company's content and multi-asset class solutions across each stage of the investment process. FactSet's goal is to provide a seamless user experience spanning idea generation, research, portfolio construction, trade execution, performance measurement, risk management, reporting, and portfolio analysis, in which the company serves the front, middle, and back offices to drive productivity and improved performance. FactSet's flexible, open data and technology solutions can be implemented both across the investment portfolio lifecycle or as standalone components serving different workflows in the organization. FactSet is focused on growing the business throughout each of its three segments, the Americas, EMEA (formerly known as Europe), and Asia Pacific. FactSet revised its internal organization within each segment to offer data, products and analytical applications by firm type: Institutional Buyside, Dealmakers, Wealth, and Partnerships and CGS. The company believes organization by firm type better aligns with its clients, the long-term view of its business and commitment to investing for growth and efficiency. FactSet currently serves financial professionals, which include portfolio managers, investment research professionals, investment bankers, risk and performance analysts, wealth advisors and corporate clients. FactSet provides both insights on global market trends and intelligence on companies and industries, as well as capabilities to monitor portfolio risk and performance and to execute trades. The company combines dedicated client service with open and flexible technology offerings, such as a configurable desktop and mobile platform, comprehensive data feeds, an open marketplace and digital portals and application programming interfaces (APIs). The company's revenue is primarily derived from subscriptions to products and services such as workstations, analytics, enterprise data, and research management. FactSet Research Systems was founded by Howard E. Wille and Charles J. Snyder in September 1978 and is headquartered in Norwalk, CT.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: FactSet Research Systems Inc.（以下簡稱「本公司」或「FactSet」）是一家全球金融數位平台和企業解決方案提供商，擁有開放、靈活的技術，旨在增強金融智慧。自成立以來，全球金融專業人士在投資過程的每個階段都利用了該公司的內容和多元資產類別解決方案。 FactSet 的目標是提供涵蓋創意生成、研究、投資組合建構、交易執行、績效衡量、風險管理、報告和投資組合分析的無縫用戶體驗，其中該公司為前台、中台和後台提供服務，以提高生產力並提高績效。 FactSet 靈活、開放的資料和技術解決方案既可以在整個投資組合生命週期中實施，也可以作為服務於組織中不同工作流程的獨立組件來實施。 FactSet 專注於發展其三個細分市場的業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲（EMEA）（以前稱為歐洲）和亞太地區。 FactSet 修改了每個部門的內部組織，以按公司類型提供資料、產品和分析應用程式：機構買方、交易撮合者、財富、合作夥伴和 CGS。該公司相信，按公司類型劃分的組織更能符合客戶、業務的長期願景以及對成長和效率投資的承諾。 FactSet 目前為金融專業人士提供服務，其中包括投資組合經理、投資研究專業人士、投資銀行家、風險和績效分析師、財富顧問和企業客戶。 FactSet 提供有關全球市場趨勢的見解和有關公司和行業的情報，以及監控投資組合風險和績效以及執行交易的功能。該公司將專門的客戶服務與開放靈活的技術產品相結合，例如可配置的桌面和行動平台、全面的資料來源、開放的市場以及數位入口網站和應用程式介面（API）。該公司的收入主要來自工作站、分析、企業數據和研究管理等產品和服務的訂閱。 FactSet Research Systems 由 Howard E. Wille 和 Charles J. Snyder 於 1978 年 9 月創立，總部位於康乃狄克州諾沃克。

info.description: ECARX Holdings, Inc. engages in the development of mobility technology services. The company was founded by Zi Yu Shen & Shu Fu Li in 2017 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: ECARX Holdings, Inc. 從事行動技術服務開發。該公司由沉子宇和李樹福於2017年創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Transcat, Inc. engages in the provision of calibration and laboratory instrument services. It operates through the following business segments: Service and Distribution. The Service segment offers calibration, repair, inspection, analytical qualifications, preventive maintenance, consulting, and other related services. The Distribution segment distributes professional grade tests, measurement, and control instrumentation. The company was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Rochester, NY.
info.description_zh: Transcat, Inc. 從事提供校準和實驗室儀器服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：服務和分銷。服務部門提供校準、維修、檢查、分析鑑定、預防性維護、諮詢和其他相關服務。分銷部門分銷專業級測試、測量和控制儀器。該公司成立於 1964 年，總部位於紐約州羅徹斯特。

info.description: AudioCodes Ltd. engages in the provision of communications software, products and productivity solutions for the digital workplace. The firm is involved in the development, manufacture, and market of products for transferring voice and data over the internet. Its products include products for Microsoft 365, session border controllers, multi-service business routers, meeting rooms, internet protocol phones, digital and analog media gateways, management products and solutions, and voice applications. The company was founded by Shabtai Adlersberg in 1992 and is headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel.
info.description_zh: AudioCodes Ltd. 致力於為數位工作場所提供通訊軟體、產品和生產力解決方案。該公司從事透過網路傳輸語音和數據的產品的開發、製造和銷售。其產品包括Microsoft 365產品、會話邊界控制器、多服務業務路由器、會議室、網際網路協定電話、數位和類比媒體閘道、管理產品和解決方案以及語音應用程式。該公司由 Shabtai Adlersberg 於 1992 年創立，總部位於以色列 Or Yehuda。

info.description: BCB Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial solutions. It offers loans, deposit products, and retail and commercial banking services. The company was founded on May 1, 2003 and is headquartered in Bayonne, NJ.
info.description_zh: BCB Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供金融解決方案。它提供貸款、存款產品以及零售和商業銀行服務。該公司成立於2003年5月1日，總部位於新澤西州巴約訥。

info.description: Park Dental Partners, Inc. engages in the provision of comprehensive business support services including clinical team members, administrative personnel, facilities and equipment. The company was founded by Gregory T. Swenson and Brian Murn in 1972 and is headquartered in Roseville, MN.
info.description_zh: Park Dental Partners, Inc. 從事提供全面的業務支援服務，包括臨床團隊成員、行政人員、設施和設備。該公司由 Gregory T. Swenson 和 Brian Murn 於 1972 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州羅斯維爾。

info.description: Macquarie Focused Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks to long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of emerging markets issuers. The fund invests primarily in a broad range of equity securities of companies located in emerging market countries and may invest in companies of any size. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 麥格理專注於新興市場股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於新興市場發行人的股本證券。該基金主要投資於新興市場國家公司的各種股本證券，並可投資於任何規模的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Innovation Beverage Group Ltd. engages in developing, manufacturing, marketing, exporting, and retailing alcoholic and non-alcoholic brands. The company was founded by Meena Beri, Amit Beri and Sahil Beri on April 20, 2018 and is headquartered in Seven Hills, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 飲料 - 釀酒廠和釀酒廠
info.description_zh: Innovation Beverage Group Ltd. 從事酒精和非酒精品牌的開發、製造、行銷、出口和零售。該公司由 Meena Beri、Amit Beri 和 Sahil Beri 於 2018 年 4 月 20 日創立，總部位於澳洲七山。

info.description: AIRO Group Holdings, Inc. engages in the purpose of acquiring and integrating various companies engaged in the aerospace and defense industry. It operates through the following segments: Avionics and Electronics, Electric Air Mobility, Drones, and Training. The Avionics and Electronics segment refers to its brand, Aspen Avionics, which designs, certifies, and manufactures critical navigation, communication, and display components and integrated systems. The Electric Air Mobility segment transforms urban transportation with its development of an electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft. The Drones perform crucial missions such as ISR and target tracking, mapping, surveying, inspection, and localization, enhancing military, and commercial operational efficiency worldwide. The Training segment relates to its brand, Coastal Defense, delivers specialized professional training services to the military and commercial aviation communities. The company was founded by Chirinjeev Kathuria on August, 30, 2021 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: AIRO Group Holdings, Inc. 致力於收購和整合從事航空航天和國防工業的多家公司。該公司透過以下部門運作：航空電子和電子部門、電動空中交通部門、無人機部門和培訓部門。航空電子設備和電子部門是指其品牌 Aspen Avionics，該公司設計、認證和製造關鍵的導航、通訊和顯示組件以及整合系統。電動空中交通部門透過開發電動垂直起降 (eVTOL) 飛機改變了城市交通。無人機執行ISR和目標追蹤、測繪、測量、檢查和定位等關鍵任務，提高全球軍事和商業營運效率。培訓部門與其品牌海岸防禦有關，為軍事和商業航空界提供專門的專業培訓服務。該公司由 Chirinjeev Kathuria 於 2021 年 8 月 30 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: Silvaco Group, Inc. provides technology computer aided design software, electronic data automation software and semiconductor intellectual property. The TCAD, EDA and SIP solutions enable semiconductor and photonics companies to increase productivity, accelerate their product's time to market and reduce their development and manufacturing costs. Its services include SPICE Modeling Services, TCAD Modeling Services, Library Design Services and Library Characterization Services. The company was founded on November 18, 2009 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Silvaco Group, Inc. 提供技術電腦輔助設計軟體、電子資料自動化軟體和半導體智慧財產權。 TCAD、EDA 和 SIP 解決方案使半導體和光子學公司能夠提高生產力、加快產品上市時間並降低開發和製造成本。其服務包括 SPICE 建模服務、TCAD 建模服務、庫設計服務和庫表徵服務。該公司成立於2009年11月18日，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Pony.ai, Inc. develops artificial intelligence-based robot designed for autonomous driving. The firm's software algorithms and infrastructure enables a vehicle to perceive its surroundings, predict what others will do, and maneuver itself accordingly. The company was founded by Jun Peng and Tian Cheng Lou in November 4, 2016 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: Pony.ai, Inc. 開發專為自動駕駛而設計的人工智慧機器人。該公司的軟體演算法和基礎設施使車輛能夠感知周圍環境，預測其他人會做什麼，並相應地進行自我操縱。該公司由彭軍和樓天成於2016年11月4日創立，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: Petco Health & Wellness Company, Inc. engages in the provision of pet health and wellness services. It operates across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, including a growing network, store veterinary hospitals, and offer a complete online resource for pet health and wellness. The firm offers grooming, as well as in-store and online training. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Petco Health & Wellness Company, Inc. 从事提供宠物健康和保健服务。該公司的業務遍及美國、墨西哥和波多黎各，包括不斷發展的網路、商店獸醫醫院，並提供完整的寵物健康線上資源。该公司提供美容服务以及店内和在线培训。该公司成立于 1965 年，总部位于加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥。

info.description: United Parcel Service, Inc. is a package delivery company, which engages in the provision of global supply chain management solutions. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Domestic Package, International Package, and Supply Chain Solutions. The U.S. Domestic Package segment includes time-definite delivery of letters, documents, and packages. The International Package segment focuses on delivery and shipments in Europe, Asia, the Indian sub-continent, the Middle East, Africa, Canada, and Latin America. The Supply Chain Solutions is involved in forwarding, logistics, Coyote, Marken, and UPS Mail Innovations. The company was founded by James E. Casey and Claude Ryan on August 28, 1907 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: United Parcel Service, Inc.是一家包裹遞送公司，提供全球供應鏈管理解決方案。該公司透過以下部門營運：美國國內包裹部門、國際包裹部門和供應鏈解決方案部門。美國國內包裹部分包括限時遞送信件、文件和包裹。國際包裹部門專注於歐洲、亞洲、印度次大陸、中東、非洲、加拿大和拉丁美洲的交付和運輸。供應鏈解決方案涉及貨運、物流、Coyote、Marken 和 UPS Mail Innovations。該公司由 James E. Casey 和 Claude Ryan 於 1907 年 8 月 28 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Palladyne AI Corp. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of industrial robotic systems that augment human performance by combining human intelligence, instinct, and judgment with the strength, endurance, and precision of machines to enhance employee safety and productivity. Its products include Palldyne IQ and Palladyne Pilot. The company was founded by Fraser M. Smith and Benjamin G. Wolff in 2015 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Palladyne AI Corp. 從事工業機器人系統的設計、開發和製造，透過將人類智慧、本能和判斷力與機器的力量、耐力和精度相結合來增強人類績效，從而提高員工的安全和生產力。其產品包括 Palldyne IQ 和 Palladyne Pilot。該公司由 Fraser M. Smith 和 Benjamin G. Wolff 於 2015 年創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Calumet, Inc. engages in the manufacturing, formulation, and sale of specialty branded products and renewable fuel. It operates through the following segments: Specialty Products and Solutions, Montana/Renewables, Performance Brands, and Corporate. The Specialty Products & Solutions segment consists of customer-focused solutions and formulation businesses. The Montana/Renewables segment is composed of a Great Falls specialty asphalt facility and Montana Renewables facility. The Performance Brands segment includes Royal Purple, Bel-Ray, and TruFuel. The Corporate segment focuses on the general and administrative expenses not allocated to other segments. The company was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, IN.
info.description_zh: Calumet, Inc. 從事專業品牌產品和再生燃料的製造、配​​製和銷售。該公司透過以下部門運作：特種產品和解決方案部門、蒙大拿州/再生能源部門、績效品牌部門和企業部門。特種產品和解決方案部門包括以客戶為中心的解決方案和配方業務。蒙大拿州/再生能源部門由大瀑布特種瀝青設施和蒙大拿州再生能源設施組成。性能品牌部門包括 Royal Purple、Bel-Ray 和 TruFuel。公司部門專注於未分配給其他部門的一般和管理費用。該公司成立於 1919 年，總部位於印第安納州印第安納波利斯。

info.description: Versus Systems, Inc. engages in the development of business-to-business video game support software. Its software platform allows video game publishers and developers to offer prize based matches. Its geographical segments include Canada and USA. The company's platform facilitates several types of single player prize challenges that includes a range of prize types, including coupons, sweepstakes style prizes, consumer packaged goods and downloadable content. The company was founded by Matthew Pierce on December 1, 1988 and is headquartered in Dover, DE.
info.description_zh: Versus Systems, Inc. 從事企業對企業電玩支援軟體的開發。其軟體平台允許視頻遊戲發行商和開發商提供有獎比賽。其地理部分包括加拿大和美國。該公司的平台支援多種類型的單人獎品挑戰，其中包括一系列獎品類型，包括優惠券、抽獎獎品、消費品和下載內容。該公司由 Matthew Pierce 於 1988 年 12 月 1 日創立，總部位於特拉華州多佛。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long XPEV Daily ETF is an actively managed fund targeting 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of XPeng Inc. (XPEV). The strategy is a tactical instrument for sophisticated traders, utilizing financial derivatives to provide magnified daily exposure to the underlying Chinese smart electric vehicle company.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2X Long XPEV Daily ETF 是一支主動式管理基金，目標投資於小鵬汽車 (XPEV) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該策略是成熟交易者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生性商品來擴大對中國智慧電動汽車公司的日常曝險。

info.description: Prenetics Global Ltd. is a health sciences company, which engages in providing consumer health products and services. The firm offers scientifically formulated supplements under the IM8 brand, sports nutrition products under the Europa platform, and direct-to-consumer DNA tests through the CircleDNA brand. It is also involved in establishing a Bitcoin treasury for the exploration of applications within the healthcare ecosystem. The company was founded by Sheng Wu Yeung and Chi Hung Tzang in 2014 and has dual headquartered in Charlotte, the United States and Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Prenetics Global Ltd. 是一家健康科學公司，致力於提供消費者健康產品和服務。該公司在 IM8 品牌下提供科學配製的補充劑，在 Europa 平台下提供運動營養產品，並透過 CircleDNA 品牌提供直接面向消費者的 DNA 測試。它還參與建立比特幣金庫，以探索醫療保健生態系統中的應用程式。該公司由Sheng Wu Yeung和Chi Hung Tzang於2014年創立，雙總部位於美國夏洛特和香港。

info.description: Appian Corp. engages in the provision of business process management (BPM) solutions. Its products include BPM software, case management, mobile application development, and platform-as-a-service. The company was founded by Matthew Wheeler Calkins, Robert Charles Kramer, Marc Wilson, and Michael Beckley in 1999 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: Appian Corp. 從事提供業務流程管理 (BPM) 解決方案。其產品包括 BPM 軟體、案例管理、行動應用程式開發和平台即服務。該公司由 Matthew Wheeler Calkins、Robert Charles Kramer、Marc Wilson 和 Michael Beckley 於 1999 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: Smurfit WestRock Plc engages in the development and provision of packaging solutions. Its products include corrugated packaging, corrugated sheet boards, hexacomb packaging, and solid boards. The company was founded on July 6, 2017 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: Smurfit WestRock Plc 從事包裝解決方案的開發和提供。其產品包括瓦楞包裝、瓦楞紙板、六格包裝和實心紙板。該公司成立於2017年7月6日，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Royal Caribbean Group is a cruise company, which engages in the ownership and operation of the following global cruise brands: Royal Caribbean International, Celebrity Cruises, and Silversea Cruises. The firm also holds interest in TUI Cruises GmbH, which operates the German brands TUI Cruises and Hapag-Lloyd Cruises. The company was founded by Arne Wilhelmsen in 1968 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: 皇家加勒比集團是一家郵輪公司，擁有並經營以下全球郵輪品牌：皇家加勒比國際郵輪、精緻郵輪、銀海郵輪。該公司還持有 TUI Cruises GmbH 的股份，該公司經營德國品牌 TUI Cruises 和 Hapag-Lloyd Cruises。該公司由 Arne Wilhelmsen 於 1968 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is an optimized equity index designed to reflect the equity performance of companies that have favorable ESG characteristics, while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the MSCI Emerging Markets Index (the "parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場擴展 ESG 焦點指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是優化的股票指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 特徵的公司的股票表現，同時表現出與 MSCI 新興市場指數（「母指數」）類似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: Cohu, Inc. engages in the provision of back-end semiconductor equipment and services. It offers test and handling capital equipment, interface products, and related services to the semiconductor and electronics manufacturing industries. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Cohu, Inc. 從事提供後端半導體設備和服務。它為半導體和電子製造業提供測試和處理資本設備、介面產品以及相關服務。該公司成立於 1947 年，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: abrdn Emerging Markets Dividend Active ETF seeks total return consisting of income and long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of emerging market companies that pay dividend income. The fund will invest primarily in common stocks but may also invest in other types of equity securities, including, but not limited to, preferred stock and depositary receipts.
info.description_zh: abrdn 新興市場股息主動 ETF 尋求由收入和長期資本增值組成的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產價值以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於支付股息收入的新興市場公司的股本證券。該基金將主要投資於普通股，但也可能投資於其他類型的股本證券，包括但不限於優先股和存託憑證。

info.description: Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. It is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. The fund invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. It primarily invests in a portfolio of convertible securities, investment grade and below investment grade bonds, loans, equity-linked notes, and floating rate securities. The fund also invests through derivatives such as options. It employs fundamental analysis with a top-down global macroeconomic approach to create its portfolio. Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund was formed on March 11, 2014 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund 是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式固定收益共同基金。它由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。該基金投資於美國的固定收益市場。它主要投資於可轉換證券、投資等級及低於投資等級債券、貸款、股票掛鉤票據和浮動利率證券的投資組合。該基金也透過選擇權等衍生性商品進行投資。它採用基本面分析和自上而下的全球宏觀經濟方法來創建其投資組合。 Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund 成立於 2014 年 3 月 11 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: GH Research Plc is a holding company, which engages in the provision of biopharmaceutical products and services. It develops therapeutic products for patients with psychiatric and neurological disorders. The firm develops novel and proprietary 5-Methoxy-N and N-Dimethyltryptamine, or 5-MeO-DMT, therapies. The company was founded by Theis Terwey, Florian Schonharting, and Magnus Halle in 2018 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: GH Research Plc 是一家控股公司，從事提供生物製藥產品和服務。它為患有精神和神經疾病的患者開發治療產品。該公司開發新穎且專有的 5-甲氧基-N 和 N-二甲基色胺（5-MeO-DMT）療法。該公司由 Theis Terwey、Florian Schonharting 和 Magnus Halle 於 2018 年創立，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Harvard Bioscience, Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells technologies, products and services that enable fundamental research, discovery, and pre-clinical testing for drug development. It operates under the geographical segments: United States, Germany, China, United Kingdom, and Rest of the World. It sells its products through catalog, Website, distributors, and direct sales force. The company was founded by Dr. William T. Porter in 1901 and is headquartered in Holliston, MA.
info.description_zh: 哈佛生物科學公司開發、製造和銷售技術、產品和服務，為藥物開發的基礎研究、發現和臨床前測試提供支援。它在以下地理區域運作：美國、德國、中國、英國和世界其他地區。它透過目錄、網站、分銷商和直銷隊伍銷售其產品。該公司由 William T. Porter 博士於 1901 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州霍利斯頓。

info.description: Agilent Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of application focused solutions for life sciences, diagnostics, and applied chemical markets. It operates through the following segments: Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets, Applied Markets, and Agilent CrossLab. The Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets segment offers active pharmaceutical ingredients for oligo-based therapeutics as well as solutions that include reagents, instruments, software and consumables. The Applied Markets segment refers to the application-focused solutions that include instruments and software that enable customers to identify, quantify, and analyze the physical and biological properties of substances and products. The Agilent CrossLab segment spans the entire lab with its extensive services and consumables portfolio in addition to software and laboratory automation solutions. The company was founded in May 1999 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: 安捷倫科技公司致力於為生命科學、診斷和應用化學市場提供以應用為中心的解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：生命科學和診斷市場、應用市場和安捷倫 CrossLab。生命科學和診斷市場部門提供基於寡核苷酸的治療的活性藥物成分以及包括試劑、儀器、軟體和消耗品的解決方案。應用市場部門是指以應用為中心的解決方案，包括使客戶能夠識別、量化和分析物質和產品的物理和生物特性的儀器和軟體。安捷倫 CrossLab 部門涵蓋整個實驗室，除了軟體和實驗室自動化解決方案之外，還提供廣泛的服務和耗材組合。該公司成立於 1999 年 5 月，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Carbon Collective Climate Solutions U.S. Equity ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in U.S.-listed equity securities of companies that, in the Sub-Adviser's opinion, are primarily focused on building solutions to address climate change. It may invest in international companies, including those in emerging markets, through U.S. exchange-tradedADRs, however, they will not be considered U.S. equity securities for purposes of the fund's 80% policy.
info.description_zh: Carbon Collective Climate Solutions 美國股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過主要投資於美國上市公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，副顧問認為這些公司主要致力於建立應對氣候變遷的解決方案。它可以透過美國交易所交易的美國存託憑證投資於國際公司，包括新興市場的公司，但是，就該基金的 80% 政策而言，它們不會被視為美國股票證券。

info.description: SoundThinking, Inc. engages in providing precision-policing and security solutions. It also includes ShotSpotter, SecureCampus, and ShotSpotter SiteSecure solutions. The company was founded by Robert B. Calhoun, Jason Dunham, and Robert Leroy Showen in 1996 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: SoundThinking, Inc. 致力於提供精準警務和安全解決方案。它還包括 ShotSpotter、SecureCampus 和 ShotSpotter SiteSecure 解決方案。該公司由 Robert B. Calhoun、Jason Dunham 和 Robert Leroy Showen 於 1996 年創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Sprott Copper Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Copper Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, and production of copper. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Copper Miners ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和開支先前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott Copper Miners Index 的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自銅礦開採、勘探、開發和生產的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Calamos Global Dynamic Income Fund is a closed ended balanced mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. The fund is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. It invests in public equity and fixed income markets across the globe. The fund seeks to invest in securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. It primarily invests in growth stocks of companies across all market capitalizations, as well as in higher yield corporate bonds, government bonds, convertibles, and alternative investments such as arbitrage and call writes. The fund employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis, focusing on such factors as source, sustainability, and risk of investment opportunities to create its portfolio. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the MSCI World Index and Merrill Lynch Global Broad Markets Index. The fund was formerly known as Calamos Global Diversified Income & Opportunities Fund. Calamos Global Dynamic Income Fund was formed on April 10, 2007 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos 全球動態收入基金是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式平衡共同基金。該基金由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。它投資於全球公共股權和固定收益市場。該基金尋求投資於多元化產業運營的公司的證券。它主要投資於所有市值公司的成長型股票，以及較高收益的公司債、政府公債、可轉換債券以及套利和買權等另類投資。本基金採用基本面分析和定量分析，重點在於投資機會的來源、永續性和風險等因素來創建投資組合。它將其投資組合的表現與摩根士丹利資本國際世界指數和美林全球廣泛市場指數進行比較。該基金以前稱為卡拉莫斯全球多元化收入和機會基金。 Calamos 全球動態收入基金成立於 2007 年 4 月 10 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: Cardio Diagnostics Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of medical diagnostic testing services. It also develops and commercializes a series of products for major types of cardiovascular disease and associated co-morbidities including coronary heart disease (CHD), stroke, heart failure, and diabetes. The company was founded in 2007, and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Cardio Diagnostics Holdings, Inc. 從事提供醫療診斷測試服務。它還開發和商業化一系列針對主要類型心血管疾病和相關併發症的產品，包括冠狀動脈心臟病（CHD）、中風、心臟衰竭和糖尿病。該公司成立於 2007 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company that combines automation, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and in vivo validation capabilities to discover novel medicines. Its Recursion operating system enables advanced machine learning approaches to reveal drug candidates, mechanisms of action, novel chemistry, and potential toxicity, with the eventual goal of decoding biology and advancing new therapeutics that radically improve people's lives. The company was founded by Blake Borgeson, Christopher C. Gibson, and Dean Y. Li on November 4, 2013 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，結合自動化、人工智慧、機器學習和體內驗證能力來發現新藥。其遞歸操作系統使先進的機器學習方法能夠揭示候選藥物、作用機制、新穎的化學物質和潛在的毒性，最終目標是解碼生物學並推進新的治療方法，從根本上改善人們的生活。該公司由 Blake Borgeson、Christopher C. Gibson 和 Dean Y. Li 於 2013 年 11 月 4 日創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Quanterix Corp. engages in the development of ultra-sensitive digital immunoassay platform that advances precision health for life sciences research and diagnostics. Its products and services include Simoa Assay Kits, HD-X analyzer, SR-X Biomarker Detection System, SP-X Imaging and Analysis System, 2470 Arrayer, Simoa Accelerator Laboratory, Uman NF-Light, and Homebrew -Custom Assay Development. The company was founded by Nicholas J. Naclerio and David R. Walt in April 2007 and is headquartered in Billerica, MA.
info.description_zh: Quanterix Corp. 致力於開發超靈敏數位免疫分析平台，促進生命科學研究和診斷的精準健康。其產品和服務包括 Simoa 檢測試劑盒、HD-X 分析儀、SR-X 生物標記檢測系統、SP-X 成像和分析系統、2470 陣列儀、Simoa 加速器實驗室、Uman NF-Light 和 Homebrew - 客製化檢測開發。該公司由 Nicholas J. Naclerio 和 David R. Walt 於 2007 年 4 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州比勒里卡。

info.description: Vulcan Materials Co. engages in the production of construction aggregates. It operates through the following segments: Aggregates, Asphalt, and Concrete. The Aggregates segment produces and sells aggregates and related products and services. The Asphalt segment relates to the production and selling of asphalt mix in Arizona, California, New Mexico, Tennessee, and Texas. The Concrete segment refers to the production and selling of ready-mixed concrete in California, Maryland, and Virginia in addition to the U.S. Virgin Islands and Washington D.C. The company was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Birmingham, AL.
info.description_zh: Vulcan Materials Co. 從事建築骨材生產。它透過以下部分運作：骨料、瀝青和混凝土。骨材部門生產和銷售骨材及相關產品和服務。瀝青部門涉及亞利桑那州、加利福尼亞州、新墨西哥州、田納西州和德克薩斯州的瀝青混合料的生產和銷售。混凝土部門是指在加利福尼亞州、馬裡蘭州和維吉尼亞州以及美屬維京群島和華盛頓特區生產和銷售預拌混凝土。該公司成立於 1909 年，總部位於阿拉巴馬州伯明罕。

info.description: Fidelity Systematic Municipal Bond Index ETF seeks to provide a high current yield exempt from federal income tax. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in municipal securities whose interest is exempt from federal income tax (but may be subject to the federal alternative minimum tax). It normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities included in the Fidelity Systematic U.S. Municipal Bond IndexSM, which aims to increase exposure to municipal bonds with higher risk-adjusted performance and liquidity characteristics relative to traditional market-capitalization weighted U.S. investment grade municipal bond indices.
info.description_zh: 富達系統市政債券指數 ETF 尋求提供免徵聯邦所得稅的高當期收益率。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於市政證券，其利息免徵聯邦所得稅（但可能需繳納聯邦替代性最低稅）。它通常將至少80%的資產投資於富達系統美國市政債券指數SM中包含的證券，該指數旨在增加對相對於傳統市值加權美國投資級市政債券指數具有更高風險調整表現和流動性特徵的市政債券的投資。

info.description: Manhattan Associates, Inc. engages in the business of developing, selling, deploying, servicing, and maintaining software solutions designed to manage supply chains, inventory, and omnichannel operations for retailers, wholesalers, manufacturers, logistics providers, and other organizations. It operates through the following geographical segments: North and Latin America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The company was founded by Deepak Raghavan in October 1990 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: 曼哈頓聯合公司 (Manhattan Associates, Inc.) 從事開發、銷售、部署、服務和維護軟體解決方案的業務，這些解決方案旨在為零售商、批發商、製造商、物流提供者和其他組織管理供應鏈、庫存和全通路營運。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美和拉丁美洲、歐洲、中東、非洲以及亞太地區。該公司由 Deepak Raghavan 於 1990 年 10 月創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Direxion Daily GOOGL Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of Alphabet Inc. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned on an investment by the fund in GOOGL that is equal, on a daily basis, to -100% of the value of the fund's net assets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily GOOGL Bear 1X Shares 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果與 Alphabet Inc. 每日業績相反（或相反）的 100%。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項掉期協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 GOOGL 的投資所賺取的回報，該回報每天等於該基金淨資產價值的 -100%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Barrett Business Services, Inc. engages in the provision of business management solutions for small and mid-sized companies. It develops a management platform that integrates a knowledge-based approach from the management consulting industry with tools from the human resource outsourcing industry. It focuses on professional employers and staffing and recruiting services. The company was founded in July 1965 and is headquartered in Vancouver, WA.
info.description_zh: Barrett Business Services, Inc. 致力於為中小型公司提供業務管理解決方案。它開發了一個管理平台，將管理諮詢行業的知識方法與人力資源外包行業的工具整合在一起。它專注於專業雇主以及人員配備和招聘服務。該公司成立於 1965 年 7 月，總部位於華盛頓州溫哥華。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2035 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2035 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Invesco Indexing LLC compiles and maintains the underlying index. The index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2035. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2035 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2035 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。 Invesco Indexing LLC 嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制和維護基礎指數。該指數旨在衡量 2035 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券投資組合的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Municipal High Income ETF seeks to provide federally tax-exempt income, and its secondary objective will be long-term capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by investing at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in municipal debt securities that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income taxes. Municipal securities are generally issued by or on behalf of states, territories or possessions of the U.S. and the District of Columbia and their political subdivisions, agencies, authorities and other instrumentalities.
info.description_zh: First Trust 市政高收入 ETF 尋求提供聯邦免稅收入，其次要目標是長期資本增值。在正常市場條件下，該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於支付免繳常規聯邦所得稅的利息的市政債務證券來實現其投資目標。市政證券通常由美國各州、領地或領地以及哥倫比亞特區及其政治分區、機構、當局和其他機構發行或代表其發行。

info.description: Victoryshares Small Cap Free Cash Flow ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory U.S. Small Cap Free Cash Flow Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the Index and at least 80% of its assets in equity securities with small market capitalizations. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity securities of U.S. issuers within the Parent Index that have high free cash flow yields.
info.description_zh: Victoryshares 小型股自由現金流 ETF 力求提供在費用和支出之前與 Victory 美國小型股自由現金流指數表現密切相關的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數中的證券以及至少80%的資產投資於小市值的股票證券來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在提供對母指數內具有高自由現金流收益率的美國發行人的股票證券的投資。

info.description: Ishares Copper And Metals Mining ETF seeks to track the investment results of the STOXX Global Copper and Metals Mining Index composed of U.S. and non-U.S. equities of companies primarily engaged in copper and metal ore mining. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Ishares 銅和金屬礦業 ETF 旨在追蹤 STOXX 全球銅和金屬礦業指數的投資結果，該指數由主要從事銅和金屬礦石開採的公司的美國和非美國股票組成。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、期權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fidelity Municipal Bond Opportunities ETF seeks to provide a high current yield exempt from federal income tax; growth of capital may also be considered. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in municipal securities whose interest is exempt from federal income tax. The fund invests up to 30% of assets in lower-quality debt securities (those of less than investment-grade quality, also referred to as high yield debt securities or junk bonds).
info.description_zh: 富達市政債券機會 ETF 尋求提供免徵聯邦所得稅的高當期收益率；資本的成長也可以考慮。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於市政證券，其利息免徵聯邦所得稅。該基金將高達 30% 的資產投資於較低品質的債務證券（低於投資等級品質的債務證券，也稱為高收益債務證券或垃圾債券）。

info.description: Workday, Inc. engages in the provision of development of enterprise cloud applications for finance and human resources. It delivers financial management, human capital management and analytics applications designed for companies, educational institutions, and government agencies. The company was founded by David A. Duffield and Aneel Bhusri in 2005 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, CA.

info.description: First Trust California Municipal High Income ETF seeks to provide current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes and California income taxes, and its secondary objective is long-term capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by investing at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in municipal debt securities that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income taxes and California income taxes. It will invest no more than 50% of its net assets in Municipal Securities that are, at the time of investment, not investment grade, commonly referred to as "high yield" or "junk" bonds.
info.description_zh: First Trust加州市政高收入ETF尋求提供免繳常規聯邦所得稅和加州所得稅的當期收入，其次要目標是長期資本增值。該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於市政債券來實現其投資目標，這些債券支付的利息免徵常規聯邦所得稅和加州所得稅。它將不超過 50% 的淨資產投資於市政證券，這些證券在投資時屬於非投資等級債券，通常被稱為「高收益」或「垃圾」債券。

info.description: First Trust Managed Municipal ETF seeks to generate current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes and its secondary objective is long term capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by investing at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in municipal debt securities that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income taxes.
info.description_zh: First Trust 管理的市政 ETF 尋求產生免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，其次要目標是長期資本增值。在正常市場條件下，該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於支付免繳常規聯邦所得稅的利息的市政債務證券來實現其投資目標。

info.description: ServiceTitan, Inc. engages in the collection of field service activities required to install, maintain, and service the infrastructure and systems of residences and commercial buildings. The company was founded by Ara Mahdessian and Vahe Kuzoyan on June 8, 2008 and is headquartered in Glendale, CA.
info.description_zh: ServiceTitan, Inc. 從事安裝、維護和維修住宅和商業建築的基礎設施和系統所需的現場服務活動。該公司由 Ara Mahdessian 和 Vahe Kuzoyan 於 2008 年 6 月 8 日創立，總部位於加州格倫代爾。

info.description: Vanguard Long-Term Treasury Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted Treasury index with a long-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Long Treasury Index. This index includes fixed income securities issued by the U.S. Treasury (not including inflation-protected bonds, floating rate securities and certain other security types), with maturities greater than 10 years. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard長期公債指數基金ETF份額旨在追蹤具有長期美元加權平均期限的市場加權國債指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國長期國債指數的表現。該指數包括美國財政部發行的期限超過 10 年的固定收益證券（不包括通膨保值債券、浮動利率證券和某些其他證券類型）。一般情況下，基金資產至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。

info.description: Grupo Financiero Galicia SA is a holding company, which engages in banking, insurance, and the issuance of certificates of deposit through its subsidiaries. It operates through the following segments: Banks, Ecosistema Naranja X, Insurance, Other Businesses, and Adjustments. The Banks segment includes the banking business operation results. The Ecosistema Naranja X segment represents the brand credit cards, consumer finance, and digital banking services business. The Insurance segment consists of insurance firms business and Sudamericana Holding SA. The Other Businesses segment refers to equity investments. The Adjustments segment relates to consolidation adjustments and eliminations of transactions among subsidiaries. The company was founded on September 14, 1999 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
info.description_zh: Grupo Financiero Galicia SA 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司從事銀行、保險和存款證發行業務。它透過以下部門運作：銀行部門、Ecosistema Naranja X 部門、保險部門、其他業務部門和調整部門。銀行部門包括銀行業務經營成果。 Ecosistema Naranja X 部門代表品牌信用卡、消費金融和數位銀行服務業務。保險部門由保險公司業務和 Sudamericana Holding SA 組成。其他業務部門是指股權投資。調整部分涉及子公司之間的合併調整和交易抵銷。該公司成立於1999年9月14日，總部位於阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯。

info.description: Definium Therapeutics, Inc. operates as clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing novel product candidates to treat brain health disorders. The company was founded by Stephen L. Hurst, Scott M. Freeman, Leonard Latchman and Jamon Alexander Rahn on July 26, 2010 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Definium Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於開發治療大腦健康疾病的新型候選產品。該公司由 Stephen L. Hurst、Scott M. Freeman、Leonard Latchman 和 Jamon Alexander Rahn 於 2010 年 7 月 26 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Northern Trust Short-Term Tax-Exempt Bond ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the ICE Short Term Focused Municipal Bond Index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of the investment-grade segment of the U.S. municipal bond market with maturities of less than five years as determined by ICE Data Indices, LLC, the index provider. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in debt instruments that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Northern Trust 短期免稅債券 ETF 尋求與 ICE 短期重點市政債券指數的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在衡量由指數提供者 ICE Data Indices, LLC 確定的期限少於五年的美國市政債券市場投資等級部分的表現。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於支付利息且免繳常規聯邦所得稅的債務工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2034 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2034 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2034. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2034 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco Bulletshares 市政債券 2034 指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2034 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券投資組合的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: International Paper Co. engages in the business of producing renewable fiber-based packaging and pulp products. It operates through the following segments: Industrial Packaging, Global Cellulose Fibers, and Corporate and Intersegment. The Industrial Packaging segment is involved in the production of fiber-based packaging that protects and promotes goods, enables worldwide commerce, and helps keep consumers safe. The Global Cellulose Fibers segment offers a wide range of applications like diapers, towel and tissue products, feminine care, incontinence, and other personal care products that promote health and wellness. The company was founded by Hugh J. Chisholm in 1898 and is headquartered in Memphis, TN.
info.description_zh: 國際紙業公司從事生產再生纖維包裝和紙漿產品的業務。它透過以下部門運作：工業包裝部門、全球纖維素纖維部門以及企業和部門間部門。工業包裝部門涉及纖維包裝的生產，以保護和促銷商品，促進全球貿易，並幫助確保消費者安全。全球纖維素纖維領域提供廣泛的應用，如尿布、毛巾和紙巾產品、女性護理、失禁和其他促進健康的個人護理產品。該公司由 Hugh J. Chisholm 於 1898 年創立，總部位於田納西州孟菲斯。

info.description: Invesco Equal Weight 0-30 Year Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the ICE 1-30 Year Laddered Maturity U.S. Treasury Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the components of the index. The index provider compiles, maintains and calculates the underlying index, which is designed to track the performance of up to 30 U.S. Treasury Notes or Bonds representing the annual February maturity ladder across the yield curve.
info.description_zh: Invesco 等權重 0-30 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 1-30 年階梯式到期美國國債指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金一般會將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的成分股。指數提供者編制、維護和計算基礎指數，該指數旨在追蹤最多 30 種美國國債或債券的表現，代表每年 2 月殖利率曲線上的到期階梯。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Multi-Sector Income ETF seeks to provide high income and some capital appreciation. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in fixed income securities. Any derivatives that provide exposure to the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, or to one or more market risk factors associated with the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, are counted (as applicable) toward compliance with the fund's 80% investment policy.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price 多部門收入 ETF 旨在提供高收入和一定的資本增值。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於固定收益證券。任何提供基金名稱所建議的投資重點或與基金名稱所建議的投資重點相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的衍生品，均被計入（如適用）以符合基金的 80% 投資政策。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2032 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2032 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2032 (collectively, "2032 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2032 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2032 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2032 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2032 年債券」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Core Bond ETF seeks to provide total return while generating a moderate level of income. The fund invests in fixed income securities of various maturities, yields, and qualities. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in bonds, which include fixed income securities such as corporate bonds; U.S. Treasury obligations and other U.S. government and agency securities; and asset-backed, mortgage-backed, and mortgage-related securities.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Core Bond ETF 尋求提供總回報，同時產生適度的收入水準。該基金投資於各種期限、收益率和品質的固定收益證券。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的資產投資於債券，其中包括公司債等固定收益證券；美國財政部債務和其他美國政府和機構證券；以及資產支持、抵押貸款支持和抵押相關證券。

info.description: iShares Fallen Angels USD Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg US High Yield Fallen Angel 3% Capped Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, high yield corporate bonds that were previously rated investment grade. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of U.S. dollar denominated, high yield corporate bonds that were previously rated investment grade.
info.description_zh: iShares Fallen Angels 美元債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國高收益 Fallen Angel 3% 上限指數的投資結果，該指數由先前被評為投資等級的以美元計價的高收益公司債券組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。該指數旨在反映先前被評為投資等級的以美元計價的高收益公司債的表現。

info.description: US Treasury 10 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 10-Year US Treasury Index. Under normal market conditions, the Adviser seeks to achieve the investment objective by investing at least 80% of the net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the index. The index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 10-year US Treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國國債 10 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 10 年期美國國債指數的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。在正常市場條件下，顧問力求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於指數的組成證券來實現投資目標。該指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 10 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2034 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2034 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2034. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2034 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2034 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2034 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2030 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2030. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2030.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2030 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2030 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2030 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: FlexShares Credit-Scored US Corporate Bond Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Northern Trust US Corporate Bond IndexSM. The underlying index is designed to reflect the performance of a diversified universe of intermediate maturity, U.S.-dollar denominated bonds of companies with investment grade credit quality, favorable valuations, and enhanced short-term and long-term solvency. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of its index.
info.description_zh: FlexShares 信用評分美國公司債指數基金尋求與 Northern Trust 美國公司債指數 SM 的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在反映具有投資等級信用品質、良好估值以及增強的短期和長期償付能力的公司的多元化中期債券的表現。该基金通常将其总资产的至少80%投资于其指数的证券。

info.description: Diamondback Energy, Inc. is an independent oil and natural gas company, which engages in the acquisition, development, exploration, and exploitation of unconventional, onshore oil, and natural gas reserves. It operates through the Upstream and Midstream Services segments. The Upstream segment focuses on the Permian Basin operations in West Texas. The Midstream Services segment is involved in the Midland and Delaware Basins. The company was founded in December 2007 and is headquartered in Midland, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Diamondback Energy, Inc.是一家獨立的石油和天然氣公司，從事非常規、陸上石油和天然氣儲量的收購、開發、勘探和開採。它透過上游和中游服務部門運作。上游部門專注於德克薩斯州西部的二疊紀盆地業務。中游服務部門涉及米德蘭和特拉華盆地。該公司成立於2007年12月，總部位於德克薩斯州米德蘭。

info.description: Fastenal Co. engages in the distribution of fasteners and tools. It also operates hardware stores. The company was founded by Robert A. Kierlin, Michael M. Gostomski, Henry K. McConnon, John D. Remick, and Stephen M. Slaggie in November 1967 and is headquartered in Winona, MN.
info.description_zh: Fastenal Co. 從事緊固件和工具的分銷。它還經營五金店。該公司由 Robert A. Kierlin、Michael M. Gostomski、Henry K. McConnon、John D. Remick 和 Stephen M. Slaggie 於 1967 年 11 月創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州威諾納。

info.description: Eaton Corp. Plc is a power management company, which provides energy-efficient solutions for electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical power. It operates through the following segments: Electrical Americas and Electrical Global; Aerospace, Vehicle, and eMobility. The Electrical Americas and Electrical Global segments engage in sales contracts for electrical components, industrial components, power distribution and assemblies, residential products, single and three phase power quality, wiring devices, circuit protection, utility power distribution, power reliability equipment, and service. The Aerospace segment supplies aerospace fuel, hydraulics, and pneumatic systems for commercial and military use. The Vehicle segment deals with the design, manufacture, marketing, and supply of drivetrain and powertrain systems and critical components that reduce emissions and improve fuel economy, stability, performance and safety of cars, light trucks and commercial vehicles. The eMobility segment designs, manufactures, markets, and supplies electrical and electronic components and systems that improve the power management and performance of both on-road and off-road vehicles. The company was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: 伊頓公司是一家電力管理公司，為電力、液壓和機械動力提供節能解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：Electrical Americas 和 Electrical Global；航空航太、車輛和電動車。 Electrical Americas 和 Electrical Global 部門從事電氣元件、工業元件、配電和組件、住宅產品、單相和三相電能品質、接線設備、電路保護、公用配電、電力可靠性設備和服務的銷售合約。航空航太部門提供商業和軍事用途的航空燃料、液壓和氣動系統。車輛部門從事傳動系統和動力系統以及關鍵部件的設計、製造、行銷和供應，以減少排放並提高轎車、輕型卡車和商用車的燃油經濟性、穩定性、性能和安全性。電動交通部門設計、製造、行銷和供應電氣和電子元件及系統，以改善公路和越野車輛的電源管理和性能。該公司成立於1911年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. is a natural resource-based building materials company, which engages in the provision of aggregates including crushed stone, sand, and gravel through its network of quarries and distribution yards. It operates through the East Group and West Group segments. The East Group segment offers aggregates and asphalt products. The West Group segment focuses on aggregates, cement, downstream products, and paving services. The company was founded on November 12, 1993 and is headquartered in Raleigh, NC.
info.description_zh: Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. 是一家以自然資源為基礎的建築材料公司，透過其採石場和配送場網路提供碎石、沙子和礫石等骨材。它透過東集團和西集團部門運作。 East Group 部門提供骨材和瀝青產品。西部集團部門專注於骨材、水泥、下游產品和鋪路服務。該公司成立於1993年11月12日，總部位於北卡羅來納州羅利。

info.description: Adeia, Inc. is a technology company, which engages in the invention, development, and licensing of innovations and technologies for entertainment, media, consumer electronics, and semiconductor industries. It operates through the following geographical segments: U.S., Asia, Canada, Europe and Middle East, and Other. The company was founded on October 1, 2022 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.

info.description_zh: Adeia, Inc. 是一家科技公司，致力於娛樂、媒體、消費性電子和半導體產業的創新和技術的發明、開發和授權。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、亞洲、加拿大、歐洲和中東等。該公司成立於2022年10月1日，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Aldeyra Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in research and development activities related to general business planning, including raising capital. It focuses on the discovery of therapies designed to treat immune-mediated diseases. The company was founded by Thomas A. Jordan and John E. Dowling on August 13, 2004 and is headquartered in Lexington, MA.
info.description_zh: Aldeyra Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生技公司，從事與一般業務規劃相關的研發活動，包括募款。它專注於發現旨在治療免疫介導疾病的療法。該公司由 Thomas A. Jordan 和 John E. Dowling 於 2004 年 8 月 13 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州列剋星敦。

info.description: Direxion Daily AMZN Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of Amazon.com, Inc. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned on an investment by the fund in AMZN that is equal, on a daily basis, to -100% of the value of the fund's net assets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AMZN Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 Amazon.com, Inc. 每日業績相反（或相反）100% 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金將與主要全球金融機構簽訂一項或多項掉期協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 AMZN 的投資所賺取的回報，該回報每天等於該基金淨資產價值的 -100%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Big Digital Energy, Inc. engages in the provision of digital asset infrastructure services. The company was founded on February 10, 2012 and is headquartered in Midland, PA.
info.description_zh: Big Digital Energy, Inc.從事提供數位資產基礎設施服務。該公司成立於2012年2月10日，總部位於賓州米德蘭市。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2035 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2035 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2035. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2035 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2035 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2035 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 1x Short COIN Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of -1 time (-100%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Coinbase Global, Inc. Class A (NASDAQ: COIN). The fund manager will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned or realized on the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 1x Short COIN Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 Coinbase Global, Inc. A 類普通股（納斯達克股票代碼：COIN）每日百分比變化的 -1 倍（-100%）。基金管理人將與主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，基金和金融機構同意交換標的股票賺取或實現的回報。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Elicio Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of cancer immunotherapies. It focuses on its Amphiphile platform for trafficking lymph nodes. The company was founded by Darrell Irvine in August 2011 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Elicio Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，從事癌症免疫療法的開發。它專注於其用於運輸淋巴結的 Aphiphile 平台。該公司由 Darrell Irvine 於 2011 年 8 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: G-III Apparel Group Ltd. engages in the designing, sourcing, and marketing of women's apparel. The firm's product range includes outerwear, dresses, sportswear, swimwear, women's suits and performance wear, as well as handbags, footwear, small leather goods, cold weather accessories, and luggage. It operates through the Wholesale Operations and Retail segments. The Wholesale Operations segment includes sales of products under the company's owned, licensed, and private label brands, as well as sales related to the Vilebrequin business and Karl Lagerfeld businesses. The Retail segment consists primarily of direct sales to consumers through company-operated stores, DKNY and Karl Lagerfeld Paris stores, as well as the digital channels for DKNY, Donna Karan, Karl Lagerfeld Paris, G.H Bass, Andrew Marc, and Wilsons Leather. The company was founded by Aron Goldfarb in 1956 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: G-III Apparel Group Ltd. 從事女裝的設計、採購和行銷。該公司的產品範圍包括外套、洋裝、運動服、泳裝、女裝和功能性服裝，以及手袋、鞋類、小皮具、寒冷天氣配件和行李箱。它透過批發業務和零售部門運作。批發營運部門包括公司自有品牌、授權品牌和自有品牌品牌產品的銷售，以及與 Vilebrequin 業務和 Karl Lagerfeld 業務相關的銷售。零售部門主要包括透過公司自營商店、DKNY 和 Karl Lagerfeld Paris 商店以及 DKNY、Donna Karan、Karl Lagerfeld Paris、G.H Bass、Andrew Marc 和 Wilsons Leather 的數位管道直接向消費者銷售。該公司由 Aron Goldfarb 於 1956 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: MiniMed Group, Inc. engages in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of a wide range of medical devices and solutions for diabetes management. Its offerings include insulin pumps, continuous glucose monitoring systems, infusion sets, software platforms, and related accessories that help patients and healthcare providers effectively monitor and control blood glucose levels. The company was founded by Alfred E. Mann in 1983 and is headquartered in Northridge, CA.
info.description_zh: MiniMed Group, Inc. 從事各種糖尿病管理醫療設備和解決方案的開發、製造和行銷。其產品包括胰島素幫浦、連續血糖監測系統、輸液器、軟體平台和相關配件，幫助患者和醫療保健提供者有效監測和控制血糖水平。該公司由 Alfred E. Mann 於 1983 年創立，總部位於加州北嶺。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2026 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM") invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2026, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2026 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資，其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金主要投資於 2026 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pacific Biosciences of California, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of advanced sequencing solutions for genetic analysis. It operates through the following geographical segments: America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The company was founded by Stephen Turner and Joseph Vincent Bonventre on July 14, 2000 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Pacific Biosciences of California, Inc. 從事遺傳分析的先進定序解決方案的開發、製造和行銷。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東、非洲以及亞太地區。該公司由 Stephen Turner 和 Joseph Vincent Bonventre 於 2000 年 7 月 14 日創立，總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Real Estate, Residential Real Estate, Commercial and Industrial, and Consumer. The Commercial Estate segment is involved in construction, non-residential, and multi-family. The Residential Real Estate Segment focuses on borrower's residential real estate generally in a first lien position. The Commercial and Industrial segment includes loans made for purposes of financing the activities of commercial customers. The Consumer segment engages in indirect automobile loans, home equity loans, and other consumer loans. The company was founded on August 30, 2018 and is headquartered in Poughkeepsie, NY.
info.description_zh: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. 作為一家銀行控股公司運營，提供銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業房地產、住宅房地產、商業和工業以及消費者。商業地產部門涉及建築、非住宅和多戶住宅。住宅房地產部分主要關注借款人的住宅房地產，通常處於第一留置權位置。商業和工業部門包括為商業客戶活動融資而發放的貸款。消費者部門從事間接汽車貸款、房屋淨值貸款和其他消費貸款。該公司成立於2018年8月30日，總部位於紐約州波基普西。

info.description: Sterling Infrastructure, Inc. engages in the provision of construction solutions. It operates through the following segments: Transportation Solutions, E-Infrastructure Solutions, and Building Solutions. The Transportation Solutions segment includes infrastructure and rehabilitation projects for highways, roads, bridges, airports, ports, light rail, water, wastewater, and storm drainage systems. The E-Infrastructure Solutions projects develop advanced, large-scale site development systems and services for data centers, e-commerce distribution centers, warehousing, transportation, energy, and more. The Building Solutions segment projects include residential and commercial concrete foundations for single-family and multi-family homes, parking structures, elevated slabs, and other concrete work. The company was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in The Woodlands, TX.
info.description_zh: Sterling Infrastructure, Inc. 從事提供建築解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：運輸解決方案、電子基礎設施解決方案和建築解決方案。交通解決方案部門包括高速公路、道路、橋樑、機場、港口、輕軌、水、廢水和暴雨排水系統的基礎設施和修復項目。電子基礎設施解決方案專案為資料中心、電子商務配送中心、倉儲、運輸、能源等開發先進的大型站點開發系統和服務。建築解決方案部門專案包括單戶和多戶住宅的住宅和商業混凝土基礎、停車場結構、高架板和其他混凝土工程。該公司成立於 1955 年，總部位於德克薩斯州伍德蘭茲。

info.description: WeRide, Inc. operates as an investment holding company. It engages in the sale of autonomous driving vehicles, primarily including robobuses, robotaxis, robosweepers and related sensor suites. The company was founded by Tony Xu Han and Yan Li in February 2017 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 文遠知行文遠知行以投資控股公司經營。它從事自動駕駛車輛的銷售，主要包括機器人公車、機器人計程車、機器人掃地機和相關感測器套件。該公司由Tony Xu Han和Yan Li於2017年2月創立，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: Wisdomtree Bianco Fixed Income Total Return Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bianco Research Fixed Income Total Return Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund primarily invests in the constituent exchange-traded funds ("ETF") of the index. The index, created by Bianco Research Advisors LLC, is composed of approximately 5 to 20 fixed income ETFs that are specifically selected and weighted using a modified market-capitalization weighting scheme to achieve specified factor exposures.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree Bianco 固定收益總回報基金旨在追蹤 Bianco Research 固定收益總回報指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。一般情況下，基金主要投資於指數成分股ETF（ETF）。該指數由 Bianco Research Advisors LLC 創建，由大約 5 至 20 個固定收益 ETF 組成，這些 ETF 是專門選擇的，並使用修改後的市值加權方案進行加權，以實現指定的因子暴露。

info.description: SanJac Alpha Low Duration ETF seeks current income consistent with preservation of capital and daily liquidity. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by principally investing in short-term, investment-grade debt instruments. It seeks to typically maintain an average portfolio duration of less than two years. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SanJac Alpha 低久期 ETF 尋求與保留資本和日常流動性一致的當前收入。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過主要投資於短期投資等級債務工具來實現其投資目標。它通常尋求將平均投資組合久期維持在兩年以下。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Eaton Vance Short Duration Income ETF seeks above-average total return over a market cycle of three to five years. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by primarily investing in a diversified portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated fixed income securities of varying maturities consistent with ordinarily seeking to maintain an average duration of approximately three years or less. The fund invests primarily in U.S. government securities, corporate bonds and mortgage- and asset-backed securities.
info.description_zh: 伊頓萬斯短期收益 ETF 尋求在三到五年的市場週期內高於平均的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過主要投資於不同期限的以美元計價的固定收益證券的多元化投資組合來實現其投資目標，並通常尋求保持約三年或更短的平均久期。該基金主要投資於美國政府證券、公司債以及抵押貸款和資產支持證券。

info.description: Honeytree U.S. Equity ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation achieved primarily through investing in responsibly growing companies. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") sub-advised by Honeytree Investment Management Ltd. (the "Sub-Adviser"). The fund does not seek to replicate the performance of a specified index. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes in a concentrated portfolio of large-cap and mid-cap U.S. listed equity stocks.
info.description_zh: Honeytree 美國股票 ETF 尋求主要透過投資負責任成長的公司來實現資本增值。該基金為一檔主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），由 Honeytree Investment Management Ltd.（「副顧問」）提供次級顧問服務。該基金並未尋求複製特定指數的表現。該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於美國上市大盤股和中盤股的集中投資組合來實現其投資目標。

info.description: iShares 1-5 Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE BofA 1-5 Year US Corporate Index.
