The index measures the performance of investment-grade corporate bonds of both U.S. and non-U.S. issuers that are U.S. dollar-denominated and publicly issued in the U.S. domestic market and have a remaining maturity of greater than or equal to one year and less than five years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares 1-5 年投資等級企業債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE BofA 1-5 年期美國企業指數的投資結果。該指數衡量美國和非美國發行人以美元計價並在美國國內市場公開發行、剩餘期限大於或等於一年且少於五年的投資等級公司債的表現。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於該基金跟踪該指數的標的指數中包含的固定收益證券類型。

info.description: iShares 0-5 Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Markit iBoxx USD Liquid Investment Grade 0-5 Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds with remaining maturities of less than five years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade corporate debt.
info.description_zh: iShares 0-5 年投資等級公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤 Markit iBoxx 美元流動投資等級 0-5 指數的投資結果，該指數由以美元計價、剩餘期限少於五年的投資等級公司債組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。该指数旨在反映以美元计价的投资级公司债务的表现。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2029 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2029. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2029.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2029 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2029 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2029 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2029 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2029, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2029 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2029年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BNY Mellon Municipal Opportunities ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks to maximize total return through high current income exempt from federal income tax and capital appreciation. The strategy utilizes fundamental credit research to identify undervalued sectors and securities within the municipal market, maintaining the flexibility to invest across all maturities and credit qualities.
info.description_zh: 紐約梅隆市政機會 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，旨在透過免除聯邦所得稅和資本增值的高流動收入來最大化總回報。該策略利用基礎信用研究來識別市政市場內被低估的行業和證券，保持在所有期限和信用品質下進行投資的靈活性。

info.description: iShares 1-3 Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 1-3 Year Bond Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity of greater than or equal to one year and less than three years.
info.description_zh: iShares 1-3 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國 1-3 年期公債指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的成分證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於基金追蹤基礎指數的美國國債。該指數衡量美國財政部剩餘期限大於或等於一年且小於三年的公共債務的履行。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2030 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2030, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2030 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2030年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Short-Term Corporate Bond Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted corporate bond index with a short-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. 1-5 Year Corporate Bond Index. This index includes U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade, fixed-rate, taxable securities issued by U.S. and non-U.S. industrial, utility, and financial companies, with maturities between 1 and 5 years. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard 短期公司債指數基金 ETF 股票旨在追蹤具有短期美元加權平均期限的市場加權公司債指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國1-5年期公司債指數的表現。該指數包括由美國和非美國工業、公用事業和金融公司發行的以美元計價、投資等級、固定利率、應稅證券，期限為 1 至 5 年。一般情況下，基金資產至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。

info.description: Vanguard Total Bond Market Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Float Adjusted Index. This index measures the performance of a wide spectrum of public, investment-grade, taxable, fixed income securities in the United States-including government, corporate, and international dollar-denominated bonds, as well as mortgage-backed and asset-backed securities-all with maturities of more than 1 year. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and at least 80% of its assets will be invested in bonds held in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total Bond Market Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤彭博美國總流通量調整指數的表現。 This index measures the performance of a wide spectrum of public, investment-grade, taxable, fixed income securities in the United States-including government, corporate, and international dollar-denominated bonds, Y 1 year. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and at least 80% of its assets will be invested in bonds held in the index.

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2030 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2030. It does not purchase all of the securities in the index; instead, the fund utilizes a "sampling" methodology to seek to achieve its investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2030 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2030 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。它不會購買指數中的所有證券；相反，該基金採用"抽樣"方法來尋求實現其投資目標。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2030 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2030 (collectively, "2030 Bonds"). It does not purchase all of the securities in the index; instead, the fund utilizes a "sampling" methodology to seek to achieve its investment objective.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2030 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2030 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2030 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2030 年債券」）。它不購買指數中的所有證券；相反，該基金採用"抽樣"方法來尋求實現其投資目標。

info.description: Vanguard Intermediate-Term Corporate Bond Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted corporate bond index with an intermediate-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. 5-10 Year Corporate Bond Index. This index includes U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade, fixed-rate, taxable securities issued by U.S. and non-U.S. industrial, utility, and financial companies, with maturities between 5 and 10 years. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard 中期公司債指數基金 ETF 股票旨在追蹤具有中期美元加權平均期限的市場加權公司債券指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國5-10年期公司債指數的表現。該指數包括由美國和非美國工業、公用事業和金融公司發行的以美元計價、投資等級、固定利率、應稅證券，期限為 5 至 10 年。一般情況下，基金資產至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。

info.description: iShares USD Green Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg MSCI USD Green Bond Select Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade green bonds that are issued by U.S. and non-U.S. issuers to fund environmental projects. The fund seeks to track the investment results of the underlying index, which measures the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade green bonds issued by U.S. and non-U.S. issuers to fund projects with direct environmental benefits.
info.description_zh: iShares 美元綠色債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博 MSCI 美元綠色債券精選指數的投資結果，該指數由美國和非美國發行人發行的以美元計價的投資級綠色債券組成，為環保項目提供資金。該基金旨在追蹤基礎指數的投資結果，該指數衡量美國和非美國發行人為資助具有直接環境效益的項目而發行的以美元計價的投資級綠色債券的表現。

info.description: NEOS Enhanced Income Credit Select ETF seeks total return from income and capital appreciation while providing a tax efficient monthly income. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing 80% or more of its net assets in bonds or ETFs that invest 80% or more of their assets in bonds and selling and purchasing S&P 500 Index put options to generate income to the fund beyond what is received from the underlying investments.
info.description_zh: NEOS 增強型收入信用精選 ETF 尋求收入和資本增值的總回報，同時提供節稅的月收入。該基金是主動式管理 ETF，旨在透過將 80% 或以上的淨資產投資於債券或將 80% 或以上的資產投資於債券的 ETF，以及買賣標普 500 指數看跌期權，為基金帶來超出基礎投資收益的收入，從而實現其投資目標。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2032 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2032 Maturity US Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2032. The index is market value-weighted based on amounts outstanding reduced by amounts held by the Federal Reserve SOMA. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the index, in each case except during the last months of the fund's operations.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2032 定期國債 ETF 旨在追蹤由 2032 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2032 年期美國國債指數的投資結果。該指數根據未償付金額減去聯準會 SOMA 持有的金額進行市值加權。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於該基金跟踪該指數的美國國債，在每種情況下，基金運營的最後幾個月除外。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2033 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2033 Maturity US Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2033. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index, in each case except during the last months of the fund's operations.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2033 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤由 2033 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2033 Maturity US Treasury Index 的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於基金追蹤基礎指數的美國國債，在每種情況下，除了在基金運作的最後幾個月。

info.description: iShares 5-10 Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE BofA 5-10 Year US Corporate Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that BFA believes will help the fund track the index. The fund will invest no more than 10% of its assets in futures, options and swaps contracts that BFA believes will help the fund track the index as well as in fixed income securities other than the types included in the index, but which BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares 5-10 年投資等級公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE BofA 5-10 年美國公司指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於基金追蹤該指數的基礎指數中包含的固定收益證券類型。該基金將不超過 10% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於該基金追蹤指數的期貨、選擇權和掉期合約，以及除指數中包含的類型之外的固定收益證券，但 BFA 認為這將有助於該基金追蹤該指數。

info.description: PIMCO Mortgage-Backed Securities Active Exchange-Traded Fund seeks maximum total return, consistent with preservation of capital and prudent investment management. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing under normal circumstances at least 80% of its assets in a diversified portfolio of mortgage-related fixed income instruments of varying maturities, which may be represented by forwards or derivatives such as options, futures contracts or swap agreements.
info.description_zh: PIMCO 抵押貸款支援證券活躍交易所交易基金尋求最大總回報，與資本保全和審慎投資管理一致。該基金尋求透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的資產投資於不同期限的抵押貸款相關固定收益工具的多元化投資組合來實現其投資目標，這些投資組合可能以遠期或衍生性商品（如選擇權、期貨合約或掉期協議）為代表。

info.description: Vanguard Intermediate-Term Treasury Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted Treasury index with an intermediate-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Treasury 3-10 Year Index. This index includes fixed income securities issued by the U.S. Treasury (not including inflation-protected bonds, floating rate securities and certain other security types), with maturities between 3 and 10 years. At least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard 中期國債指數基金 ETF 股票旨在追蹤具有中期美元加權平均期限的市場加權國債指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國國債 3-10 年指數的表現。該指數包括美國財政部發行的固定收益證券（不包括通膨保值債券、浮動利率證券和某些其他證券類型），期限在 3 年至 10 年之間。該基金至少80%的資產將投資於該指數所包含的債券。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2031 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2031 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2031 (collectively, "2031 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2031 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2031 Index（「基本指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2031 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）（統稱為「2031 年債券」）的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2034 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results the of ICE 2034 Maturity US Treasury Index. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2034 and December 15, 2034, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2034 定期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 2034 年到期美國公債指數的投資結果。該基金通常透過投資於滿足指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由計劃於 2034 年 1 月 1 日至 2034 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。

info.description: Vanguard Mortgage-Backed Securities Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted mortgage-backed securities index. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. MBS Float Adjusted Index. This index covers U.S. agency mortgage-backed pass-through securities issued by the GNMA, the FNMA, and the FHLMC. To be included in the index, pool aggregates must have at least $1 billion currently outstanding and a weighted average maturity of at least 1 year. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard 抵押貸款支持證券指數基金 ETF 股票旨在追蹤市場加權抵押貸款支持證券指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國MBS浮動調整指數的表現。該指數涵蓋 GNMA、FNMA 和 FHLMC 發行的美國機構抵押貸款支持傳遞證券。要納入該指數，資金池總計必須擁有至少 10 億美元的當前未償還資金，且加權平均期限至少為 1 年。基金的所有投資將透過抽樣過程進行篩選，基金資產的至少80%將投資於指數納入的債券。

info.description: iShares 7-10 Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 7-10 Year Bond Index. The underlying index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity of greater than or equal to seven years and less than ten years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that the advisor believes will help the fund track the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares 7-10 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國公債 7-10 年期債券指數的投資結果。該指數衡量美國財政部剩餘期限大於或等於七年且小於十年的公共債務的履行。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於顧問認為將有助於基金追蹤標的指數的美國國債。

info.description: National Security Emerging Markets Index ETF seeks to track the results, before fees and expenses, of the Alerian National Security Emerging Markets Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index. The index consists of stocks listed on globally recognized stock exchanges that excludes companies benefiting end-users that, in the view of the sponsor of the fund, National Security Index, LLC (the "Sponsor") pose a threat to the national security interests of the United States.
info.description_zh: 國家安全新興市場指數 ETF 旨在追蹤 Alerian 國家安全新興市場指數（未計費用和開支）的結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於該指數的組成證券。該指數由在全球公認的證券交易所上市的股票組成，不包括使最終用戶受益的公司，該基金的發起人 National Security Index, LLC（「發起人」）認為這些公司對美國的國家安全利益構成威脅。

info.description: iShares 3-7 Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 3-7 Year Bond Index (the "underlying index"). The index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity of greater than or equal to three years and less than seven years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares 3-7 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國 3-7 年期公債指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該指數衡量美國財政部剩餘期限大於或等於三年且小於七年的公共債務的履行。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於該指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少90%的資產投資於BFA認為將有助於該基金追蹤該指數的美國國債。

info.description: IPG Photonics Corp. engages in the provision of design, development, production and distribution of fiber lasers, laser systems, fiber amplifiers, and related optical components. Its products include lasers, beam delivery, medical, telecom equipment, product finder and components such as pump diodes, chillers, and mid-IR crystals. The company was founded by Valentin P. Gapontsev and Igor Samartsev in 1990 and is headquartered in Marlborough, MA.
info.description_zh: IPG Photonics Corp. 從事光纖雷射、雷射系統、光纖放大器和相關光學元件的設計、開發、生產和分銷。其產品包括雷射、光束傳輸、醫療、電信設備、產品查找器以及泵浦二極體、冷卻器和中紅外線晶體等組件。該公司由 Valentin P. Gapontsev 和 Igor Samartsev 於 1990 年創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州馬爾伯勒。

info.description: iShares MBS ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg U.S. MBS Index composed of investment-grade mortgage-backed pass-through securities issued and/or guaranteed by U.S. government agencies. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and TBAs that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares MBS ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國 MBS 指數的投資結果，該指數由美國政府機構發行和/或擔保的投資等級抵押貸款支持傳遞證券組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及經濟特徵與該指數組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的 TBA，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於基金跟踪該指數的標的指數中包含的固定收益證券類型。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2032 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2032 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the index. The index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2032. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2032 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2032 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2032 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。該指數是非多元化的。

info.description: Weyerhaeuser Co. engages in the manufacture, distribution, and sale of forest products. It operates through the following segments: Timberlands, Real Estate, Energy, and Natural Resources (Real Estate and ENR), and Wood Products. The Timberlands segment manages private commercial forestland worldwide and engages in growing and harvesting trees for lumber, building, pulp, paper, and other wood products. The Real Estate and ENR segment delivers premiums to timber value by identifying and monetizing higher and better use of lands and capturing the full value of surface and subsurface assets. The Wood Products segment delivers lumber, structural panels, engineered wood products and complementary building products for residential, multi-family, industrial, and light commercial applications. The company was founded by Frederick T. Weyerhaeuser on January 18, 1900 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Weyerhaeuser Co. 從事林產品的製造、分銷和銷售。該公司透過以下部門運作：Timberlands、房地產、能源和自然資源（房地產和 ENR）以及木製品部門。 Timberlands 部門管理全球私人商業林地，並從事種植和採伐樹木以獲取木材、建築、紙漿、紙張和其他木製品。房地產和 ENR 部門透過識別和貨幣化更高更好的土地利用以及獲取地表和地下資產的全部價值，為木材價值提供溢價。木製品部門為住宅、多戶住宅、工業和輕型商業應用提供木材、結構板、工程木製品和補充建築產品。該公司由 Frederick T. Weyerhaeuser 於 1900 年 1 月 18 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Dollar Tree, Inc. owns and operates discount variety stores offering merchandise at fixed prices. It operates through the Dollar Tree business segment. The Dollar Tree segment includes operations under Dollar Tree and Dollar Tree Canada brands, with its distribution centers in the United States and Canada. The company was founded by J. Douglas Perry and Macon F. Brock, Jr. in 1953 and is headquartered in Chesapeake, VA.
info.description_zh: Dollar Tree, Inc. 擁有並經營以固定價格提供商品的折扣雜貨店。它透過 Dollar Tree 業務部門運作。 Dollar Tree 部門包括 Dollar Tree 和 Dollar Tree Canada 品牌下的業務，其配送中心位於美國和加拿大。該公司由 J. Douglas Perry 和 Macon F. Brock, Jr. 於 1953 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州切薩皮克。

info.description: United Bancorp, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and retail banking. It provides accepting demand, savings and time deposits and granting commercial, real estate, and consumer loans. The company was founded on July 8, 1983 and is headquartered in Martins Ferry, OH.
info.description_zh: United Bancorp, Inc. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事商業和零售銀行業務。它提供接受活期存款、儲蓄存款和定期存款，並發放商業、房地產和消費貸款。該公司成立於 1983 年 7 月 8 日，總部位於俄亥俄州馬丁斯費裡。

info.description: First Trust Mid Cap Value AlphaDEX Fund seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Mid Cap Value Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select value stocks from the NASDAQ US 600 Mid Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 中型價值 AlphaDEX 基金尋求與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 中型價值指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 600 中型股指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇價值股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: Apogee Enterprises, Inc. engages in the design and development of architectural products and services. It also provides architectural glass, aluminum framing systems, and installation services for buildings, as well as value-added glazing products for custom picture framing. The firm operates through the following segments: Architectural Metals, Architectural Glass, Architectural Services, and Performance Surfaces. The Architectural Metals segment designs, engineers, fabricates and finishes aluminum window, curtainwall, storefront and entrance systems comprising the exterior of buildings. The Architectural Glass segment fabricates coated glass used in custom window and wall systems. The Architectural Services segment integrates technical services, project management, and field installation services to design, engineer, fabricate, and install building glass and curtainwall systems. The Performance Surfaces segment develops and manufactures coated materials for a variety of applications. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: Apogee Enterprises, Inc. 從事建築產品和服務的設計和開發。它還提供建築玻璃、鋁框架系統和建築物安裝服務，以及用於客製化畫框的增值玻璃產品。該公司透過以下部門運作：建築金屬、建築玻璃、建築服務和性能表面。建築金屬部門設計、工程、製造和裝飾鋁窗、帷幕牆、店面和入口系統，包括建築物的外部。建築玻璃部門製造用於定制窗戶和牆壁系統的鍍膜玻璃。建築服務部門整合了技術服務、專案管理和現場安裝服務，以設計、工程、製造和安裝建築玻璃和帷幕牆系統。高性能表面部門開發和製造適用於各種應用的塗層材料。該公司成立於 1949 年，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: Applied Finance IVS US SMID ETF seeks long term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities of U.S. small to mid ("SMID") capitalization companies. The fund is actively managed and does not seek to replicate an index. The Adviser anticipates generally holding at least 150 different positions in the fund's portfolio. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Applied Finance IVS US SMID ETF 尋求長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於美國中小型（「SMID」）資本公司的股本證券。該基金採用主動管理方式，不尋求複製指數。顧問預計通常在基金投資組合中持有至少 150 個不同的部位。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VictoryShares International Value Momentum ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Nasdaq Victory International Value Momentum Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index, depositary receipts on securities in the index and securities underlying depositary receipts in the index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity market performance in non-U.S. developed markets and provide higher exposure to value and momentum factors within the parent index while also maintaining moderate Index turnover and lower realized volatility than traditional capitalization weighted indexes.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares 國際價值動量 ETF 力求提供在費用和支出之前與納斯達克勝利國際價值動量指數表現密切相關的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數中的證券、指數中證券的存託憑證以及指數中存託憑證的相關證券。該指數旨在提供對非美國已開發市場股票市場表現的曝險，並提供對母指數內更高的價值和動量因素的曝險，同時保持適度的指數換手率和比傳統資本加權指數更低的實際波動性。

info.description: TKO Group Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of sports and entertainment. It operates through the following segments: Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE), and IMG. The UFC segment refers to a global sports brand and media content company. The WWE segment is involved in media organizations and global leaders in sports entertainment. The IMG segment manages the operations of the IMG business and on location. The company was founded on March 29, 2023 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: TKO Group Holdings, Inc. 從事提供體育和娛樂業務。它透過以下部門運作：終極格鬥錦標賽 (UFC)、世界摔角娛樂 (WWE) 和 IMG。 UFC 部門是指一家全球運動品牌和媒體內容公司。 WWE 部門涉及媒體組織和體育娛樂的全球領導者。 IMG 部門管理 IMG 業務和現場營運。該公司成立於2023年3月29日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: NVR, Inc. engages in the construction and sale of single-family detached homes, townhomes, and condominium buildings. It operates through the following geographical segments: Mid Atlantic, North East, Mid East, and South East. The Mid Atlantic segment includes Maryland, Virginia, West Virginia, Delaware, and Washington, D.C. The North East segment pertains to New Jersey and Eastern Pennsylvania. The Mid East segment refers to New York, Ohio, Western Pennsylvania, Indiana, and Illinois. The South East segment consists of North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Florida, Georgia, and Kentucky. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: NVR, Inc. 從事單戶獨立住宅、連棟房屋和公寓大樓的建設和銷售。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：大西洋中部、東北部、中東和東南部。大西洋中部航段包括馬裡蘭州、維吉尼亞州、西維吉尼亞州、德拉瓦州和華盛頓特區。東北航段涉及新澤西州和賓夕法尼亞州東部。中東部分是指紐約州、俄亥俄州、賓州西部、印第安納州和伊利諾州。東南部部分包括北卡羅來納州、南卡羅來納州、田納西州、佛羅裡達州、喬治亞州和肯塔基州。該公司成立於 1980 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: Citigroup, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial products and services. It operates through the following segments: Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth, U.S. Personal Banking (USPB), and All Other. The Services segment includes Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) which provides an integrated suite of tailored cash management, trade, and working capital solutions to multinational corporations, financial institutions and public sector organizations, and Securities Services, which offers cross-border support for clients, providing on-the-ground local market expertise, post-trade technologies, customized data solutions, and a wide range of securities services solutions that can be tailored to meet client needs. The Markets segment provides corporate, institutional, and public sector clients around the world with a full range of sales and trading services across equities, foreign exchange, rates, spread products, and commodities. The Banking segment offers Investment Banking and Corporate Lending services. The Wealth segment includes Private Bank, Wealth at Work, and Citigold and provides financial services to a range of client segments through banking, lending, mortgages, investment, custody, and trust product offerings. The USPB segment includes Branded Cards and Retail Services, which have proprietary card portfolios and co-branded card portfolios within Branded Cards, and co-brand and private label relationships within Retail Services. The All Other segment consists of activities not assigned to the reportable operating segments, including certain unallocated costs of global functions, other corporate expenses, and net treasury results. The company was founded in 1812 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 花旗集團是一家控股公司，從事提供金融產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：服務部門、市場部門、銀行部門、財富部門、美國個人銀行部門 (USPB) 和所有其他部門。服務部門包括資金和貿易解決方案（TTS），為跨國公司、金融機構和公共部門組織提供一整套量身定制的現金管理、貿易和營運資金解決方案；以及證券服務，為客戶提供跨境支持，提供實地本地市場專業知識、交易後技術、定制數據解決方案以及可根據客戶需求定制的廣泛證券服務解決方案。市場部門為世界各地的企業、機構和公共部門客戶提供涵蓋股票、外匯、利率、價差產品和大宗商品的全方位銷售和交易服務。銀行部門提供投資銀行和企業貸款服務。財富部門包括私人銀行、Wealth at Work 和 Citigold，透過銀行、貸款、抵押貸款、投資、託管和信託產品向一系列客戶群提供金融服務。 USPB 部門包括品牌卡和零售服務，其中在品牌卡內擁有專有卡組合和聯合品牌卡組合，以及零售服務內的聯合品牌和自有品牌關係。所有其他部門由未分配給可報告經營部門的活動組成，包括全球職能的某些未分配成本、其他公司費用和淨財務表現。該公司成立於 1812 年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: The BeeHive ETF seeks capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund primarily invests in equity securities of domestic companies with large and mid-sized market capitalizations. Equity securities in which the fund invests on a principal basis include common stock and sponsored and unsponsored American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"). The fund may also invest in foreign securities and equity securities of domestic companies with small market capitalizations.
info.description_zh: BeeHive ETF 尋求資本增值。在正常市場情況下，該基金主要投資於境內大中型市值公司的股票型證券。本基金主要投資的股本證券包括普通股以及保薦和非保薦美國存託憑證（「ADR」）。該基金亦可投資於外國證券及國內小市值公司的股本證券。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST QBTS ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on D-Wave Quantum, Inc.'s common share (NYSE: QBTS) (the "Underlying Stock"; to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains is a secondary consideration. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to pay weekly distributions by selling put options on the Underlying Leveraged ETF, which provides exposure to 2 times the daily performance of the Underlying Stock. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST QBTS ETF 力求實現 D-Wave Quantum, Inc. 普通股（NYSE：QBTS）（「基礎股票」）出售選擇權所產生收入的 2 倍（200%）；獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 的表現，但潛在投資收益的上限是次要考慮因素。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），尋求每週支付透過出售標的槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權進行分配，該 ETF 提供的敞口是標的股票每日表現的 2 倍。

info.description: Landmark Bancorp, Inc. /Kansas/ is a holding company. The firm engages in the provision of financial and banking services. It offers checking accounts, savings and investments, loans, online and mobile, business checking and business services. The company was founded on April 22, 1885 and is headquartered in Manhattan, KS.
info.description_zh: Landmark Ba​​rcorp, Inc. /堪薩斯州/是一家控股公司。該公司從事提供金融和銀行服務。它提供支票帳戶、儲蓄和投資、貸款、線上和行動、商業支票和商業服務。該公司成立於 1885 年 4 月 22 日，總部位於堪薩斯州曼哈頓。

info.description: Invesco High Yield Equity Dividend Achievers ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the NASDAQ US Dividend AchieversTM 50 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Nasdaq, Inc. includes common stocks in the underlying index that have a consistent record of dividend increases, principally on the basis of dividend yield and consistent growth in dividends.
info.description_zh: Invesco High Yield Equity Dividend Achievers ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克美國 Dividend AchieversTM 50 指數（「基本指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序，納斯達克公司將具有一致股息增長記錄的普通股納入基礎指數，主要基於股息收益率和股息持續增長。

info.description: Strattec Security Corp. is a global automotive access company that designs and delivers safe, secure, and highly engineered access solutions for the automotive and mobility industries. The firm offers vehicle access solutions, security and authorization solutions, user interface controls solutions, dealer direct fulfillment services, aftermarket solutions, and bolt. The company was founded on February 27, 1995 and is headquartered in Milwaukee, WI.
info.description_zh: Strattec Security Corp. 是一家全球汽車門禁公司，為汽車和行動產業設計並提供安全可靠且高度工程化的門禁解決方案。該公司提供車輛存取解決方案、安全性和授權解決方案、使用者介面控制解決方案、經銷商直接履行服務、售後解決方案和螺栓。該公司成立於1995年2月27日，總部位於威斯康辛州密爾瓦基。

info.description: Hub Group, Inc. engages in the provision of comprehensive transportation and logistics management services focused on reliability, visibility, and value for customers. It operates through the Intermodal and Transportation Solutions (ITS) and Logistics segments. The ITS segment includes intermodal and dedicated trucking. The Logistics segment focuses on full outsource logistics solutions, transportation management services, consolidation and fulfillment services, and final mile delivery services. The company was founded by Phillip C. Yeager in 1971 and is headquartered in Oak Brook, IL.
info.description_zh: Hub Group, Inc. 致力於提供全面的運輸和物流管理服務，專注於為客戶提供可靠性、可見度和價值。它透過聯運和運輸解決方案（ITS）和物流部門運作。 ITS 部分包括聯運和專用卡車運輸。物流部門專注於全面外包物流解決方案、運輸管理服務、整合和履行服務以及最後一哩交付服務。該公司由 Phillip C. Yeager 於 1971 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州奧克布魯克。

info.description: PPG Industries, Inc. engages in the manufacture and distribution of paints, coatings, and specialty materials. It operates through the following segments: Global Architectural Coatings, Performance Coatings, and Industrial Coatings. The Global Architectural Coatings segment includes architectural coatings EMEA and architectural coatings Latin America and Asia Pacific operations, which supplies paints, wood stains, adhesives, sealants, and purchased sundries. The Performance Coatings segment is involved in the automotive refinish coatings, aerospace coatings, protective and marine coatings, and traffic solutions operations. The Industrial Coatings segment refers to automotive OEM coatings, industrial coatings, packaging coatings, and specialty products. The company was founded by John B. Ford and John A. Pitcairn in 1883 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: PPG Industries, Inc. 從事油漆、塗料和特殊材料的製造和分銷。該公司透過以下部門運作：全球建築塗料部門、高性能塗料部門和工業塗料部門。全球建築塗料部門包括歐洲、中東和非洲建築塗料以及拉丁美洲和亞太地區的建築塗料業務，供應油漆、木材著色劑、黏合劑、密封劑和採購雜貨。高性能塗料部門涉及汽車修補塗料、航太塗料、防護和船舶塗料以及交通解決方案業務。工業塗料領域包括汽車原始設備製造商塗料、工業塗料、包裝塗料和特殊產品。該公司由 John B. Ford 和 John A. Pitcairn 於 1883 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州匹茲堡。

info.description: First Trust Small Cap US Equity Select ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq Riskalyze US Small Cap IndexTM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the common stocks and real estate investment trusts ("REITs") that comprise the index. The index is designed to select dividend-paying securities issued by small capitalization U.S. companies.
info.description_zh: First Trust Small Cap US Equity Select ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Nasdaq Riskalyze US Small Cap IndexTM 的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的普通股和房地產投資信託基金（「REIT」）。該指數旨在選擇美國小型公司發行的派息證券。

info.description: National CineMedia, Inc. is a holding company which engages in the provision of various advertising, business meetings, event services, and third-party theatre circuits under network affiliate agreements. It mainly operates as a cinema advertising platform. National CineMedia was founded on October 5, 2006 and is headquartered in Centennial, CO.
info.description_zh: National CineMedia, Inc. 是一家控股公司，根據網路附屬協議提供各種廣告、商務會議、活動服務和第三方影院影院。它主要作為影院廣告平台運作。 National CineMedia 成立於 2006 年 10 月 5 日，總部位於科羅拉多州 Centennial。

info.description: Invesco KBW Bank ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the KBW Nasdaq Bank Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is a modified-market capitalization-weighted index of companies primarily engaged in U.S. banking activities, as determined by the index provider. The underlying index is designed to track the performance of large national U.S. money centers, regional banks, and thrift institutions that are publicly traded in the U.S. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco KBW Bank ETF 旨在追蹤 KBW 納斯達克銀行指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數是由指數提供者決定的主要從事美國銀行業務的公司的修正市值加權指數。基礎指數旨在追蹤在美國公開交易的大型國家級貨幣中心、地區銀行和儲蓄機構的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Danaher Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of professional, medical, industrial, and commercial products and services. It operates through the following segments: Biotechnology, Life Sciences, and Diagnostics. The Biotechnology segment includes bioprocessing, discovery, and medical businesses and offers a range of tools, consumables, and services. The Life Sciences segment offers a range of instruments and consumables to study the basic building blocks of life, including DNA and RNA. The Diagnostics segment offers clinical instruments, reagents, consumables, software, and services used to diagnose disease and make treatment decisions. The company was founded by Steven M. Rales and Mitchell P. Rales in 1984 and is headquartered in Washington, DC.
info.description_zh: 丹納赫公司從事專業、醫療、工業和商業產品和服務的設計、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：生物技術、生命科學和診斷。生技部門包括生物加工、發現和醫療業務，並提供一系列工具、消耗品和服務。生命科學部門提供一系列儀器和消耗品來研究生命的基本組成部分，包括 DNA 和 RNA。診斷部門提供用於診斷疾病和做出治療決策的臨床儀器、試劑、消耗品、軟體和服務。該公司由 Steven M. Rales 和 Mitchell P. Rales 於 1984 年創立，總部位於華盛頓特區。

info.description: M&T Bank Corp. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of retail and commercial banking, trust, wealth management, and investment services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Bank, Retail Bank, Institutional Services and Wealth Management, and All Other. The Commercial Bank segment offers a wide range of credit products and banking services to middle-market and large commercial customers, mainly within the markets served by the company. The Retail Bank segment refers to the services to consumers and small businesses through the company's branch network and several other delivery channels such as telephone banking, internet banking, and ATMs. The Institutional Services and Wealth Management segment relates to helping high net worth individuals, institutions, and families grow, preserve, and transfer wealth. The All Other segment reflects other activities of the company that are not directly attributable to the reported segments. The company was founded on August 30, 1856 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: M&T Bank Corp. 作為一家銀行控股公司經營，提供零售和商業銀行、信託、財富管理和投資服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業銀行、零售銀行、機構服務和財富管理以及所有其他部門。商業銀行部門主要在公司服務的市場內向中型市場和大型商業客戶提供廣泛的信貸產品和銀行服務。零售銀行部門是指透過公司的分行網路和電話銀行、網路銀行和自動櫃員機等其他幾種交付管道向消費者和小型企業提供的服務。機構服務和財富管理部門涉及幫助高淨值個人、機構和家庭成長、保存和轉移財富。所有其他部門反映了公司不直接歸屬於報告部門的其他活動。該公司成立於 1856 年 8 月 30 日，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: Scharf ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund primarily invests in equity securities that the Adviser believes have significantly more appreciation potential than downside risk over the long term. Equity securities in which the fund may invest include, but are not limited to, common and preferred stock of companies of all size market capitalizations, rights and warrants. It may invest up to 50% of its total assets in securities of foreign issuers listed on foreign exchanges (excluding depositary receipts), including up to 25% of its total assets in issuers in emerging markets.
info.description_zh: Scharf ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常市場條件下，該基金主要投資於顧問認為長期來看升值潛力明顯大於下行風險的股票證券。本基金可投資的股本證券包括但不限於各種市值公司的普通股和優先股、權利和認股權證。它可以將其總資產的最多50%投資於在外匯交易所上市的外國發行人的證券（不包括存託憑證），其中最多將其總資產的25%投資於新興市場的發行人。

info.description: Freeport-McMoRan, Inc. engages in the mining of copper, gold, and molybdenum. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Copper Mines, South America Operations, Indonesia Operations, Molybdenum Mines, U.S. Rod and Refining, Atlantic Copper, and Corporate and Other. The U.S. Copper Mines segment operates open-pit copper mines in Morenci, Bagdad, Safford, Sierrita, Miami in Arizona and Chino, and Tyrone in New Mexico. The South America Operations segment includes Cerro Verde in Peru and El Abra in Chile. The Indonesia Operations segment handles the operations of the Grasberg minerals district that produce copper concentrate containing significant quantities of gold and silver. The Molybdenum Mines segment includes the Henderson underground mine and Climax open pit mine, both in Colorado. The U.S. Rod and Refining segment consists of copper conversion facilities located in North America and includes refinery and rod mills. The Atlantic Copper segment smelts and refines copper concentrate and markets refined copper and precious metals in slimes. The Corporate and Other segment offers other mining and eliminations, oil and gas operations, and other corporate and elimination items. The company was founded by James R. Moffett on November 10, 1987, and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Freeport-McMoRan, Inc. 從事銅、金和鉬的開採。該公司透過以下部門運作：美國銅礦部門、南美業務部門、印尼業務部門、鉬礦部門、美國棒材和精煉部門、大西洋銅業部門以及企業及其他部門。美國銅礦部門在亞利桑那州的莫倫西、巴格達、薩福德、謝里塔、邁阿密和新墨西哥州的奇諾和蒂龍經營露天銅礦。南美洲業務部門包括秘魯的Cerro Verde 和智利的El Abra。印尼業務部門負責格拉斯伯格礦區的業務，該礦區生產含有大量金和銀的銅精礦。鉬礦部門包括位於科羅拉多州的亨德森地下礦和 Climax 露天礦場。美國棒材和精煉部門由位於北美的銅轉化設施組成，包括精煉廠和棒材軋鋼機。大西洋銅業部門冶煉和精煉銅精礦，並銷售精煉銅和礦泥中的貴金屬。公司及其他部門提供其他採礦和消除、石油和天然氣業務以及其他公司和消除項目。該公司由 James R. Moffett 於 1987 年 11 月 10 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯。

info.description: VanEck Biotech ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS US Listed Biotech 25 Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The Biotech Index includes common stocks and depositary receipts of U.S. exchange-listed companies in the biotechnology industry. Such companies may include medium-capitalization companies and foreign companies that are listed on a U.S. exchange. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Biotech ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製未計費用和支出之前的 MVIS 美國上市生物科技 25 指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。生技指數包括美國交易所上市公司生技產業的普通股和存託憑證。此類公司可能包括中等資本公司和在美國交易所上市的外國公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Hilton Worldwide Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of hospitality businesses. It operates through the Management and Franchise, and Ownership segments. The Management and Franchise segment operates hotels of third-party owners. The Ownership segment includes owned, leased, and joint venture hotels. The company was founded by Conrad N. Hilton in 1925 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: 希爾頓全球控股公司 (Hilton Worldwide Holdings, Inc.) 從事飯店業務。它透過管理和特許經營以及所有權部門進行運作。管理和特許經營部門經營第三方業主的旅館。所有權部門包括自有、租賃和合資酒店。該公司由 Conrad N. Hilton 於 1925 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: Byrna Technologies, Inc. is a less-lethal self-defense technology company, which engages in the business of developing, manufacturing, and selling innovative less-lethal personal security solutions. It operates through the following geographical segments: the United States, South Africa, Europe, South America, and Asia, and Canada. The company was founded on March 1, 2005 and is headquartered in Andover, MA.
info.description_zh: Byrna Technologies, Inc. 是一家低致命性自衛技術公司，從事開發、製造和銷售創新的低致命性個人安全解決方案業務。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、南非、歐洲、南美洲、亞洲和加拿大。該公司成立於2005年3月1日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州安多佛。

info.description: Lennar Corp. engages in the provision of real estate related financial and investment management services. It operates through the following segments: Homebuilding, Financial Services, Multifamily, and Lennar Other. The Homebuilding segment refers to the construction and sale of single-family attached and detached homes and the purchase, development, and sale of residential land directly and through entities. The Financial Services segment focuses on mortgage financing, title, and closing services for buyers. The Multifamily segment is involved in the development, construction, and property management of multifamily rental properties. The Lennar Other segment includes funds, asset management platform, and strategic investments in technology companies. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Lennar Corp. 從事提供房地產相關的金融和投資管理服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：住宅建築部門、金融服務部門、多戶住宅部門和 Lennar 其他部門。住宅建築部門是指單戶附屬住宅和獨立住宅的建造和銷售，以及直接和透過實體購買、開發和銷售住宅用地。金融服務部門專注於為買家提供抵押貸款融資、所有權和成交服務。多戶型部門從事多戶型租賃物業的開發、建造和物業管理。 Lennar 其他部門包括基金、資產管理平台以及對科技公司的策略性投資。該公司成立於 1954 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Cheesecake Factory, Inc. engages in the operation of restaurant chains. It operates through the following segments: The Cheesecake Factory Restaurants, North Italia, Other FRC, and Other. The Cheesecake Factory Restaurants segment offers appetizers, pizza, seafood, steaks, chicken, burgers, small plates, pastas, salads, sandwiches and omelettes, and a selection of gluten-free items. The North Italia segment specializes in Italian cuisine. The Other FRC segment includes brands acquired from Fox Restaurant Concepts. The Other segment consists of the Flower Child brand, along with other businesses. The company was founded by David M. Overton, Oscar Overton, and Evelyn Overton in 1972 and is headquartered in Calabasas Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: Cheesecake Factory, Inc. 從事連鎖餐廳的經營。它透過以下部門運作：Cheesecake Factory 餐廳部門、North Italia 部門、其他 FRC 部門和其他部門。 Cheesecake Factory 餐廳部門提供開胃菜、披薩、海鮮、牛排、雞肉、漢堡、小盤、義大利麵、沙拉、三明治和煎蛋，以及精選的無麩質食品。北義大利部門專注於義大利美食。其他 FRC 部門包括從 Fox Restaurant Concepts 收購的品牌。其他部門包括 Flower Child 品牌以及其他業務。該公司由 David M. Overton、Oscar Overton 和 Evelyn Overton 於 1972 年創立，總部位於加州卡拉巴薩斯山。

info.description: Repligen Corp. is a global life sciences company, which engages in providing bioprocessing technologies and solutions used in the process of manufacturing biological drugs. It operates through the North America. Europe, and Asia Pacific Region or Other geographical segments. The company was founded by Alexander G. Rich and Paul R. Schimmel in May 1981 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Repligen Corp.是一家全球生命科學公司，致力於提供生物藥物製造過程中使用的生物加工技術和解決方案。它的業務遍及北美。歐洲、亞太地區或其他地理區域。該公司由 Alexander G. Rich 和 Paul R. Schimmel 於 1981 年 5 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Shopify, Inc. is a global commerce company that provides essential internet infrastructure for commerce, offering trusted tools to start, scale, market, and run a retail business of any size. The Company's software enables merchants to run their business across all of their sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts and marketplaces. The Shopify platform provides merchants with a single view of their business across all of their sales channels and enables them to manage products and inventory, process orders and payments, fulfill and ship orders, build customer relationships, source products, leverage analytics and reporting and access financing, all from one integrated back office. The company was founded on September 28, 2004 and is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada.
info.description_zh: Shopify, Inc. 是一家全球商業公司，為商業提供必要的網路基礎設施，並提供值得信賴的工具來啟動、擴展、行銷和經營任何規模的零售業務。該公司的軟體使商家能夠在所有銷售管道上開展業務，包括網路和行動店面、實體零售店、社交媒體店面和市場。 Shopify 平台為商家提供了跨所有銷售管道的單一業務視圖，使他們能夠管理產品和庫存、處理訂單和付款、履行和發貨訂單、建立客戶關係、採購產品、利用分析和報告以及獲取融資，所有這些都透過一個整合後台進行。該公司成立於2004年9月28日，總部位於加拿大渥太華。

info.description: Hormel Foods Corp. engages in the manufacturing and marketing of branded food products. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Foodservice, and International. The Retail segment consists of the processing, marketing, and sale of food products sold predominantly in the retail market. The Foodservice segment includes the processing, marketing, and sale of food and nutritional products for foodservice, convenience store, and commercial customers. The International segment focuses on processing, marketing, and selling company products internationally. The company was founded by George A. Hormel in 1891 and is headquartered in Austin, MN.
info.description_zh: 荷美爾食品公司從事品牌食品的製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：零售、餐飲服務和國際。零售部門包括主要在零售市場銷售的食品的加工、行銷和銷售。餐飲服務部門包括為餐飲服務、便利商店和商業客戶加工、行銷和銷售食品和營養產品。國際部門專注於在國際上加工、行銷和銷售公司產品。該公司由 George A. Hormel 於 1891 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州奧斯汀。

info.description: DouYu International Holdings Ltd. engages in the development and operation of a game-centric live streaming platform in China, both on personal computer and mobile apps. It delivers its content through the integration of livestreaming, video, graphics, and virtual communities with a primary focus on games. The company was founded by Shao Jie Chen and Wen Ming Zhang on April 3, 2014 and is headquartered in Wuhan, China.
info.description_zh: 鬥魚國際控股有限公司在中國從事以遊戲為中心的直播平台的開發和運營，包括個人電腦和行動應用程式。它透過整合直播、視訊、圖形和虛擬社群來提供內容，主要專注於遊戲。該公司由陳少杰和張文明於2014年4月3日創立，總部位於中國武漢。

info.description: Saia, Inc. operates as a transportation company. It provides regional and interregional less-than-truckload (LTL) services. The firm offers full value coverage, logistics services, distribution and consolidation, trade show, customs clearance, retail delivery, cross border shipping to Mexico and Canada, and offshore shipping to Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico. The company was founded by Louis Saia, Sr. in 1924 and is headquartered in Johns Creek, GA.
info.description_zh: Saia, Inc. 是一家運輸公司。它提供區域和區域間零擔 (LTL) 服務。該公司提供全方位的價值覆蓋、物流服務、分銷和集運、貿易展、清關、零售交付、墨西哥和加拿大的跨境運輸以及阿拉斯加、夏威夷和波多黎各的離岸運輸。該公司由 Louis Saia, Sr. 於 1924 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州約翰斯克里克。

info.description: Emerson Electric Co. is a global technology and software company, which engages in the provision of solutions. It operates through the following segments: Final Control, Measurement and Analytical, Discrete Automation, Safety and Productivity, Intelligent Devices, and Software and Control. The Final Control segment focuses on providing control, isolation, shutoff, pressure relief, pressure safety valves, actuators, and regulators for process and hybrid industries. The Measurement and Analytical segment involves the instrumentation measuring the physical properties of liquids, gases, pressure, temperature, level, flow, acoustics, corrosion, pH, conductivity, water quality, toxic gases, and flame. The Discrete Automation segment includes solenoid, pneumatic, valve position indicators, pneumatic cylinders and actuators, air preparation equipment, pressure and temperature switches, electric linear motion solutions, programmable automation control systems and software, electrical distribution equipment, and materials joining solutions. The Safety and Productivity segment consists of pipe-working tools: pipe wrenches, pipe cutters, pipe threading and roll grooving equipment, battery hydraulic tools for press connections, drain cleaners, tubing tools and diagnostic systems, including sewer inspection cameras and locating equipment. The Software and Control segment processes by collecting and analyzing information from measurement devices in the plant and using that information to adjust valves, pumps, motors, drives, and other control hardware. The company was founded by Charles Meston and Alexander Meston on September 24, 1890, and is headquartered in St. Louis, MO.
info.description_zh: 艾默生電氣公司是一家全球技術和軟體公司，致力於提供解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：最終控制、測量和分析、離散自動化、安全性和生產力、智慧設備以及軟體和控制。最終控制部門專注於為製程和混合產業提供控制、隔離、關閉、洩壓、壓力安全閥、致動器和調節器。測量和分析部分涉及測量液體、氣體、壓力、溫度、液位、流量、聲學、腐蝕、pH、電導率、水質、有毒氣體和火焰物理特性的儀器。離散自動化部門包括電磁閥、氣動閥、閥門位置指示器、氣缸和執行器、空氣準備設備、壓力和溫度開關、電動直線運動解決方案、可編程自動化控制系統和軟體、配電設備以及材料連接解決方案。安全和生產力部門包括管道加工工具：管扳手、切管機、管螺紋和滾制開槽設備、用於壓力連接的電池液壓工具、排水管清潔器、管道工具和診斷系統，包括下水道檢查攝影機和定位設備。軟體和控制部分透過收集和分析來自工廠測量設備的資訊並使用這些資訊來調整閥門、泵浦、馬達、驅動器和其他控制硬體來處理。該公司由 Charles Meston 和 Alexander Meston 於 1890 年 9 月 24 日創立，總部位於密蘇裡州聖路易斯。

info.description: Solid Power, Inc. engages in the manufacture and supply of power batteries. The firm develops all solid state battery cell technology that replaces the liquid or gel polymer electrolyte used in conventional lithium-ion battery cells with a sulfide-based solid electrolyte. It focuses on the development and commercialization of all solid state battery cells and solid electrolyte materials, primarily for the battery-powered electric vehicle market. The company was founded on August 3, 2011 and is headquartered in Louisville, CO.
info.description_zh: Solid Power, Inc.從事動力電池的製造和供應。該公司開發全固態電池技術，以硫化物固態電解質取代傳統鋰離子電池中使用的液體或凝膠聚合物電解質。它專注於全固態電池和固體電解質材料的開發和商業化，主要面向電池驅動的電動車市場。該公司成立於2011年8月3日，總部位於科羅拉多州路易斯維爾。

info.description: MSCI, Inc. engages in the provision of investment decision support tools including indices, portfolio risk and performance analytics and corporate governance products and services. It operates through the following segments: Index, Analytics, ESG and Climate, and All Other-Private Assets. The Index segment focuses on the investment process, including developing indexed financial products. The Analytics segment offers risk management, performance attribution and portfolio management content, applications, and services. The ESG and Climate segment includes providing data, ratings, research, and tools to help investors navigate increasing regulation, meet new client demands and better integrate ESG and climate elements into their investment processes. The All Other-Private Assets segment refers to the business intelligence products to real estate owners, managers, developers, and brokers. The company was founded by Andrew Thomas Rudd in 1998 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: MSCI, Inc. 從事提供投資決策支援工具，包括指數、投資組合風險和績效分析以及公司治理產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：指數部門、分析部門、ESG 和氣候部門以及所有其他私人資產部門。指數部門專注於投資過程，包括開發指數金融產品。分析部門提供風險管理、績效歸因和投資組合管理內容、應用程式和服務。 ESG 和氣候部門包括提供數據、評級、研究和工具，以幫助投資者應對日益嚴格的監管、滿足新的客戶需求以及更好地將 ESG 和氣候要素融入其投資流程。所有其他私人資產部分是指為房地產所有者、管理者、開發商和經紀人提供的商業智慧產品。該公司由 Andrew Thomas Rudd 於 1998 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Riverview Bancorp, Inc. operates as a holding company. It provides community banking services to small and medium size businesses, professionals, and individuals. It offers a range of deposit products, including demand deposits, negotiable order of withdrawal accounts, money market accounts, savings accounts, certificates of deposit, and retirement savings plans. The company also provides commercial business, commercial real estate, other real estate mortgage, and real estate construction loans, and consumer loans, such as one-to-four family mortgage loans, home equity lines of credit, land loans, and other secured and unsecured consumer loans. In addition, it is involved in the provision of brokerage and mortgage loan servicing activities, as well as offering asset management services consisting of trust, estate planning, and investment management services. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Vancouver, WA.
info.description_zh: Riverview Bancorp, Inc. 作為控股公司運營。它為中小型企業、專業人士和個人提供社區銀行服務。它提供一系列存款產品，包括活期存款、可轉讓提款帳戶、貨幣市場帳戶、儲蓄帳戶、存款證和退休儲蓄計劃。該公司還提供商業業務、商業房地產、其他房地產抵押貸款和房地產建設貸款，以及消費貸款，例如一對四個家庭抵押貸款、房屋淨值信貸額度、土地貸款以及其他有擔保和無擔保消費貸款。此外，該公司還從事提供經紀和抵押貸款服務活動，以及提供包括信託、遺產規劃和投資管理服務在內的資產管理服務。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於華盛頓州溫哥華。

info.description: First Trust S-Network Global E-Commerce ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the S-Network Global E-Commerce Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the securities that comprise the index. The index seeks to provide exposure to companies with securities listed on major global recognized exchanges that are engaged in the global e-commerce industry. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust S-Network 全球電子商務 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與稱為 S-Network 全球電子商務指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在為在全球主要公認交易所上市、從事全球電子商務行業的公司提供投資機會。它是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI New Zealand ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI New Zealand IMI 25/50 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index that is designed to measure the performance of the large-, mid- and small-capitalization segments of the equity market in New Zealand. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 紐西蘭 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 紐西蘭 IMI 25/50 指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量紐西蘭股票市場大、中、小型股的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a medicine company, which engages in the provision of pharmaceuticals. Its product portfolio includes generics, specialty, biosciences, and product catalog. It operates through the following segments: Generics, Specialty, and AvKARE. The Generics segment relates to oral solids, powders, liquids, sterile injectables, nasal sprays, inhalation and respiratory products, biosimilar products, ophthalmics, films, and transdermal patches and topicals. The Specialty segment refers to the development, promotion, sale, and distribution of proprietary branded pharmaceutical products. The AvKARE segment provides pharmaceuticals, medical, and surgical products and services to governmental agencies. The company was founded by Chirag K. Patel and Chintu Patel in 2002 and is headquartered in Bridgewater, NJ.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家從事藥品供應的醫藥公司。其產品組合包括仿製藥、特種藥、生物科學和產品目錄。它透過以下部門運作：仿製藥部門、專業部門和 AvKARE 部門。仿製藥部門涉及口服固體、粉末、液體、無菌注射劑、鼻噴劑、吸入和呼吸產品、生物相似藥、眼科、薄膜、透皮貼片和外用藥。特種藥品部門是指專有品牌藥品的開發、推廣、銷售及分銷。 AvKARE 部門向政府機構提供藥物、醫療和外科產品及服務。該公司由 Chirag K. Patel 和 Chintu Patel 於 2002 年創立，總部位於新澤西州布里奇沃特。

info.description: Reynolds Consumer Products, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of household products. It operates through the following segments: Reynolds Cooking and Baking, Hefty Waste and Storage, Hefty Tableware, and Presto Products. The Reynolds Cooking and Baking segment produces branded and store brand foil, disposable aluminum pans, parchment paper, freezer paper, wax paper, plastic wrap, baking cups, oven bags and slow cooker liners. The Hefty Waste and Storage segment offers both branded and store brand trash and food storage bags. The Hefty Tableware segment sells both branded and store brand disposable and compostable plates, bowls, platters, cups and cutlery. The Presto Products segment focuses on store brand products in four main categories including food storage bags, trash bags, reusable storage containers, and plastic wrap. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Lake Forest, IL.
info.description_zh: Reynolds Consumer Products, Inc. 從事家用產品的製造和銷售。該公司透過以下部門營運：Reynolds Cooking and Baking、Hefty Waste and Storage、Hefty Tableware 和 Presto Products。雷諾茲烹飪和烘焙部門生產品牌和商店品牌箔、一次性鋁鍋、羊皮紙、冷凍紙、蠟紙、保鮮膜、烤杯、烤箱袋和慢燉鍋內襯。 Hefty Waste and Storage 部門提供品牌和商店品牌垃圾和食物儲存袋。 Hefty 餐具部門銷售品牌和商店品牌的一次性和可堆肥盤子、碗、淺盤、杯子和餐具。 Presto 產品部門專注於四個主要類別的商店品牌產品，包括食品儲存袋、垃圾袋、可重複使用的儲存容器和保鮮膜。該公司成立於 2010 年，總部位於伊利諾伊州森林湖。

info.description: Fidelity D&D Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial and Industrial, Commercial Real Estate, Consumer, and Residential Real Estate. The Commercial and Industrial segment refers to identified historic and the projected cash flows of the borrower and secondarily to the underlying collateral provided by the borrower. The Commercial Real Estate segment offers loans to finance the purchase of real estate, refinance existing obligations, and/or to provide capital. The Consumer segment includes home equity installment loans and lines of credit. The Residential Real Estate segment operates as a secured first lien position of the borrower's residential real estate. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Dunmore, PA.
info.description_zh: Fidelity D&D Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供商業銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業和工業、商業房地產、消費者和住宅房地產。商業和工業部分是指借款人已確定的歷史和預計現金流量，其次是藉款人提供的基礎抵押品。商業房地產部門提供貸款，為購買房地產提供資金、為現有債務再融資和/或提供資本。消費者部門包括房屋淨值分期貸款和信貸額度。住宅房地產部門作為借款人住宅房地產的有擔保第一留置權進行運作。該公司成立於 1902 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州鄧莫爾。

info.description: Marriott International, Inc. engages in the operation and franchise of hotel, residential, and timeshare properties. It operates through the following geography segments: United States and Canada, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia Pacific excluding China. Its brands include Marriott Bonvoy, The Ritz-Carlton, Edition, W Hotels Worldwide, The Luxury Collection, and Stregis Hotels and Resorts etc. The company was founded by John Willard Marriott and Alice Sheets Marriott in 1927 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: 萬豪國際集團從事酒店、住宅和分時度假物業的營運和特許經營。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國和加拿大、歐洲、中東和非洲以及除中國外的亞太地區。旗下品牌包括萬豪旅享家、麗茲卡爾頓酒店、艾迪遜酒店、W 酒店全球、豪華精選、斯特吉斯酒店及度假村等。該公司由 John Willard Marriott 和 Alice Sheets Marriott 於 1927 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Liquidity Services, Inc. engages in the provision of e-commerce solutions to manage, value, and sell inventory and equipment for business and government clients. It operates through the following business segments: GovDeals, Capital Assets Group (CAG), Retail Supply Chain Group (RSCG), and Machinio. The GovDeals segment provides self-directed service solutions that enable local and state government entities including city, county, and state agencies to sell surplus and salvage assets through the firm's GovDeals marketplace. The CAG segment offers managed and self-directed service solutions to sellers and consists of marketplaces that enable commercial businesses to sell surplus and idle assets. CAG also offers a suite of services that includes surplus management, asset valuation, asset sales, and marketing. The RSCG segment consists of marketplaces that enable corporations located in the U.S. and Canada to sell surplus and salvage consumer goods and retail capital assets. Its services also include returns management, asset recovery, and e-commerce services. The Machinio segment operates a global search engine platform for listing used equipment for sale in the construction, machine tool, transportation, printing, and agriculture sectors. The company was founded by William P. Angrick III, Jaime Mateus-Tique and Benjamin Ronald Brown in 1999 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Liquidity Services, Inc. 致力於提供電子商務解決方案，為企業和政府客戶管理、評估和銷售庫存和設備。該公司透過以下業務部門營運：GovDeals、Capital Assets Group (CAG)、Retail Supply Chain Group (RSCG) 和 Machinio。 GovDeals 部門提供自主服務解決方案，使包括市、縣和州機構在內的地方和州政府實體能夠透過公司的 GovDeals 市場出售剩餘和回收資產。 CAG 部門為賣家提供託管和自主服務解決方案，並由允許商業企業出售剩餘和閒置資產的市場組成。 CAG 還提供一整套服務，包括盈餘管理、資產評估、資產銷售和行銷。 RSCG 部門由多個市場組成，這些市場使位於美國和加拿大的公司能夠出售剩餘產品並回收消費品和零售資本資產。其服務還包括退貨管理、資產追回和電子商務服務。 Machinio 部門經營一個全球搜尋引擎平台，列出建築、工具機、運輸、印刷和農業領域待售的二手設備。該公司由 William P. Angrick III、Jaime Mateus-Tique 和 Benjamin Ronald Brown 於 1999 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Century Aluminum Co. is a producer of aluminum and operates aluminum reduction facilities, or smelters, in the United States and Iceland. Its products include standard ingots, T-ingot, extrusion billet, horizontal direct chill ingot, molten, slab, and sow. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Century Aluminium Co. 是一家鋁生產商，在美國和冰島經營鋁還原設施或冶煉廠。其產品包括標準鋼錠、T型鋼錠、擠壓鋼坯、水平直冷鋼錠、熔煉鋼錠、板坯和母材。該公司成立於 1995 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Relay Therapeutics, Inc. engages in transforming the drug discovery process with an initial focus on enhancing small molecule therapeutic discovery in targeted oncology. Its Dynamo platform is use to integrate an array of edge experimental and computational approaches, which allows to apply the understanding of protein structure and motion to drug discovery. The company was founded by David Elliot Shaw, Matthew P. Jacobson, Dorothee Kern, Mark Murcko, Alexis Borisy, and Jakob Loven on May 4, 2015 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Relay Therapeutics, Inc. 致力於改變藥物發現過程，最初的重點是增強靶向腫瘤學中的小分子治療發現。其 Dynamo 平台用於整合一系列邊緣實驗和計算方法，從而可以將對蛋白質結構和運動的理解應用於藥物發現。該公司由 David Elliot Shaw、Matthew P. Jacobson、Dorothee Kern、Mark Murcko、Alexis Borisy 和 Jakob Loven 於 2015 年 5 月 4 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Coda Octopus Group, Inc. engages in the developing, manufacturing, and marketing of subsea products. The firm operates through the following segments: Marine Technology Business (Products), Acoustics Sensors and Materials Business (PAL), and Defense Engineering Services Business. The Marine Technology Business segment develops solutions for subsea and underwater markets. The Acoustics Sensors and Materials Business segment engages in the provision of a comprehensive range of products and solutions, with a primary focus on medical imaging and Non-Destructive Testing. The Defense Engineering Services Business segment engages in defense contractors and designs, engineers, manufactures and supplies proprietary sub-assemblies for incorporation into broader mission critical defense systems. It also operates through the Americas, Europe, Australia or Asia, and Middle East or Africa geographical segments. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: Coda Octopus Group, Inc. 從事海底產品的開發、製造和行銷。該公司透過以下部門運作：海洋技術業務（產品）、聲學感測器和材料業務（PAL）以及國防工程服務業務。海洋技術業務部門為海底和水下市場開發解決方案。聲學感測器和材料業務部門提供全面的產品和解決方案，主要專注於醫學影像和無損檢測。國防工程服務業務部門與國防承包商合作，設計、工程師、製造和供應專有的子組件，以納入更廣泛的關鍵任務防禦系統。它也透過美洲、歐洲、澳洲或亞洲、中東或非洲地理區域開展業務。該公司成立於 1994 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: Progress Software Corp. engages in the provision of products that develop and deploy mission-critical business applications. Its products and solutions include Chef, Corticon, DataDirect, Developer Tools, Flowmon, Kemp LoadMaster, MarkLogic, MOVEit, OpenEdge, Semaphore, ShareFile, Sitefinity & WhatsUp Gold. The company was founded by Joseph Wright Alsop, Clyde Kessel, and Charles Arthur Ziering in 1981 and is headquartered in Burlington, MA.
info.description_zh: Progress Software Corp. 致力於提供開發和部署關鍵任務業務應用程式的產品。其產品和解決方案包括 Chef、Corticon、DataDirect、開發人員工具、Flowmon、Kemp LoadMaster、MarkLogic、MOVEit、OpenEdge、Semaphore、ShareFile、Sitefinity 和 WhatsUp Gold。該公司由 Joseph Wright Alsop、Clyde Kessel 和 Charles Arthur Ziering 於 1981 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州伯靈頓。

info.description: Medalist Diversified, Inc. engages in the acquisition, reposition, renovation, lease, and management of income-producing properties. It focuses on commercial properties, including flex-industrial and retail properties, multi-family residential properties, and limited-service hotel properties. It operates through the following segments: Retail Center Properties, Flex Center Property and STNL Properties. The Retail Center Properties segment consists of the Shops at Franklin Square, the Ashley Plaza Shopping Center, the Lancer Center, and the Salisbury Marketplace Shopping Center. The Flex Center Property segment consists of Brookfield Center, the Greenbrier Business Center, and the Parkway property. The STNL Properties segment consists of the Citibank property, an outparcel at its Salisbury Marketplace property, and the Hanover Square outparcel. The company was founded on September 28, 2015 and is headquartered in Richmond, VA.
info.description_zh: Medalist Diversified, Inc. 從事創收財產的收購、重新定位、翻新、租賃和管理。它專注於商業房地產，包括靈活工業和零售房地產、多戶住宅房地產和有限服務酒店房地產。該公司透過以下部門營運：Retail Center Properties、Flex Center Property 和 STNL Properties。零售中心地產部門包括富蘭克林廣場商店、阿什利廣場購物中心、蘭瑟中心和索爾茲伯里市場購物中心。 Flex Center 物業部分包括 Brookfield Center、Greenbrier Business Center 和 Parkway 物業。 STNL 地產部門包括花旗銀行地產、索爾茲伯里市場地產和漢諾威廣場地產。該公司成立於2015年9月28日，總部位於維吉尼亞州里士滿。

info.description: Carnival Corp. Ltd. engages in the operation of cruise ships. It operates through the following business segments: North America Cruise Operations, Europe Cruise Operations, Cruise Support, and Tour and Others. The North America Cruise Operations segment includes the Carnival Cruise Line, Holland America Line, Princess Cruises, and Seabourn. The Europe Cruise Operations segment consists of AIDA, Costa, Cunard, and P&O Cruises (UK). The Cruise Support segment represents port destinations and private islands for the benefit of its cruise brands. The Tour and Other segment operates hotel and transportation operations of Holland America Princess Alaska Tours. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Carnival Corp. Ltd. 從事遊輪營運。該公司透過以下業務部門營運：北美郵輪營運部門、歐洲郵輪營運部門、郵輪支援部門以及旅遊及其他部門。北美郵輪營運部門包括嘉年華郵輪公司、荷美郵輪公司、公主郵輪公司和世邦郵輪公司。歐洲郵輪營運部門包括 AIDA、Costa、Cunard 和 P&O Cruises（英國）。郵輪支援部門代表港口目的地和私人島嶼，以維護其郵輪品牌的利益。旅遊及其他部門經營荷美阿拉斯加公主旅行社的飯店和運輸業務。該公司成立於 1972 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: BioVie, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovery, development, and marketing drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative disorders, and liver disease. The company was founded on April 10, 2013 and is headquartered in Carson City, NV.
info.description_zh: BioVie, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和行銷神經系統和神經退化性疾病以及肝病的藥物療法。該公司成立於2013年4月10日，總部位於內華達州卡森市。

info.description: argenx SE is a global immunology company, which engages in improving the lives of people suffering from severe autoimmune diseases. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Japan, EMEA, and China. The company was founded by Hans J. W. de Haard, Torsten Dreier, and Tim van Hauwermeiren in 2008 and is headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: argenx SE 是一家全球免疫學公司，致力於改善患有嚴重自體免疫疾病的人們的生活。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、日本、歐洲、中東和非洲地區和中國。該公司由 Hans J. W. de Haard、Torsten Dreier 和 Tim van Hauwermeiren 於 2008 年創立，總部位於荷蘭阿姆斯特丹。

info.description: Verisk Analytics, Inc. engages in the provision of data, analytics, and technology services. The firm also offers predictive analytics and decision support solutions to clients in rating, underwriting, claims, catastrophe, and weather risk fields. It operates through the Insurance segment. The Insurance segment offers fraud-detection solutions including review of data on claim histories, analysis of claims to find emerging patterns of fraud, and identification of suspicious claims in the insurance sector and offers solutions and services primarily through annual subscriptions or long-term agreements. The company was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Jersey City, NJ.
info.description_zh: Verisk Analytics, Inc. 從事提供數據、分析和技術服務。該公司還為評級、承保、索賠、災難和天氣風險領域的客戶提供預測分析和決策支援解決方案。它透過保險部門運作。保險部門提供詐欺偵測解決方案，包括審查索賠歷史數據、分析索賠以發現新出現的詐欺模式以及識別保險領域的可疑索賠，並主要透過年度訂閱或長期協議提供解決方案和服務。該公司成立於 1971 年，總部位於新澤西州澤西市。

info.description: Alto Ingredients, Inc. engages in the production and marketing of specialty alcohols and essential ingredients. It operates through the following segments: Marketing and Distribution, Pekin Production, and Western Production. The Marketing and Distribution segment includes marketing and merchant trading for company-produced alcohols and essential ingredients, on an aggregated basis, and third-party fuel-grade ethanol. The Pekin Campus Production segment deals with the production and sale of alcohols and essential ingredients produced at the company's Pekin, Illinois campus. The Western Production segment covers the production and sale of renewable fuel and essential ingredients produced at two western production facilities. The company was founded by William L. Jones and Neil M. Koehler on January 30, 2003 and is headquartered in Pekin, IL.
info.description_zh: Alto Ingredients, Inc. 從事特殊酒精和基本成分的生產和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：行銷和分銷部門、北京製作部和西部製作部。行銷和分銷部門包括公司生產的酒精和基本成分以及第三方燃料級乙醇的營銷和商業貿易。北京校園生產部門負責生產和銷售該公司伊利諾伊州北京校園生產的酒精和基本成分。西部生產部門涵蓋兩個西部生產設施生產的可再生燃料和基本成分的生產和銷售。該公司由 William L. Jones 和 Neil M. Koehler 於 2003 年 1 月 30 日創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州北京。

info.description: The Mosaic Co. engages in the production and marketing of concentrated phosphate and potash crop nutrients. It operates through the following segments: Phosphates, Potash, and Mosaic Fertilizantes. The Phosphates segment is involved in the ownership and operation of mines and production facilities which produce concentrated phosphate crop nutrients and phosphate-based animal feed ingredients, and processing plants which produce concentrated phosphate crop nutrients. The Potash segment includes mining, processing, and selling potash. The Mosaic Fertilizantes segment focuses on mines, chemical plants, crop nutrient blending and bagging facilities, port terminals, and warehouses. The company was founded on March 25, 2004 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: 馬賽克公司從事濃縮磷酸鹽和鉀肥作物營養素的生產和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：磷酸鹽、鉀鹽和馬賽克肥料。磷酸鹽部門參與生產濃縮磷酸鹽作物營養素和磷酸鹽動物飼料成分的礦山和生產設施以及生產濃縮磷酸鹽作物營養素的加工廠的所有權和運營。鉀肥部門包括開採、加工和銷售鉀肥。馬賽克肥料部門專注於礦山、化工廠、作物養分混合和裝袋設施、港口碼頭和倉庫。該公司成立於2004年3月25日，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: Shoe Carnival, Inc. engages in the retail of footwear products. It offers casual and athletic footwear for men, women, and children. It operates under banners which include Shoe Carnival stores and Shoe Station banner. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Fort Mill, SC.
info.description_zh: Shoe Carnival, Inc. 從事鞋類產品零售業務。它為男士、女士和兒童提供休閒鞋和運動鞋。它的經營旗幟包括鞋業嘉年華商店和鞋業站旗幟。該公司成立於 1978 年，總部位於南卡羅來納州米爾堡。

info.description: Simulations Plus, Inc. engages in the provision of software and consulting services supporting drug discovery, development, research, clinical trial operations, regulatory submissions, and commercialization. The firm operates through the Software and Services segment. The Software segment offers software products for pharmaceutical research, development, and commercialization of the firm's products. The Services segment focuses on contracted consulting studies for customers and offers services supporting marketplace insight and medical communications for clinical and commercial drug development. The company was founded by Walter S. Woltosz and Virginia E. Woltosz on July 17, 1996 and is headquartered in Durham, NC.
info.description_zh: Simulations Plus, Inc. 從事提供支援藥物發現、開發、研究、臨床試驗操作、監管提交和商業化的軟體和諮詢服務。該公司透過軟體和服務部門運作。軟體部門為公司產品的藥物研究、開發和商業化提供軟體產品。服務部門專注於為客戶提供合約諮詢研究，並提供支援臨床和商業藥物開發的市場洞察和醫療溝通的服務。該公司由 Walter S. Woltosz 和 Virginia E. Woltosz 於 1996 年 7 月 17 日創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州達勒姆。

info.description: eGain Corp. engages in the development, licensing, implementation, and support of customer service infrastructure software solutions. Its solutions include financial services, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, ecommerce, helpdesks, and marketing. The company was founded by Ashutosh Roy and Gunjan K. Sinha on September 10, 1997 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: eGain Corp. 從事客戶服務基礎設施軟體解決方案的開發、授權、實施和支援。其解決方案包括金融服務、保險、零售、旅遊和酒店、電子商務、服務台和行銷。該公司由 Ashutosh Roy 和 Gunjan K. Sinha 於 1997 年 9 月 10 日創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long MP Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of MP. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of MP, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 MP 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 MP 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 MP 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Qfin Holdings, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of AI-empowered Credit-Tech platform. It provides comprehensive suite of technology services to assist financial institutions and consumers and SMEs in the loan lifecycle, ranging from borrower acquisition, preliminary credit assessment, fund matching and post-facilitation services. It is dedicated to making credit services more accessible and personalized to consumers and SMEs through Credit-Tech services to financial institutions. The company was founded on July 25, 2016 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Qfin Holdings, Inc.是一家控股公司，致力於提供人工智慧賦能的信用科技平台。它提供全面的技術服務，在貸款生命週期中為金融機構、消費者和中小企業提供幫助，包括借款人獲取、初步信用評估、資金匹配和後期便利服務。它致力於透過向金融機構提供信貸科技服務，讓消費者和中小企業更容易獲得和個人化的信貸服務。公司成立於2016年7月25日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Global X Telemedicine & Digital Health ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Telemedicine & Digital Health Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies that are positioned to benefit from further advances in the field of telemedicine and digital health, as well as applications thereof (collectively, "Telemedicine & Digital Health Companies"), as defined by Solactive AG, the provider of the index. The Adviser uses a "passive" or indexing approach to try to achieve the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
