info.description_zh: Global X 遠距醫療和數位健康 ETF 尋求提供與 Solactive 遠距醫療和數位健康指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在為交易所上市公司提供投資機會，這些公司將受益於遠距醫療和數位健康及其應用領域的進一步發展（統稱為「遠距醫療和數位健康公司」），正如指數提供者 Solactive AG 所定義的那樣。顧問使用「被動」或指數化方法來嘗試實現基金的投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Ziff Davis, Inc. is a digital media and internet company. The firm's portfolio includes brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, connectivity, health, cybersecurity, and Martech. It operates through the following segments: Technology and Shopping, Gaming and Entertainment, Health and Wellness, Connectivity, and Cybersecurity and Martech. The company was founded by Jaye Muller and John F. Rieley in 1995 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Ziff Davis, Inc. 是一家數位媒體和網路公司。該公司的產品組合包括科技、購物、遊戲和娛樂、連接、健康、網路安全和 Martech 領域的品牌。它透過以下部門運作：科技和購物、遊戲和娛樂、健康和保健、連接、網路安全和行銷技術。該公司由 Jaye Muller 和 John F. Rieley 於 1995 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: IperionX Ltd. engages in the development of low carbon titanium for advanced industries, including space, aerospace, electric vehicles and 3D printing. It produces titanium metal powders from titanium scrap at its operational pilot facility in Utah and intends to scale production at a Titanium Demonstration Facility in Virginia. The company was founded by Anastasios Arima and Scott Sparks on May 5, 2017 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: IperionX Ltd. 致力於為太空、航太、電動車和 3D 列印等先進產業開發低碳鈦。該公司在猶他州的營運試點工廠利用鈦廢料生產鈦金屬粉末，並打算在維吉尼亞州的鈦示範工廠擴大生產規模。該公司由 Anastasios Arima 和 Scott Sparks 於 2017 年 5 月 5 日創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Mustang Bio, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the translation of medical breakthroughs in cell and gene therapies into potential cures for hematologic cancers, solid tumors, and rare genetic diseases. Its pipeline includes CAR T therapies for hematologic malignancies, CAR T therapies for solid tumors, and gene therapies for rare genetic disorders. The company was founded on March 13, 2015 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Mustang Bio, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於將細胞和基因療法的醫學突破轉化為血液癌症、實體瘤和罕見遺傳疾病的潛在療法。其產品線包括針對血液惡性腫瘤的 CAR T 療法、針對實體瘤的 CAR T 療法以及針對罕見遺傳性疾病的基因療法。該公司成立於2015年3月13日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: ProShares UltraShort Nasdaq Biotechnology seeks daily investment results that correspond to two times the inverse (-2x) of the daily performance of the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective. The index is a modified capitalization weighted index that includes securities of Nasdaq listed companies that are classified as either biotechnology or pharmaceutical. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares UltraShort 納斯達克生物技術尋求相當於納斯達克生物技術指數每日表現的兩倍（-2x）的每日投資結果。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與基金投資目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數是修改後的資本加權指數，包括納斯達克上市公司的證券，這些公司被分類為生物技術或製藥。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cellebrite DI Ltd. engages in the provision of digital investigative solutions for the public and private sectors, empowering organizations in mastering the complexities of legally sanctioned digital investigations by streamlining intelligence processes. Its services include training and advisory, value realization, advanced services, and technical customer support. The firm also offers software solutions and analytic tools designed to accelerate digital investigations and address the growing complexity of handling crime and security challenges in the digital era. The company was founded on April 13, 1999 and is headquartered in Petach Tikva, Israel.
info.description_zh: Cellebrite DI Ltd. 致力於為公共和私營部門提供數位調查解決方案，使組織能夠透過簡化情報流程來掌握法律批准的數位調查的複雜性。其服務包括培訓和諮詢、價值實現、高級服務和技術客戶支援。該公司還提供軟體解決方案和分析工具，旨在加速數位調查並解決數位時代處理犯罪和安全挑戰日益複雜的問題。該公司成立於1999年4月13日，總部位於以色列佩塔提克瓦。

info.description: Sprott Active Metals & Miners ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund, which is actively managed, seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities of (i) companies that are engaged in the mining, exploration, production, development, distribution or recycling of metals and raw materials that frequently are used to support growing global demand for energy and (ii) royalty and streaming companies engaged in financing such metals and raw materials. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Active Metals & Miners ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金採用主動管理方式，在正常情況下，力求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於 (i) 從事金屬和原材料採礦、勘探、生產、開發、分銷或回收的公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，這些金屬和原材料經常用於支持全球不斷增長的能源需求，以及 (ii) 從事為此類金屬和原材料的特許經營權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: NIKE, Inc. engages in the design, development, marketing, and sale of athletic footwear, apparel, accessories, equipment, and services. It operates through the following segments: North America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), Greater China, Asia Pacific and Latin America (APLA), Global Brand Divisions, Converse, and Corporate. The North America, EMEA, Greater China, and APLA segments refer to the design, development, marketing, and selling of athletic footwear, apparel, and equipment. The Global Brand Divisions segment represents its NIKE Brand licensing businesses. The Converse segment designs, markets, licenses, and sells casual sneakers, apparel, and accessories. The Corporate segment is composed of unallocated general and administrative expenses. The company was founded by William Jay Bowerman and Philip Hampson Knight on January 25, 1964 and is headquartered in Beaverton, OR.
info.description_zh: NIKE, Inc. 從事運動鞋、服裝、配件、設備和服務的設計、開發、行銷和銷售。該公司透過以下部門營運：北美、歐洲、中東和非洲 (EMEA)、大中華、亞太和拉丁美洲 (APLA)、全球品牌部門、Converse 和企業部門。北美、歐洲、中東和非洲、大中華區和 APLA 細分市場涉及運動鞋、服裝和裝備的設計、開發、行銷和銷售。全球品牌部門代表其耐吉品牌授權業務。匡威部門設計、行銷、授權和銷售休閒運動鞋、服裝和配件。公司部門由未分配的一般費用和管理費用組成。該公司由 William Jay Bowerman 和 Philip Hampson Knight 於 1964 年 1 月 25 日創立，總部位於俄勒岡州比佛頓。

info.description: Terrestrial Energy, Inc. is an advanced nuclear technology company focused on next-generation nuclear energy systems. The company is developing the Integral Molten Salt Reactor (IMSR), an innovative type of Generation IV molten salt reactor designed to produce reliable, low-carbon heat and electricity at competitive costs. The company is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: 陸地能源公司是一家專注於下一代核能係統的先進核能技術公司。該公司正在開發整體熔鹽反應器（IMSR），這是一種創新第四代熔鹽反應堆，旨在以具有競爭力的成本生產可靠、低碳的熱能和電力。該公司總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Central Garden & Pet Co. engages in the production and distribution of branded and private label products for the lawn, garden, and pet supplies markets. It operates through the Pet and Garden segments. The Pet segment focuses on dog and cat supplies such as dog treats and chews, toys, pet beds and containment, grooming products, waste management and training pads, supplies for aquatics, small animals, reptiles and pet birds including toys, cages and habitats, bedding, food and supplements, products for equine and livestock, animal and household health and insect control products, live fish, and small animals, as well as outdoor cushions. The Garden segment includes lawn and garden consumables such as grass, vegetable, flower and herb seed, wild bird feed, bird houses and other birding accessories, weed, grass, and other herbicides, insecticide and pesticide products, fertilizers, and live plants. The company was founded by William E. Brown in 1980 and is headquartered in Walnut Creek, CA.
info.description_zh: Central Garden & Pet Co. 從事草坪、花園和寵物用品市場的品牌和自有品牌產品的生產和分銷。它透過寵物和花園部門運作。寵物部門專注於狗和貓用品，如狗零食和咀嚼物、玩具、寵物床和圍護用品、美容產品、廢物管理和訓練墊、水生動物、小動物、爬行動物和寵物鳥類用品，包括玩具、籠子和棲息地、床上用品、食品和補充劑、馬和牲畜產品、動物和家庭健康和昆蟲控制產品、活魚和小動物以及戶外墊子。花園部門包括草坪和花園消耗品，如草、蔬菜、花卉和藥草種子、野鳥飼料、鳥舍和其他觀鳥配件、雜草、草和其他除草劑、殺蟲劑和殺蟲劑產品、肥料和活體植物。該公司由 William E. Brown 於 1980 年創立，總部位於加州核桃溪。

info.description: Life360, Inc. engages in the development of location sharing mobile applications. It offers mobile applications, which include features that range from communications to driving safety and location sharing. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Other International Regions. The company was founded by Chris Hulls, Dilpreet Singh, and Alex Haro in 2007 and is headquartered in San Mateo, CA.

info.description: Sprott Energy Transition Materials ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Energy Transition Materials Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from (i) mining, exploration, development, production, recycling, refining, or smelting of energy transition materials; (ii) investments in energy transition materials that represent all or a significant portion of their assets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott 能源轉型材料 ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和開支先前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott 能源轉型材料指數的總回報表現相對應。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 收入和/或資產來自 (i) 能源轉型材料的採礦、勘探、開發、生產、回收、精煉或冶煉的公司的業績； (ii) 代表其全部或大部分資產的能源轉型材料投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Crown Crafts, Inc. engages in designing, marketing, and distributing infant, toddler, and juvenile products. It also offers infant and toddler bedding, blankets and swaddle blankets, nursery and toddler accessories, room decor, reusable and disposable bibs, burp cloths, hooded bath towels and wash clothes, development toys, and feeding and care goods. The firm's brands include Sassy, Manhattan Toy, NoJo, and Neat Solutions. The company was founded by Philip Bernstein in 1957 and is headquartered in Gonzales, LA.
info.description_zh: Crown Crafts, Inc. 從事嬰兒、幼兒和青少年產品的設計、行銷和分銷。它還提供嬰幼兒床上用品、毯子和襁褓毯、托兒所和幼兒配件、房間裝飾、可重複使用和一次性圍兜、打嗝布、連帽浴巾和洗衣服、發育玩具以及餵食和護理用品。該公司的品牌包括 Sassy、Manhattan Toy、NoJo 和 Neat Solutions。該公司由 Philip Bernstein 於 1957 年創立，總部位於路易斯安那州岡薩雷斯。

info.description: TransDigm Group, Inc. engages in the design, production, and supply of aircraft components. It operates through the following segments: Power and Control, Airframe, and Non-Aviation. The Power and Control segment includes electromechanical actuators and controls, ignition systems and engine technology, specialized pumps and valves, and power conditioning devices. The Airframe segment covers engineered latching and locking devices, engineered rods, engineered connectors, and elastomer sealing solutions. The Non-Aviation segment involves off-road vehicle suppliers and subsystem suppliers, child restraint system suppliers, and satellite and space system suppliers. The company was founded by W. Nicholas Howley and Douglas W. Peacock in 1993 and is headquartered in Cleveland, OH.
info.description_zh: TransDigm Group, Inc. 從事飛機零件的設計、生產和供應。它透過以下部門運作：動力和控制、機身和非航空部門。電力和控制部門包括機電執行器和控制裝置、點火系統和引擎技術、專用泵浦和閥門以及電力調節裝置。機身部分涵蓋工程閂鎖和鎖定裝置、工程桿、工程連接器和彈性體密封解決方案。非航空部門涉及越野車輛供應商和子系統供應商、兒童約束系統供應商以及衛星和太空系統供應商。該公司由 W. Nicholas Howley 和 Douglas W. Peacock 於 1993 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州克利夫蘭。

info.description: Air T, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of overnight air freight service to the express delivery industry, manufactures and sells aircraft deicers and other industrial equipment, and provides ground support equipment and facilities maintenance to airlines. It operates through the following segments: Overnight Air Cargo, Ground Equipment Sales, Ground Support Services, Printing Equipment & Maintenance, Commercial Aircrafts Engines & Parts, Printing Equipment & Maintenance and Corporate & Other. The Overnight Air Cargo segment operates in the air express delivery services industry. The Ground Equipment Sales segment manufactures and provides mobile deicers and other specialized equipment products to passenger and cargo airlines, airports, the military and industrial customers. The Ground Support Services segment offers ground support equipment maintenance and facilities maintenance services to domestic airlines and aviation service providers. The Commercial Aircrafts, Engines & Parts segment manages and leases aviation assets, supplies surplus and aftermarket commercial jet engine components, provides commercial aircraft disassembly, part-out services, and commercial aircraft parts sales. The Printing Equipment & Maintenance segment designs, manufactures, and sells advanced digital print production equipment and provides maintenance services to commercial customers. The Corporate & Other segment acts as the capital allocator and resource for other segments. The company was founded on November 17, 1980 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Air T, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事向快遞行業提供隔夜航空貨運服務，製造和銷售飛機除冰器和其他工業設備，並向航空公司提供地面支援設備和設施維護。該公司透過以下部門運作：隔夜航空貨運部門、地面設備銷售部門、地面支援服務部門、列印設備及維修部門、商用飛機引擎及零件部門、列印設備及維修部門以及企業及其他部門。隔夜航空貨運部門從事航空快遞服務業。地面設備銷售部門為客運和貨運航空公司、機場、軍事和工業客戶製造和提供行動除冰器和其他專用設備產品。地面保障服務部門為國內航空公司和航空服務提供者提供地面保障設備維護和設施維護服務。商用飛機、發動機和零件部門管理和租賃航空資產，供應剩餘和售後商用噴射發動機零件，提供商用飛機拆解、拆解服務以及商用飛機零件銷售。印刷設備及維修部門設計、製造及銷售先進的數位印刷生產設備，並為商業客戶提供維修服務。公司及其他部門充當其他部門的資本分配者和資源。該公司成立於1980年11月17日，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: American Battery Technology Co. is a technology company, which engages in the development and marketing of lithium-ion batteries. Its projects include recycling plant, United States Advanced Battery Consortium (USABC), and Tonopah flats. The company was founded on October 6, 2011 and is headquartered in Reno, NV.
info.description_zh: 美國電池科技有限公司是一家從事鋰離子電池研發和行銷的科技公司。其項目包括回收廠、美國先進電池聯盟 (USABC) 和托諾帕公寓。該公司成立於2011年10月6日，總部位於內華達州里諾。

info.description: Sprott Junior Copper Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Junior Copper Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, and production of copper. The index generally consists of from 25 to 45 constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott 初級銅礦 ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支之前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott 初級銅礦指數的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自銅礦開採、勘探、開發和生產的公司的表現。該指數通常由 25 至 45 隻成分股組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Greenpro Capital Corp. engages in the provision of business solution services to small and medium-size enterprises. It operates through the following business segments: Service Business, Digital Business, and Real Estate Business. The Service Business segment offers advisory and business solution services. The Digital Business segment focuses on the digital platform and trading of digital assets. The Real Estate Business segment trades or leases commercial real estate properties in Hong Kong and Malaysia. The company was founded by Lee Chong Kuang on July 19, 2013 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: 綠專資本致力於為中小企業提供商業解決方案服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：服務業務、數位業務和房地產業務。服務業務部門提供諮詢和業務解決方案服務。數位業務部門專注於數位平台和數位資產交易。房地產業務部門在香港和馬來西亞交易或租賃商業房地產。該公司由李宗光於2013年7月19日創立，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: Sprott Rare Earths Ex-China ETF is a non-diversified exchange-traded fund that provides targeted, "pure-play" exposure to the global rare earths industry while specifically excluding companies domiciled in or primarily operating within China. The fund tracks an index of companies involved in the mining, separation, refining, and production of rare earth elements (REEs), catering to investors seeking to capitalize on the geopolitical realignment of critical material supply chains.
info.description_zh: Sprott Rare Earths Ex-China ETF 是一款非多元化交易所交易基金，提供針對全球稀土行業的有針對性的「純粹」投資，同時明確排除在中國註冊或主要在中國運營的公司。該基金追蹤參與稀土元素 (REE) 開採、分離、精煉和生產的公司指數，迎合尋求利用關鍵材料供應鏈地緣政治重組的投資者。

info.description: BioMarin Pharmaceutical, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for people with serious and life-threatening rare diseases and medical conditions. Its pipeline products include Valoctocogene roxaparvovec, Vosoritide, and BMN 307. The company was founded by John C. Klock, Christopher M. Starr and Grant W. Denison on March 21, 1997, and is headquartered in San Rafael, CA.
info.description_zh: BioMarin Pharmaceutical, Inc. 致力於針對患有嚴重和危及生命的罕見疾病和醫療狀況的患者的療法的開發和商業化。其管道產品包括 Valoctocogene roxaparvovec、Vosoritide 和 BMN 307。該公司由 John C. Klock、Christopher M. Starr 和 Grant W. Denison 於 1997 年 3 月 21 日創立，總部位於加州聖拉斐爾。

info.description: American Resources Corp. engages in the extraction, processing, transportation, and distribution of metallurgical coal to the steel industry. It focuses on the operation of coal mining complexes located primarily within Pike, Knott, and Letcher Counties, Kentucky, and Wyoming County, West Virginia. The company was founded in 2006 and in headquartered in Fishers, IN.
info.description_zh: 美國資源公司從事冶金煤的開採、加工、運輸和分配給鋼鐵業。該公司專注於主要位於肯塔基州派克縣、諾特縣和萊徹縣以及西維吉尼亞州懷俄明縣的煤礦綜合體的運作。該公司成立於 2006 年，總部位於印第安納州費希爾斯。

info.description: Eagle Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking services. It offers checking accounts, business savings accounts, online and mobile banking, insurance, and investment advisory services, borrowing, and treasury management. Its customers include sole proprietors, small and medium-sized businesses, partnerships, corporations, non-profit organizations and associations, and investors living and working in and near the bank's primary service area. The company was founded on October 28, 1997 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Eagle Bancorp, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營，提供商業銀行服務。它提供支票帳戶、企業儲蓄帳戶、線上和行動銀行、保險、投資諮詢服務、借款和資金管理。其客戶包括獨資經營者、中小型企業、合夥企業、公司、非營利組織和協會，以及在銀行主要服務區域內和附近生活和工作的投資者。該公司成立於1997年10月28日，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Electra Battery Materials Corp. engages in the refining, acquisition, and exploration of resource properties. Its project portfolio includes Iron Creek, Becancour, Ontario Refinery and North American Nickel. The company was founded on July 13, 2011 and is headquartered Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Electra Battery Materials Corp. 從事資源資產的精煉、收購和勘探。其項目組合包括 Iron Creek、Becancour、Ontario Refinery 和 North American Nickel。該公司成立於2011年7月13日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: LCNB Corp. is a financial holding company, which offers commercial and personal banking services. It offers services such as checking rates, debit card resources, electronic banking, fraud and identity theft, education and awareness. The company was founded in December 1998 and is headquartered in Lebanon, OH.
info.description_zh: LCNB Corp. 是一家金融控股公司，提供商業和個人銀行服務。它提供的服務包括查詢利率、金融卡資源、電子銀行、詐欺和身分盜用、教育和意識等。該公司成立於 1998 年 12 月，總部位於俄亥俄州黎巴嫩。

info.description: Reading International, Inc. is an entertainment and real estate company, which engages in the development, ownership, and operation of multiplex cinemas and retail and commercial real estate in the United States, Australia, and New Zealand. It operates through the Cinema Exhibition and Real Estate segments. The Cinema Exhibition segment includes Reading Cinemas, Angelika Film Center, Consolidated Theatres, City Cinemas, 44 Union Square, and Liberty Theatres brands. The Real Estate segment consists of real estate development and the rental or licensing of retail, commercial and live theater assets. The company was founded by James J. Cotter Sr. in 1999 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Reading International, Inc.是一家娛樂和房地產公司，在美國、澳洲和紐西蘭從事多廳影院以及零售和商業房地產的開發、擁有和營運。它透過電影展覽和房地產部門運作。電影展覽部分包括 Reading Cinemas、Angelika Film Center、Consolidated Theatres、City Cinemas、44 Union Square 和 Liberty Theaters 品牌。房地產部門包括房地產開發以及零售、商業和現場劇院資產的租賃或許可。該公司由 James J. Cotter Sr. 於 1999 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Canadian Solar, Inc. engages in the manufacture of solar photovoltaic modules, provision of solar energy and battery storage solutions, and development of utility-scale solar and battery storage products. It operates through the CSI Solar and Global Energy segments. The CSI Solar segment designs, develops, and manufactures solar ingots, wafers, cells, modules, and other solar power and battery storage products. The Global Energy segment includes solar and battery storage project development and sale, asset management services for operational projects, sale of electricity, and investment in retained assets. The company was founded by Shawn Qu in October 2001 and is headquartered in Kitchener, Canada.
info.description_zh: 阿特斯陽光電力有限公司從事太陽能光伏組件製造、提供太陽能和電池儲存解決方案以及開發公用事業規模太陽能和電池儲存產品。它透過 CSI Solar 和 Global Energy 部門運作。 CSI Solar部門設計、開發和製造太陽能錠、矽片、電池、模組以及其他太陽能和電池儲存產品。全球能源部門包括太陽能和電池儲存項目的開發和銷售、營運項目的資產管理服務、電力銷售以及保留資產的投資。該公司由Shawn Qu於2001年10月創立，總部位於加拿大基奇納。

info.description: Arhaus, Inc. engages in the retail of furniture, outdoor, lighting, textiles, and decor. The company was founded by John Reed in 1986 and is headquartered in Hudson, OH.
info.description_zh: Arhaus, Inc. 從事家具、戶外用品、照明、紡織品和裝飾品的零售。該公司由 John Reed 於 1986 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州哈德遜。

info.description: Accenture is a global professional services company that helps the world's businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services, creating tangible value at speed and scale. The firm combines technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Its services include Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X, and Song. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, EMEA, and Growth Markets. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: 埃森哲是一家全球專業服務公司，幫助世界各地的企業、政府和其他組織建立數位核心、優化營運、加速收入成長並增強公民服務，從而快速、大規模地創造有形價值。該公司將雲端、數據和人工智慧方面的技術和領導力與行業經驗、職能專業知識和全球交付能力相結合。其服務包括策略與諮詢、技術、營運、Industry X 和 Song。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美、歐洲、中東和非洲和成長型市場。該公司成立於1989年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Lyft, Inc. engages in the provision and management of an online social rideshare community platform. It offers access to a network of shared bikes and scooters for shorter rides and first mile and last-mile legs of multimodal trips, information about nearby public transit routes, and Lyft Rentals to offer riders a view of transportation options when planning any trip. The company was founded by Marcus Cohn, John Zimmer, Rajat Suri, Matt van Horn, and Logan D. Green on March 5, 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Lyft, Inc. 從事線上社交乘車共享社群平台的提供和管理。它提供共享自行車和踏板車網路的存取權限，以實現短途騎行以及多式聯運的第一英里和最後一英里行程、附近公共交通路線的資訊以及Lyft Rentals，以便乘客在計劃任何旅行時了解交通選擇。該公司由 Marcus Cohn、John Zimmer、Rajat Suri、Matt van Horn 和 Logan D. Green 於 2007 年 3 月 5 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Themes Transatlantic Defense ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Transatlantic Aerospace and Defense Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that have business operations in the aerospace and defense industry and are headquartered in a country that is a member of NATO. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities that comprise the index and ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Transatlantic Defense ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive 跨大西洋航空航太和國防指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該指數旨在為在航空航太和國防工業開展業務且總部位於北約成員國的公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Veeva Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of industry cloud solutions for the global life sciences industry. The firm's solutions enable pharmaceutical and other life sciences companies to realize the benefits of modern cloud-based architectures and mobile applications for their most critical business functions, without compromising industry-specific functionality or regulatory compliance. Its customer relationship management solutions enable its customers to increase the productivity and compliance of their sales and marketing functions. The firm's regulated content management and collaboration solutions enable its customers to more efficiently manage regulated, content-centric processes across the enterprise. Its customer master solution enables customers to more effectively manage complex healthcare provider and healthcare organization data. The company was founded by Mark Armenante, Peter P. Gassner, Doug Ostler, Mitch Wallace and Matthew J. Wallach on January 12, 2007 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, CA.
info.description_zh: Veeva Systems, Inc. 致力於為全球生命科學產業提供產業雲端解決方案。該公司的解決方案使製藥和其他生命科學公司能夠實現現代基於雲端的架構和行動應用程式對其最關鍵業務功能的好處，而不會影響行業特定的功能或法規遵循。其客戶關係管理解決方案使客戶能夠提高其銷售和行銷職能的生產力和合規性。該公司的受監管內容管理和協作解決方案使其客戶能夠更有效地管理整個企業受監管、以內容為中心的流程。其客戶主解決方案使客戶能夠更有效地管理複雜的醫療保健提供者和醫療保健組織資料。該公司由 Mark Armenante、Peter P. Gassner、Doug Ostler、Mitch Wallace 和 Matthew J. Wallach 於 2007 年 1 月 12 日創立，總部位於加州普萊森頓。

info.description: Paysign, Inc. engages in the provision of prepaid card programs and processing services for corporate, consumer & government applications. It specializes in corporate incentive products, payroll cards, general purpose re-loadable cards, and travel cards. The firm markets prepaid solutions through its PaySign brand. The company was founded by Mark R. Newcomer and Daniel H. Spencer on August 24, 1995 and is headquartered in Henderson, NV.
info.description_zh: Paysign, Inc. 致力於為企業、消費者和政府應用程式提供預付卡程序和處理服務。該公司專注於企業獎勵產品、薪資卡、通用可充值卡和旅行卡。該公司透過其 PaySign 品牌銷售預付費解決方案。該公司由 Mark R. Newcomer 和 Daniel H. Spencer 於 1995 年 8 月 24 日創立，總部位於內華達州亨德森。

info.description: Roundhill Glp-1 & Weight Loss ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The fund's manager will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the equity securities of GLP-1 & Weight Loss Companies or any derivative instruments (such as swap agreements or forward contracts) that utilize one or more GLP-1 & Weight Loss Companies as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Roundhill Glp-1 和減肥 ETF 旨在提供資本增值。基金管理人將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 GLP-1 和減肥公司的股本證券或利用一家或多家 GLP-1 和減肥公司作為參考資產的任何衍生工具（例如掉期協議或遠期合約）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: EVgo, Inc. engages in the provision of electric vehicle charging station services. It offers the EVgo network, home charging solutions, work charging solutions, and freedom station plans to electric car owners. The company was founded in October 2010 and is headquartered in El Segundo, CA.
info.description_zh: EVgo, Inc. 從事提供電動車充電站服務。它為電動車車主提供 EVgo 網路、家庭充電解決方案、工作充電解決方案和自由站計劃。該公司成立於 2010 年 10 月，總部位於加州埃爾塞貢多。

info.description: Fox Factory Holding Corp. engages in designing, engineering, manufacturing and marketing performance ride dynamics products. The firm offers bicycles, side-by-sides and on-road vehicles with off-road capabilities, off-road vehicles and trucks, all - terrain vehicles, snowmobiles, specialty vehicles and applications and motorcycles. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Asia, Europe and Rest of the World. The company was founded on December 28, 2007 and is headquartered in Duluth, GA.
info.description_zh: Fox Factory Holding Corp. 從事設計、工程、製造和行銷高性能駕駛動力產品。該公司提供自行車、並排式和具有越野功能的公路車、越野車和卡車、全地形車、雪地車、特殊車輛和應用以及摩托車。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美、亞洲、歐洲和世界其他地區。該公司成立於2007年12月28日，總部位於喬治亞州德盧斯。

info.description: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc. engages in the design, development, and commercialization of products for people with insulin-dependent diabetes. Its products include Tandem Mobi System and t:slim X2 Insulin Pump. The company was founded by Paul M. DiPerna on January 27, 2006 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc. 致力於為胰島素依賴型糖尿病患者設計、開發和商業化產品。其產品包括 Tandem Mobi System 和 t:slim X2 胰島素幫浦。該公司由 Paul M. DiPerna 於 2006 年 1 月 27 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Stagwell, Inc. operates as media and public relations agency. It delivers brands that connect culture-moving creativity with technology to harmonize the art and science of marketing. It operates through the following segments: Integrated Agencies Network, Brand Performance Network and Communications Network. The Integrated Agencies Network segment includes five operating segments: the Anomaly Alliance, Constellation, the Doner Partner Network, Code and Theory Network, and National Research Group. The Brand Performance Network consists of a single operating segment. BPN includes a unified media and data management structure with omnichannel media placement, creative media consulting, influencer and business-to-business marketing capabilities. The Communications Network reportable segment consists of a single operating segment, specialist network that provides advocacy, strategic corporate communications, investor relations, public relations, online fundraising and other services to both corporations and political and advocacy organizations and includes Allison, SKDK, Targeted Victory, and Consulum. The Corporate segment includes corporate office expenses. The company was founded on April 29, 2011 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Stagwell, Inc. 是一家媒體和公共關係機構。它提供的品牌將推動文化的創造力與技術聯繫起來，從而協調行銷的藝術和科學。它透過以下部門運作：綜合代理商網路、品牌績效網路和通訊網路。綜合機構網路部門包括五個營運部門：異常聯盟、星座、捐贈者合作夥伴網路、代碼和理論網絡以及國家研究小組。品牌績效網絡由單一營運部門組成。 BPN 包括統一的媒體和資料管理結構，具有全通路媒體投放、創意媒體諮詢、影響者和企業對企業行銷功能。通訊網路報告部門由單一營運部門和專業網絡組成，為企業、政治和宣傳組織提供宣傳、策略企業傳播、投資者關係、公共關係、線上募款和其他服務，包括 Allison、SKDK、Targeted Victory 和 Consulum。公司部門包括公司辦公室費用。該公司成立於2011年4月29日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Omega Flex, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of flexible metal hose and accessories. It offers products to numerous industries, such as steel production, fuel-handling, semiconductor, medical, pharmaceutical, petrochemical, residential and commercial construction, and power generation. Its products include TracPipe CounterStrike, DoubleTrac, Def-Trac, industrial, and Meditrac. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Exton, PA.
info.description_zh: Omega Flex, Inc. 从事柔性金属软管及配件的制造和销售。它為眾多行業提供產品，例如鋼鐵生產、燃料處理、半導體、醫療、製藥、石化、住宅和商業建築以及發電。其產品包括TracPipe CounterStrike、DoubleTrac、Def-Trac、工業和Meditrac。該公司成立於 1975 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州埃克斯頓。

info.description: Global-e Online Ltd. engages in the provision of cross-border e-commerce solutions. It offers Global-e Pro and Global-e enterprise. The firm enables merchants to increase the conversion of international traffic into sales by providing online shoppers across global destinations with a seamless, localized shopping experience. Global-e Online was founded by Shahar Tamari, Amir Schlachet, and Nir Debbi on February 21, 2013 and is headquartered in Petach Tikva, Israel.
info.description_zh: Global-e Online Ltd.從事提供跨境電子商務解決方案。它提供 Global-e Pro 和 Global-e enterprise。該公司為全球目的地的線上購物者提供無縫、在地化的購物體驗，幫助商家提高國際流量轉換為銷售額的能力。 Global-e Online 由 Shahar Tamari、Amir Schlachet 和 Nir ​​Debbi 於 2013 年 2 月 21 日創立，總部位於以色列佩塔提克瓦。

info.description: HealthEquity, Inc. engages in the provision of technology-enabled services for healthcare and spending decisions. The company was founded by Stephen D. Neeleman on September 18, 2002 and is headquartered in Draper, UT.
info.description_zh: HealthEquity, Inc. 致力於為醫療保健和支出決策提供技術支援的服務。該公司由 Stephen D. Neeleman 於 2002 年 9 月 18 日創立，總部位於猶他州德雷珀。

info.description: IAC, Inc. engages in media and Internet business. It operates through the following segments: Dotdash Meredith, Angi Inc, Search, and Emerging and Other. The Dotdash Meredith segment provides digital and print publishing services from mobile to magazines. The ANGI Homeservices segment offers repairing, remodeling, cleaning, and landscaping through category-transforming products under HomeAdvisor, Angie's List, Handy, and Fixd Repair brands. The Search segment consists of Ask Media Group, which provides general search services and information. The Emerging and Other segment includes platforms Care.com, Bluecrew, NurseFly Mosaic Group, Vivian Health, The Daily Beast, IAC Films, and Newco. The company was founded on August 24, 1995, and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: IAC, Inc.从事媒体和互联网业务。该公司通过以下部门运营：Dotdash Meredith、Angi Inc、Search、Emerging and Other。 Dotdash Meredith 部门提供从手机到杂志的数字和印刷出版服务。 ANGI Homeservices 部門透過 HomeAdvisor、Angie's List、Handy 和 Fixd Repair 品牌下的類別轉型產品提供維修、改造、清潔和景觀美化服務。搜索部门由 Ask Media Group 组成，该集团提供一般搜索服务和信息。新兴和其他部门包括 Care.com、Bluecrew、NurseFly Mosaic Group、Vivian Health、The Daily Beast、IAC Films 和 Newco 等平台。该公司成立于1995年8月24日，总部位于纽约州纽约市。

info.description: Payoneer Global, Inc. is a financial technology company, which engages in providing a financial platform for small and medium-sized businesses to transact and do business. It operates through the Israel, United States, and All Other Countries geographical segments. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Payoneer Global, Inc.是一家金融科技公司，致力於為中小型企業提供交易和開展業務的金融平台。它透過以色列、美國和所有其他國家的地理部門開展業務。該公司成立於2005年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Aya Gold & Silver, Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration and development of mineral properties. Its portfolio include Zgounder, Imiter bis, Boumadine, Amizmiz, and Azegour properties. Zgounder, Boumadine, Tirzzit, Tijirit, Imiter bis, Amizmiz, Azegour and Reserves & Resources. The company was founded by Rejean Gosselin on December 19, 2007 and is headquartered in Montreal, Canada.
info.description_zh: Aya Gold & Silver, Inc. 從事礦產收購、勘探和開發。其投資組合包括 Zgounder、Imiter bis、Boumadine、Amizmiz 和 Azegour 房地產。 Zgounder、Boumadine、Tirzzit、Tijirit、Imiter bis、Amizmiz、Azegour 以及儲備和資源。該公司由Rejean Gosselin於2007年12月19日創立，總部位於加拿大蒙特婁。

info.description: Denali Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of a portfolio of product candidates for neurodegenerative diseases. Its product pipeline includes LRRK2, RIPK1, TREM2, and Tau. The company was founded by Ryan J. Watts, Marc Tessier-Lavigne, and Alexander Schuth on October 14, 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Denali Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於神經退化性疾病候選產品組合的開發和商業化。其產品管線包括LRRK2、RIPK1、TREM2和Tau。該公司由 Ryan J. Watts、Marc Tessier-Lavigne 和 Alexander Schuth 於 2013 年 10 月 14 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Fiserv, Inc. engages in the provision of financial services technology. It operates through the Merchant and Financial segments. The Merchant segment offers commerce-enabling products and services including merchant acquiring and digital commerce and mobile payment services, and security and fraud protection, stored-value, and pay-by-bank solutions to companies of all sizes. The Financial segment provides products and services such as processing of customer loan and deposit accounts, digital payments, and card transactions to financial institutions and corporate and public sector clients. The company was founded by Leslie M. Muma and George D. Dalton on July 31, 1984 and is headquartered in Milwaukee, WI.
info.description_zh: Fiserv, Inc. 從事提供金融服務技術。它透過商業和金融部門運作。商家部門為各種規模的公司提供商業支援產品和服務，包括商家收單、數位商務和行動支付服務，以及安全和詐欺保護、儲值和銀行支付解決方案。金融部門向金融機構以及企業和公共部門客戶提供客戶貸款和存款帳戶處理、數位支付和卡片交易等產品和服務。該公司由 Leslie M. Muma 和 George D. Dalton 於 1984 年 7 月 31 日創立，總部位於威斯康辛州密爾瓦基。

info.description: Alaunos Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company and clinical-stage oncology-focused cell therapy company, which engages in the development of adoptive TCR engineered T-cell therapies, or TCR-T, designed to treat multiple solid tumor types in large cancer patient populations with unmet clinical needs. Its pipeline includes Library TCR-T cell and mblL-15 TCR-T cell Therapy. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL.
info.description_zh: Alaunos Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司和專注於臨床階段腫瘤學的細胞治療公司，致力於開發過繼性 TCR 工程 T 細胞療法 (TCR-T)，旨在治療臨床需求未得到滿足的大型癌症患者群體中的多種實體瘤類型。其管道包括 Library TCR-T 細胞和 mblL-15 TCR-T 細胞療法。該公司成立於 2003 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州勞德代爾堡。

info.description: Dyne Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage company, which engages in developing innovative life-transforming therapies for genetically driven muscle diseases. It develops a broad portfolio of therapeutics for muscle diseases, including lead programs in myotonic dystrophy type 1, Duchenne muscular dystrophy, and facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy. The company was founded by Jason P. Rhodes and Romesh R. Subramanian on December 1, 2017 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Dyne Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段公司，致力於開發針對遺傳驅動的肌肉疾病的創新的改變生命的療法。該公司開發了廣泛的肌肉疾病治療藥物組合，包括 1 型強直性肌肉營養不良症、杜氏肌肉營養不良症和麵肩肱型肌肉營養不良症的主導項目。該公司由 Jason P. Rhodes 和 Romesh R. Subramanian 於 2017 年 12 月 1 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Versamet Royalties Corp. engages in the business of acquiring and managing royalties, streams, and other similar interests on metals and mining operations and projects globally. It focuses on precious metals, copper, and other diversified metals. Its portfolio includes the Kolpa, Kiaka, and Greenstone projects. The company was founded on January 31, 2022 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Versamet Royalties Corp. 從事收購和管理全球金屬和採礦業務及專案的特許權使用費、資源和其他類似權益的業務。它專注於貴金屬、銅和其他多元化金屬。其投資組合包括 Kolpa、Kiaka 和 Greenstone 項目。該公司成立於2022年1月31日，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Stitch Fix, Inc. engages in the provision of personalized shipments of apparel, shoes, and accessories. Its main sections are men's, kids, petite, maternity, and plus apparels. The company was founded by Katrina Lake and Erin Morrison Flynn in February, 2011 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Stitch Fix, Inc. 從事服裝、鞋子和配件的個人化運輸服務。其主要品類有男裝、童裝、小裝、孕婦裝和大尺碼服裝。該公司由 Katrina Lake 和 Erin Morrison Flynn 於 2011 年 2 月創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: AvePoint, Inc. operates as a digital collaboration innovator, which provides data management services. It develops, markets, and sells its suite of software solutions and services in North America, Europe, Australia, and Asia. The company was founded on July 24, 2001 and is headquartered in Jersey City, NJ.
info.description_zh: AvePoint, Inc. 是一家提供資料管理服務的數位協作創新者。該公司在北美、歐洲、澳洲和亞洲開發、行銷和銷售其軟體解決方案和服務套件。該公司成立於2001年7月24日，總部位於新澤西州澤西市。

info.description: Trump Media & Technology Group Corp. engages in operating social media and in the technology business. Its brands include TRUTH Social, TMTG+, and TMTG News. It operates through the Media and Truth.Fi segments. The Media segment includes products and services such as advertisement through the Truth Social platform. The Truth.Fi segment relates to customized exchange-traded funds or exchange-traded products invested in America First principles, and bitcoin and similar cryptocurrencies or crypto-related securities. The company was founded on March 28, 2024 and is headquartered in Sarasota, FL.
info.description_zh: Trump Media & Technology Group Corp. 從事社群媒體營運和技術業務。其品牌包括 TRUTH Social、TMTG+ 和 TMTG News。它透過 Media 和 Truth.Fi 部門運作。媒體部門包括產品和服務，例如透過 Truth Social 平台進行廣告。 Truth.Fi 部門涉及投資於美國優先原則的客製化交易所交易基金或交易所交易產品，以及比特幣和類似的加密貨幣或加密相關證券。該公司成立於2024年3月28日，總部位於佛羅裡達州薩拉索塔。

info.description: AXS 2X Innovation ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of the ARK Innovation ETF. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the ARK Innovation ETF. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AXS 2X Innovation ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 ARK Innovation ETF 每日業績的 200%。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一份或多份互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，根據該協議，基金和全球金融機構將同意交換在ARK Innovation ETF上賺取或實現的回報（或回報率差異）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Upstart Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of a cloud-based artificial intelligence lending platform. It operates through the following segments: Personal Lending, Auto Lending, and Other. The Personal Lending segment focuses on unsecured personal loans and small dollar loans. The Auto Lending segment is involved in auto refinance and auto retail loans. The Other segment refers to HELOCs and other. The company was founded by David Joseph Girouard, Anna Mongayt Counselman, and Paul Gu in December 2013 and is headquartered in San Mateo, CA.
info.description_zh: Upstart Holdings, Inc. 從事提供基於雲端的人工智慧借貸平台。它透過以下部門運作：個人貸款、汽車貸款和其他。個人貸款部門專注於無擔保個人貸款和小額美元貸款。汽車貸款部門涉及汽車再融資和汽車零售貸款。其他部分是指 HELOC 和其他。該公司由 David Joseph Girouard、Anna Mongayt Counselman 和 Paul Gu 於 2013 年 12 月創立，總部位於加州聖馬刁。

info.description: The Hershey Co. engages in the manufacture and marketing of chocolate, sweets, mints and confectionery products. The firm operates through the following segments: North America Confectionery, North America Salty Snacks and International. The North America Confectionery segment is responsible for the traditional chocolate and non-chocolate confectionery market position of the company, as well as its grocery and snacks market positions, in the United States and Canada. The North America Salty Snacks segment is responsible for the salty snack products in the United States. The International segment includes the combination of all other operating segments, including those geographic regions where the company operates outside of North America. Its brands include Hershey's, Reese's, and Kisses. The company was founded by Milton S. Hershey in 1894 and is headquartered in Hershey, PA.
info.description_zh: 好時公司從事巧克力、糖果、薄荷糖和糖果產品的製造和行銷。該公司透過以下部門營運：北美糖果部門、北美鹹味零食部門和國際部門。北美糖果部門負責公司在美國和加拿大的傳統巧克力和非巧克力糖果市場地位，以及雜貨和零食市場地位。北美鹹味零食部門負責美國的鹹味零食產品。國際部門包括所有其他營運部門的組合，包括公司在北美以外營運的地理區域。其品牌包括 Hershey's、Reese's 和 Kisses。該公司由 Milton S. Hershey 於 1894 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州好時市。

info.description: Clarus Corp engages in the development, manufacture, and distribution of outdoor equipment and lifestyle products. The firm's brands include Black Diamond, Rhino-Rack, MAXTRAX, and RockyMounts. It operates through Outdoor and Adventure segments. The Outdoor segment manufactures outdoor engineered equipment and apparel for climbing, mountaineering, trail running, backpacking, skiing, and a wide range of other year-round outdoor recreation activities. The Adventure segment sells automotive roof racks, trays, mounting systems, luggage boxes, carriers, and accessories. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Clarus Corp 從事戶外設備和生活風格產品的開發、製造和分銷。該公司的品牌包括 Black Diamond、Rhino-Rack、MAXTRAX 和 RockyMounts。它透過戶外和探險部門運作。戶外部門生產用於攀岩、登山、越野跑、背包旅行、滑雪和各種其他全年戶外休閒活動的戶外工程設備和服裝。 Adventure 部門銷售汽車車頂架、托盤、安裝系統、行李箱、托架和配件。該公司成立於 1989 年，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long RDDT Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Reddit Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long RDDT Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為 Reddit Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過輸入標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: CRISPR Therapeutics AG is a gene editing company, which engages in the development of transformative gene-based medicines for serious diseases using its proprietary CRISPR/Cas9 platform. Its CRISPR/Cas9 platform is a gene editing technology that allows for precise, directed changes to genomic DNA. The firm offers a portfolio of therapeutic programs across a broad range of disease areas including hemoglobinopathies, oncology, regenerative medicine, and rare diseases. The company was founded by Rodger Novak, Emmanuelle Charpentier, Shaun Patrick Foy, Matthew Porteus, Daniel Anderson, Chad Cowan, and Craig Mellow on October 31, 2013 and is headquartered in Zug, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: CRISPR Therapeutics AG 是一家基因編輯公司，利用其專有的 CRISPR/Cas9 平台開發針對嚴重疾病的轉化基因藥物。其 CRISPR/Cas9 平台是一種基因編輯技術，可對基因組 DNA 進行精確、定向的改變。該公司提供涵蓋廣泛疾病領域的治療項目組合，包括血紅蛋白病、腫瘤學、再生醫學和罕見疾病。該公司由 Rodger Novak、Emmanuelle Charpentier、Shaun Patrick Foy、Matthew Porteus、Daniel Anderson、Chad Cowan 和 Craig Mellow 於 2013 年 10 月 31 日創立，總部位於瑞士楚格。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long IREN Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of IREN. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of IREN, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 IREN 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支），為 IREN 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 IREN 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Morningstar, Inc. engages in the provision of investment research. It offers Morningstar data, direct, investment management, advisor workstation, workplace solutions, pitchbook data, enterprise components, research, credit ratings and indexes. It operates through the following segments: Morningstar Data and Analytics, PitchBook, Morningstar Wealth, Morningstar Credit, Morningstar Retirement, and Corporate and All Other. The Morningstar Data and Analytics segment is involved in providing investors data, research and insights, and investment analysis to empower investment decision-making. The PitchBook segment focuses on providing investors with access to a broad collection of data and research covering the private capital markets, including venture capital, private equity, private credit and bank loans, and merger and acquisition activities. The Morningstar Wealth segment refers to model portfolios and wealth platform, practice and portfolio management software for registered investment advisers, data aggregation, enrichment capabilities, and individual investor platform. The Morningstar Credit segment includes credit ratings, research, data, and credit analytics solutions that contribute to the transparency of international and domestic credit markets. The Morningstar Retirement segment offers products designed to help individuals reach retirement goals. The company was founded by Joseph D. Mansueto on May 16, 1984, and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: Morningstar, Inc. 從事提供投資研究。它提供晨星數據、直接、投資管理、顧問工作站、工作場所解決方案、宣傳冊數據、企業組件、研究、信用評級和指數。它透過以下部門運作：晨星數據和分析部門、PitchBook部門、晨星財富部門、晨星信貸部門、晨星退休部門以及企業和所有其他部門。晨星數據和分析部門致力於為投資者提供數據、研究和見解以及投資分析，以促進投資決策。 PitchBook 部門專注於為投資者提供涵蓋私人資本市場的廣泛數據和研究，包括風險投資、私募股權、私人信貸和銀行貸款以及併購活動。晨星財富部門是指模型投資組合和財富平台、註冊投資顧問的實踐和投資組合管理軟體、資料聚合、豐富能力和個人投資者平台。晨星信貸部門包括信用評級、研究、數據和信用分析解決方案，有助於提高國際和國內信貸市場的透明度。晨星退休部門提供旨在幫助個人實現退休目標的產品。該公司由 Joseph D. Mansueto 於 1984 年 5 月 16 日創立，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: CuriosityStream, Inc. is a media and entertainment company. It offers video and audio programming across the principal categories of factual entertainment, including science, history, society, nature, lifestyle, and technology. The company was founded by John S. Hendricks on June 06, 2008 and is headquartered in Silver Spring, MD.
info.description_zh: CuriosityStream, Inc. 是一家媒體和娛樂公司。它提供橫跨事實娛樂主要類別的視訊和音訊節目，包括科學、歷史、社會、自然、生活方式和技術。該公司由 John S. Hendricks 於 2008 年 6 月 6 日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州銀泉。

info.description: Upbound Group, Inc. engages in the provision of furniture, electronics, appliances, computers, and smartphones through flexible rental purchase agreements. It operates through the following segments: Rent-A-Center Business, Preferred Lease, Mexico, and Franchising. The Rent-A-Center Business segment consists of company-owned rent-to-own stores in the United States and Puerto Rico. The Preferred Lease segment offers an on-site rent-to-own option at a third-party retailer's location. The Mexico segment consists of its company-owned rent-to-own stores in Mexico. The Franchising segment sells rental merchandise to its franchisees. The company was founded by Mark E. Speese on September 16, 1986 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Upbound Group, Inc. 透過靈活的租賃購買協議提供家具、電子產品、電器、電腦和智慧型手機。該公司透過以下部門營運：租賃中心業務部門、優先租賃部門、墨西哥部門和特許經營部門。 Rent-A-Center 業務部門由公司在美國和波多黎各擁有的先租後買商店組成。首選租賃部門在第三方零售商所在地提供現場先租後買的選擇。墨西哥部門由公司在墨西哥擁有的先租後買商店組成。特許經營部門向其特許經營商出售租賃商品。該公司由 Mark E. Speese 於 1986 年 9 月 16 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: NioCorp Developments Ltd. engages in the evaluation, acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral deposits. It focuses on a super alloy materials project in Nebraska for producing niobium, scandium, and titanium. The company was founded on February 27, 1987, and is headquartered in Centennial, CO.
info.description_zh: NioCorp Developments Ltd. 從事礦藏的評估、收購、勘探和開發。它專注於內布拉斯加州的一個生產鈮、鈧和鈦的超級合金材料項目。該公司成立於1987年2月27日，總部位於科羅拉多州森特尼爾。

info.description: BlackLine, Inc. engages in providing a cloud-based software platform that automates and controls financial close and accounting processes. It operates through the United States and International geographical segments. The company was founded by Therese Tucker in May 2001 and is headquartered in Woodland Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: BlackLine, Inc. 致力於提供基於雲端的軟體平台，可自動執行和控制財務結算和會計流程。它透過美國和國際地理部門開展業務。該公司由 Therese Tucker 於 2001 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州伍德蘭希爾斯。

info.description: Outset Medical, Inc. engages in the provision of dialysis solutions to patients and healthcare providers. Its product, Tablo Hemodialysis System (Tablo), offers technological advancement enabling novel, transformational dialysis care in acute and home settings. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Outset Medical, Inc. 致力於為患者和醫療保健提供者提供透析解決方案。其產品 Tablo 血液透析系統 (Tablo) 提供了先進的技術，可在急診和家庭環境中實現新穎的、變革性的透析護理。該公司成立於 2003 年，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Lands' End, Inc. operates as a digital retailer of solution-based apparel, swimwear, outerwear, accessories, footwear, home products and uniforms. It operates through the following segments: U.S. eCommerce, Europe eCommerce, Outfitters, Third Party, and Retail. The U.S. eCommerce segment offers products through its eCommerce website. The Europe eCommerce segment provides products direct to consumers located in Europe through eCommerce international websites and third-party marketplace websites. The Outfitters segment focuses on the sale of uniforms and logo apparel to businesses, its employees, and to student households through school relationships. The Third Party segment engages in the sale of products direct to consumers through third-party marketplace websites. The Licensing segment earns royalties on the use of its trademark and any fulfillment fees for fulfillment services provided by the firm. The Retail segment engages in the sale of products through company operated stores located in the U.S. The company was founded by Gary C. Comer in 1963 and is headquartered in Dodgeville, WI.
info.description_zh: Lands' End, Inc. 是一家數位零售商，銷售以解決方案為基礎的服裝、泳裝、外套、配件、鞋類、家居產品和製服。它透過以下部門運作：美國電子商務、歐洲電子商務、服裝、第三方和零售。美國電子商務部門透過其電子商務網站提供產品。歐洲電子商務部門透過電子商務國際網站和第三方市場網站直接向歐洲消費者提供產品。 Outfitters 部門專注於向企業、其員工以及透過學校關係向學生家庭銷售制服和標誌服裝。第三方部門透過第三方市場網站直接向消費者銷售產品。許可部門透過使用其商標賺取特許權使用費以及公司提供的履行服務的任何履行費用。零售部門透過位於美國的公司自營商店銷售產品。該公司由 Gary C. Comer 於 1963 年創立，總部位於威斯康辛州道奇維爾。

info.description: Karyopharm Therapeutics, Inc. is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of drugs directed against nuclear export for the treatment of cancer and other diseases. The company was founded by Joseph Araujo, Ronald A. DePinho, Pamela A. Silver, Giulio Draetta, Michael G. Kauffman, and Sharon Shacham on December 22, 2008 and is headquartered in Newton, MA.
info.description_zh: Karyopharm Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家商業階段的製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和商業化針對核輸出的藥物，用於治療癌症和其他疾病。該公司由 Joseph Araujo、Ronald A. DePinho、Pamela A. Silver、Giulio Draetta、Michael G. Kauffman 和 Sharon Shacham 於 2008 年 12 月 22 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州牛頓。

info.description: WisdomTree Inflation Plus Fund seeks total return. The fund is actively managed using a model-based approach. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, either directly or through a wholly owned subsidiary, in a portfolio primarily composed of inflation-protected U.S. Treasury Bonds ("TIPS") and other debt securities issued by the U.S. Treasury, including bills, notes, bonds, and floating rate public obligations of the U.S. Treasury ("Floating Rate Notes"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree Inflation Plus 基金追求總回報。該基金採用基於模型的方法進行積極管理。該基金尋求透過直接或透過全資子公司投資於主要由通膨保值美國國債（「TIPS」）和美國財政部發行的其他債務證券（包括票據、票據、債券和美國財政部浮動利率公共債務（「浮動利率票據」））組成的投資組合來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Interparfums, Inc. engages in the business of manufacturing, marketing, and distributing a wide array of fragrances and related products. It operates through the United States and European geographical segments. The United States segment includes the sale of prestige brand name fragrances. The European segment conducts primarily in France. The company was founded by Jean Madar and Philippe Benacin in 1982 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Interparfums, Inc. 從事製造、行銷和分銷各種香水及相關產品的業務。它透過美國和歐洲的地理部門開展業務。美國部門包括銷售知名品牌香水。歐洲部分主要在法國進行。該公司由 Jean Madar 和 Philippe Benacin 於 1982 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: RenovoRx, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of a therapy platform to deliver chemotherapy. Its therapy platform includes RenovoTAMP, a therapy platform designed for targeted delivery of chemotherapy enabling localized treatment of solid tumors. The company was founded by Ramtin Agah and Kamran Najmabadi in 2009 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.

info.description: Telos Corp. engages in the design and provision of advanced technologies solutions and services. It operates through the following segments: Security Solutions and Secure Networks. The Security Solutions segment focuses on cybersecurity, cloud, identity solutions, and secure messaging. The Secure Networks segment provides secure networking architectures and solutions to its customers through secure mobility solutions and network management and defense services. The company was founded in October 1971 and is headquartered in Ashburn, VA.
info.description_zh: Telos Corp. 從事先進技術解決方案和服務的設計和提供。它透過以下部門運作：安全解決方案和安全網路。安全解決方案部門專注於網路安全、雲端、身分解決方案和安全訊息傳遞。安全網路部門透過安全移動解決方案以及網路管理和防禦服務為客戶提供安全網路架構和解決方案。該公司成立於 1971 年 10 月，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿什本。

info.description: First Guaranty Bancshares, Inc. engages in the provision of personalized commercial banking services to businesses, professionals, and individuals. Its services include personal checking, money market, loans, courtesy sweep, business checking, cash management, courtesy pay, and digital. The company was founded on July 27, 2007 and is headquartered in Hammond, LA.
