info.description: MillerKnoll, Inc. engages in the research, design, manufacturing, and distribution of interior furnishings. It operates through the following segments: North America Contract, International Contract, and Global Retail. The North America Contract segment refers to the operations involving design, sourcing, manufacture, and sale of furniture products directly and indirectly through an independent dealership network for office, healthcare, and educational environments throughout the United States and Canada. The International Contract segment pertains to the operations concerning furniture products directly or indirectly through an independent dealership network in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. The Global Retail segment is involved in global operations associated with the sale of modern design furnishings and accessories to third party retailers. The company was founded by Dirk Jan de Pree in 1905 and is headquartered in Zeeland, MI.
info.description_zh: MillerKnoll, Inc. 從事室內家具的研究、設計、製造和分銷。它透過以下部門運作：北美合約部門、國際合約部門和全球零售部門。北美合約部門是指透過遍布美國和加拿大的辦公、醫療保健和教育環境的獨立經銷商網路直接和間接涉及家具產品的設計、採購、製造和銷售的業務。國際合約部門涉及透過歐洲、中東、非洲、亞太和拉丁美洲的獨立經銷商網路直接或間接涉及家具產品的運作。全球零售部門參與與向第三方零售商銷售現代設計家具和配件相關的全球業務。該公司由 Dirk Jan de Pree 於 1905 年創立，總部位於密西根州澤蘭。

info.description: Agios Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in a research engine, multiple novels, and investigational therapies in preclinical development. It focuses on cellular metabolism and classical hematology. The company was founded by Lewis Clayton Cantley, Tak W. Mak, Craig B. Thompson and Shin-Shan Michael Su on August 7, 2007 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Agios Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，從事研究引擎、多種小說和臨床前開發的研究療法。它专注于细胞代谢和经典血液学。該公司由 Lewis Clayton Cantley、Tak W. Mak、Craig B. Thompson 和 Shin-Shan Michael Su 於 2007 年 8 月 7 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Citi Trends, Inc. engages in the retail of urban fashion apparel, accessories, and home trends. It offers products under its Citi Steps and Red Ape brands. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Savannah, GA.
info.description_zh: Citi Trends, Inc. 從事都市時尚服飾、配件和家居潮流的零售。該公司提供 Citi Steps 和 Red Ape 品牌的產品。該公司成立於 1946 年，總部位於喬治亞州薩凡納。

info.description: Filana Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the development of novel drugs and diagnostics. It focuses on developing product candidates intended for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, including PTI-125 and PTI-125Dx. The company was founded by Remi Barbier in May 1998 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Filana Therapeutics, Inc. 從事新藥和診斷方法的開發。它專注於開髮用於治療阿茲海默症的候選產品，包括 PTI-125 和 PTI-125Dx。該公司由 Remi Barbier 於 1998 年 5 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Repay Holdings Corp. engages in the provision of integrated payment processing solutions to vertical markets that have specific and bespoke transactions. It offers payments, instant funding, active safe, AP automation, clearing and settlement, messaging management, STX mortgage transfer automation, virtual debit cards, and value-added services. The firm operates through the Consumer Payments and Business Payments segments. The Consumer Payments segment provides solutions such as debit and credit card processing, ACH processing and other electronic payment acceptance solutions. The Business Payments segment provides payment processing solutions, which includes accounts payable automation, debit and credit card processing, virtual credit card processing, ACH processing and other electronic payment acceptance solutions The company was founded by John Morris and Shaler A. Alias in 2006 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Repay Holdings Corp. 致力於為具有特定和客製化交易的垂直市場提供整合支付處理解決方案。它提供支付、即時資金、主動安全、AP自動化、清算和結算、訊息管理、STX抵押轉帳自動化、虛擬借記卡和增值服務。該公司透過消費者支付和商業支付部門運作。消費者支付部門提供金融卡和信用卡處理、ACH 處理和其他電子支付受理解決方案等解決方案。商業支付部門提供支付處理解決方案，包括應付帳款自動化、金融卡和信用卡處理、虛擬信用卡處理、ACH 處理和其他電子支付受理解決方案。該公司由 John Morris 和 Shaler A. Alias 於 2006 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: ADTRAN Holdings, Inc. develops and provides network access solutions. It is a global provider of open, disaggregated networking and communications equipment that enable voice, data, video and internet communications across any network infrastructure. It operates through the Network Solutions and Services and Support segments. The Network Solutions segment offers hardware and software products. The Service and Support segment manages a comprehensive portfolio of network design, implementation, maintenance and cloud-hosted services supporting its subscriber, access and aggregation, and optical networking solutions. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Huntsville, AL.
info.description_zh: ADTRAN Holdings, Inc. 開發並提供網路存取解決方案。它是開放式、分類網路和通訊設備的全球供應商，可在任何網路基礎設施上實現語音、資料、視訊和網路通訊。它透過網路解決方案以及服務和支援部門運作。網路解決方案部門提供硬體和軟體產品。服務和支援部門管理全面的網路設計、實施、維護和雲端託管服務組合，支援其訂戶、存取和聚合以及光網路解決方案。該公司成立於 1985 年，總部位於阿拉巴馬州亨茨維爾。

info.description: XTI Aerospace, Inc. engages in the provision of aircraft manufacturing. The firm primarily focuses on the light and mid-size business aircraft market. It operates through the following segments: Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) and Commercial Aviation. The UAS segment provides comprehensive drone solutions to enterprise, government, and defense clients. The Commercial Aviation segment focuses on development of the TriFan 600 VTOL aircraft through research and engineering activities. The company was founded in April 1999 and is headquartered in Addison, TX.
info.description_zh: XTI Aerospace, Inc. 從事飛機製造。該公司主要專注於輕型和中型公務飛機市場。它透過以下部門運作：無人機系統（UAS）和商業航空。 UAS 部門為企業、政府和國防客戶提供全面的無人機解決方案。商業航空部門專注於透過研究和工程活動開發 TriFan 600 VTOL 飛機。該公司成立於 1999 年 4 月，總部位於德克薩斯州艾迪生。

info.description: Beam Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the establishment of integrated platform for precision genetic medicines. Its pipeline includes BEAM-101, BEAM-302, Engineered Stem Cell Antibody Paired Evasion (ESCAPE), BEAM-301, and BEAM-201. The company was founded by David R. Liu, Feng Zhang, Alexis Komor, Nicole Gaudelli, and J. Keith Joung on January 25, 2017 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Beam Therapeutics, Inc.是一家致力於精準基因藥物綜合平台建置的生物科技公司。其管道包括BEAM-101、BEAM-302、工程幹細胞抗體配對規避（ESCAPE）、BEAM-301和BEAM-201。該公司由 David R. Liu、Feng Zhang、Alexis Komor、Nicole Gaudelli 和 J. Keith Joung 於 2017 年 1 月 25 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. It focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of innovative treatments for severe, rare muscle disorders for which there is significant unmet medical need. Its platform utilizes custom-built throughput and translatable systems that measure integrated muscle function in whole organ extracts to identify small molecule precision medicines regulating key proteins in muscle tissue, initially focused on addressing rare neuromuscular and cardiac diseases. The company was founded by Badreddin Edris, Alan Russel and Peter A. Thompson in 2017 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.
info.description_zh: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。它專注於針對嚴重、罕見肌肉疾病的創新療法的發現、開發和商業化，這些疾病的醫療需求尚未得到滿足。其平台利用定制的通量和可翻譯系統來測量整個器官提取物中的綜合肌肉功能，以識別調節肌肉組織中關鍵蛋白質的小分子精準藥物，最初專注於解決罕見的神經肌肉和心臟病。該公司由 Badreddin Edris、Alan Russel 和 Peter A. Thompson 於 2017 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州博爾德。

info.description: Criteo SA is a global technology company, which specializes in digital performance marketing. The firm enables e-commerce companies to leverage large volumes of granular data to engage and convert their customers. It operates through the following segments: Marketing Solutions, Retail Media, and Iponweb. The Marketing Solutions segment is involved in helping advertisers achieve their customer acquisition and retention goals. The Retail Media segment assists retailers in generating high-margin advertising revenues from brands and agencies looking to address multiple marketing goals. The iponweb segment specializes in building real-time advertising technology and trading infrastructure, delivering advanced media buying, selling, and packaging capabilities for media owners, agencies, performance advertisers, and third-party AdTech platforms. The company was founded by Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, Franck Le Ouay, Pascal Gauthier, Laurent Quatrefages and Romain Niccoli on November 3, 2005 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
info.description_zh: Criteo SA 是一家專注於數位效果行銷的全球科技公司。該公司使電子商務公司能夠利用大量精細數據來吸引和轉換客戶。它透過以下部門運作：行銷解決方案部門、零售媒體部門和 Iponweb 部門。行銷解決方案部門致力於幫助廣告商實現其客戶獲取和保留目標。零售媒體部門幫助零售商從尋求實現多種行銷目標的品牌和代理商那裡獲得高利潤的廣告收入。 iponweb 部門專注於建立即時廣告技術和交易基礎設施，為媒體所有者、代理商、效果廣告商和第三方 AdTech 平台提供先進的媒體購買、銷售和打包功能。該公司由 Jean-Baptiste Rudelle、Franck Le Ouay、Pascal Gauthier、Laurent Quatrefages 和 Romain Niccoli 於 2005 年 11 月 3 日創立，總部位於法國巴黎。

info.description: Direxion Daily SHOP Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of SHOP. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of SHOP and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to SHOP, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily SHOP Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 SHOP 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 SHOP 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權，這些組合起來為 SHOP 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. engages in the provision of mission critical products, services and solutions for United States national security priorities. It operates through the Kratos Government Solutions (KGS) and Unmanned Systems (US) segments. The KGS segment consists of an aggregation of KGS operating segments, including microwave electronic products, space, satellite and cyber, training solutions. The US segment refers to the unmanned aerial, unmanned ground, unmanned seaborne and related command, control and communications system businesses. The company was founded on December 19, 1994, and is headquartered in Round Rock, TX.
info.description_zh: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. 致力於為美國國家安全優先事項提供關鍵任務產品、服務和解決方案。它透過 Kratos Government Solutions (KGS) 和 Unmanned Systems (US) 部門運作。 KGS 部門由 KGS 營運部門組成，包括微波電子產品、太空、衛星和網路、培訓解決方案。美國業務涉及無人機、無人地面、無人海上及相關指揮、控制和通訊系統業務。該公司成立於1994年12月19日，總部位於德克薩斯州朗德羅克。

info.description: Dragonfly Energy Holdings Corp. engages in the manufacture and supply of deep cycle lithium-ion batteries. It also focuses on delivering an energy storage solution to enable a more sustainable and reliable smart grid through the future deployment of its proprietary and patented solid-state cell technology. The company was founded on June 23, 2020 and is headquartered in Reno, NV.
info.description_zh: 蜻蜓能源控股公司從事深循環鋰離子電池的製造和供應。它還專注於提供能源儲存解決方案，透過未來部署其專有的專利固態電池技術，實現更永續可靠的智慧電網。該公司成立於2020年6月23日，總部位於內華達州里諾。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long USAR Daily ETF is an actively managed fund targeting 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR). The strategy is a tactical instrument for sophisticated traders, utilizing financial derivatives to provide magnified daily exposure to the underlying company involved in the critical minerals supply chain.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 USAR 每日 ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，目標是 USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該策略是經驗豐富的交易者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生性商品為參與關鍵礦產供應鏈的基礎公司提供放大的每日風險敞口。

info.description: AeroVironment, Inc. is a defense technology company delivering integrated capabilities across air, land, sea, space, and cyber. The company develops and deploys autonomous systems, loitering munitions, counter-UAS technologies, space-based platforms, directed energy systems, and cyber and electronic warfare capabilities-built to meet the mission needs of today's warfighter and tomorrow's conflicts. At the core of these technologies lies AV_Halo, a modular, mission-ready suite of AI-powered software tools that empowers warfighters and enables full-battlefield dominance: detect, decide, deliver. With a national manufacturing footprint and a deep innovation pipeline, AV delivers proven systems and future-defining capabilities at speed, scale, and operational relevance. The company was founded by Paul B. MacCready, Jr. in July 1971 and is headquartered in Arlington, VA.
info.description_zh: AeroVironment, Inc. 是一家國防技術公司，提供跨空中、陸地、海上、太空和網路的綜合能力。該公司開發和部署自主系統、巡飛彈藥、反無人機技術、天基平台、定向能係統以及網路和電子戰能力，旨在滿足當今作戰人員的任務需求和未來的衝突。這些技術的核心是 AV_Halo，這是一套模組化、任務就緒的人工智慧軟體工具套件，可為作戰人員提供支援並實現全戰場主導地位：偵測、決策、交付。 AV 憑藉全​​國製造足跡和深入的創新管道，以速度、規模和營運相關性提供經過驗證的系統和未來定義能力。該公司由 Paul B. MacCready, Jr. 於 1971 年 7 月創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿靈頓。

info.description: Pagaya Technologies Ltd. engages in the development of AI and data networks for the financial industry. Its product deploys data science, machine learning and AI technology to evaluate the customers' applications in real time. The company was founded by Gal Krubiner, Sanjiv Das, Yahav Yulzari, and Avital Pardo on March 20, 2016 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Pagaya Technologies Ltd. 從事金融業人工智慧和數據網路的開發。其產品部署資料科學、機器學習和人工智慧技術來即時評估客戶的應用程式。該公司由 Gal Krubiner、Sanjiv Das、Yahav Yulzari 和 Avital Pardo 於 2016 年 3 月 20 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: The Honest Co., Inc. is a personal care company dedicated to creating cleanly-formulated and sustainably-designed products spanning categories across diapers, wipes, baby personal care, beauty, apparel, household care and wellness. The company is on a mission to challenge ingredients, ideals, and industries through the power of the Honest brand, the Honest team, and the Honest Standard. The Honest Co., Inc. was founded by Jessica Alba, Christopher Gavigan, Sean Kane, Brian S. Lee, and Jessica Marie Warren in 2011 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: The Honest Co., Inc. 是一家個人護理公司，致力於創造清潔配方和永續設計的產品，涵蓋尿布、濕紙巾、嬰兒個人護理、美容、服裝、家庭護理和健康等類別。公司的使命是透過誠實品牌、誠實團隊和誠實標準的力量挑戰成分、理想和行業。 The Honest Co., Inc. 由 Jessica Alba、Christopher Gavigan、Sean Kane、Brian S. Lee 和 Jessica Marie Warren 於 2011 年創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Marqeta, Inc. engages in the creation of digital payment technology. The firm develops a modern card issuing platform, providing infrastructure and tools for building configurable payment cards. It provides its customers issuer processor services and also acts as a card program manager. The company was founded by Jason M. Gardner in 2010 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Marqeta, Inc. 致力於數位支付技術的創建。該公司開發了一個現代化的發卡平台，為建立可配置的支付卡提供基礎設施和工具。它為其客戶提供發卡機構服務並充當卡程序管理器。該公司由 Jason M. Gardner 於 2010 年創立，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: The Joint Corp. engages in the revolutionizing access to chiropractic care by making quality healthcare affordable for patients seeking pain relief and ongoing wellness. It operates through the Corporate Clinics and Franchise Operations segments. The Corporate Clinics segment consists of the operating activities of the company-owned or managed clinics. The Franchise Operations segment includes the operating activities of the franchise business unit. The Joint was founded by Fred Gerretzen, Charles Barnwell, John Leonesio, Todd Welker, Barbara Holland, Steven P. Colmar, Craig P. Colmar, and Richard Rees on March 10, 2010 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.description_zh: Joint Corp. 致力於為尋求緩解疼痛和持續健康的患者提供負擔得起的優質醫療服務，從而徹底改變脊椎按摩治療的獲取方式。它透過企業診所和特許經營業務部門進行運作。企業診所部門包括公司擁有或管理的診所的經營活動。特許經營業務部門包括特許經營業務部門的經營活動。該聯合會由 Fred Gerretzen、Charles Barnwell、John Leonesio、Todd Welker、Barbara Holland、Steven P. Colmar、Craig P. Colmar 和 Richard Rees 於 2010 年 3 月 10 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: Gain Therapeutics, Inc. is a redefining drug discovery company, which identifies and optimizes allosteric binding sites that never targeted before. Its See-Tx target identification platform uses the published 3D structure of enzymes and a proprietary computational technology to discover new allosteric binding sites and predict their druggability. The firm is also unlocking new treatment options to treat disorders characterized by protein misfolding. The company was founded by Khalid Islam in 2017 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Gain Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家重新定義的藥物發現公司，該公司識別並優化以前從未靶向的變構結合位點。其 See-Tx 標靶識別平台使用已發布的酶 3D 結構和專有計算技術來發現新的變構結合位點並預測其成藥性。該公司還正在開發新的治療方案來治療以蛋白質錯誤折疊為特徵的疾病。該公司由 Khalid Islam 於 2017 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Prime Medicine, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in developing one-time curative genetic therapies. The company was founded by David R. Liu on September 13, 2019 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Prime Medicine, Inc. 是一家生技公司，致力於開發一次性治療性基因療法。該公司由 David R. Liu 於 2019 年 9 月 13 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Allot Ltd. engages in the provision of network intelligence and security solutions. The firm's solutions turn network, application, usage, and security data into intelligence. Its products include Allot Secure, Allot Smart, Application Control Gateway, DDoS Secure, and NFV Compliant. The company was founded by Yigal Jacoby and Michael Shurman on November 12, 1996 and is headquartered in Hod-Hasharon, Israel.
info.description_zh: Allot Ltd. 從事提供網路智慧和安全解決方案。該公司的解決方案將網路、應用程式、使用情況和安全資料轉化為情報。其產品包括 Allot Secure、Allot Smart、應用程式控制網關、DDoS Secure 和 NFV Compliant。該公司由 Yigal Jacoby 和 Michael Shurman 於 1996 年 11 月 12 日創立，總部位於以色列 Hod-Hasharon。

info.description: JetBlue Airways Corp. engages in the provision of air transportation services. Its brands include jetBlue, jetBlue Vacations, Paisly, and TrueBlue. It operates through the following geographic segments: Domestic and Canada, Caribbean and Latin America, and Atlantic. The company was founded by David Gary Neeleman in August 1998 and is headquartered in Long Island City, NY.
info.description_zh: 捷藍航空 (JetBlue Airways Corp.) 從事提供航空運輸服務。其品牌包括捷藍航空、捷藍假期、Paisly 和 TrueBlue。它透過以下地理區域運作：國內和加拿大、加勒比海和拉丁美洲以及大西洋。該公司由 David Gary Neeleman 於 1998 年 8 月創立，總部位於紐約長島市。

info.description: Dave, Inc. is a digital banking service. Its products include a budgeting tool to help members manage their upcoming bills to avoid overspending, cash advances through its flagship ExtraCash product to help members avoid punitive overdraft fees, a Side Hustle product, where Dave helps connect members with supplemental work opportunities, and Dave Banking, a modern checking account experience with valuable tools for building long-term financial health. The company was founded by Jason Wilk, Paras Chitrakar, and John Wolanin in October 2015 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Dave, Inc. 是一家數位銀行服務公司。其產品包括預算工具，幫助會員管理即將到來的帳單，避免超支；透過旗艦產品 ExtraCash 產品預支現金，幫助會員避免懲罰性透支費用；Side Hustle 產品，Dave 幫助會員獲得補充工作機會；Dave Banking，一種現代支票帳戶體驗，提供建立長期財務健康的寶貴工具。該公司由 Jason Wilk、Paras Chitrakar 和 John Wolanin 於 2015 年 10 月創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Acumen Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages and develops medicines and diagnostics for Alzheimer's disease. The company was founded by William L. Klein, Grant A. Krafft, and Caleb Finch in 1996 and is headquartered in Newton, MA.
info.description_zh: Acumen Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，從事和開發阿茲海默症的藥物和診斷方法。該公司由 William L. Klein、Grant A. Krafft 和 Caleb Finch 於 1996 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州牛頓。

info.description: Absci Corp. is the drug and target discovery company harnessing deep learning AI and synthetic biology to expand the therapeutic potential of proteins. It partners with pharma and biotech innovators to create the next generation of protein-based drugs. The company was founded by Sean McClain in 2011 and is headquartered in Vancouver, WA.
info.description_zh: Absci Corp. 是一家藥物和標靶發現公司，利用深度學習人工智慧和合成生物學來擴大蛋白質的治療潛力。它與製藥和生物技術創新者合作，創造下一代基於蛋白質的藥物。該公司由 Sean McClain 於 2011 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州溫哥華。

info.description: Robinhood Markets, Inc is a financial services platform, which engages in the provision of retail brokerage and offers trading in U.S. listed stocks and Exchange Traded Funds, related options, and cryptocurrency trading, as well as cash management, which includes debit cards services. The company was founded by Vladimir Tenev and Baiju Prafulkumar Bhatt in 2013 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Robinhood Markets, Inc 是一家金融服務平台，從事提供零售經紀業務，並提供美國上市股票和交易所交易基金、相關選擇權、加密貨幣交易以及現金管理（包括金融卡服務）的交易。該公司由 Vladimir Tenev 和 Baiju Prafulkumar Bhatt 於 2013 年創立，總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: Alkami Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of digital banking software solutions to credit unions, banks, credit union service organizations, and service bureaus. It offers content management and an online and mobile banking suite that brings together a snapshot view of accounts with recent and upcoming activities. The company was founded by Louis A. Iannaccone, Scott Klososky, Steve Meston, Gary L. Nelson, Gruenewald Bobby, Jay Lackey, Stephen Bohanon, and Kim Stroh in 2007 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Alkami Technology, Inc. 致力於向信用社、銀行、信用社服務組織和服務局提供數位銀行軟體解決方案。它提供內容管理以及線上和行動銀行套件，將帳戶快照視圖與最近和即將進行的活動結合在一起。該公司由 Louis A. Iannaccone、Scott Klososky、Steve Meston、Gary L. Nelson、Gruenewald Bobby、Jay Lackey、Stephen Bohanon 和 Kim Stroh 於 2007 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: Iveda Solutions, Inc. enables cloud video surveillance via its Sentir data and video management platform, utilizing proprietary video streaming and big data storage technology. The firm provides services for telecommunications companies, datacenter operators, ISPs, and cable companies. It operates through the US and Taiwan segments. The company was founded by David Ly in 2003 and is headquartered in Mesa, AZ.
info.description_zh: Iveda Solutions, Inc. 利用專有的視訊串流和大數據儲存技術，透過其 Sentir 資料和視訊管理平台實現雲端視訊監控。該公司為電信公司、資料中心營運商、ISP 和有線電視公司提供服務。它透過美國和台灣部門運作。該公司由 David Ly 於 2003 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州梅薩。

info.description: MIRA Pharmaceuticals, Inc. operates as a clinical development stage biopharmaceutical company. It engages in developing its product candidates, Ketamir-2 and MIRA-55, designed to address unmet medical needs in pain management, depression, PTSD, and cognitive function. The company was founded by Adam Kaplin on September 3, 2020 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: MIRA Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家临床开发阶段的生物制药公司。該公司致力於開發候選產品 Ketamir-2 和 MIRA-55，旨在解決疼痛管理、憂鬱症、創傷後壓力症候群 (PTSD) 和認知功能方面未滿足的醫療需求。该公司由 Adam Kaplin 于 2020 年 9 月 3 日创立，总部位于佛罗里达州迈阿密。

info.description: Sprout Social, Inc. engages in the provision of online social media management tools for businesses. It offers communication tools, contact management, lead generation, and analytics services. The firm also offers solutions for enterprises, agencies, small businesses, customer service, social media marketing, and employee advocacy sectors. The company was founded by Justyn Howard, Aaron Rankin, Gilbert Lara, and Peter Soung on April 21, 2010 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Sprout Social, Inc. 致力於為企業提供線上社群媒體管理工具。它提供通訊工具、聯絡人管理、潛在客戶開發和分析服務。該公司也為企業、機構、小型企業、客戶服務、社群媒體行銷和員工倡導領域提供解決方案。該公司由 Justyn Howard、Aaron Rankin、Gilbert Lara 和 Peter Soung 於 2010 年 4 月 21 日創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州芝加哥。

info.description: Caribou Biosciences, Inc. engages in the development of an internal pipeline of off-the-shelf CAR-T and CAR-NK cell therapies. Its tools and technologies provide transformative capabilities to basic and applied biological research, therapeutic development, agricultural biotechnology, and industrial biotechnology. The company was founded by Jennifer A. Doudna, Rachel E. Haurwitz, Martin Jinek and James Berger on October 28, 2011 and is headquartered in Berkeley, CA.
info.description_zh: Caribou Biosciences, Inc. 致力於開發現成的 CAR-T 和 CAR-NK 細胞療法的內部管道。其工具和技術為基礎和應用生物學研究、治療開發、農業生物技術和工業生物技術提供變革能力。該公司由 Jennifer A. Doudna、Rachel E. Haurwitz、Martin Jinek 和 James Berger 於 2011 年 10 月 28 日創立，總部位於加州伯克利。

info.description: IN8bio, Inc. operates as a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on developing novel therapies for the treatment of cancers, including solid tumors, by employing allogeneic, autologous and genetically modified gamma-delta T cells. The company was founded by Lawrence S. Lamb and William T. Ho on February 8, 2016 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: IN8bio, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，專注於透過使用同種異體、自體和轉基因的 γ-δ T 細胞開發治療癌症（包括實體瘤）的新療法。該公司由 Lawrence S. Lamb 和 William T. Ho 於 2016 年 2 月 8 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Aware, Inc. is a biometrics software and services company. The firm's products are used in government and commercial biometrics systems, which are capable of determining or verifying an individual's identity. It also provides interoperable, standards-compliant, field-proven biometric functionality, used to capture, verify, format, compress and decompress biometric images, as well as aggregate, analyze, process, and transport those images within biometric systems. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Burlington, MA.
info.description_zh: Aware, Inc. 是一家生物辨識軟體和服務公司。該公司的產品用於政府和商業生物識別系統，能夠確定或驗證個人身份。它還提供可互通、符合標準、經過現場驗證的生物辨識功能，用於擷取、驗證、格式化、壓縮和解壓縮生物辨識影像，以及在生物辨識系統內聚合、分析、處理和傳輸這些影像。該公司成立於 1986 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州伯靈頓。

info.description: Bridger Aerospace Group Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of aerial wildfire surveillance, relief and suppression, and aerial firefighting services using next-generation technology and environmentally friendly and sustainable firefighting methods. Its fleet includes Daher Kodiak 100, Twin Commander, Pilatus PC-12, DeHaviland Twin Otter 300, and De Havilland CL-415EAF. The company was founded by Timothy Sheehy and Matthew P. Sheehey in 2014 and is headquartered in Belgrade, MT.
info.description_zh: Bridger Aerospace Group Holdings, Inc.利用下一代技術以及環保和永續的消防方法，提供空中野火監視、救援和撲滅以及空中消防服務。其機隊包括 Daher Kodiak 100、Twin Commander、Pilatus PC-12、DeHaviland Twin Otter 300 和 De Havilland CL-415EAF。該公司由 Timothy Sheehy 和 Matthew P. Sheehey 於 2014 年創立，總部位於蒙大拿州貝爾格萊德。

info.description: Fusion Fuel Green Plc engages in the research and development of solar technologies. It develops a process and technology to produce emission-free green hydrogen using concentrated photovoltaic technology. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 再生能源
info.description_zh: Fusion Fuel Green Plc 從事太陽能技術的研究和開發。它開發了一種利用聚光光伏技術生產無排放綠色氫的製程和技術。該公司成立於2018年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Fate Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the development of programmed cellular immunotherapies for cancer and immune disorder. Its pipeline of products includes immuno-ocology candidates and immuno-regulation candidates. The company was founded by Philip Beachy, Sheng Ding, Rudolf Jaenisch, Randall T. Moon, Michael Rudnicki, David Scadden, Leonard Zon, Alexander Rives, Scott Wolchko, and John D. Mendlein on April 27, 2007 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Fate Therapeutics, Inc. 致力於開發針對癌症和免疫疾病的程序化細胞免疫療法。其產品線包括免疫生態學候選藥物和免疫調節候選藥物。該公司由 Philip Beachy、Sheng D.、Rudolf Jaenisch、Randall T. Moon、Michael Rudnicki、David Scadden、Leonard Zon、Alexander Rives、Scott Wolchko 和 John D. Mendlein 於 2007 年 4 月 27 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Adicet Bio, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in discovering and developing allogeneic gamma delta T cell therapies for cancer. It also focuses on developing a pipeline of "off-the-shelf" gamma delta T cells. The company was founded by Aya Jakobovits in November 2014 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Adicet Bio, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發癌症同種異體 γ δ T 細胞療法。它還專注於開發一系列「現成」的 γ δ T 細胞。該公司由 Aya Jakobovits 於 2014 年 11 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Upland Software, Inc. engages in providing cloud-based software applications. Its products include AccuRoute, Adestra, Altify, BA Insight, Cimpl, ComSci, Eclipse PPM, FileBound, InGenius, Intelligent Capture, InterFAX, Kapost, Localytics, Mobile Commons, Objectif Lune, Panviva, PostUp, PowerStreering, PSA, Qvidian, Rant and Rave, RightAnswers, RO Innovation, Second Street, Ultriva, and Waterfall. The company was founded by John T. McDonald in July 2010 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Upland Software, Inc. 致力於提供基於雲端的軟體應用程式。其產品包括 AccuRoute、Adestra、Altify、BA Insight、Cimpl、ComSci、Eclipse PPM、FileBound、InGenius、Intelligent Capture、InterFAX、Kapost、Localytics、Mobile Commons、Objectif Lune、Panviva、PostUp、PowerStreering、Localytics、Mobile Commons、Objectif Lune、Panviva、PostUp. Waterfall。該公司由 John T. McDonald 於 2010 年 7 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: The Children's Place, Inc. engages in the provision of apparel, footwear, accessories, and other items for children. The firm also designs contracts to manufacture and sell fashionable and value-priced merchandise under the brand names of The Children's Place, Baby Place, and Gymboree. It operates through the following segments: The Children's Place U.S. and The Children's Place International. The Children's Place U.S. segment refers to the company's U.S. and Puerto Rico-based stores and revenue from its U.S. based wholesale business. The Children's Place International segment is involved in the Canadian-based stores, revenue from the company's Canadian-based wholesale business and revenue from international franchisees. The company was founded by David Pulver and Clinton A. Clark in 1969 and is headquartered in Secaucus, NJ.
info.description_zh: The Children's Place, Inc. 從事為兒童提供服裝、鞋類、配件和其他物品的業務。該公司還設計合同，以 The Children's Place、Baby Place 和 Gymboree 品牌製造和銷售時尚且物有所值的商品。它透過以下部門運作：The Children's Place U.S. 和 The Children's Place International。 Children's Place 美國部門是指該公司位於美國和波多黎各的商店以及來自美國批發業務的收入。 Children's Place International 部門涉及加拿大的商店、公司加拿大批發業務的收入以及國際特許經營商的收入。該公司由 David Pulver 和 Clinton A. Clark 於 1969 年創立，總部位於新澤西州錫考克斯。

info.description: Bright Minds Biosciences, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development of therapeutics. The company was founded by Ian B. McDonald and Alan P. Kozikowski on May 31, 2019 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Bright Minds Biosciences, Inc.是一家生技公司，從事治療藥物的開發。該公司由 Ian B. McDonald 和 Alan P. Kozikowski 於 2019 年 5 月 31 日創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州芝加哥。

info.description: Direxion Daily PLTR Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of PLTR. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of PLTR and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to PLTR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily PLTR Bull 2X Shares 尋求 PLTR 每日表現的 200% 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 PLTR 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和期權，這些證券結合起來為 PLTR 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long LAC Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of LAC. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of LAC, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 LAC 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 LAC 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 LAC 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Scilex Holding Co. engages in the acquisition, development, and commercialization of non-opioid pain management products for the treatment of acute and chronic pain. Its products include ZTLido, Elyxyb, and Gloperba. The company was founded on February 21, 2020 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Scilex Holding Co. 從事用於治療急性和慢性疼痛的非鴉片類疼痛管理產品的收購、開發和商業化。其產品包括 ZTLido、Elyxyb 和 Gloperba。該公司成立於2020年2月21日，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Mineralys Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on developing medicines to target diseases driven by abnormally elevated aldosterone. Its clinical-stage product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor that are initially developing for the treatment of cardiorenal conditions affected by abnormally elevated aldosterone, including hypertension and chronic kidney disease. The company was founded by Brian Taylor Slingsby on May 31, 2019 and is headquartered in Radnor, PA.
info.description_zh: Mineralys Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發針對由醛固酮異常升高引起的疾病的藥物。其臨床階段候選產品lorundrostat是一種專有的口服高選擇性醛固酮合成酶抑制劑，最初開發用於治療受醛固酮異常升高影響的心臟腎臟疾病，包括高血壓和慢性腎臟病。該公司由 Brian Taylor Slingsby 於 2019 年 5 月 31 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州拉德諾。

info.description: Immuneering Corp. operates as a clinical-stage oncology company, which engages in developing medicines for cancer patients. Its pipeline of drug candidates focuses on treating aspects of disease that have eluded conventional approaches, including cancer cachexia and metastasis. The company was founded by Robert J. Carpenter and Benjamin J. Zeskind in 2008 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Immuneering Corp. 是一家臨床階段的腫瘤公司，致力於為癌症患者開發藥物。其候選藥物管道專注於治療傳統方法無法解決的疾病，包括癌症惡病質和轉移。該公司由 Robert J. Carpenter 和 Benjamin J. Zeskind 於 2008 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: CEA Industries, Inc. engages in in the development, design, and distribution of cultivation technologies for controlled environment agriculture, primarily for cannabis crops. It offers controlled climate systems, controls, and biosecurity cultivation products, and MEP engineering, odor control, and installation support services. The company was founded by Brandy Marie Keen and Stephen Keen on October 15, 2009 and is headquartered in Louisville, CO.
info.description_zh: CEA Industries, Inc. 從事受控環境農業（主要針對大麻作物）種植技術的開發、設計和分銷。它提供受控氣候系統、控制和生物安全栽培產品，以及機電工程、氣味控制和安裝支援服務。該公司由 Brandy Marie Keen 和 Stephen Keen 於 2009 年 10 月 15 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州路易斯維爾。

info.description: Polyrizon Ltd. is a development stage biotech company, which engages in the development of nasal hydrogels. It provides barriers from the interaction of biological assaults, including a new strain of coronavirus, influenza, allergens and other airborne pathogens with the nasal epithelial tissue. The company was founded by Tomer Izraeli in January 2005 and is headquartered in Raanana, Israel.
info.description_zh: Polyrizon Ltd.是一家處於發展階段的生物技術公司，從事鼻腔水凝膠的開發。它為生物攻擊提供了屏障，包括新型冠狀病毒、流感、過敏原和其他空氣傳播的病原體與鼻上皮組織的相互作用。該公司由 Tomer Izraeli 於 2005 年 1 月創立，總部位於以色列 Raanana。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long HOOD Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of HOOD. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of HOOD, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 HOOD 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 HOOD 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 HOOD 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of Internet access and Internet Protocol (IP) communications solutions. It offers Internet access and data transport through its fiber optic, IP data-only network, ethernet transport, and colocation services. The company was founded by David Schaeffer in August 1999 and is headquartered in Washington, DC.
info.description_zh: Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. 從事提供網際網路存取和網際網路協定 (IP) 通訊解決方案。它透過光纖、純 IP 資料網路、乙太網路傳輸和託管服務提供網路存取和資料傳輸。該公司由 David Schaeffer 於 1999 年 8 月創立，總部位於華盛頓特區。

info.description: Ohmyhome Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in buying, selling, and renting real estate properties. It operates through the Brokerage, Emerging, and Another Related Service; and Estate Management Services and Other Related Services segments. The Brokerage, Emerging, and Another Related Service segment refers to the provision of brokerage and documentation services for buying, selling, leasing, and renting properties. The Estate Management Services and Other Related Services provides estate management services for residential, commercial and industrial real estate in Singapore. The company was founded by Wan Chew Wong and Wan Pei Wong in 2016 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Ohmyhome Ltd. 是一家控股公司，從事房地產買賣和租賃業務。它通过经纪、新兴和其他相关服务运营；物业管理服务及其他相关服务部门。經紀、新興和其他相關服務部門是指為購買、出售、租賃和出租房產提供經紀和文件服務。物業管理服務及其他相關服務為新加坡的住宅、商業和工業房地產提供物業管理服務。該公司由 Wan Chew Wong 和 Wan Pei Wong 於 2016 年創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Netclass Technology, Inc. operates as a holding company, which provides IT solutions to schools, training institutions, corporations, public agencies and other institutions. Its solutions include teaching management, campus management, online teaching, online examination, epidemic prevention and control, education credit block chain system, and lecturer evaluation services. The company was founded January 4, 2022 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Netclass Technology, Inc. 作為一家控股公司運營，為學校、培訓機構、企業、公共機構和其他機構提供 IT 解決方案。其解決方案包括教學管理、校園管理、線上教學、線上考試、疫情防治、教育學分區塊鏈系統、講師評估服務等。該公司成立於2022年1月4日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Astrotech Corp. engages in the mass spectrometry company that launches, manages and commercializes scalable companies based on its innovative core technology through its wholly-owned subsidiaries. Its business units include 1st Detect, BreathTech, and AgLab. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Astrotech Corp. 是一家質譜公司，透過其全資子公司推出、管理和商業化基於其創新核心技術的可擴展公司。其業務部門包括 1st Detect、BreathTech 和 AgLab。該公司成立於 1984 年，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Genenta Science SpA is an early-stage company, which engages in the development of first-in-class cell and gene cancer therapies. Its lead product candidate, Temferon, was developed using its platform and carries an interferon-alpha payload. The company was founded by Pierluigi Paracchi, Luigi Naldini and Bernhard Gentner on July 24, 2014 and is headquartered in Milan, Italy.
info.description_zh: Genenta Science SpA 是一家早期公司，致力於開發一流的細胞和基因癌症療法。其主要候選產品 Temferon 是使用其平台開發的，並攜帶幹擾素-α 有效負載。該公司由Pierluigi Paracchi、Luigi Naldini和Bernhard Gentner於2014年7月24日創立，總部位於義大利米蘭。

info.description: Hang Feng Technology Innovation Co., Ltd. is a holding company which engages in the provision of corporate management consulting and asset management services. Its business consists of two main segments: corporate management consulting services and asset management services. The firm provides following services through its subsidiaries: Management consulting, Regulatory compliance and governance consulting. Its asset management services include: fund subscription and fund management services. The company was founded on October 15, 2024 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 航峰科技創新有限公司是一家從事提供企業管理顧問和資產管理服務的控股公司。其業務包括兩個主要板塊：企業管理諮詢服務和資產管理服務。該公司透過其子公司提供以下服務：管理諮詢、監管合規和治理諮詢。其資產管理服務包括：基金認購及基金管理服務。該公司成立於2024年10月15日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Devvstream Corp. engages in the development and monetization of environmental assets, with an initial focus on carbon markets. It focuses on the co-development and generation of technology-based carbon offset credits, in partnership with governments and corporations worldwide, across voluntary and compliance markets. The company was founded on November 6, 2024 and is headquartered in Sacramento, CA.
info.description_zh: Devvstream Corp. 從事環境資產的開發和貨幣化，最初專注於碳市場。它專注於與世界各地的政府和企業合作，在自願和合規市場上共同開發和產生基於技術的碳抵消信用。該公司成立於 2024 年 11 月 6 日，總部位於加州薩克拉門托。

info.description: Bluejay Diagnostics, Inc. operates as a diagnostic company. It develops and markets minimally-invasive Point-of-Care diagnostics tests and devices that provide patients and providers with access to affordable and timely healthcare. It focus is on the infectious disease, inflammation, and oncology markets. The company was founded by Svetlana Dey and Dey Indraneil on March 20, 2015 and is headquartered in Acton, MA.
info.description_zh: Bluejay Diagnostics, Inc. 是一家診斷公司。該公司開發和銷售微創即時診斷測試和設備，為患者和醫療服務提供者提供負擔得起且及時的醫療服務。它的重點是傳染病、發炎和腫瘤市場。該公司由 Svetlana Dey 和 Dey Indraneil 於 2015 年 3 月 20 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州阿克頓。

info.description: Sphere 3D Corp. is a bitcoin mining company. The firm is engaged in growing its digital asset mining operation through the capital-efficient procurement of next-generation mining equipment and partnering with data center operators. Its bitcoin mining business segment involves acquiring computer servers, which operate application-specific integrated circuit chips designed specifically to mine bitcoin, and deploy, such miners at-scale utilizing its hosting agreements. The company was founded on May 2, 2007 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Sphere 3D Corp. 是一家比特幣挖礦公司。該公司致力於透過資本高效的下一代採礦設備採購以及與資料中心營運商合作來發展其數位資產採礦業務。其比特幣挖礦業務部門涉及收購電腦伺服器，這些伺服器運行專門為挖掘比特幣而設計的專用集成電路晶片，並利用其託管協議大規模部署此類礦機。該公司成立於2007年5月2日，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Short MSTR Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of -2 times (-200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of MicroStrategy Inc. (NASDAQ: MSTR). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2x the inverse (-200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Short MSTR Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 MicroStrategy Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：MSTR）普通股每日百分比變化的 -2 倍 (-200%)。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具來複製標的股票每日反向百分比變化的兩倍（-200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iOThree Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the business of satellite communications and software. It operates through the Satellite Connectivity Solution and Digitalization and Other Solutions segments. The Satellite Connectivity Solution segment offers integrated satellite connectivity solutions through the provision of satellite connectivity services and the sale and lease of satellite network equipment and devices for shipboard network management. The Digitalization and Other Solutions segment is involved in designing digital solutions and providing information technology support and shipboard support services for IT and OT applications enablement. The company was founded by Eng Chye Koh on August 21, 2023 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: iOThree Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事衛星通訊和軟體業務。它透過衛星連接解決方案以及數位化和其他解決方案部門運作。衛星連接解決方案部門透過提供衛星連接服務以及衛星網路設備和船上網路管理設備的銷售和租賃，提供整合的衛星連接解決方案。數位化和其他解決方案部門參與設計數位解決方案，並為 IT 和 OT 應用啟用提供資訊技術支援和船上支援服務。該公司由Eng Chye Koh於2023年8月21日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Laser Photonics Corp. engages in the business of manufacturing, research, and development of industrial laser technologies and systems. The firm offers operations that enable customers to reduce development and advanced laser equipment manufacturing time, achieve better pricing, maintain quality control, and protect proprietary know-how and technology compared to other laser cleaning companies and competing technologies. The company was founded on November 8, 2019 and is headquartered in Lake Mary, FL.
info.industry_zh: Error 500 (Server Error)!!1500.That’s an error.There was an error. Please try again later.That’s all we know.
info.description_zh: Laser Photonics Corp. 從事工業雷射技術和系統的製造、研究和開發業務。與其他雷射清潔公司和競爭技術相比，該公司提供的業務使客戶能夠減少開發和先進雷射設備的製造時間、實現更好的定價、保持品質控制並保護專有知識和技術。該公司成立於2019年11月8日，總部位於佛羅裡達州瑪麗湖。

info.description: Cheer Holding, Inc. engages in the provision of advertisement and content production services. It operates through the Cheers APP Internet Business and Traditional Media Business segments. The Cheers APP Internet Business segment generates advertising revenue from broadcasting IP short videos, live streaming, and APP advertising through the Cheers APP; and service revenue from Cheers E-mall marketplace. The Traditional Media Business segment mainly contributes to the advertising revenue from the Cheers TV-series, copyright revenue, customized content production revenue, and others. The company was founded on February 5, 2018 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Cheer Holding, Inc. 從事提供廣告和內容製作服務。它透過乾杯APP網路業務和傳統媒體業務部門進行營運。乾杯網路業務部門透過乾杯APP播放IP短影片、直播、APP廣告產生廣告收入；以及來自Cheers E-mall市場的服務收入。傳統媒體業務主要貢獻《乾杯》電視劇的廣告收入、版權收入、客製化內容製作收入等。公司成立於2018年2月5日，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Equillium, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company that engages in the development of novel therapeutics to treat severe autoimmune and inflammatory disorders with high unmet medical need. Its product pipeline includes EQ001, which is a monoclonal antibody that selectively targets the novel immune checkpoint receptor CD6. The company was founded by Daniel Mark Bradbury, Bruce D. Steel, and Stephen Connelly in March 2017 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.description_zh: Equillium, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於開發新型療法來治療醫療需求未滿足的嚴重自體免疫和發炎性疾病。其產品線包括EQ001，這是一種選擇性靶向新型免疫檢查點受體CD6的單株抗體。該公司由 Daniel Mark Bradbury、Bruce D. Steel 和 Stephen Connelly 於 2017 年 3 月創立，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short MSTR ETF seeks daily inverse investment results, before fees and expenses, of -2.0 times (-200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of MSTR. The fund advisor has adopted a policy to have at least 80% of its investment exposure to financial instruments with economic characteristics that should provide 2 times the inverse exposure to the daily performance of the underlying security. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short MSTR ETF 尋求每日反向投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 MSTR 股價每日百分比變化的 -2.0 倍（-200%）。基金顧問已採取一項政策，將其至少 80% 的投資敞口投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具應為基礎證券的日常表現提供 2 倍的反向敞口。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Namib Minerals is a gold producer, developer and explorer with operations focused in Zimbabwe. The company was founded on June 5, 2025 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Namib Minerals 是一家黃金生產商、開發商和勘探商，業務重點在於辛巴威。該公司成立於2025年6月5日，總部位於開曼群島喬治敦。

info.description: ParaZero Technologies Ltd. develops drone technology and safety systems. It is engaged in the business of designing, developing, and providing autonomous parachute safety systems for commercial drones, also known as Unmanned Aerial Systems or UAS. The company was founded by Amir Tsaliah and Ran Krauss on June 30, 2013 and is headquartered in Kiryat Ono, Israel.
info.description_zh: ParaZero Technologies Ltd. 開發無人機技術和安全系統。該公司從事設計、開發和提供商用無人機自主降落傘安全系統（也稱為無人機系統或 UAS）的業務。該公司由 Amir Tsaliah 和 Ran Krauss 於 2013 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於以色列 Kiryat Ono。

info.description: Azenta, Inc. is a global provider of life sciences solutions, enabling organizations worldwide to bring impactful breakthroughs and therapies to market faster. The company offers a suite of reliable cold-chain sample management solutions and multiomics services supporting drug development, clinical research, and advanced cell therapies for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, academic, and healthcare institutions globally. It operates through the following segments: Sample Management Solutions and Multiomics. The Sample Management Solutions segment provides end-to-end sample management products and services, including Sample Repository Services (SRS). Its core products include automated stores, cryogenic systems, automated sample tubes, consumables and instruments, and controlled-rate thawing devices. The Multiomics segment delivers genomic and other sample analysis services, including gene sequencing, gene synthesis, and related services. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Burlington, MA.
info.description_zh: Azenta, Inc. 是生命科學解決方案的全球供應商，幫助世界各地的組織更快地將有影響力的突破和療法推向市場。該公司提供一套可靠的冷鏈樣本管理解決方案和多組學服務，為全球製藥、生物技術、學術和醫療機構提供藥物開發、臨床研究和先進細胞療法的支援。它透過以下部門運作：樣本管理解決方案和多組學。樣品管理解決方案部門提供端到端樣品管理產品和服務，包括樣品儲存庫服務（SRS）。其核心產品包括自動化商店、低溫系統、自動化樣品管、耗材和儀器以及控速解凍設備。多組學部門提供基因組和其他樣本分析服務，包括基因定序、基因合成和相關服務。該公司成立於 1978 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州伯靈頓。

info.description: Turbo Energy SA provides energy solutions. It engages in the developing, manufacturing and distributing of photovoltaic products. The company was founded on September 18, 2013 and is headquartered in Valencia, Spain.
info.description_zh: Turbo Energy SA 提供能源解決方案。它從事光伏產品的開發、製造和銷售。該公司成立於2013年9月18日，總部位於西班牙巴倫西亞。

info.description: Safe Pro Group, Inc. engages in the provision and acquisition of security and protection products. Its products include Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) software technology and photogrammetry analysis tools, bullet and blast resistant personal protection equipment, and aerial managed services and mission-critical uncrewed solutions. The firm operates through the following segments: Safe-PRO USA, Airborne Response, and Safe Pro AI. The company was founded by Daniyel Erdberg on December 15, 2021 and is headquartered in Aventura, FL.
info.description_zh: Safe Pro Group, Inc. 從事安全和保護產品的提供和收購。其產品包括人工智慧（AI）和機器學習（ML）軟體技術和攝影測量分析工具、防彈和防爆個人防護設備以及空中管理服務和關鍵任務無人解決方案。該公司透過以下部門營運：Safe-PRO USA、Airborne Response 和 Safe Pro AI。該公司由 Daniyel Erdberg 於 2021 年 12 月 15 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州阿文圖拉。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long UPS Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of UPS. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of UPS, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 UPS 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 UPS 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 UPS 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd. engages in the provision of business consulting services and information technology customization solutions. Its products include Tridentity, TriVerse, TriEvents, and TriFood. The company was founded by Soon Huat Lim in 2014 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd. 從事提供商業諮詢服務和資訊科技客製化解決方案。其產品包括 Tridentity、TriVerse、TriEvents 和 TriFood。該公司由Soon Huat Lim於2014年創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Aptorum Group Ltd. is a pharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercializing of therapeutic assets to treat diseases with unmet medical needs. It operates through the Therapeutics and Non-Therapeutics segments. The Therapeutics segment seeks to develop drug molecules and certain technologies for the treatment and diagnosis of human disease conditions. The Non-Therapeutics segment encompasses diagnostics projects including a novel molecular-based rapid pathogen identification and detection diagnostics, AML Clinic, and sale of natural supplements. Its pipeline include Smart-Act, Acticule, RPIDD, Nativus, and Claves series. The company was founded by Ian Huen on September 13, 2010 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: 知臨集團有限公司是一家製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和商業化治療資產，以治療醫療需求未滿足的疾病。它透過治療和非治療部門運作。治療部門致力於開發藥物分子和某些技術來治療和診斷人類疾病。非治療部門涵蓋診斷項目，包括新型基於分子的快速病原體識別和檢測診斷、AML 診所和天然補充劑的銷售。其產品線包括 Smart-Act、Acticule、RPIDD、Nativus 和 Claves 系列。該公司由Ian Huen於2010年9月13日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Eltek Ltd. engages in the manufacturing, supply, marketing, and sale of circuitry solutions for use in electronic products. The firm offers its solutions and services to the printed circuit board (PCB) business in Israel, Europe, North America, and Asia. Its products include flex-rigid boards, rigid multilayer boards, high density interconnect, flex and multi-flex boards, Teflon and hybrid boards, and backplanes. The company was founded on January 1, 1970 and is headquartered in Petach Tikva, Israel.

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long ANET ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Arista Networks, Inc. (NYSE: ANET). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the Underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund manager is expected to allocate between 40% and 60% of fund's assets as collateral for swap agreements or as premiums for purchased options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance 每日目標 2 倍多頭 ANET ETF 尋求 Arista Networks, Inc.（NYSE：ANET）每日股價變動百分比兩倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。基金經理人預計將分配 40% 至 60% 的基金資產作為掉期協議的抵押品或作為購買選擇權合約的溢價。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lifecore Biomedical, Inc. engages in the development and manufacturing of pharmaceuticals products and services. It focuses on selling products utilizing hyaluronan, a naturally occurring polysaccharide that is widely distributed in the extracellular matrix of connective tissues in both animals and humans, and non-HA products for medical use primarily in the Ophthalmic, Orthopedic and other markets. The company was founded by Otto Sartorius in 1965 and is headquartered in Chaska, MN.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Lifecore Biomedical, Inc. 從事醫藥產品和服務的開發和製造。該公司專注於銷售利用透明質酸的產品，透明質酸是一種天然存在的多醣，廣泛分佈於動物和人類結締組織的細胞外基質中，以及主要用於眼科、骨科和其他市場的非透明質酸產品。該公司由 Otto Sartorius 於 1965 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州查斯卡。

info.description: Amplitude, Inc. provides a digital analytics platform that helps companies analyze their customer behavior within digital products. It delivers its application over the Internet as a subscription service using a software as a service (SaaS) model. The company was founded by Spenser Skates, Jeffrey Wang, and Curtis Liu in November 2011 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Amplitude, Inc. 提供數位分析平台，幫助公司分析數位產品中的客戶行為。它使用軟體即服務 (SaaS) 模型透過互聯網將其應用程式作為訂閱服務提供。該公司由 Spenser Skates、Jeffrey Wang 和 Curtis Liu 於 2011 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Gaxos.ai, Inc. is a technology-based company, which engages in the developing applications aimed at redefining the way they utilize artificial intelligence to optimize the user experience. The company was founded by Vadim Mats on October 27, 2021 and is headquartered in Roseland, NJ.
info.description_zh: Gaxos.ai, Inc. 是一家技術型公司，致力於開發應用程序，旨在重新定義利用人工智慧來優化用戶體驗的方式。該公司由 Vadim Mats 於 2021 年 10 月 27 日創立，總部位於新澤西州羅斯蘭。

info.description: BioNexus Gene Lab Corp. operates as a holding company, which engages in the sale of chemical raw materials for the manufacture of industrial, medical, appliance, aero, automotive, mechanical, and electronic industries. It is also involved in the development of liquid biopsy tests for the early detection of biomarkers that are linked to diseases. It operates through the BioNexus Malaysia and Chemrex segments. The company was founded by Liew Choong-Chin on May 12, 2017 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: BioNexus Gene Lab Corp. 作為一家控股公司經營，從事工業、醫療、家電、航空、汽車、機械和電子行業製造的化學原材料銷售。它還參與液體活檢測試的開發，以早期檢測與疾病相關的生物標記。它透過 BioNexus Malaysia 和 Chemrex 部門運作。該公司由Liew Choong-Chin於2017年5月12日創立，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: Themes Cybersecurity ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of Solactive Cyber Security Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that have business operations in the cybersecurity industry. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities that comprise the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Cyber​​security ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive Cyber​​ Security Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數旨在為在網路安全產業開展業務的公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Arista Networks, Inc. engages in the development, marketing, and sale of cloud networking solutions. Its solutions include EOS, a set of network applications, and Gigabit Ethernet switching and routing platforms. Its product categories include Core, Cognitive Adjacencies, and Network Software and Services. The company was founded by Andreas Bechtolsheim, David Cheriton, and Kenneth Duda in November 2004 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Arista Networks, Inc. 從事雲端網路解決方案的開發、行銷和銷售。其解決方案包括EOS、一套網路應用程式以及千兆乙太網路交換和路由平台。其產品類別包括核心、認知鄰接以及網路軟體和服務。該公司由 Andreas Bechtolsheim、David Cheriton 和 Kenneth Duda 於 2004 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Ascent Solar Technologies, Inc. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of photovoltaic solar modules. It integrates photovoltaic modules into a variety of applications such as aerospace, defense, transportation, and electronic products. The company was founded by Mohan S. Misra and Joseph H. Armstrong on October 18, 2005 and is headquartered in Thornton, CO.
info.description_zh: Ascent Solar Technologies, Inc.從事光伏太陽能模組的設計、開發和製造。它將光伏組件整合到航空航天、國防、交通和電子產品等多種應用中。該公司由 Mohan S. Misra 和 Joseph H. Armstrong 於 2005 年 10 月 18 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州桑頓。

info.description: Pacific NoS Global EM Equity Active ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that invests in a concentrated portfolio of equity and equity-related securities of large and mid-capitalization companies with market capitalization over USD 5 Billion at time of purchase and issued by emerging market companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacific NoS 全球新興市場股票主動式 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），投資於購買時市值超過 50 億美元並由新興市場公司發行的大中型公司的股票和股票相關證券的集中投資組合。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nortech Systems, Inc. operates as an electronic manufacturing services company. The firm offers engineering design and manufacturing solutions for complex electromedical devices, electromechanical systems, assemblies and components. Its manufacturing and engineering services include complete medical devices, printed circuit board assemblies, wire and cable assemblies, and complex higher-level electromechanical assemblies. The company was founded in December 1990 and is headquartered in Maple Grove, MN.
info.description_zh: Nortech Systems, Inc. 是一家電子製造服務公司。該公司為複雜的電子醫療設備、機電系統、組件和零件提供工程設計和製造解決方案。其製造和工程服務包括完整的醫療設備、印刷電路板組件、電線和電纜組件以及複雜的高級機電組件。該公司成立於 1990 年 12 月，總部位於明尼蘇達州楓樹林。

info.description: Global X Social Media ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Social Media Total Return Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index and in American Depositary Receipts and Global Depositary Receipts based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index tracks the equity performance of the largest and most liquid companies involved in the social media industry, including companies that provide social networking, file sharing, and other web-based media applications. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 社群媒體 ETF 力求提供與 Solactive 社群媒體總回報指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少80%的總資產投資於標的指數的證券以及基於標的指數的證券的美國存託憑證和全球存託憑證。該指數追蹤社交媒體行業規模最大、流動性最強的公司的股票表現，包括提供社交網路、文件共享和其他基於網路的媒體應用程式的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BRP, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the design, development, manufacture, distribution, and marketing of power sports vehicles and marine products. The firm operates through the Powersports and Marine segments. The Powersports segment includes year-round products, seasonal products and powersports PA&A and OEM Engines. The Marine segment includes outboard and jet boat engines, boats, and related PA&A and other services. Its brands include Ski-Doo, Lynx, Sea-Doo, Evinrude, Rotax, Can-Am, and Alumacraft. The company was founded on May 1, 2003 and is headquartered in Valcourt, Canada.
info.description_zh: BRP, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事動力運動車輛和船用產品的設計、開發、製造、分銷和行銷。該公司透過動力運動和海洋部門運作。 Powersports 部門包括全年產品、季節性產品以及 Powersports PA&A 和 OEM 引擎。船舶部門包括舷外機和噴射船發動機、船舶以及相關的 PA&A 和其他服務。其品牌包括 Ski-Doo、Lynx、Sea-Doo、Evinrude、Rotax、Can-Am 和 Alumacraft。該公司成立於2003年5月1日，總部位於加拿大瓦爾考特。

info.description: Quest Resource Holding Corp. engages in the provision of waste and recycling services to customers from across multiple industry sectors that are typically larger, multi-location businesses. It focuses on the waste streams and recyclables from big box, food chain, and other retailers, automotive repair, maintenance, and tire operations, truck and bus fleet operators, manufacturing plants, multi-family and commercial properties, and construction and demolition projects. The company was founded in July 2002 and is headquartered in The Colony, TX.
info.description_zh: Quest Resource Holding Corp. 致力於為多個行業的客戶提供廢棄物和回收服務，這些行業通常是大型、多地點的企業。它專注於來自大賣場、食品連鎖店和其他零售商、汽車維修、保養和輪胎運營、卡車和公共汽車車隊運營商、製造工廠、多戶和商業地產以及建築和拆除項目的廢物流和可回收物。該公司成立於 2002 年 7 月，總部位於德克薩斯州科勒尼。

info.description: Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity Etf is an exchange traded fund launched by Opal Capital LLC. It is managed by Vident Asset Management. It invests in public equity markets of United States. It invests in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It invests in growth and value stocks of companies across diversified market capitalization. The fund employs quantitative analysis to create its portfolio. Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity Etf is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity ETF 是 Opal Capital LLC 推出的交易所交易基金。它由 Vident 資產管理公司管理。它投資於美國公共股票市場。它投資於多元化行業的公司股票。它投資於多元化市值公司的成長型股票和價值型股票。該基金採用定量分析來創建其投資組合。 Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity ETF 註冊地為美國。

info.description: Wisdomtree High Income Laddered Municipal Fund seeks to generate a high level of current income that is exempt from federal income taxes. The manager seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through investments in municipal debt securities whose interest payments generally are exempt from U.S. federal income taxes. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in high income municipal debt securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree 高收入階梯市政基金旨在產生高水準的當前收入，且免徵聯邦所得稅。該管理人主要透過投資市政債務證券來實現其投資目標，這些證券的利息支付通常免徵美國聯邦所得稅。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於高收入市政債務證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Freedom Holding Corp. operates as an investment company, which provides securities brokerage and financial services. The firm engages in a range of activities including securities brokerage, securities dealing for customers, market making activities, investment research, investment counseling, investment banking services, retail and commercial banking, insurance products, payment services, and information processing services. It operates through the following segments: Brokerage, Banking, Insurance, and Other. The company was founded in July 1981 is headquartered in Almaty, Kazakhstan.
info.description_zh: Freedom Holding Corp. 作為一家投資公司經營，提供證券經紀和金融服務。該公司從事一系列活動，包括證券經紀、客戶證券交易、做市活動、投資研究、投資諮詢、投資銀行服務、零售和商業銀行、保險產品、支付服務和資訊處理服務。它透過以下部門運作：經紀部門、銀行部門、保險部門和其他部門。該公司成立於1981年7月，總部位於哈薩克阿拉木圖。

info.description: FONAR Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, sale, and servicing of magnetic resonance imaging scanners. It operates through Manufacturing and Servicing of Medical Equipment, and Management of Diagnostic Imaging Center segments. The Manufacturing and Servicing of Medical Equipment segment promotes its product, Fonar Upright MRI. The Management of Diagnostic Imaging Center segment offers management, administrative, billing and collection services, office space, equipment, repair, maintenance service and clerical, and non-medical personnel to medical providers through its subsidiary, Health Management Corp. of America. The company was founded by Raymond V. Damadian on July 17, 1978 and is headquartered in Melville, NY.
info.description_zh: FONAR Corp. 從事磁振造影掃描儀的設計、製造、銷售和服務。它透過醫療設備的製造和服務以及診斷成像中心的管理部門進行運作。醫療設備製造和服務部門推廣其產品 Fonar Upright MRI。診斷影像中心管理部門透過其子公司 Health Management Corp. of America 向醫療服務提供者提供管理、行政、計費和收款服務、辦公空間、設備、維修、維護服務以及文員和非醫務人員。該公司由 Raymond V. Damadian 於 1978 年 7 月 17 日創立，總部位於紐約州梅爾維爾。

info.description: Caesars Entertainment, Inc. engages in the management of casinos and resorts under the Caesars, Harrah's, Horseshoe, and Eldorado brands. It operates through the following segments: Las Vegas, Regional, Caesars Digital, Managed and Branded, and Corporate and Other. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Reno, NV.
info.description_zh: Caesars Entertainment, Inc. 從事 Caesars、Harrah's、Horseshoe 和 Eldorado 品牌下的賭場和度假村的管理。它透過以下部門運作：拉斯維加斯部門、區域部門、凱撒數位部門、管理和品牌部門以及企業和其他部門。該公司成立於 1937 年，總部位於內華達州里諾。

info.description: Ribbon Communications, Inc. delivers communications software, IP and optical networking solutions to service providers, enterprises, and infrastructure sectors. It operates through the Cloud and Edge and IP Optical Networks segments. The Cloud and Edge segment offers secure and reliable software and hardware products, solutions, and services for enabling Voice over Internet Protocol communications, Voice over Long-Term Evolution and Voice Over 5G communications, and Unified Communications and Collaboration within service provider and enterprise networks and from the cloud. The IP Optical Networks segment secures reliable hardware and software products solutions for IP networking, switching, routing, and optical transport designed to support and enable technologies like 5G, distributed cloud computing and corresponding applications by delivering ultra-low cost-per-bit transport and multi-service flexibility. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Ribbon Communications, Inc. 為服務供應商、企業和基礎設施部門提供通訊軟體、IP 和光網路解決方案。它透過雲端和邊緣以及 IP 光網路部門運作。雲端和邊緣部門提供安全可靠的軟體和硬體產品、解決方案和服務，用於實現互聯網協議語音通信、長期演進語音和 5G 語音通信，以及服務提供商和企業網絡內以及雲端的統一通信和協作。 IP光網路部門為IP網路、交換、路由和光傳輸提供可靠的硬體和軟體產品解決方案，旨在透過提供超低的每位元成本傳輸和多服務靈活性來支援和實現5G、分散式雲端運算和相應應用等技術。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2031 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, the Adviser invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2031, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund may also invest in municipal bonds with maturity dates within six months prior to or after the fund's target maturity year. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2031 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，顧問將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅的投資。該基金主要投資於 2031 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金還可以投資於到期日在基金目標到期年份之前或之後六個月內的市政債券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MU ETF is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks Micron Technology, Inc. (MU). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the performance of the underlying leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MU ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤美光科技 (MU) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 績效的曝險，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。

info.description: NCS Multistage Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of engineered products and services that facilitate the optimization of oil and natural gas well completions and field development strategies. It offers fracturing systems, repeat precision, tracer diagnostics, and well construction. The company was founded by Robert Nipper and Marty Stromquist in 2006 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: NCS Multistage Holdings, Inc. 從事提供工程產品和服務，以促進石油和天然氣完井和油田開發策略的最佳化。它提供壓裂系統、重複精度、示踪劑診斷和建井。該公司由 Robert Nipper 和 Marty Stromquist 於 2006 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2028 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM") invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2028, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2028 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資，其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金主要投資於 2028 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: F/m Opportunistic Income ETF seeks is to maximize total return, including both income and appreciation, by identifying undervalued and opportunistic sectors and securities in the U.S. fixed income markets. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") managed by F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC (the "adviser") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in fixed-income securities.
info.description_zh: F/m 機會主義收入 ETF 尋求透過識別美國固定收益市場中被低估和機會主義的行業和證券來最大化總回報，包括收入和升值。該基金為一檔主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），由 F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC（「顧問」）管理，旨在透過投資固定收益證券來實現其投資目標。

info.description: Launch One Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on February 21, 2024 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Launch One Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其業務目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年2月21日，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: RF Acquisition Corp. III operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: RF Acquisition Corp. III 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月15日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Calamos Global Total Return Fund is a closed ended balanced mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. It is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. The fund invests in public equity and fixed income markets across the globe. It seeks to invest in securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. The fund primarily invests in equities, convertible bonds, and high yield corporate bonds. It employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis to create its portfolio. The fund benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against MSCI World Index. Calamos Global Total Return Fund was formed on March 30, 2004 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos Global Total Return Fund 是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封闭式平衡共同基金。它由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。该基金投资于全球公共股权和固定收益市场。它寻求投资于多元化行业运营的公司的证券。该基金主要投资于股票、可转换债券和高收益公司债券。它采用基本面分析和定量分析来创建其投资组合。该基金将其投资组合的表现与 MSCI 世界指数进行比较。 Calamos Global Total Return Fund成立于2004年3月30日，注册地为美国。

info.description: AB Core Plus Bond ETF seeks to maximize total return through current income and long-term capital appreciation. The fund pursues its objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, including any borrowings for investment purposes, in fixed-income securities. It may invest in a broad range of debt securities, including corporate bonds and debt and mortgage- and other asset-backed securities issued by U.S. government-sponsored entities and federal agencies and instrumentalities that are not backed by the full faith and credit of the U.S. government.
info.description_zh: AB Core Plus Bond ETF 尋求透過當前收入和長期資本增值來最大化總回報。在正常情況下，該基金透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於固定收益證券來實現其目標。它可能投資於廣泛的債務證券，包括公司債以及由美國政府資助的實體和聯邦機構發行的債務和抵押貸款及其他資產支持證券以及不受美國政府完全信任和信用支持的工具。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2031 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2031 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2031 (collectively, "2031 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2031 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2031 指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2031 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2031 年債券」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Electronic Arts, Inc. engages in the development, marketing, publication, and distribution of games, content, and services for game consoles, PCs, mobile phones, and tablets. The firm develops and publishes games and services across various genres, such as sports, first-person shooter, action, role-playing, and simulation primarily under the Battlefield, The Sims, Apex Legends, Anthem, Need for Speed, and Plants v. Zombies brands, and license games, including FIFA, Madden NFL, and Star Wars brands. The firm also provides advertising services and licenses its games to third parties to distribute and host its games. It markets and sells its games and services through digital distribution channels, as well as through retail channels, such as mass-market retailers, electronics specialty stores, and game software specialty stores. The company was founded by William M. Hawkins III and William Gordon in 1982 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.description_zh: Electronic Arts, Inc. 從事遊戲機、個人電腦、手機和平板電腦的遊戲、內容和服務的開發、行銷、出版和發行。該公司開發和發行各種類型的遊戲和服務，例如運動、第一人稱射擊、動作、角色扮演和模擬遊戲，主要以《戰地》、《模擬市民》、《Apex Legends》、《聖歌》、《極品飛車》和《植物大戰殭屍》品牌為主，並授權遊戲，包括《FIFA》、《Madden NFLFA》和《星際大戰》品牌。該公司還提供廣告服務並將其遊戲授權給第三方來分發和託管其遊戲。該公司透過數位分銷管道以及大眾市場零售商、電子產品專賣店和遊戲軟體專賣店等零售通路行銷和銷售其遊戲和服務。該公司由 William M. Hawkins III 和 William Gordon 於 1982 年創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: BNY Mellon Municipal Short Duration ETF is an actively managed fund designed to maximize current income exempt from federal income tax by investing in a diversified portfolio of short-duration municipal bonds. The strategy emphasizes capital preservation and liquidity by maintaining an average effective portfolio duration of three years or less
info.description_zh: 紐約梅隆市政短期 ETF 是一款積極管理的基金，旨在透過投資短期市政債券的多元化投資組合，最大限度地提高免徵聯邦所得稅的當前收入。此策略透過維持三年或更短的平均有效投資組合久期來強調資本保值和流動性

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2033 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2033 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2033. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2033 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2033 指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2033 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Epsium Enterprise Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in import trading and distribution of wines and spirits. It offers a range of products, including Chinese liquor, French cognac, Scottish whisky, fine wines, champagne, and other miscellaneous alcoholic beverages. Its brands include Moutai, Xijiu, Wuliangye, Remy Martin Cognac, Macallan, Cointreau, Piper Heidsieck Champagne, French Fine Wines, Red and White Wines. The company was founded by Son I Tam on March 24, 2020 and is headquartered in Macau.
info.industry_zh: 飲料 - 釀酒廠和釀酒廠
info.description_zh: Epsium Enterprise Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，從事葡萄酒和烈酒的進口貿易和分銷。它提供一系列產品，包括中國白酒、法國干邑白蘭地、蘇格蘭威士忌、精品葡萄酒、香檳和其他各種酒精飲料。旗下品牌包括茅台、習酒、五糧液、人頭馬干邑、麥卡倫、君度、海德雪香檳、法國精品葡萄酒、紅白葡萄酒等。該公司由Son I Tam於2020年3月24日創立，總部位於澳門。

info.description: Highview Merger Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 16, 2025 and is headquartered in Delray Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Highview Merger Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 4 月 16 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州德爾雷海灘。

info.description: MiNK Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of allogeneic invariant natural killer T cell therapies to treat cancer and other immune mediated diseases. The company was founded by Garo H. Armen in 2017 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: MiNK Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於同種異體不變自然殺手T細胞療法的發現、開發和商業化，以治療癌症和其他免疫介導的疾病。該公司由 Garo H. Armen 於 2017 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Launchpad Cadenza Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or other similar business combination, involving one or more businesses or assets. The company was founded on June 27, 2025 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Launchpad Cadenza Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是實現涉及一項或多項業務或資產的合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或其他類似業務合併。该公司成立于2025年6月27日，总部位于加利福尼亚州奥克兰。

info.description: Matrix Service Co. engages in the provision of engineering, fabrication, construction, and maintenance services to support critical energy infrastructure and industrial markets. It operates through the following segments: Storage and Terminal Solutions, Utility and Power Infrastructure, and Process and Industrial Facilities. The Storage and Terminal Solutions segment is related to cryogenic and other specialty tanks and terminals for LNG, NGLs, hydrogen, ammonia, propane, butane, liquid nitrogen/liquid oxygen, and liquid petroleum. The Utility and Power Infrastructure segment refers to LNG utility peak shaving facilities. The Process and Industrial Facilities segment is focused on plant maintenance, repair, and turnarounds in the downstream and midstream markets for energy clients including refining and processing of crude oil, fractionating, and marketing of natural gas and natural gas liquids.
