The company was founded by Bill Lee, Doyl D. West, Harold Morgan, and Martin Lee Rinehart on April 4, 1984, and is headquartered in Tulsa, OK.
info.description_zh: Matrix Service Co. 從事提供工程、製造、施工和維護服務，以支援關鍵能源基礎設施和工業市場。該公司透過以下部門運作：儲存和終端解決方案部門、公用事業和電力基礎設施部門以及流程和工業設施部門。儲存和終端解決方案部門涉及液化天然氣、液化天然氣、氫氣、氨、丙烷、丁烷、液態氮/液態氧和液態石油的低溫和其他特殊儲槽和終端。公用事業和電力基礎設施部門是指液化天然氣公用事業調峰設施。流程和工業設施部門專注於為能源客戶提供下游和中游市場的工廠維護、維修和周轉服務，包括原油精煉和加工、天然氣和液化天然氣的分餾和行銷。該公司由 Bill Lee、Doyl D. West、Harold Morgan 和 Martin Lee Rinehart 於 1984 年 4 月 4 日創立，總部位於俄克拉荷馬州塔爾薩。

info.description: Newbridge Acquisition Ltd. is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on April 16, 2021 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Newbridge Acquisition Ltd. 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是實現合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2021年4月16日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Stoneport Advisors Commodity Long Short ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Stoneport Advisors Dynamic Commodity Index - Total Return. The fund invests both long and short, in highly liquid U.S. exchange-listed physical commodity futures contracts that are contained in the index or that have characteristics that the Adviser believes make their return performance likely to be highly correlated to futures contracts that are contained in the index. The index is a rules-based, quantitative, long-short commodity futures index comprised of liquid, U.S. exchange-listed physical commodity futures contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Stoneport Advisors 商品多空 ETF 旨在追蹤 Stoneport Advisors 動態商品指數 - 總回報（未計費用和開支）的表現。該基金對流動性高的美國交易所上市實體商品期貨合約進行多頭和空頭投資，這些期貨合約包含在指數中，或具有顧問認為其回報表現可能與指數中包含的期貨合約高度相關的特徵。該指數是一種基於規則的定量多空商品期貨指數，由流動性強、在美國交易所上市的實體商品期貨合約組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sadot Group, Inc. operates as a restaurant chain business. It operates through the following segments: Muscle Maker Grill Restaurant, Pokemoto Hawaiian Poke Restaurant, Non-Traditional (Hybrid), SuperFit Foods Meal Prep, and Sadot. The firm offers protein- based meals featuring chicken, seafood, pasta, hamburgers, wraps and flat breads. It also provides salads, protein shakes and fruit smoothies. The company was founded by Rodney C. Silva in 2022 and is headquartered in Burleson, TX.
info.description_zh: Sadot Group, Inc. 是一家連鎖餐廳企業。它透過以下部門運作：Muscle Maker Grill Restaurant、Pokemoto Hawaiian Poke Restaurant、非傳統（混合）、SuperFit Foods Meal Prep 和 Sadot。該公司提供蛋白質食品，包括雞肉、海鮮、義大利麵、漢堡、捲餅和扁麵包。它還提供沙拉、蛋白奶昔和水果冰沙。該公司由 Rodney C. Silva 於 2022 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州伯利森。

info.description: Semilux International Ltd. engages in the development of laser lights modules and optical components. The company was founded on July 19, 2023 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Semilux International Ltd.從事雷射燈模組和光學元件的開發。該公司成立於2023年7月19日，總部位於開曼群島喬治敦。

info.description: Stabilis Solutions, Inc. is an energy transition company, which engages in providing turnkey clean energy production, storage, transportation, and fueling solutions. It also builds power and control systems for the energy industry in China. The company was founded by J. Casey Crenshaw on October 21, 1996 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Stabilis Solutions, Inc. 是一家能源轉型公司，致力於提供統包清潔能源生產、儲存、運輸和燃料加註解決方案。它也為中國的能源產業建造電力和控制系統。該公司由 J. Casey Crenshaw 於 1996 年 10 月 21 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: VersaBank engages in the provision of financial services. It operates through Digital Banking and DRTC. The Digital Banking segment offers business to business model using its financial technoolgy to address issues in the U.S. banking market. The DRTC segment refers to developed IT security software and capabilities. The company was founded by David Roy Taylor on January 18, 1993 and is headquartered in London, Canada.
info.description_zh: VersaBank 從事提供金融服務。它透過數位銀行和 DRTC 運作。數位銀行部門利用其金融科技提供企業對企業模式來解決美國銀行市場的問題。 DRTC 部分是指開發的 IT 安全軟體和功能。該公司由David Roy Taylor於1993年1月18日創立，總部位於加拿大倫敦。

info.description: VisionSys AI, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of IT-focused supplementary science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) education services. It operates an education platform that has live distance instruction, classroom-based learning, and online learning modules. The company was founded by Shao Yun Han in September 2002 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: VisionSys AI, Inc. 是一家控股公司，致力於提供以 IT 為重點的補充科學、技術、工程和數學 (STEM) 教育服務。它經營一個教育平台，具有遠距教學、課堂學習和線上學習模組。該公司由邵雲韓於2002年9月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Wellchange Holdings Co. Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of enterprise software solution services. It provides tailor-made software solutions, cloud-based software-as-a-service (SaaS) services, and white-labelled software design and development services. The company was founded by Kin Pong Shek on July 13, 2023, and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Wellchange Holdings Co. Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事提供企業軟體解決方案服務。它提供量身定制的軟體解決方案、基於雲端的軟體即服務（SaaS）服務以及白標軟體設計和開發服務。該公司由Kin Pong Shek於2023年7月13日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Hall Chadwick Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It engages in the effecting of a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on May 22, 2025 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Hall Chadwick Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它從事與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年5月22日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: BNY Mellon Municipal Intermediate ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks to maximize current income exempt from federal income tax while prioritizing capital preservation. The strategy primarily targets investment-grademunicipal bonds with an intermediate-term profile, generally maintaining an average effective portfolio duration between three and eight years.
info.description_zh: 紐約梅隆市政中級 ETF 是一隻積極管理的基金，旨在最大限度地提高當前免繳聯邦所得稅的收入，同時優先考慮資本保值。該策略主要針對具有中期特徵的投資等級市政債券，通常將平均有效投資期間維持在三到八年之間。

info.description: iShares Core 1-5 Year USD Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg U.S. Universal 1-5 Year Index, which measures the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated taxable bonds that are rated either investment-grade or high yield with remaining effective maturities between one and five years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and TBA transactions that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of the component securities of the index and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the index.
info.description_zh: iShares Core 1-5 年期美元債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國通用 1-5 年期指數的投資結果，該指數衡量以美元計價的應稅債券的表現，這些債券被評為投資級或高收益，剩餘有效期限為 1 至 5 年。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與該指數組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的經濟特徵的 TBA 交易，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於該指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。

info.description: iShares ESG 1-5 Year USD Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg MSCI US Corporate 1-5 Year ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The index has been developed by Bloomberg Finance L.P. and its affiliates with environmental, social and governance ("ESG") rating inputs from MSCI ESG Research LLC pursuant to an agreement between MSCI ESG Research and Bloomberg Index Services Limited, a subsidiary of Bloomberg.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG 1-5 年期美元公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博 MSCI 美國企業 1-5 年期 ESG 焦點指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並可能將最多 10% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該指數由 Bloomberg Finance L.P. 及其附屬公司根據 MSCI ESG Research 與 Bloomberg 子公司 Bloomberg Index Services Limited 的協議，可利用 MSCI ESG Research LLC 提供的環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）評級資訊開發。

info.description: iShares ESG Advanced High Yield Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investments results of the Bloomberg MSCI US High Yield Choice ESG Screened Index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bonds of issuers with favorable ESG ratings, as identified by the index Provider, while applying additional screens. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Advanced High Yield Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤 Bloomberg MSCI US High Yield Choice ESG Screened Index 的投資成果。該指數旨在反映指數提供者確定的具有良好 ESG 評級的發行人以美元計價的高收益公司債的表現，同時應用額外的篩選。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的成分證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於基礎指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。

info.description: Vanguard Short-Term Treasury Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted Treasury index with a short-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg US Treasury 1-3 Year Index. This index includes fixed income securities issued by the U.S. Treasury (not including inflation-protected securities, floating rate securities and certain other security types), all with maturities between 1 and 3 years. At least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard 短期國債指數基金 ETF 股票旨在追蹤具有短期美元加權平均期限的市場加權國債指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國公債1-3年期指數的表現。該指數包括美國財政部發行的固定收益證券（不包括通膨保值證券、浮動利率證券和某些其他證券類型），所有證券的期限均在 1 至 3 年之間。該基金至少80%的資產將投資於該指數所包含的債券。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2029 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2029 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2029 (collectively, "2029 Bonds").
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2029 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2029 指數（「基本指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2029 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）（統稱為「2029 年債券」）的表現。

info.description: SanJac Alpha Core Plus Bond ETF seeks current income and total returns consistent with limited volatility and the preservation of capital. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a portfolio of income-oriented instruments principally consisting of investment-grade U.S. corporate and government debt obligations (including securities issued or guaranteed by the U.S. government or its agencies or instrumentalities), mortgage-backed securities, mortgage real estate investment trusts, and preferred stocks. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SanJac Alpha Core Plus Bond ETF 尋求與有限波動性和資本保存一致的當前收入和總回報。該基金是一隻主動管理的ETF，旨在透過投資收入導向工具投資組合來實現其投資目標，這些工具主要包括投資級美國公司和政府債務債券（包括由美國政府或其機構或工具發行或擔保的證券）、抵押貸款支持證券、抵押房地產投資信託和優先股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Armlogi Holding Corp. engages in the provision of warehousing and logistics services. It offers a comprehensive package of supply-chain solutions relating to warehouse management and order fulfillment. The company was founded by Aidy Chou and Tong Wu on September 29, 2022 and is headquartered in Walnut, CA.
info.description_zh: Armlogi Holding Corp. 從事提供倉儲和物流服務。它提供與倉庫管理和訂單履行相關的一整套供應鏈解決方案。該公司由 Aidy Chou 和 Tong Wu 於 2022 年 9 月 29 日創立，總部位於加州核桃市。

info.description: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of retail and commercial banking services, demand, savings and time deposits, consumer, mortgage and commercial loans. It offers telephone banking, internet banking, and mobile banking to its customers. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Berryville, VA.
info.description_zh: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營，從事提供零售和商業銀行服務、活期存款、儲蓄和定期存款、消費者貸款、抵押貸款和商業貸款。它為客戶提供電話銀行、網路銀行和手機銀行。該公司成立於 1991 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州貝裡維爾。

info.description: ITHAX Acquisition Corp. III is a blank check company. It was formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 3, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: ITHAX Acquisition Corp. III 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立是為了與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月3日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Xtrackers RREEF Global Natural Resources ETF seeks total return from both capital appreciation and current income. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes (calculated at the time of any investment), in securities of companies in the natural resources sector. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers RREEF 全球自然資源 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額（在任何投資時計算）投資於自然資源產業公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X Renewable Energy Producers ETF seeks to track, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the Indxx Renewable Energy Producers Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index and in ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to publicly traded companies that produce energy from renewable sources including wind, solar, hydroelectric, geothermal, and biofuels (including publicly traded companies that are formed to own operating assets that produce defined cash flows. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 再生能源生產商 ETF 旨在追蹤未計費用和支出之前的 Indxx 再生能源生產商指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於標的指數的證券以及基於標的指數的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。基礎指數旨在提供對利用風能、太陽能、水力發電、地熱能和生物燃料等再生能源生產能源的上市公司的投資（包括為擁有產生固定現金流的營運資產而組建的上市公司）。该​​基金是非多元化的。

info.description: OneIM Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 05, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: OneIM Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月5日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: 3 E Network Technology Group Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of business-to-business information technology business solutions. It offers business solutions to a variety of industries and sectors, including food establishments, real estate, exhibition and conferencing, and clean energy utilities. The company was founded on October 6, 2021 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 3 E Network Technology Group Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，從事提供企業對企業資訊技術業務解決方案。它為各種行業和領域提供業務解決方案，包括食品企業、房地產、展覽和會議以及清潔能源公用事業。公司成立於2021年10月6日，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: Bogota Financial Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of business activities that are permissible for mutual holding companies under New Jersey law, including investing in loans and securities. It also focuses on the acquisition of banking and financial services companies. The firm operates through the following loan portfolio segments: residential first mortgage, commercial and multi-family real estate, construction, home equity and other, and commercial and industrial. The company was founded in September 2019 and is headquartered in Teaneck, NJ.
info.description_zh: 波哥大金融公司是一家控股公司，從事提供新澤西州法律允許的共同控股公司的業務活動，包括投資貸款和證券。它還專注於收購銀行和金融服務公司。該公司透過以下貸款組合部門運作：住宅第一抵押貸款、商業和多戶房地產、建築、房屋淨值及其他以及商業和工業。該公司成立於 2019 年 9 月，總部位於新澤西州蒂內克。

info.description: Revolution Medicines, Inc. is a clinical-stage precision oncology company, which engages in developing novel targeted therapies. It engages in the discovery and development of cancer treatment by pioneering novel combination and monotherapy treatment regimens to maximize the depth and durability of clinical benefit and circumvent adaptive resistance mechanisms for patients which are dependent on the RAS and mTOR pathway. The company was founded by Mark A. Goldsmith, Kevan Shokat, Martin D. Burke, David L. Pompliano and Michael Fischbach in October 2014 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.description_zh: Revolution Medicines, Inc.是一家臨床階段精準腫瘤學公司，致力於開發新型標靶療法。它透過開創性的新型聯合和單一療法治療方案來探索和開發癌症治療，以最大限度地提高臨床獲益的深度和持久性，並規避依賴於 RAS 和 mTOR 途徑的患者的適應性抗藥性機制。該公司由 Mark A. Goldsmith、Kevan Shokat、Martin D. Burke、David L. Pompliano 和 Michael Fischbach 於 2014 年 10 月創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: Wells Fargo & Co. is a diversified and community-based financial services company, which engages in the provision of banking, insurance, investments, mortgage, and consumer and commercial finance products and services. It operates through the following segments: Consumer Banking and Lending, Commercial Banking, Corporate and Investment Banking, and Wealth and Investment Management. The Consumer Banking and Lending segment offers consumer and small business banking, home lending, credit cards, auto, and personal lending. The Commercial Banking segment provides banking and credit products across industry sectors and municipalities, secured lending and lease products, and treasury management. The Corporate and Investment Banking segment is composed of corporate banking, investment banking, treasury management, commercial real estate lending and servicing, and equity and fixed income solutions, as well as sales, trading, and research capabilities. The Wealth and Investment Management segment refers to personalized wealth management, brokerage, financial planning, lending, private banking, trust, and fiduciary products and services. The company was founded by Henry Wells and William G. Fargo on March 18, 1852 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: 富國銀行是一家多元化、以社區為基礎的金融服務公司，從事提供銀行、保險、投資、抵押貸款以及消費者和商業金融產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：消費者銀行和貸款部門、商業銀行部門、企業和投資銀行部門以及財富和投資管理部門。消費者銀行和貸款部門提供消費者和小型企業銀行業務、房屋貸款、信用卡、汽車和個人貸款。商業銀行部門提供跨行業和市政當局的銀行和信貸產品、擔保貸款和租賃產品以及資金管理。企業和投資銀行部門由企業銀行、投資銀行、資金管理、商業房地產貸款和服務、股票和固定收益解決方案以及銷售、交易和研究能力組成。財富與投資管理部門指個人化財富管理、經紀、財務規劃、貸款、私人銀行、信託和信託產品和服務。該公司由 Henry Wells 和 William G. Fargo 於 1852 年 3 月 18 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州舊金山。

info.description: comScore, Inc. is a global information and analytics company, which engages in the measurement of audiences, consumer behavior, and advertising across media platforms. The company was founded by Magid M. Abraham and Gian Mark Fulgoni in August 1999 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: comScore, Inc. 是一家全球資訊和分析公司，致力於跨媒體平台的受眾、消費者行為和廣告測量。該公司由 Magid M. Abraham 和 Gian Mark Fulgoni 於 1999 年 8 月創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: Xenetic Biosciences, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company engaged in the advancement of cell-based therapeutics to target the B-cell receptor on the surface of an individual patient's malignant tumor cells. Its product pipeline includes XCart Platform and Polyxen. The company was founded on August 9, 2011 and is headquartered in Framingham, MA.
info.description_zh: Xenetic Biosciences, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發基於細胞的療法，以靶向個別患者惡性腫瘤細胞表面的 B 細胞受體。其產品線包括 XCart Platform 和 Polyxen。該公司成立於2011年8月9日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州弗雷明漢。

info.description: Jin Medical International Ltd. is a holding company. It is engaged in the design, development, manufacturing, and sale of wheelchair and other living aids products to be used by people with disabilities or impaired mobility. The company was founded on January 14, 2020 and is headquartered in Changzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 金醫療國際股份有限公司是一家控股公司。其從事設計、開發、製造和銷售供殘疾人或行動不便人士使用的輪椅及其他生活輔助產品。公司成立於2020年1月14日，總部位於中國常州。

info.description: Wynn Resorts Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the design, development, and operation of destination casino resorts. It operates through the following segments: Wynn Palace, Wynn Macau, Las Vegas Operations, Encore Boston Harbor, and Corporate and Other. The company was founded by Stephen Alan Wynn, Elaine P. Wynn, and Kazuo Okada in 2002 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: 永利度假村有限公司是一家控股公司，從事目的地賭場度假村的設計、開發和營運。該公司透過以下部門運作：永利皇宮部門、永利澳門部門、拉斯維加斯業務部門、安可波士頓港部門以及企業及其他部門。該公司由 Stephen Alan Wynn、Elaine P. Wynn 和 Kazuo Okada 於 2002 年創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Enlivex Ltd. engages in the development of macrophage reprogramming immunotherapy products. It focuses on the development of Allocetra, a universal off-the-shelf cell therapy designed to reprogram macrophages into their homeostatic state. The company was founded by Dror Mevorach on January 22, 2012 and is headquartered in Ness Ziona, Israel.
info.description_zh: Enlivex Ltd.從事巨噬細胞重編程免疫治療產品的開發。它專注於 Allocetra 的開發，這是一種通用的現成細胞療法，旨在將巨噬細胞重新編程至穩態。該公司由 Dror Mevorach 於 2012 年 1 月 22 日創立，總部位於以色列 Ness Ziona。

info.description: MVB Financial Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of community and mortgage banking services. It operates through the following segments: CoRe Banking, Mortgage Banking, and Financial Holding Company. The CoRe Banking segment includes the Fintech division, which represents banking products and services offered to customers by the bank, primarily loans and deposits accounts. The Mortgage Banking segment focuses on the share of net income or loss from mortgage banking activities of equity method investments in ICM and Warp Speed. The Financial Holding Company segment refers to the intercompany service income and dividends. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Fairmont, WV.
info.description_zh: MVB Financial Corp. 是一家控股公司，從事提供社區和抵押銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：核心銀行部門、抵押銀行部門和金融控股公司部門。核心銀行業務部門包括金融科技部門，該部門代表銀行向客戶提供的銀行產品和服務，主要是貸款和存款帳戶。抵押銀行業務部門專注於 ICM 和 Warp Speed 權益法投資的抵押銀行業務淨收入或虧損份額。金融控股公司分部是指公司間服務收入及股利。該公司成立於 1999 年，總部位於西維吉尼亞州費爾蒙特。

info.description: Invesco Electric Vehicle Metals Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that, under normal circumstances, seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a combination of financial instruments that are economically linked to the tradeable metals widely used in the production of an electric vehicle (which include, but are not limited to, iron ore, copper, aluminum, nickel, cobalt and lithium). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 景順電動車金屬商品策略No K-1 ETF尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，尋求透過投資與電動車生產中廣泛使用的可交易金屬（包括但不限於鐵礦石、銅、鋁、鎳、鈷和鋰）經濟相關的金融工具組合來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: IRIDEX Corp. engages in developing, manufacturing, and marketing medical systems, delivery devices, and consumable instrumentation for the ophthalmology market. Its products include lasers, laser delivery and glaucoma devices, retinal surgical instruments, veterinary, and ENT. The company was founded by Eduardo Arias, Theodore A. Boutacoff, David M. Buzawa and James L. Donovan in February 1989 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.
info.description_zh: IRIDEX Corp. 從事眼科市場醫療系統、輸送設備和消耗性儀器的開發、製造和行銷。其產品包括雷射、雷射傳輸和青光眼設備、視網膜手術器械、獸醫和耳鼻喉科器械。該公司由 Eduardo Arias、Theodore A. Boutacoff、David M. Buzawa 和 James L. Donovan 於 1989 年 2 月創立，總部位於加州山景城。

info.description: Global Interactive Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of a global multi-media platform for users to interact with other like-minded users to share appreciation of various types of entertainment and cultures such as K-POP and modern Korean culture. It operates through the FANTOO platform. The company was founded on October 20, 2021 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
info.description_zh: Global Interactive Technologies, Inc. 致力於提供一個全球多媒體平台，讓用戶與其他志同道合的用戶互動，分享對各種類型的娛樂和文化的欣賞，例如 K-POP 和現代韓國文化。它透過 FANTOO 平台運作。該公司成立於2021年10月20日，總部位於韓國首爾。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF  is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the underlying security while managing potential downside through a specific volatility-linked framework.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤 CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌選擇權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎證券的敞口，同時透過特定的波動性相關框架管理潛在的下行風險。

info.description: Concentrix Corp. engages in the provision of customer experience solutions and technology. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Newark, CA.
info.description_zh: Concentrix Corp. 從事提供客戶體驗解決方案和技術。該公司成立於 1973 年，總部位於加州紐瓦克。

info.description: Greenland Technologies Holding Corp. engages in the manufacture of drivetrain systems for material handling machineries and electric vehicles, as well as electric industrial vehicles. Its products include the GEF-series electric forklifts, a series of lithium-powered forklifts with three models ranging in size from 1.8 tons to 3.5 tons, and GEL-1800, a 1.8 ton rated load lithium-powered electric wheeled front loader and GEX-8000, an all-electric 8.0 ton rated load lithium-powered wheeled excavator. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in East Windsor, NJ.
info.description_zh: 格陵蘭科技控股公司從事物料搬運機械和電動汽車以及電動工業車輛傳動系統的製造。產品包括GEF系列電動堆高機、1.8噸至3.5噸三種型號的鋰動力堆高機、1.8噸額定載重鋰動力電動輪式裝載機GEL-1800及8.0噸額定載重全電動鋰動力輪式挖土機GEX-8000。該公司成立於 2006 年，總部位於新澤西州東溫莎。

info.description: Capital Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and consumer banking services through its subsidiary, Capital Bank, NA. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Banking, Capital Bank Home Loans, OpenSky, Windsor Advantage, and Corporate. The Commercial Banking segment provides personalized service to commercial clients throughout the Washington, D.C. and Baltimore metropolitan areas. The Capital Bank Home Loans segment represents the company's mortgage loan division. The OpenSky segment refers to the credit card division. The Windsor Advantage segment provides loan services that offer community banks and credit unions a comprehensive outsourced SBA and USDA lending platform. The Corporate segment includes non-recurring expenses, merger-related expenses, and operational expenses. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Rockville, MD.
info.description_zh: Capital Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司 Capital Bank, NA 提供商業和消費者銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業銀行部門、資本銀行房屋貸款部門、OpenSky、Windsor Advantage 部門和企業部門。商業銀行部門為華盛頓特區和巴爾的摩大都會區的商業客戶提供個人化服務。 Capital Bank 房屋貸款部門代表該公司的抵押貸款部門。 OpenSky 部門是指信用卡部門。 Windsor Advantage 部門提供貸款服務，為社區銀行和信用合作社提供全面的外包 SBA 和 USDA 貸款平台。公司部門包括非經常性費用、合併相關費用和營運費用。該公司成立於 1988 年，總部位於馬裡蘭州羅克維爾。

info.description: Red Cat Holdings, Inc. provides products, services and solutions to the drone industry. It also engages in the provision of distributed data storage, analytics and services for the drone industry.The firm product include Dronebox, which is a blockchain technology that records, stores and analyzes flight data and information from a drone. It operates through the Enterprise Segment. The Enterprise Segment will focus on developing a hardware enabled software platform of services and solutions to government and commercial enterprises and the military. The company was founded by Jeffrey M. Thompson in February 1984 and is headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico.
info.description_zh: Red Cat Holdings, Inc. 為無人機產業提供產品、服務和解決方案。它還致力於為無人機行業提供分散式資料儲存、分析和服務。該公司的產品包括 Dronebox，這是一種記錄、儲存和分析無人機飛行數據和資訊的區塊鏈技術。它透過企業部門運作。企業部門將專注於為政府、商業企業和軍隊開發硬體支援的服務和解決方案軟體平台。該公司由 Jeffrey M. Thompson 於 1984 年 2 月創立，總部位於波多黎各聖胡安。

info.description: Mobile Infrastructure Corp. engages in the acquisition, ownership, and lease of parking facilities and related infrastructure, including parking lots, parking garages, and other parking structures. The company was founded on May 4, 2015 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Mobile Infrastructure Corp. 從事停車設施及相關基礎設施的收購、所有權和租賃業務，包括停車場、停車庫和其他停車設施。該公司成立於2015年5月4日，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: Trinity Biotech Plc engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of medical diagnostic products for the clinical laboratory and point-of-care segments of the diagnostic market. It operates through the Americas and Rest of World geographical segments. The company was founded by Ronan O'Caoimh and Denis R. Burger in June 1992 and is headquartered in Bray, Ireland.
info.description_zh: Trinity Biotech Plc 從事臨床實驗室和診斷市場即時護理領域的醫療診斷產品的開發、製造和行銷。它透過美洲和世界其他地區的地理部分開展業務。該公司由 Ronan O'Caoimh 和 Denis R. Burger 於 1992 年 6 月創立，總部位於愛爾蘭布雷。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long FCX Daily ETF is an exchange-traded fund that seeks to provide daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the common stock of Freeport-McMoRan Inc. The fund employs a leveraged strategy to amplify the daily performance of its underlying security through the use of financial derivative instruments and direct investment.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2x Long FCX Daily ETF 是一款交易所交易基金，旨在提供 Freeport-McMoRan Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金採用槓桿策略，透過使用金融衍生工具和直接投資來放大其基礎證券的每日表現。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptive Medicine ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities of disruptive medicine companies. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 富達顛覆性醫藥 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於顛覆性醫藥公司的證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Decent Holding, Inc. engages in the provision of wastewater treatment by cleansing the industrial wastewater, ecological river restoration, and river ecosystem management. Its products and services include river water quality management and microbial products for water quality enhancement and pollutant cleansing purposes. The company was founded by Ding Xin Sun on January 6, 2022 and is headquartered in Yantai, China.
info.description_zh: Decent Holding, Inc. 從事工業廢水淨化、河川生態修復和河川生態系統管理等廢水處理業務。其產品和服務包括河流水質管理以及用於水質提高和污染物淨化的微生物產品。該公司由孫鼎新於2022年1月6日創立，總部位於中國煙台。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long NET Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of NET. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of NET, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 NET 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 NET 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 NET 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Aureus Greenway Holdings, Inc. engages in the ownership and operation of public golf country clubs, namely Kissimmee Bay Country Club and Remington Golf Club. It operates through the following segments: Golf Recreation, Retail Golf Products, and Equipment and Facilities Rental, Membership Dues, Food and Beverage Services, and Ancillary Services and Amenities. The Golf Recreation, Retail Golf Products, and Equipment and Facilities Rental segment is involved in the collection of fees for every round of eighteen holes, provision of driving ranges for practice, sale of golf apparel and equipment, and rental of golf products and cars. The Membership Dues segment refers to the membership fees for customers to access the club's facilities and services for a set period or daily at the point of sale. The Food and Beverage Services segment provides culinary services such as catering. The Ancillary Services and Amenities segment offers leisure activities hosted in an on-premises clubhouse, kitchen, bar, and dining area. The company was founded on December 22, 2023 and is headquartered in Kissimmee, FL.
info.description_zh: Aureus Greenway Holdings, Inc. 從事公共高爾夫鄉村俱樂部的所有權和運營，即基西米灣鄉村俱樂部和雷明頓高爾夫俱樂部。它透過以下部門運作：高爾夫娛樂部門、零售高爾夫產品部門、設備和設施租賃部門、會員費部門、餐飲服務部門以及輔助服務和便利設施部門。高爾夫娛樂、零售高爾夫產品以及設備和設施租賃分部涉及每輪十八洞收費、提供練習場、銷售高爾夫服裝和設備以及租賃高爾夫產品和汽車。會員費部分是指顧客在一定期限內或每天在銷售點使用俱樂部設施和服務所繳納的會員費。餐飲服務部門提供餐飲等烹飪服務。輔助服務和設施部分提供在內部俱樂部會所、廚房、酒吧和用餐區舉辦的休閒活動。該公司成立於2023年12月22日，總部位於佛羅裡達州基西米。

info.description: Euroholdings Ltd. engages in the provision of shipping transportation services. It specializes in ownership of vessels. The company was founded on March 20, 2024 and is headquartered in Maroussi, Greece.
info.description_zh: Euroholdings Ltd. 從事提供航運服務。它專門從事船舶的所有權。該公司成立於2024年3月20日，總部位於希臘馬魯西。

info.description: Abits Group, Inc. engages in the provision of Internet media marketing services in China and bitcoin mining and related services in the United States. It is the operator of the Games Channel of the Xinhua App, an application developed and operated by Xinhua New China News Agency. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Abits Group, Inc.在中國提供網路媒體行銷服務，在美國提供比特幣挖礦及相關服務。它是新華社開發和運營的應用程式“新華社”遊戲頻道的運營商。公司成立於2013年，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: HomesToLife Ltd. engages in the retail of home furniture and sale of customized furniture solutions. It operates through the following business segments: Retail, Export sales and Leather Trading. The Retail segment includes the results of operations of HTL SG and HTLK. The Export Sales segment includes the results of operations of HTL FE, HTLF, HTLA, HTLJ, HTLUK, and HTL Marketing in relation to export sales. The Leather Trading segment includes the results of operations of HTL Marketing in relation to leather trading. The company was founded by Yong Pin Phua and Yong Tat Phua in September 1989 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: HomesToLife Ltd. 從事家居家具零售和訂製家具解決方案銷售。它透過以下業務部門運作：零售、出口銷售和皮革貿易。零售部門包括 HTL SG 和 HTLK 的營運表現。出口銷售部門包括 HTL FE、HTLF、HTLA、HTLJ、HTLUK 和 HTL Marketing 與出口銷售相關的營運績效。皮革貿易部門包括 HTL Marketing 與皮革貿易相關的營運績效。該公司由Yong Pin Phua 和Yong Tat Phua 於1989 年9 月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Genasys, Inc. engages in the provision of critical communications hardware and software solutions and a multi-channel approach to deliver geo-targeted alerts, notifications, instructions, and information before, during, and after public safety threats and critical business events. Its communications platform includes Genasys Emergency Management (GEM) applications, National Emergency Warning Systems (NEWS), and LRAD long-range voice broadcast systems. The firm operates through the following segments: Hardware and Software. The company was founded by Elwood G. Norris in 1980 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Genasys, Inc. 致力於提供關鍵通訊硬體和軟體解決方案以及多通道方法，以在公共安全威脅和關鍵業務事件之前、期間和之後提供針對地理的警報、通知、指令和資訊。其通信平台包括 Genasys 应急管理 (GEM) 应用程序、国家紧急预警系统 (NEWS) 和 LRAD 远程语音广播系统。该公司通过以下部门运营：硬件和软件部门。该公司由 Elwood G. Norris 于 1980 年创立，总部位于加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥。

info.description: Olenox Industries Inc. is a design and construction services company, which engages in the provision of code engineered cargo shipping containers. It operates through the following segments: Construction, Medical, Development, and Corporate and Support. The Construction Services segment includes the manufacturing of unit SG ECHO and other modules projects. The Medical segment consists of joint venture COVID-19 laboratory operations. The Development segment focuses on real property development. The Corporate and Support segment includes general corporate expenses such as the executive office, corporate finance, accounting, audit, tax, human resources, risk management, information technology, marketing, and legal groups, corporate overhead, and other items not allocated to any of the company's other segments. The company was founded on December 29, 1993 and is headquartered in Conroe, TX.
info.description_zh: Olenox Industries Inc. 是一家設計和施工服務公司，致力於提供規範設計的貨運貨櫃。它透過以下部門運作：建築部門、醫療部門、開發部門以及企業和支援部門。建築服務部門包括 SG ECHO 單元和其他模組項目的製造。醫療部門由合資的 COVID-19 實驗室運作組成。開發部門專注於房地產開發。企業和支援部門包括一般公司開支，如行政辦公室、公司財務、會計、審計、稅務、人力資源、風險管理、資訊科技、行銷和法律團隊、公司管理費用以及未分配給公司任何其他部門的其他項目。該公司成立於1993年12月29日，總部位於德克薩斯州康羅。

info.description: Socket Mobile, Inc. is a mobile data capture company, which engages in the provision of data capture and delivery solutions for enhanced productivity in workforce mobilization. Its products are incorporated into mobile applications used in point of sale (POS), commercial services (field workers), asset tracking, manufacturing process and quality control, transportation and logistics (goods tracking and movement), event management (ticketing, entry, access control, and identification), medical and education. The company's primary products are cordless data capture devices incorporating barcode scanning or RFID/Near Field Communications (NFC) technologies that connect over Bluetooth. All products work with applications running on smartphones, mobile computers and tablets using operating systems from Apple (iOS), Google (Android), and Microsoft (Windows). It also offers an easy-to-use software developer kit (Capture SDK) to application developers, which enables them to provide their users with advanced barcode scanning and RFID/NFC features. The firm's products are integrated in their application solutions and are marketed by the application developers or the resellers of their applications and number of registered developers for data capture applications continues to grow. The company was founded by Michael L. Gifford and Charlie Bass in March 1992 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Socket Mobile, Inc. 是一家行動數據採集公司，致力於提供數據採集和交付解決方案，以提高勞動力動員的生產力。其產品被納入銷售點 (POS)、商業服務（現場工作人員）、資產追蹤、製造過程和品質控制、運輸和物流（貨物追蹤和移動）、活動管理（票務、進入、存取控制和識別）、醫療和教育等領域使用的行動應用程式。該公司的主要產品是採用條碼掃描或透過藍牙連接的 RFID/近場通訊 (NFC) 技術的無線資料擷取設備。所有產品均可與使用 Apple (iOS)、Google (Android) 和 Microsoft (Windows) 作業系統的智慧型手機、行動電腦和平板電腦上執行的應用程式搭配使用。它還為應用程式開發人員提供易於使用的軟體開發工具包（Capture SDK），使他們能夠為用戶提供先進的條碼掃描和 RFID/NFC 功能。該公司的產品整合在他們的應用程式解決方案中，並由應用程式開發人員或其應用程式經銷商進行行銷，並且資料擷取應用程式的註冊開發人員數量持續增長。該公司由 Michael L. Gifford 和 Charlie Bass 於 1992 年 3 月創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Spero Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on identifying, developing, and commercializing treatments involving bacterial infections, including multi-drug resistant bacterial infections, and rare diseases Its pipeline product candidates include Tebipenem HBr, SPR720, and SPR206. The company was founded by Ankit A. Mahadevia and Laurence Rahme in April 2013 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Spero Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於識別、開發和商業化涉及細菌感染（包括多重抗藥性細菌感染）和罕見疾病的治療方法，其管道候選產品包括Tebipenem HBr、SPR720和SPR206。該公司由 Ankit A. Mahadevia 和 Laurence Rahme 於 2013 年 4 月創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Erasca, Inc. is a clinical stage precision oncology company. It focuses on discovering, developing, and commercializing therapies for patients with RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers. It has assembled a wholly owned or controlled RAS/MAPK pathway focused pipeline comprising modality-agnostic programs. The company was founded by Jonathan E. Lim and Kevan Shokat on July 2, 2018 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Erasca, Inc.是一家臨床階段精準腫瘤學公司。它專注於發現、開發和商業化針對 RAS/MAPK 路徑驅動的癌症患者的療法。它已經組成了一個全資擁有或控制的以 RAS/MAPK 通路為重點的管道，其中包括與模態無關的程序。該公司由 Jonathan E. Lim 和 Kevan Shokat 於 2018 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Celularity, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of off-the-shelf placental-derived allogeneic cell therapies for the treatment of cancer and immune and infectious diseases. It operates through the following segments: Cell Therapy, BioBanking, Degenerative Disease, and Other. The Cell Therapy segment consists of the therapies the company is researching and developing. The BioBanking segment focuses on stem cells from umbilical cords and placentas and provides storage of such cells on behalf of individuals for future use. The Degenerative Disease segment offers products used in surgical and wound care markets. The company was founded by Robert Joseph Hariri Gordon in 2016 and is headquartered in Florham Park, NJ.
info.description_zh: Celularity, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發現成的胎盤來源同種異體細胞療法，用於治療癌症、免疫和傳染病。它透過以下部門運作：細胞治療、生物銀行、退化性疾病等。細胞療法部門由公司正在研究和開發的療法組成。生物銀行部門專注於來自臍帶和胎盤的幹細胞，並代表個人儲存此類細胞以供將來使用。退化性疾病部門提供外科和傷口護理市場的產品。該公司由 Robert Joseph Hariri Gordon 於 2016 年創立，總部位於新澤西州弗洛勒姆公園。

info.description: Cre8 Enterprise Ltd. engages in the provision of financial printing, typesetting, artwork design and translation services. The company through its subsidiary provides integrated financial printing services for listed companies, IPO applicants and private companies in the finance and capital market. The firm's services cover concept creation and artwork design, typesetting, proofreading, translation, printing, binding, logistics arrangement, uploading or making e-Submissions of financial reports and compliance documents on the website of the Stock Exchange and media placements. The company was founded on December 4, 2023 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Cre8 Enterprise Ltd. 從事提供財經印刷、排版、藝術品設計及翻譯服務。該公司透過其子公司為金融和資本市場的上市公司、IPO申請人和私人企業提供綜合財經印刷服務。該公司的服務涵蓋概念創作和美術設計、排版、校對、翻譯、印刷、裝訂、物流安排、在聯交所網站上傳或電子提交財務報告和合規文件以及媒體投放。該公司成立於2023年12月4日，總部位於香港。

info.description: FTC Solar, Inc. provides solar tracker systems, technology, software, and engineering services. Solar trackers significantly increase energy production at solar power installations by dynamically optimizing solar panel orientation to the sun. The company was founded by David Springer and Ahmad R. Chatila in 2017 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: FTC Solar, Inc. 提供太陽能追蹤系統、技術、軟體和工程服務。太陽能追蹤器透過動態優化太陽能板對太陽的方向，顯著提高太陽能發電裝置的發電量。該公司由 David Springer 和 Ahmad R. Chatila 於 2017 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: VanEck Gaming ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS Global Gaming Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. To be initially eligible for the index, companies must generate at least 50% of their revenues from gaming. Gaming includes casinos and casino hotels, sports betting (including internet gambling and racetracks) and lottery services as well as gaming services, gaming technology and gaming equipment. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Gaming ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製未計費用和支出之前的 MVIS 全球博彩指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。為了最初符合該指數的資格，公司必須至少 50% 的收入來自遊戲。博彩包括賭場和賭場酒店、體育博彩（包括網路博彩和賽馬場）和彩票服務以及博彩服務、博彩技術和博彩設備。它是非多元化的。

info.description: GoodRx Holdings, Inc. engages in the business of a consumer-focused digital healthcare platform. It offers consumers free access to transparent and lower prices for brand and generic medications, affordable and convenient medical provider consultations via telehealth, and comprehensive healthcare research and information. The company was founded by Trevor Bezdek and Douglas Joseph Hirsch in September 2011 and is headquartered in Santa Monica, CA.
info.description_zh: GoodRx Holdings, Inc.從事以消費者為中心的數位醫療平台業務。它為消費者提供免費獲得透明且較低價格的品牌和仿製藥、透過遠距醫療提供負擔得起且方便的醫療服務提供者諮詢以及全面的醫療保健研究和資訊。該公司由 Trevor Bezdek 和 Douglas Joseph Hirsch 於 2011 年 9 月創立，總部位於加州聖莫尼卡。

info.description: Medicus Pharma Ltd. is a biotech life sciences company, which focuses on accelerating the clinical development programs of novel and disruptive therapeutic assets. It develops a product, SkinJectTM, with an indication for basal cell carcinoma. The company was founded on April 30, 2008 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Medicus Pharma Ltd. 是一家生物技術生命科學公司，專注於加速新型顛覆性治療資產的臨床開發計畫。它開發了一種產品 SkinJectTM，適用於基底細胞癌。該公司成立於2008年4月30日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Atai Beckley, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing effective, rapid-acting, and convenient mental health treatments. The company is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Atai Beckley, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發有效、快速、方便的心理健康治療方法。該公司總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: DirectBooking Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of transportation services through its subsidiary, Primega Construction. Its services include soil and rock transportation, diesel oil trading, and construction works such as excavation and lateral support works and bored piling. The company was founded on April 14, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: DirectBooking Technology Co., Ltd. 透過其子公司 Primega Construction 提供運輸服務。其服務包括土壤和岩石運輸、柴油貿易以及挖掘和橫向支撐工程以及鑽孔打樁等建築工程。該公司成立於2022年4月14日，總部位於香港。

info.description: iShares Defense Industrials Active ETF seeks to maximize total return by investing in companies that fund management believes are well-positioned to benefit from increased global defense and security spending. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in equity securities issued by U.S. and non-U.S. defense and related industrials companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Defense Industrials Active ETF 尋求透過投資基金管理公司認為能夠從全球國防和安全支出增加中受益的公司來最大化總回報。該基金尋求透過在正常市場條件下將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款投資於美國和非美國國防及相關工業公司發行的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nixxy, Inc. engages in the provision of communications, technology, and data-driven platform services. It focuses on building an artificial intelligence-enabled communications and data infrastructure platform that supports global telecommunications services and emerging transaction-enabled workflows. The company was founded by Michael Jay Solomon, Ashley Saddul, and Miles Jennings on July 28, 2008 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Nixxy, Inc. 從事提供通訊、技術和數據驅動的平台服務。它專注於建立一個支援人工智慧的通訊和數據基礎設施平台，支援全球電信服務和新興的交易支援工作流程。該公司由 Michael Jay Solomon、Ashley Saddul 和 Miles Jennings 於 2008 年 7 月 28 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Great Elm Capital Corp., a publicly traded business development company located in the United States, which operates through the broad range of sectors. The company was founded on April 01, 2016, and is headquartered in Palm Beach Gardens, FL.
info.description_zh: Great Elm Capital Corp. 是一家位於美國的上市業務開發公司，業務涉及廣泛的行業。該公司成立於2016年4月1日，總部位於佛羅裡達州棕櫚灘花園。

info.description: Rocky Brands, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of footwear and apparel. Its brands include Rocky, Georgia Boot, Durango, Lehigh, and Michelin. It operates through the following segments: Wholesale, Retail, and Contract Manufacturing. The Wholesale segment distributes products through retail stores. The Retail segment includes direct sales of products to consumers through e-commerce websites, third party marketplaces, and Rocky outlet stores. The Contract Manufacturing segment focuses on wholesale, retail business and footwear contracts with the U.S. military. The company was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Nelsonville, OH.
info.description_zh: Rocky Brands, Inc. 從事鞋類和服裝的設計、製造和行銷。其品牌包括 Rocky、Georgia Boot、Durango、Lehigh 和 Michelin。它透過以下部門運作：批發、零售和合約製造。批發部門透過零售店分銷產品。零售部門包括透過電子商務網站、第三方市場和 Rocky 直銷店直接向消費者銷售產品。合約製造部門專注於批發、零售業務以及與美國軍方的鞋類合約。該公司成立於 1932 年，總部位於俄亥俄州尼爾森維爾。

info.description: HeartCore Enterprises, Inc. operates as a software development company. It operates through the following business units: the customer experience management platform and the digital transformation. The customer experience management platform includes marketing, sales, service, and a content management system. The digital transformation business provides customers with robotic process automation, process mining, and task mining. The company was founded on May 18, 2021 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
info.description_zh: HeartCore Enterprises, Inc. 是一家軟體開發公司。它透過以下業務部門運作：客戶體驗管理平台和數位轉型。客戶體驗管理平台包括行銷、銷售、服務和內容管理系統。數位轉型業務為客戶提供機器人流程自動化、流程挖掘、任務挖掘。該公司成立於2021年5月18日，總部位於日本東京。

info.description: Guardforce AI Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of integrated security solutions. It operates through the following segments: Secured Logistics, AI and Robotics Solutions, General Security Solutions, and Corporate and Others. The Corporate and Others segment covers the non-operating activities supporting the company. The company was founded on April 20, 2018 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: 衛安人工智慧有限公司從事提供綜合安全解決方案。該公司透過以下部門運作：安全物流部門、人工智慧和機器人解決方案部門、通用安全解決方案部門以及企業及其他部門。本公司及其他部門涵蓋支援公司的非經營活動。該公司成立於2018年4月20日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2x Long RCAT ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to provide daily investment results, before fees and expenses, corresponding to 200% of the daily performance of Red Cat Holdings, Inc. (RCAT) common stock. The fund employs a leveraged single-stock strategy designed for sophisticated investors to express short-term bullish views on the underlying issuer's performance through the use of swap agreements and other derivative instruments.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2x Long RCAT ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在提供扣除費用和開支之前的每日投資結果，相當於 Red Cat Holdings, Inc. (RCAT) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該基金採用槓桿單一股票策略，專為經驗豐富的投資者而設計，透過互換協議和其他衍生性工具表達對基礎發行人績效的短期看漲觀點。

info.description: SPS Commerce, Inc. engages in the provision of cloud-based supply chain management services. The firm serves retailers, suppliers, grocers, distributors and logistics firms to orchestrate the management of item data, order fulfillment, inventory control and sales analytics across all channels. Its SPS Commerce cloud services platform offers Trading Partner Community, Fulfillment, Assortment, Analytics, Sourcing, and Other Trading Partner Solutions. The company was founded by Gary W. Anderson and Roger Anderson on January 28, 1987 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: SPS Commerce, Inc. 從事提供基於雲端的供應鏈管理服務。該公司為零售商、供應商、雜貨商、分銷商和物流公司提供服務，協調所有通路的商品資料管理、訂單履行、庫存控制和銷售分析。其 SPS Commerce 雲端服務平台提供貿易合作夥伴社群、履行、分類、分析、採購和其他貿易合作夥伴解決方案。該公司由 Gary W. Anderson 和 Roger Anderson 於 1987 年 1 月 28 日創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: The Descartes Systems Group, Inc. engages in the provision of on-demand, software-as-a-service solutions focused on improving the productivity, performance and security of logistics-intensive businesses. It uses modular, software-as-a-service solutions to route, schedule, track and measure delivery resources; plan, allocate and execute shipments; rate, audit and pay transportation invoices; access global trade data; file customs and security documents for imports and exports; and complete numerous other logistics processes by participating in the world's largest, collaborative multimodal logistics community. The company was founded on May 22, 1981 and is headquartered in Waterloo, Canada.
info.description_zh: Descartes Systems Group, Inc. 致力於提供按需軟體即服務解決方案，專注於提升物流密集型企業的生產力、效能和安全性。它使用模組化的軟體即服務解決方案來路由、調度、追蹤和測量交付資源；計劃、分配和執行運輸；評估、審核並支付運輸發票；訪問全球貿易數據；歸檔進出口海關和安全文件；並透過參與世界上最大的協作多式聯運物流社區來完成眾多其他物流流程。該公司成立於1981年5月22日，總部位於加拿大滑鐵盧。

info.description: Chagee Holdings Ltd. engages in the sales of freshly-made tea drinks, related raw materials, packaging, teahouse equipment, and other supplies. Its products include tea latte, teapuccino, iced oriental tea, teaspresso, and other creative tea drinks. The company was founded by Jun Jie Zhang in June 2017 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 昌吉控股有限公司從事現泡茶飲料、相關原料、包裝、茶館設備及其他用品的銷售。其產品包括拿鐵茶、茶布奇諾、冰東方茶、特濃咖啡等創意茶飲。該公司由張軍傑於2017年6月創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: REX Drone ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the VettaFi Drone IndexSM (the "Index"). Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities that comprise the index. The index tracks the performance of a portfolio of global equity securities of companies that are engaged in drone and/or unmanned aerial vehicles ("UAV") manufacturing and enabling technologies. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: REX 無人機 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 VettaFi Drone IndexSM（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數追蹤從事無人機和/或無人駕駛飛行器（“UAV”）製造和支援技術的公司的全球股票證券投資組合的表現。它是非多元化的。

info.description: NextPlat Corp. engages in the provision of satellite-based services and solutions for commercial, government and individual users. The firm's services include satellite communication solutions, emergency location systems, high-speed satellite internet and global asset and personnel monitoring, customized ground station systems and custom product design. It operates through the e-Commerce Operations and Healthcare Operations segments. The e-Commerce Operations segment refers to acquiring and leasing, primarily an e-commerce platform to collaborate with businesses to optimize their ability to sell their goods online, domestically, and internationally. The Healthcare Operations segment refers TPA, data management, COVID-19 related diagnostics and vaccinations, prescription pharmaceuticals, compounded medications, tele pharmacy services, anti-retroviral medications, and medication therapy management. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Hallandale Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: NextPlat Corp. 致力於為商業、政府和個人用戶提供基於衛星的服務和解決方案。該公司的服務包括衛星通訊解決方案、緊急定位系統、高速衛星互聯網和全球資產和人員監控、客製化地面站系統和客製化產品設計。它透過電子商務營運和醫療保健營運部門運作。電子商務營運部門涉及收購和租賃，主要是一個與企業合作的電子商務平台，以優化其在國內和國際上在線銷售商品的能力。醫療保健營運部門涉及 TPA、資料管理、COVID-19 相關診斷和疫苗接種、處方藥、複方藥物、遠距藥房服務、抗逆轉錄病毒藥物和藥物治療管理。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州哈倫代爾海灘。

info.description: Gulf Resources, Inc. is a holding company that engages in the manufacture of chemical products. It operates through the following segments: Bromine, Crude Salt, Chemical Products, and Natural Gas. It produces and trades bromine, crude salt and natural gas, and manufactures and sells chemical products used in oil and gas field exploration, oil and gas distribution, and oil field drilling. The firm also supplies papermaking chemical agents, inorganic chemicals, and manufactures materials for human and animal antibiotics. The company was founded by Ming Yang on February 28, 1989 and is headquartered in Shouguang, China.
info.description_zh: Gulf Resources, Inc.是一家從事化學產品製造的控股公司。該公司透過以下部門營運：溴部門、原鹽部門、化學產品部門和天然氣部門。它生產和貿易溴、原鹽和天然氣，並製造和銷售用於油氣田勘探、油氣分配和油田鑽井的化學產品。該公司還供應造紙化學製劑、無機化學品以及生產人類和動物抗生素材料。該公司由明陽於1989年2月28日創立，總部位於中國壽光。

info.description: ABVC BioPharma, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of new drugs and medical devices. The firm's product pipeline includes ABV-1501, which is a combination therapy for triple negative breast cancer, ABV-1504, which is a botanical reuptake inhibitor that targets norepinephrine, ABV-1505 for treating attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, ABV-1702 to treat myelodysplastic syndromes, ABV-1703 for Pancreatic Cancer, ABV-1601 for treating depression in cancer patients, ABV-1701, which is a vitreous substitute for vitrectomy, ABV-2001, and ABV-2002. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: ABVC BioPharma, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，從事新藥和醫療器材的開發。該公司的產品線包括ABV-1501（一種用於三陰性乳癌的聯合療法）、ABV-1504（一種針對去甲腎上腺素的植物再攝取抑制劑）、用於治療注意力缺陷多動障礙的ABV-1505、用於治療骨髓增生異常綜合徵的ABV-1702、用於胰腺癌的ABV-1505、用於治療骨髓增生異常綜合徵的ABV-1702、用於胰腺癌的ABV-1703、用於治療骨髓增生異常抑鬱症的ABV-1702、用於胰腺癌的ABV-1703、用於治療103137-1073-10313703333303000333000003年的SVWV-1703、333、333-1333333年》。是玻璃體切除術、ABV-2001 和 ABV-2002 的玻璃體替代品。該公司成立於 1990 年，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Gartner, Inc. is a research and advisory company, which engages in the provision of insights, advice, and tools that help build organizations. It operates through the following segments: Insights, Consulting, Conferences, and Other. The Insights segment equips executives and their teams from every major function, geography, industry and sector with actionable, objective insights, guidance, and tools. The Consulting segment serves the chief information officer and other senior executives who are driving technology-driven strategic initiatives to optimize technology investments and drive business impact. The Conferences segment focuses on information technology and business executives as well as decision makers looking to adapt and evolve their organizations through disruption and uncertainty, navigate risks, and prioritize investments. The company was founded by Gideon I. Gartner and Dave L. R. Stein in 1979 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Gartner, Inc. 是一家研究和顧問公司，致力於提供有助於建立組織的見解、建議和工具。它透過以下部門運作：洞察部門、諮詢部門、會議部門和其他部門。洞察部門為來自各個主要職能、地理位置、產業和部門的高階主管及其團隊提供可行的、客觀的洞察、指導和工具。諮詢部門為資訊長和其他高階主管提供服務，他們推動技術驅動的策略計劃，以優化技術投資並推動業務影響。會議部分重點關注資訊科技和業務高管以及決策者，他們希望透過顛覆和不確定性來適應和發展其組織、駕馭風險並確定投資優先順序。該公司由 Gideon I. Gartner 和 Dave L. R. Stein 於 1979 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: SoFi Technologies, Inc. is a financial service platform, which engages in the provision of student loan refinancing options to the private student loan market. It operates through the following segments: Lending, Technology Platform, and Financial Services. The Lending segment offers personal loans, student loans, home loan products, and related servicing activities. The Technology Platform segment focuses on technology products and solutions revenue. The Financial Services segment includes the SoFi Money product, SoFi Invest product, SoFi Credit Card product, SoFi Relay personal finance management product, and other financial services. The company was founded in April 2011 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: SoFi Technologies, Inc. 是一家金融服務平台，致力於向私人學生貸款市場提供學生貸款再融資選項。它透過以下部門運作：貸款、技術平台和金融服務。貸款部門提供個人貸款、學生貸款、房屋貸款產品和相關服務活動。技術平台部門專注於技術產品和解決方案收入。金融服務部門包括SoFi Money產品、SoFi Invest產品、SoFi信用卡產品、SoFi Relay個人財務管理產品和其他金融服務。該公司成立於2011年4月，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of global maritime shipping services through its subsidiaries. Its services include time chartering and vessel management. The company was founded on July 4, 2023 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司提供全球海運服務。其服务包括期租和船舶管理。該公司成立於2023年7月4日，總部位於香港。

info.description: The Hackett Group, Inc. engages in the provision of dedicated expertise in generative artificial intelligence strategy, operations, finance, human capital management, strategic sourcing, procurement, and information technology. Its solutions include AI implementation, application managed services, applied intelligence programs, business benchmarking, cloud services, data and analytics, digital transformation, enterprise applications, Gen AI consulting, learning and development, outsourcing consulting, solution intelligence, strategic cost reduction, talent management, third-party risk management, and working capital management. It operates through the following segments: Global Strategy and Business Transformation (S&BT), Oracle Solutions, and SAP Solutions. The Global S&BT segment includes the results of the company's strategic business consulting practices. The Oracle Solutions segment is involved in oracle enterprise performance management, enterprise resource planning, and application maintenance and support practices. The SAP Solutions segment focuses on the SAP applications and related SAP service offerings. The company was founded by Ted A. Fernandez and David N. Dungan in 1991 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Hackett Group, Inc. 致力於提供產生人工智慧策略、營運、財務、人力資本管理、策略採購、採購和資訊科技方面的專門專業知識。其解決方案包括人工智慧實施、應用託管服務、應用智慧專案、業務基準測試、雲端服務、數據和分析、數位轉型、企業應用、Gen AI諮詢、學習和開發、外包諮詢、解決方案智慧、策略成本降低、人才管理、第三方風險管理和營運資本管理。它透過以下部門運作：全球策略和業務轉型 (S&BT)、Oracle 解決方案和 SAP 解決方案。全球 S&BT 部門包括公司策略性商業諮詢實務的成果。 Oracle 解決方案部門涉及 Oracle 企業績效管理、企業資源規劃以及應用程式維護和支援實務。 SAP 解決方案部門專注於 SAP 應用程式和相關 SAP 服務產品。該公司由 Ted A. Fernandez 和 David N. Dungan 於 1991 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Five9, Inc. engages in the provision of cloud software for contact centers. It specializes in omnichannel routing, analytics, workforce organization, and reporting. The company was founded in December 2001 and is headquartered in San Ramon, CA.
info.description_zh: Five9, Inc. 致力於為聯絡中心提供雲端軟體。它專注於全通路路由、分析、勞動力組織和報告。該公司成立於 2001 年 12 月，總部位於加州聖拉蒙。

info.description: MongoDB, Inc. engages in the development and provision of a general-purpose database platform. The firm's products include MongoDB Enterprise Advanced, MongoDB Atlas, and Community Server. It also offers professional services including consulting and training. The company was founded by Eliot Horowitz, Dwight A. Merriman, Kevin P. Ryan, and Geir Magnusson Jr. in November 2007 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: MongoDB, Inc. 從事通用資料庫平台的開發和提供。該公司的產品包括 MongoDB Enterprise Advanced、MongoDB Atlas 和 Community Server。它還提供包括諮詢和培訓在內的專業服務。該公司由 Eliot Horowitz、Dwight A. Merriman、Kevin P. Ryan 和 Geir Magnusson Jr. 於 2007 年 11 月創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: BNB Plus Corp. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development and commercialization of technologies to produce and detect deoxyribonucleic acid and ribonucleic acid. It operates through the following segments: Therapeutic DNA Production Services, MDx Testing Services, and DNA Tagging and Security Products and Services. The Therapeutic DNA Production Services segment consists of the enzymatic manufacture of synthetic DNA for use in the production of nucleic acid-based therapeutics and the development and sale of a proprietary RNAP for use in the production of mRNA therapeutics. The MDx Testing Services segment develops clinical molecular diagnostic and genetic tests and clinical laboratory testing services. The DNA Tagging and Security Products and Services segment is involved in the detection of DNA for industrial supply chains and security services. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Stony Brook, NY.
info.description_zh: BNB Plus Corp.是一家生物技術公司，從事脫氧核糖核酸和核糖核酸生產和檢測技術的開發和商業化。該公司透過以下部門運作：治療性 DNA 生產服務、MDx 測試服務以及 DNA 標記和安全產品及服務。治療性 DNA 生產服務部門包括用於生產基於核酸的治療劑的合成 DNA 的酶促生產，以及用於生產 mRNA 治療劑的專有 RNAP 的開發和銷售。 MDx 測試服務部門開發臨床分子診斷和基因測試以及臨床實驗室測試服務。 DNA 標籤和安全產品及服務部門涉及工業供應鏈和安全服務的 DNA 檢測。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於紐約州石溪。

info.description: IM Cannabis Corp. engages in the production and sale of medical cannabis products. It offers dry flower products and cannabis oil products under the IMC brand. The company was founded on March 7, 1980 and is headquartered in Glil Yam, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: IM Cannabis Corp. 從事醫用大麻產品的生產和銷售。它以 IMC 品牌提供乾燥花產品和大麻油產品。該公司成立於1980年3月7日，總部位於以色列Glil Yam。

info.description: Galmed Pharmaceuticals Ltd. is a clinical-stage drug development biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of oral therapy for the treatment of non-alcoholic steato-hepatitis (NASH). Its product candidate, Aramchol, is a synthetic fatty acid-bile acid conjugate molecule for the oral treatment of NASH in patients who are overweight or obese and have prediabetes or type II diabetes mellitus. The company was founded by Allen Baharaff and Tuvia Gilat in 2000 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.description_zh: Galmed Pharmaceuticals Ltd.是一家臨床階段藥物開發生物製藥公司，致力於開發治療非酒精性脂肪性肝炎（NASH）的口服療法。其候選產品Aramchol是一種合成脂肪酸-膽汁酸結合分子，用於口服治療超重或肥胖以及患有前驅糖尿病或II型糖尿病的患者的NASH。該公司由 Allen Baharaff 和 Tuvia Gilat 於 2000 年創立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: Opendoor Technologies, Inc. engages in the operation of buying, selling, and trading of residential properties online. The company was founded by Eric Wu on December 30, 2013, and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: Opendoor Technologies, Inc. 從事住宅物業的線上購買、銷售和交易業務。該公司由 Eric Wu 於 2013 年 12 月 30 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: SciSparc Ltd. is a clinical stage pharmaceutical company, which focuses on creating and enhancing a portfolio of technologies and assets based on cannabinoid pharmaceuticals. It operates through the Drug Development and Online Sales segments. The Drug Development segment focuses on cannabinoid molecules to be approved by an official regulatory authority. The Online Sales segment consists of hemp-based products including hemp gummies, hemp oil capsules, hemp gel, hemp cream, detox pills, height pills, antibacterial creams, and anti-aging creams, among other beauty and hair treatment products that are all manufactured in the United States. The company was founded on August 23, 2004 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.description_zh: SciSparc Ltd. 是一家临床阶段制药公司，专注于创建和增强基于大麻素药物的技术和资产组合。它透過藥物開發和線上銷售部門運作。藥物開發部門專注於待官方監管機構批准的大麻素分子。線上銷售部門包括大麻基產品，包括大麻軟糖、大麻油膠囊、大麻凝膠、大麻霜、排毒丸、增高丸、抗菌霜和抗衰老霜以及其他美容和護髮產品，這些產品均在美國製造。該公司成立於2004年8月23日，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: EPAM Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of digital engineering, cloud, and artificial intelligence-enabled transformation services. The firm combines software engineering with customer experience design, business consulting, strategy, and technology innovation services in areas such as cloud platforms, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence. It operates through the North America and Europe geographical segments. The company was founded by Leonid Lozner and Arkadiy Dobkin in 1993 and is headquartered in Newtown, PA.
info.description_zh: EPAM Systems, Inc. 從事提供數位工程、雲端和人工智慧支援的轉型服務。該公司將軟體工程與雲端平台、網路安全和人工智慧等領域的客戶體驗設計、業務諮詢、策略和技術創新服務相結合。它透過北美和歐洲地理部門開展業務。該公司由 Leonid Lozner 和 Arkadiy Dobkin 於 1993 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州紐敦。

info.description: Ultralife Corp. engages in the manufacture and sale of products for power solutions. It operates through the following segments: Battery and Energy Products and Communications System. The Battery and Energy Products segment includes Lithium 9-volt, cylindrical, thin cell and various other non-rechargeable batteries, in addition to rechargeable batteries, uninterruptable power supplies, charging systems, and accessories such as cables. The Communications System segment consists of radio frequency amplifiers, power supplies, cable and connector assemblies, amplified speakers, equipment mounts, case equipment, integrated communication systems for fixed or vehicle applications, and communications and electronics systems design. The company was founded by Arthur M. Liberman in December 1990 and is headquartered in Newark, NY.
info.description_zh: Ultralife Corp. 從事電源解決方案產品的製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：電池和能源產品以及通訊系統。電池和能源產品部門包括 9 伏特鋰電池、圓柱形薄電池和各種其他不可充電電池，以及可充電電池、不間斷電源、充電系統和電纜等配件。通訊系統部門包括射頻放大器、電源、電纜和連接器組件、放大揚聲器、設備支架、機箱設備、固定或車輛應用的整合式通訊系統以及通訊和電子系統設計。該公司由 Arthur M. Liberman 於 1990 年 12 月創立，總部位於紐約州紐瓦克。

info.description: Jet.AI, Inc. engages in the provision of a business-to-business software platform for SaaS products and private aviation services. Its projects include Manitoba, Maritimes, and Moapa. The company was founded by Michael D. Winston on June 4, 2018 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: Jet.AI, Inc. 致力於為 SaaS 產品和私人航空服務提供企業對企業軟體平台。其項目包括曼尼托巴省、濱海省和莫阿帕省。該公司由 Michael D. Winston 於 2018 年 6 月 4 日創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Sypris Solutions, Inc. engages in the provision of truck components, oil and gas pipeline components, and aerospace and defense electronics. It operates through the following segments: Sypris Technologies and Sypris Electronics. The Sypris Technologies segment is involved in the selling of forged, machined, welded, and heat-treated steel components primarily for heavy commercial vehicle and high-pressure energy pipeline applications. The Sypris Electronics segment includes circuit card and full box build manufacturing, high reliability manufacturing, systems assembly and integration, design for manufacturability and design to specification work. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Louisville, KY.
info.description_zh: Sypris Solutions, Inc. 從事卡車零件、石油和天然氣管道零件以及航空航太和國防電子產品的供應。它透過以下部門運作：Sypris Technologies 和 Sypris Electronics。 Sypris Technologies 部門從事鍛造、機械加工、焊接和熱處理鋼零件的銷售，主要用於重型商用車和高壓能源管道應用。 Sypris Electronics 部門包括電路卡和整機組裝製造、高可靠性製造、系統組裝和整合、可製造性設計以及規格設計工作。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於肯塔基州路易斯維爾。

info.description: Lion Group Holding Ltd. operates an all-in-one, state-of-the-art trading platform that offers a wide spectrum of products and services. It operates through the following segments: Futures and Securities Brokerage Services, Contract-For-Difference (CFD) Trading, Total Return Service (TRS) Trading and OTC Stock Option Trading. The company was founded by Jian Wang in 2015 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Lion Group Holding Ltd. 經營著一個一體化、最先進的交易平台，提供廣泛的產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：期貨和證券經紀服務、差價合約（CFD）交易、總回報服務（TRS）交易和場外股票選擇權交易。該公司由王健於2015年創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: VirnetX Holding Corp. engages in the provision of Internet security software and technology solutions to facilitate secure network communications, including 5G and 4G LTE. Its products include War Room, Gabriel secure gateway, collaboration suite, secure domains, secure communication platform, and connection technology. The company was founded on August 5, 2005 and is headquartered in Zephyr Cove, NV.
info.description_zh: VirnetX Holding Corp. 從事提供網路安全軟體和技術解決方案，以促進安全網路通信，包括 5G 和 4G LTE。其產品包括 War Room、Gabriel 安全閘道、協作套件、安全域、安全通訊平台和連接技術。該公司成立於2005年8月5日，總部位於內華達州Zephyr Cove。

info.description: CISO Global, Inc. engages in the provision of cybersecurity services and solutions. The firm provides information technology managed services such as infrastructure and network assessment, data and server migration, enterprise network design, network security systems assessment and deployment, phone and communication services including voice over Internet protocol, and technology operation process and procedures. It also offers security consulting solutions which consist of cybersecurity consulting, penetration testing, compliance auditing, security remediation, and vulnerability assessments. The company was founded by David G. Jemmett, Alan Kierman and Stephen Scott on March 5, 2019 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.description_zh: CISO Global, Inc. 從事提供網路安全服務和解決方案。該公司提供資訊技術管理服務，例如基礎設施和網路評估、數據和伺服器遷移、企業網路設計、網路安全系統評估和部署、電話和通訊服務（包括網際網路協定語音）以及技術操作流程和程序。它還提供安全諮詢解決方案，包括網路安全諮詢、滲透測試、合規審計、安全修復和漏洞評估。該公司由 David G. Jemmett、Alan Kierman 和 Stephen Scott 於 2019 年 3 月 5 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: Eastern International Ltd. operates as a holding company. It engages in the provision of logistic services for entities. It operates through the Transportation Services and Warehouse Subleasing Services segments. The Transportation Services segment includes project logistic, cross border logistic, and basic logistic. The company was founded on July 27, 2023 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 東方國際有限公司作為一家控股公司運作。它從事為實體提供物流服務。它透過運輸服務和倉庫轉租服務部門運作。運輸服務部門包括專案物流、跨境物流和基礎物流。公司成立於2023年7月27日，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long DNN Daily ETF is an aggressively managed single-stock exchange-traded fund that targets daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily price performance of the common stock of Denison Mines Corp. The fund is designed as a tactical tool for sophisticated investors to amplify short-term bullish views on a prominent uranium exploration and development company through the use of daily-resetting financial derivatives.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2x Long DNN Daily ETF 是一款積極管理的單一股票交易所交易基金，其目標是丹尼森礦業公司 (Denison Mines Corp) 普通股每日價格表現的 200% 的每日投資業績（扣除費用和開支）。該基金旨在作為成熟投資者的戰術工具，透過使用每日重置的金融衍生性商品來放大對一家著名鈾勘探和開發公司的短期看漲觀點。

info.description: Cuprina Holdings (Cayman) Ltd. engages in the manufacturing, sale, and supply of medical devices to manage and accelerate healing and closure of chronic wounds. Its products include nature-based bioactive, in the form of advanced wound dressings, derived from sustainable sources. The company was founded by Carl Marc Baptista on August 28, 2019 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Cuprina Holdings (Cayman) Ltd. 從事醫療設備的製造、銷售和供應，以管理和加速慢性傷口的癒合和閉合。其產品包括源自永續來源的先進傷口敷料形式的基於天然的生物活性物質。該公司由Carl Marc Baptista於2019年8月28日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Galaxy Payroll Group Ltd. is a holding company which provides payroll outsourcing services. It also offers employment, consultancy and market research services. The outsourcing services assist its end-users in calculating employees' salaries and the required employer's contributions to social security and housing provident funds as well as individual income tax and any other deductions. The employment services act as the employers of record to employ suitable candidates, who are sourced by their end-users. The consultancy and market research services provides consultation for local policy and delivery of country profile reports. The company was founded by Wai Hong Lao, Yiu Kong But, and Wai Cheung Yeung in April 2013 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Galaxy Payroll Group Ltd.是一家提供薪資外包服務的控股公司。它還提供就業、諮詢和市場研究服務。外包服務協助最終用戶計算員工薪資、雇主所需繳納的社會安全和住房公積金以及個人所得稅和任何其他扣除項目。就業服務機構作為記錄雇主來僱用合適的候選人，這些候選人是由其最終用戶尋找的。諮詢和市場研究服務為當地政策提供諮詢並提供國家概況報告。該公司由Wai Hong Lao、Yiu Kong But和Wai Cheung Yeung於2013年4月創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Orion Energy Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of light emitting diode lighting systems, wireless Internet of Things enabled control, commercial and industrial electric vehicle charging infrastructure solutions, and lighting and electrical maintenance services. It operates through the following segments: Lighting, Maintenance, Electric Vehicle Charging (EV), and Corporate and Other. The Lighting segment is involved in the development and sale of lighting products and provides construction and engineering services for commercial lighting and energy management systems. The Maintenance segment focuses on retailers, distributors, and other businesses with maintenance, repair, and replacement services for lighting and related electrical components. The EV segment offers electric vehicle charging expertise and provides EV turnkey installation solutions with ongoing support to all commercial verticals. The Corporate and Other segment includes operating expenses. The company was founded by Neal R. Verfuerth and Patrick J. Trotter in April 1996 and is headquartered in Manitowoc, WI.
info.description_zh: Orion Energy Systems, Inc. 從事提供發光二極管照明系統、無線物聯網控制、商業和工業電動車充電基礎設施解決方案以及照明和電氣維護服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：照明部門、維修部門、電動車充電部門（EV）以及企業及其他部門。照明部門從事照明產品的開發和銷售，並為商業照明和能源管理系統提供建築和工程服務。維修部門專注於為照明及相關電氣元件提供維護、維修和更換服務的零售商、經銷商和其他企業。電動車部門提供電動車充電專業知識，並提供電動車交鑰匙安裝解決方案，並為所有商業垂直領域提供持續支援。公司及其他部門包括營運費用。該公司由 Neal R. Verfuerth 和 Patrick J. Trotter 於 1996 年 4 月創立，總部位於威斯康辛州馬尼托瓦克。

info.description: ProCap Financial, Inc. is a bitcoin-native financial services firm offering lending, trading, and investment solutions tailored to institutional clients. It combines traditional finance infrastructure with a bitcoin-focused treasury and service model. The company was founded on June 17, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: ProCap Financial, Inc. 是一家比特幣原生金融服務公司，為機構客戶提供量身訂製的貸款、交易和投資解決方案。它將傳統的金融基礎設施與以比特幣為中心的金庫和服務模式結合起來。該公司成立於2025年6月17日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Oncolytics Biotech, Inc. engages in the provision of development of immuno-oncolytic virus for the treatment of solid tumors and hematological malignancies. It offers a non-pathogenic, properietary isolation of the reovirus that induces selective tumor lysis and promotes an inflamed tumor phenotype through innate and adaptive immune responses. The company was founded by Matthew C. Coffey and Bradley George Thompson on April 2, 1998 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
info.description_zh: Oncolytics Biotech, Inc. 從事免疫溶瘤病毒的開發，用於治療實體瘤和血液惡性腫瘤。它提供了呼腸孤病毒的非致病性、專有分離，誘導選擇性腫瘤溶解並透過先天和適應性免疫反應促進發炎的腫瘤表型。該公司由 Matthew C. Coffey 和 Bradley George Thompson 於 1998 年 4 月 2 日創立，總部位於加拿大卡加利。

info.description: TSS, Inc. engages in the provision of comprehensive services for the planning, design, development and maintenance of mission-critical facilities and information infrastructure as well as integration services. It operates through the Facilities and Systems Integration Services business segments. The Facilities segment consists of the design, project management, and maintenance of data center and mission-critical business operations. The Systems Integration segment integrates information technology equipment for original equipment manufacturer vendors and customers to be used inside data center environments, including modular data centers. The company was founded by Gerard J. Gallagher on December 20, 2004 and is headquartered in Georgetown, TX.
info.description_zh: TSS, Inc. 致力於為關鍵任務設施和資訊基礎設施的規劃、設計、開發和維護以及整合服務提供綜合服務。它透過設施和系統整合服務業務部門運作。設施部門包括資料中心和關鍵任務業務運作的設計、專案管理和維護。系統整合部門為原始設備製造商供應商和客戶整合資訊科技設備，以便在資料中心環境（包括模組化資料中心）內使用。該公司由 Gerard J. Gallagher 於 2004 年 12 月 20 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州喬治敦。

info.description: My Size, Inc. engages in the development of measurement technologies. It provides solutions for e-commerce, apparel, shipping and parcel delivery, and do-it-yourself industry applications. It offers measurement apps including MySizeID, BoxSize, and SizeUP. It operates through the Fashion and Equipment E-commerce Platform, and SaaS Solutions segments. The Fashion and Equipment E-commerce Platform segment represents Orgad's activity that was acquired by the company, mainly operates on Amazon. The SaaS Solutions segment relates to innovative artificial intelligence driven measurement solutions. The company was founded by Ronen Luzon on September 20, 1999 and is headquartered in Airport City, Israel.
info.description_zh: My Size, Inc. 從事測量技術的開發。它為電子商務、服裝、運輸和包裹遞送以及DIY行業應用提供解決方案。它提供的測量應用程式包括 MySizeID、BoxSize 和 SizeUP。它透過時尚和裝備電子商務平台和 SaaS 解決方案部門運作。時尚和裝備電子商務平台部門代表了 Orgad 的業務，已被該公司收購，主要在亞馬遜上營運。 SaaS 解決方案部門涉及創新的人工智慧驅動的測量解決方案。該公司由Ronen Luzon於1999年9月20日創立，總部位於以色列機場城。

info.description: Greenwich LifeSciences, Inc. engages in the development of a breast cancer immunotherapy designed to prevent the recurrence of breast cancer following surgery. The company was founded by Eric Rothe on August 29, 2006 and is headquartered in Stafford, TX.
info.description_zh: Greenwich LifeSciences, Inc. 致力於乳癌免疫療法的開發，旨在預防乳癌手術後復發。該公司由 Eric Rothe 於 2006 年 8 月 29 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州斯塔福德。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long SOFI ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of SoFi Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: SOFI). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance 每日目標 2 倍多頭 SOFI ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 SoFi Technologies, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：SOFI）每日股價變化百分比的兩倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。
