info.description: Direxion Daily SOFI Bull 2X ETF is an aggressively managed single-stock leveraged exchange-traded fund that targets daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily price performance of the common shares of SoFi Technologies, Inc. Designed as a tactical instrument for sophisticated investors, the fund utilizes financial derivative instruments to amplify short-term bullish conviction in a leading digital financial services platform, necessitating daily monitoring due to the effects of compounding and path dependency.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily SOFI Bull 2X ETF 是一款積極管理的單股槓桿交易所交易基金，其目標是 SoFi Technologies, Inc. 普通股每日價格表現 200% 的每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）。該基金被設計為成熟投資者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生工具來放大領先數位金融服務平台的短期看漲信念，由於複利和路徑依賴的影響，需要進行日常監控。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long PLTR Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the common stock of Palantir Technologies Inc. (NYSE: PLTR). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. It will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned or realized on the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long PLTR Daily ETF 尋求每日投資收益（扣除費用和開支）為 Palantir Technologies Inc.（NYSE：PLTR）普通股的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。它將與主要金融機構簽訂一份或多份互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，根據該協議，基金和金融機構將同意交換標的股票賺取或實現的回報。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PLTR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of PLTR. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PLTR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PLTR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 PLTR 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 PLTR 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long OPEN Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of OPEN. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of OPEN, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 OPEN 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 OPEN 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些工具結合起來提供 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long AVAV ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Aerovironment Inc. (NASDAQ: AVAV). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is expected to allocate between 40% and 60% of its assets as collateral for swap agreements or as premiums for purchased options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long AVAV ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Aerovironment Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：AVAV）每日股價變化百分比的兩倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金預計將分配 40% 至 60% 的資產作為掉期協議的抵押品或作為購買選擇權合約的溢價。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Workhorse Group, Inc. engages in the provision of sustainable solutions to the commercial transportation sector. It operates as an original equipment manufacturer, which designs and builds battery-electric vehicles including trucks and aircraft. The company was founded by Stephen S. Burns on February 20, 2007 and is headquartered in Wixom, MI.
info.description_zh: Workhorse Group, Inc. 致力於為商業運輸領域提供永續解決方案。它是一家原始設備製造商，設計和製造電池電動車，包括卡車和飛機。該公司由 Stephen S. Burns 於 2007 年 2 月 20 日創立，總部位於密西根州威克瑟姆。

info.description: Editas Medicine, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of genome editing technology. Its technology includes clustered, regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR), and CRISPR associated protein 9 (Cas9). The company was founded by Feng Zhang, Jennifer A. Doudna, George McDonald Church, J. Keith Joung and David R. Liu on September 3, 2013 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Editas Medicine, Inc. 從事基因組編輯技術的開發和商業化。其技術包括成簇、規則間隔的短回文重複序列 (CRISPR) 和 CRISPR 相關蛋白 9 (Cas9)。該公司由 Feng Zhang、Jennifer A. Doudna、George McDonald Church、J. Keith Joung 和 David R. Liu 於 2013 年 9 月 3 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Direxion Daily HOOD Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of HOOD. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of HOOD and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to HOOD, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily HOOD Bull 2X ETF 寻求每日投资结果（未计费用和开支）为 HOOD 每日业绩的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 HOOD 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和期權，這些組合起來為 HOOD 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long HOOD ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Robinhood Markets, Inc. (Nasdaq: HOOD). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the Underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long HOOD ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Robinhood Markets, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：HOOD）每日股價變化百分比的兩倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long ONDS Daily ETF is an actively managed fund targeting 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of Ondas Holdings Inc. (ONDS). The strategy is a tactical instrument for sophisticated traders, utilizing financial derivatives to provide magnified daily exposure to the underlying wireless communication and automated drone technology firm.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 ONDS 每日 ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，目標為 Ondas Holdings Inc. (ONDS) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該策略是經驗豐富的交易者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生性商品來擴大對基礎無線通訊和自動無人機技術公司的日常曝險。

info.description: VSee Health, Inc. is a no-code or low-code software as a service (SaaS) platform that enables clinicians and enterprises to create their telehealth workflows without programming. It engages in providing timely, quality healthcare to patients regardless of geographical barriers. The company was founded on June 24, 2024 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: VSee Health, Inc. 是一個無程式碼或低程式碼軟體即服務 (SaaS) 平台，讓臨床醫生和企業無需編程即可建立遠距醫療工作流程。它致力於為患者提供及時、優質的醫療保健，不受地理障礙的影響。該公司成立於 2024 年 6 月 24 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Founder Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the supply and installation of solar systems and other engineering works involving civil, structural, mechanical, and electrical engineering. It operates through the Large-Scale Solar and Commercial and Industrial segments. The Large-Scale Solar segment offers ground mounted solar projects designed to supply power to the power grid. The Commercial and Industrial segment provides solar projects systems installed on rooftops designed to generate electricity for commercial and industrial properties such as factories, warehouses, and commercial stores. The company was founded by Lee Seng Chi on April 13, 2021 and is headquartered in Klang, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: 方正集團有限公司是一家控股公司，從事太陽能係統的供應和安裝以及其他涉及土木、結構、機械和電氣工程的工程。它透過大型太陽能和商業和工業部門運作。大型太陽能部門提供地面安裝太陽能項目，旨在為電網供電。商業和工業部門提供安裝在屋頂上的太陽能專案系統，旨在為工廠、倉庫和商業商店等商業和工業房地產發電。該公司由李成志於2021年4月13日創立，總部位於馬來西亞巴生。

info.description: Veea, Inc. is a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) company, which engages in the sale of smart computing hubs and related subscriptions and licenses. Its solutions include digital inclusion, connected buildings, precision agriculture, TROLLEE, and Internet-of-Things (IoT) and Industrial internet of things (IIoT) connectivity. The company was founded by Allen B. Salmasi and Michael Salmasi in 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Veea, Inc. 是一家平台即服務 (PaaS) 公司，從事智慧運算中心及相關訂閱和授權的銷售。其解決方案包括數位包容、互聯建築、精準農業、TROLLEE、物聯網 (IoT) 和工業物聯網 (IIoT) 連接。該公司由 Allen B. Salmasi 和 Michael Salmasi 於 2014 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: PRF Technologies Ltd. is a pharmaceutical company, which focuses on reformulation of established therapeutics. It offers PRF-110, an oil-based, viscous, clear solution that is deposited directly into the surgical wound bed prior to closure to provide localized and extended post-operative analgesia. The company was founded by Lihu Avitov and Dan Teleman in 2007 and is headquartered in Herzliya, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: PRF Technologies Ltd. 是一家製藥公司，專注於現有療法的重新配製。它提供 PRF-110，一種油基粘性透明溶液，在閉合前直接沉積到手術創面床上，以提供局部和長期的術後鎮痛。該公司由 Lihu Avitov 和 Dan Teleman 於 2007 年創立，總部位於以色列荷茲利亞。

info.description: The Growhub Ltd. engages in the provision of product traceability and authenticity solutions through the GrowHub Platform. It also provides product trading facilitation services. The company was founded by Choon Yew Chan in January 2020 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Growhub Ltd. 透過 GrowHub 平台提供產品可追溯性和真實性解決方案。它還提供產品交易便利服務。該公司由 Choon Yew Chan 於 2020 年 1 月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Soligenix, Inc. is a late-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of products to treat rare diseases. It operates through the Specialized BioTherapeutics and Public Health Solutions segments. The Specialized BioTherapeutics segment focuses on the development of a novel photodynamic therapy (SGX301) utilizing topical synthetic hypericin activated with safe visible fluorescent light for the treatment of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma. The Public Health Solutions segment consists of active development programs for RiVax, a ricin toxin vaccine candidate, and SGX943, a therapeutic candidate for antibiotic resistant and emerging infectious disease. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered Princeton, NJ.
info.description_zh: Soligenix, Inc.是一家后期生物制药公司，从事治疗罕见疾病的产品的开发和商业化。它透過專業生物治療和公共衛生解決方案部門運作。專業生物治療部門專注於開發一種新型光動力療法 (SGX301)，利用安全可見螢光活化的局部合成金絲桃素來治療皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤。公共衛生解決方案部門包括 RiVax（一種候選蓖麻毒素疫苗）和 SGX943（一種抗生素抗藥性和新興傳染病的治療候選藥物）的積極開發計劃。該公司成立於 1987 年，總部位於新澤西州普林斯頓。

info.description: Jianzhi Education Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of educational content and information technology (IT) solutions. It operates through the IT Related Solution Services and Educational Content Services and Other Services. The IT Related Solutions Services segment offers IT related solution services such as software solutions and customizes intelligent solutions, and related services including maintenance and technical support services. The Educational Content segment covers the provision and licensing of educational content. The company was founded by Pei Xuan Wang in May 2011 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 建智教育科技集團股份有限公司從事提供教育內容與資訊科技（IT）解決方案。它透過 IT 相關解決方案服務、教育內容服務和其他服務運作。 IT相關解決方案服務部門提供軟體解決方案和客製化智慧解決方案等IT相關解決方案服務，以及維護和技術支援服務等相關服務。教育內容部門涵蓋教育內容的提供與許可。該公司由王培軒於2011年5月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Hitek Global, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of information technology consulting and solutions. It operates through the services to small and medium businesses, which consists of anti-counterfeiting tax control system tax devices, golden tax disk and printers, and information technology services; and services to hardware and software sales business lines. The company was founded by Shen Ping Yin on November 3, 2017 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.
info.description_zh: Hitek Global, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供資訊科技諮詢和解決方案。其營運範圍為中小企業服務，包括防偽稅控系統稅控設備、金稅盤和印表機以及資訊科技服務；以及硬體和軟體銷售業務線的服務。該公司由沈平尹於2017年11月3日創立，總部位於中國廈門。

info.description: Indaptus Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical biotechnology company. The firm engages in the development of a novel and patented systemically-administered anti-cancer and anti-viral immunotherapy. It created patented treatment methods and associated patented compositions for attenuation and killing of non-pathogenic, Gram-negative bacteria. The company was founded by Michael James Newman on February 24, 2021 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Indaptus Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床生物技術公司。該公司致力於開發一種新型的、專利的系統性抗癌和抗病毒免疫療法。它創造了專利治療方法和相關專利組合物，用於減弱和殺死非致病性革蘭氏陰性細菌。該公司由邁克爾詹姆斯紐曼於 2021 年 2 月 24 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Allient, Inc. is a global engineering and manufacturing enterprise that develops solutions to drive the future of market-moving industries, including medical, life sciences, aerospace and defense, industrial automation, robotics, semi-conductor, transportation, agriculture, construction and facility infrastructure. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Amherst, NY.
info.description_zh: Allient, Inc. 是一家全球工程和製造企業，開發解決方案來推動市場驅動產業的未來，包括醫療、生命科學、航空航太和國防、工業自動化、機器人、半導體、交通、農業、建築和設施基礎設施。該公司成立於 1962 年，總部位於紐約州阿默斯特。

info.description: Titan Machinery, Inc. engages in the management of agricultural and construction equipment stores. It operates through the following segments: Agriculture, Construction, Europe, and Australian. The Agriculture segment sells services and rents machinery and related parts and attachments, for uses from large-scale farming to home and garden use in North America. The Construction segment focuses on machinery and related parts and attachments, for uses from heavy construction to light industrial machinery. The Europe segment manages ancillary sales and services related to agricultural activities and products in Eastern Europe and Germany. The Australian segments offer products such as equipment transportation, GPS signal subscriptions, and finance and insurance products in Southeastern Australia. The company was founded by David Joseph Meyer in 1980 and is headquartered in West Fargo, ND.
info.description_zh: Titan Machinery, Inc. 從事農業和建築設備商店的管理。它透過以下部門運作：農業、建築、歐洲和澳洲。農業部門銷售服務並租賃機械及相關零件和配件，用於北美的大規模農業以及家庭和花園用途。建築部門專注於機械及相關零件和附件，適用於從重型建築到輕工業機械的用途。歐洲部門管理與東歐和德國農業活動和產品相關的輔助銷售和服務。澳洲分部在澳洲東南部提供設備運輸、GPS 訊號訂閱以及金融和保險產品等產品。該公司由 David Joseph Meyer 於 1980 年創立，總部位於北達科他州西法戈。

info.description: Axon Enterprise, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of conducted electrical weapons for personal defense. It operates through the TASER segment and Software and Sensors segment. The TASER segment sells conducted electrical weapons, accessories, and other related products and services. The Software and Sensors segment includes devices, wearables, applications, cloud, and mobile products. The company was founded by Patrick W. Smith and Thomas P. Smith on September 7, 1993 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.description_zh: Axon Enterprise, Inc. 從事個人防禦傳導電子武器的開發、製造和銷售。它透過 TASER 部門以及軟體和感測器部門運作。泰瑟槍部門銷售傳導電子武器、配件以及其他相關產品和服務。軟體和感測器部分包括設備、穿戴式裝置、應用程式、雲端和行動產品。該公司由 Patrick W. Smith 和 Thomas P. Smith 於 1993 年 9 月 7 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long TER Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of TER. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of TER, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 TER 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 TER 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 TER 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: 908 Devices, Inc. engages in the development of measurement devices for chemical and biochemical analysis. It offers products using mass spectrometry technology, an analytical technique for measuring the mass of charged molecules that is used in chemical analysis laboratories for applications, such as safety and security, food science, biotechnology, clinical diagnostics, and controlling industrial processes. Its products include desktops and handhelds. The company was founded by Kevin J. Knopp, Miller Scott, Steve Araiza, Andrew Bartfay, Michael Jobin, Christopher D. Brown, and Christopher J. Petty in 2012 and is headquartered in Burlington, MA.
info.description_zh: 908 Devices, Inc. 從事化學和生化分析測量設備的開發。它提供使用質譜技術的產品，質譜技術是一種用於測量帶電分子質量的分析技術，用於化學分析實驗室的應用，例如安全和安保、食品科學、生物技術、臨床診斷和控制工業過程。其產品包括桌上型電腦和手持機。該公司由 Kevin J. Knopp、Miller Scott、Steve Araiza、Andrew Bartfay、Michael Jobin、Christopher D. Brown 和 Christopher J. Petty 於 2012 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州伯靈頓。

info.description: Adaptive Biotechnologies Corp. engages in the development of an immune medicine platform. Its products and services include immunoSEQ, clonoSEQ, cellular therapy, and vaccines. The company was founded by Chad Robins, Harlan Robins, and Chris Carlson on September 8, 2009 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Adaptive Biotechnologies Corp. 從事免疫醫學平台的開發。其產品和服務包括immunoSEQ、clonoSEQ、細胞療法和疫苗。該公司由 Chad Robins、Harlan Robins 和 Chris Carlson 於 2009 年 9 月 8 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Nicholas Bitcoin Tail ETF is an actively managed fund that implements a systematic options-based strategy designed to hedge against significant declines in the price of bitcoin and bitcoin-related investments. The fund seeks to provide investors with a "tail risk" or defensive profile relative to the cryptocurrency market by utilizing long put options to capture gains during sharp market downturns while employing call spreads to mitigate the cost of the protection.
info.description_zh: Nicholas Bitcoin Tail ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，實施基於選擇權的系統策略，旨在對沖比特幣和比特幣相關投資價格的大幅下跌。該基金旨在透過利用多頭看跌期權在市場急劇下滑期間獲取收益，同時利用看漲期權價差來降低保護成本，為投資者提供相對於加密貨幣市場的「尾部風險」或防禦性配置。

info.description: Nova Minerals Ltd. engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties. Its projects include Estelle Gold, RPM, Korbel, Train, Stoney and Studies projects. The company was founded in January 1987 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.

info.description: Diodes Inc. engages in the manufacturing and supply of application-specific standard products within the broad discrete, logic, analog, and mixed-signal semiconductor markets. The firm offers diodes, rectifiers, transistors, MOSFETs, protection devices, functional specific arrays, single gate, dual gate and standard logic, amplifiers and comparators, Hall-effect, and temperature sensors. It operates through the following geographical segments: Asia, the Americas, and Europe. The company was founded on June 15, 1959 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Diodes Inc. 致力於在廣泛的分立、邏輯、類比和混合訊號半導體市場中製造和供應特定應用的標準產品。該公司提供二極體、整流器、電晶體、MOSFET、保護元件、功能特定陣列、單閘極、雙閘極和標準邏輯、放大器和比較器、霍爾效應和溫度感測器。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：亞洲、美洲和歐洲。該公司成立於 1959 年 6 月 15 日，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: Deere & Co. engages in the manufacture and distribution of equipment used in agriculture, construction, forestry, and turf care. It operates through the following segments: Agriculture and Turf, Construction and Forestry, and Financial Services. The Agriculture and Turf segment focuses on the distribution and manufacture of a full line of agriculture and turf equipment and related service parts. The Construction and Forestry segment offers machines and service parts used in construction, earthmoving, road building, material handling and timber harvesting. The Financial Services segment finances sales and leases by John Deere dealers of new and used agriculture and turf equipment and construction and forestry equipment. The company was founded by John Deere in 1837 and is headquartered in Moline, IL.
info.industry_zh: Error 500 (Server Error)!!1500.That’s an error.There was an error. Please try again later.That’s all we know.
info.description_zh: Deere & Co. 從事農業、建築、林業和草坪護理設備的製造和分銷。它透過以下部門運作：農業和草坪部門、建築和林業部門以及金融服務部門。農業和草坪部門專注於全系列農業和草坪設備及相關服務零件的分銷和製造。建築和林業部門提供用於建築、土方工程、道路建設、材料處理和木材採伐的機器和服務零件。金融服務部門為約翰迪爾經銷商銷售和租賃新的和二手的農業和草坪設備以及建築和林業設備提供融資。該公司由約翰迪爾於 1837 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州莫林。

info.description: Climb Global Solutions, Inc. engages in the distribution of software developed by others through resellers indirectly to customers. It operates through the Distribution and Solutions segments. The Distribution segment distributes technical software to corporate resellers, value added resellers (VARs), consultants and systems integrators worldwide under the names Climb Channel Solutions and Sigma Software Distribution. The Solutions segment provides cloud solutions and value-added reseller of software, hardware, and services to customers worldwide under the names TechXtend and Grey Matter. The company was founded by Edwin Huffman Morgens in 1982 and is headquartered in Eatontown, NJ.
info.description_zh: Climb Global Solutions, Inc. 從事透過經銷商間接向客戶分銷他人開發的軟體的業務。它通过分销和解决方案部门运营。分銷部門以 Climb Channel Solutions 和 Sigma Software Distribution 的名義向全球企業經銷商、增值經銷商 (VAR)、顧問和系統整合商分銷技術軟體。解決方案部門以 TechXtend 和 Gray Matter 的名義向全球客戶提供雲端解決方案和軟體、硬體和服務的加值經銷商。該公司由 Edwin Huffman Morgens 於 1982 年創立，總部位於新澤西州伊頓敦。

info.description: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 20+ Year Bond Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that the advisor believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity greater than or equal to twenty years.
info.description_zh: iShares 20+ 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國 20+ 年期公債指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於顧問認為將有助於基金追蹤標的指數的美國國債。基礎指數衡量剩餘期限大於或等於二十年的美國財政部公共債務的履行。

info.description: Cohen Circle Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company. It is created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on December 4, 2024 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: Cohen Circle Acquisition Corp. II 以空白支票公司經營。它的創建目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年12月4日，總部位於賓州費城。

info.description: Vanguard Emerging Markets Government Bond Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg USD Emerging Markets Government RIC Capped Index that measures the investment return of U.S. dollar-denominated bonds issued by governments and government-related issuers in emerging market countries. The manager employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of index. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and under normal circumstances at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Emerging Markets Government Bond Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤彭博美元新興市場政府 RIC 上限指數的表現，該指數衡量新興市場國家政府和政府相關發行人發行的美元計價債券的投資回報。管理人採用旨在追蹤指數表現的指數投資方法。基金的所有投資都會透過抽樣過程進行篩選，一般情況下基金資產的至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: WEBs Materials XLB Defined Volatility ETF is a passively managed fund that provides exposure to the U.S. large-cap materials sector while employing a systematic, rules-based strategy to target a specific annual volatility rate. The fund dynamically adjusts its market exposure between 0% and 200% based on recent realized volatility, increasing exposure through derivatives when market fluctuations are low and reducing exposure to cash when volatility exceeds the target.
info.description_zh: WEBs Materials XLB 定義波動率 ETF 是一款被動管理基金，提供對美國大盤材料行業的投資，同時採用系統化的、基於規則的策略來瞄準特定的年度波動率。該基金根據近期實現的波動率在0%至200%之間動態調整其市場敞口，當市場波動較低時透過衍生性商品增加敞口，當波動率超過目標時減少現金敞口。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Intermediate Municipal Income ETF seeks the highest level of income exempt from federal income taxes consistent with moderate price fluctuation. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in investment-grade municipal securities or derivatives that are linked to or provides investment exposure to the municipal market. Under normal conditions, the fund's weighted average effective maturity will be four to twelve years. There are no maturity limitations on individual securities.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price 中等市政收入 ETF 尋求與溫和的價格波動相一致的最高水平的聯邦所得稅豁免收入。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於與市政市場相關或提供投資風險的投資等級市政證券或衍生性商品。在正常情況下，該基金的加權平均有效期限為四至十二年。個別證券沒有期限限制。

info.description: iShares J.P. Morgan USD Emerging Markets Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the J.P. Morgan EMBI Global Core Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, emerging market bonds. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is a broad, diverse U.S. dollar-denominated emerging markets debt benchmark that tracks the total return of actively traded external debt instruments in emerging market countries.
info.description_zh: iShares 摩根大通美元新興市場債券 ETF 旨在追蹤由以美元計價的新興市場債券組成的摩根大通 EMBI 全球核心指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於基礎指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。該指數是一個廣泛、多樣化的以美元計價的新興市場債務基準，追蹤新興市場國家交易活躍的外債工具的總回報。

info.description: Cayson Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on May 27, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Cayson Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年5月27日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Vanguard Long-Term Corporate Bond Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted corporate bond index with a long-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. 10+ Year Corporate Bond Index. This index includes U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade, fixed-rate, taxable securities issued by U.S. and non-U.S. industrial, utility, and financial companies, with maturities greater than 10 years. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard長期公司債指數基金ETF份額旨在追蹤具有長期美元加權平均期限的市場加權公司債指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國10年以上企業債券指數的表現。該指數包括由美國和非美國工業、公用事業和金融公司發行的、期限超過 10 年的以美元計價、投資等級、固定利率、應稅證券。一般情況下，基金資產至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。

info.description: BlackRock Large Cap Growth ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to invest at least 80% of its net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in large cap equity securities and derivatives that have similar economic characteristics to such securities. For purposes of the fund's 80% policy, large cap equity securities are equity securities that at the time of purchase have a market capitalization within the range of companies included in the Russell 1000 Growth Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 贝莱德大盘成长 ETF 寻求长期资本增值。在正常情況下，該基金尋求將至少80%的淨資產加上用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於大盤股證券以及與此類證券具有類似經濟特徵的衍生品。就基金的 80% 政策而言，大盘股证券是指购买时市值处于 Russell 1000 Growth Index 所包含公司范围内的股本证券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leapfrog Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It engages in the effecting of a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 20, 2025 and is headquartered in Summit, NJ.
info.description_zh: Leapfrog Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它從事與一個或多個企業的合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月20日，總部位於新澤西州薩米特。

info.description: iShares Core Total USD Bond Market ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg U.S. Universal Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and to-be-announced transactions ("TBAs") that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of the component securities of the underlying index. The index measures the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated taxable bonds that are rated either investment-grade or high yield.
info.description_zh: iShares Core Total USD Bond Market ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國通用指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的成分證券以及具有與標的指數成分證券的經濟特徵基本相同的經濟特徵的待宣布交易（「TBA」）。此指數衡量投資等級或高收益等級美元計價應稅債券的表現。

info.description: X3 Acquisition Corp. Ltd. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 31, 2025 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: X3 Acquisition Corp. Ltd. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 7 月 31 日，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: VictoryShares Core Plus Intermediate Bond ETF seeks high current income without undue risk to principal. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in debt securities and in derivatives and other instruments that have economic characteristics similar to such securities. The fund primarily invests in securities that have a dollar-weighted average portfolio maturity between three to 10 years. The fund will invest primarily in investment-grade securities, but may invest up to 20% of its net assets in below-investment-grade securities which are sometimes referred to as high-yield or "junk" bonds.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares Core Plus Intermediate Bond ETF 追求高當期收入，且不會對本金造成不當風險。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於債務證券以及具有與此類證券類似經濟特徵的衍生性商品和其他工具。該基金主要投資於美元加權平均投資組合期限為三至十年的證券。该基金将主要投资于投资级证券，但最多可将其净资产的 20% 投资于低于投资级的证券，这些证券有时被称为高收益或“垃圾”债券。

info.description: Vanguard Core-Plus Bond ETF seeks to provide total return while generating a moderate to high level of current income. The fund invests in fixed income securities of various maturities, yields, and qualities. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in bonds, which include fixed income securities such as corporate bonds; U.S. Treasury obligations and other U.S. government and agency securities; and asset-backed, mortgage-backed, and mortgage-related securities.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Core-Plus Bond ETF 尋求提供總回報，同時產生中等到高水準的當前收入。該基金投資於各種期限、收益率和品質的固定收益證券。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的資產投資於債券，其中包括公司債等固定收益證券；美國財政部債務和其他美國政府和機構證券；以及資產支持、抵押貸款支持和抵押相關證券。

info.description: Vanguard Total Corporate Bond ETF ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Corporate Bond Index. The fund is a fund of funds and employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Corporate Bond Index, which measures the investment-grade, fixed-rate, taxable corporate bond market. The index includes U.S. dollar-denominated securities that are publicly issued by industrial, utility, and financial issuers.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total Corporate Bond ETF ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Corporate Bond Index.該基金是基金中的基金，採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國公司債指數的表現，該指數衡量投資等級、固定利率、應稅公司債券市場。 The index includes U.S. dollar-denominated securities that are publicly issued by industrial, utility, and financial issuers.

info.description: iShares ESG USD Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the Bloomberg MSCI US Corporate ESG Focus Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds issued by companies that have positive environmental, social and governance characteristics while seeking to exhibit risk and return characteristics similar to those of the parent index of such index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents, as well as in securities not included in the index, but which BFA believes will help it track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG 美元公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博 MSCI 美國企業 ESG 焦點指數，該指數由具有積極環境、社會和治理特徵的公司發行的以美元計價的投資級公司債組成，同時尋求表現出與該指數母指數類似的風險和回報特徵。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券，並可能將最多 10% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物，以及未包含在該指數中的證券，但 BFA 認為這將有助於其追蹤該指數。

info.description: VictoryShares Core Intermediate Bond ETF seeks high current income without undue risk to principal. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in debt securities and in derivatives and other instruments that have economic characteristics similar to such securities. The fund may invest up to 20% of its net assets in foreign debt securities, including non-U.S. dollar- denominated securities and securities of companies in emerging market countries (i.e., those that are in the early stages of their industrial cycles).
info.description_zh: VictoryShares Core Intermediate Bond ETF 追求高当期收入，且不对本金造成不当风险。一般情况下，基金至少80%的资产投资于债务证券以及具有与此类证券类似经济特征的衍生品和其他工具。該基金最多可將其淨資產的20%投資於外債證券，包括非美元計價的證券和新興市場國家（即處於工業週期早期階段的國家）公司的證券。

info.description: iShares Broad USD Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE BofA US Corporate Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that the advisor believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of investment-grade corporate bonds of both U.S. and non-U.S. issuers that are U.S. dollar-denominated and publicly issued in the U.S. domestic market.
info.description_zh: iShares Broad 美元投資等級企業債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE BofA 美國企業指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數中包含的固定收益證券類型，顧問認為這將有助於基金追蹤標的指數。該指數衡量美國和非美國發行人在美國國內市場公開發行的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的表現。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2031 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2031. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2031.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2031 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2031 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2031 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: First Trust High Income Strategic Focus ETF seeks risk-adjusted income; capital appreciation is the secondary objective. Under normal market conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by investing in a portfolio of U.S.-listed ETFs that is designed to follow the High Income Model developed by the advisor. The fund, through its investments in the underlying ETFs comprising the High Income Model, seeks to provide investors with a diversified income stream by holding a blend of fixed income assets that are actively managed to seek levels of high income and total return. It invests significantly in shares of the First Trust TCW Opportunistic Fixed Income ETF.
info.description_zh: First Trust High Income Strategy Focus ETF尋求風險調整後收益；資本增值是次要目標。在正常市場條件下，該基金尋求透過投資於美國上市的 ETF 投資組合來實現其投資目標，該投資組合旨在遵循顧問開發的高收入模型。該基金透過對構成高收入模型的基礎 ETF 的投資，尋求透過持有積極管理的固定收益資產組合來為投資者提供多元化的收入來源，以尋求高收入和總回報水平。它大量投資於 First Trust TCW 機會性固定收益 ETF 的股票。

info.description: F/M 3-Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the [ICE BofA 3-Year Target Maturity Index]. Under normal market conditions, F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC (the "Adviser") seeks to achieve the F/m 3-Year Bond ETF's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the F/m 3-Year Bond ETF's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The [ICE BofA 3-Year Target Maturity Index] is an index comprised of U.S. investment-grade corporate bonds.
info.description_zh: F/M 3 年期投資等級公司債 ETF 尋求大體上與 [ICE BofA 3 年期目標到期指數] 的價格和收益率表現相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常市場條件下，F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC（「顧問」）尋求透過將 F/m 3 年期債券 ETF 淨資產的至少 80%（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於基礎指數的成分證券，來實現 F/m 3 年期債券 ETF 的投資目標。 [ICE BofA 3 年目標到期指數] 是由美國投資等級公司債所組成的指數。

info.description: Analog Devices, Inc. is a semiconductor company, which engages in the combination of analog, digital, and software technologies into engineering solutions. Its products include analog and mixed signals, power management and reference, amplifiers radio frequency, and reference, sensors and actuators, and digital signal processing and system. The company was founded by Raymond P. Stata and Matthew Lorber in 1965 and is headquartered in Wilmington, MA.
info.description_zh: Analog Devices, Inc. 是一家半導體公司，致力於將類比、數位和軟體技術結合到工程解決方案中。其產品包括類比和混合訊號、電源管理和基準、放大器射頻和基準、感測器和執行器以及數位訊號處理和系統。該公司由 Raymond P. Stata 和 Matthew Lorber 於 1965 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州威爾明頓。

info.description: Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. designs, develops, and markets integrated power semiconductor solutions and power delivery architectures for computing and storage, automotive, industrial, communications, and consumer applications markets. The firm's products include portable electronic devices, wireless LAN access points, computers and notebooks, monitors, infotainment applications, and medical equipment. It operates through the following geographical segments: China, US, Taiwan, and Other. The company was founded by Michael R. Hsing, and James C. Moyer on August 22, 1997, and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. 為運算和儲存、汽車、工業、通訊和消費應用市場設計、開發和銷售整合式功率半導體解決方案和電力傳輸架構。該公司的產品包括便攜式電子設備、無線區域網路存取點、電腦和筆記型電腦、顯示器、資訊娛樂應用和醫療設備。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：中國、美國、台灣和其他地區。該公司由 Michael R. Hsing 和 James C. Moyer 於 1997 年 8 月 22 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州西棕櫚灘。

info.description: Johnson Controls International Plc engages in the provision of building products, energy solutions, integrated infrastructure and next generation transportation systems. Its products and solutions include fire detection and suppression, security, HVAC equipment, building automation and controls, digital, industrial refrigeration, residential and smart home, retail, distributed energy storage, and batteries. The company was established in 1885 and is headquartered in Cork, Ireland.
info.description_zh: 江森自控國際有限公司致力於提供建築產品、能源解決方案、綜合基礎設施和下一代交通系統。其產品和解決方案包括火災偵測和滅火、安全、暖通空調設備、樓宇自動化和控制、數位、工業冷凍、住宅和智慧家居、零售、分散式能源儲存和電池。該公司成立於1885年，總部位於愛爾蘭科克。

info.description: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. engages in the provision of cruise travel services. It offers cruise experiences for travelers with itineraries in Europe, Asia, Australia, New Zealand, South America, Africa, Canada, Bermuda, Caribbean, Alaska and Hawaii. Its brands include Norwegian Cruise Line, Oceania Cruises, and Regent Seven Seas Cruises. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: 挪威郵輪控股有限公司從事提供郵輪旅遊服務。它為旅客提供歐洲、亞洲、澳洲、紐西蘭、南美洲、非洲、加拿大、百慕達、加勒比海、阿拉斯加和夏威夷航線的郵輪體驗。旗下品牌包括挪威郵輪、大洋洲郵輪、麗晶七海郵輪。該公司成立於 1966 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Single Stock Universe ETF seeks current income and pay weekly distributions. The Fund is a "fund of funds," meaning that it primarily invests its assets in the shares of other ETFs, rather than in securities of individual companies. The Fund's portfolio will be primarily composed of "YieldBOOST ETFs," which are all affiliated ETFs advised by GraniteShares Advisors LLC (the "Adviser") (each, an "Underlying YieldBOOST ETF"). Each of the Underlying YieldBOOST ETFs in which the Fund may invest has for objective to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on an "Underlying Stock" by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock (the "Underlying ETF"). The Underlying YieldBoost ETF's secondary investment objective is to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. Each Underlying YieldBoost ETF may implement a downside protection which could affect the net income level.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Single Stock Universe ETF 尋求當前收入並支付每週分配。該基金是“基金中的基金”，這意味著它主要將其資產投資於其他 ETF 的股票，而不是個別公司的證券。該基金的投資組合將主要由「YieldBOOST ETF」組成，這些都是由 GraniteShares Advisors LLC（「顧問」）提供諮詢服務的附屬 ETF（每個都是「基礎 YieldBOOST ETF」）。本基金可能投資的每隻標的 YieldBOOST ETF 的目標是透過出售槓桿交易所交易基金的選擇權來實現出售「標的股票」選擇權所產生的收入的 2 倍 (200%)，該基金旨在實現標的股票（「標的 ETF」）每日表現的 2 倍（200%）。標的 YieldBoost ETF 的次要投資目標是獲得標的 ETF 表現的投資機會，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。每個基礎 YieldBoost ETF 可能會實施下行保護，這可能會影響淨收入水準。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2035 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2035 Maturity US Treasury Index. The index to track the investment results of an index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2035. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2035 定期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 2035 年到期美國公債指數的投資結果。該指數追蹤由2035年到期的美國國債組成的指數的投資結果。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少90%的資產投資於BFA認為將有助於基金追蹤標的指數的美國國債。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Ocean Park High Income ETF seeks to provide total return and to limit exposure to downside risk. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by tactically allocating the fund's assets between unaffiliated higher yielding ETFs ("High Income ETFs"), long-term Treasury ETFs ("Treasury ETFs") and cash equivalents. Under normal market conditions, the advisor expects to invest substantially all of its assets in high income ETFs.
info.description_zh: 海洋公園高收入 ETF 旨在提供總回報並限制下行風險。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過戰術性地在獨立的高收益 ETF（「高收入 ETF」）、長期國債 ETF（「國債 ETF」）和現金等價物之間分配基金資產來實現其投資目標。在正常市場條件下，顧問預計將其大部分資產投資於高收益 ETF。

info.description: First Trust Large Cap Value AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Large Cap Value Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select value stocks from the NASDAQ US 500 Large Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 大盤價值 AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 大盤價值指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 500 大盤指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇價值股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: Dac 3D Dividend Growth ETF seeks capital appreciation and current income. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that invests in dividend-paying, U.S.-listed companies and depositary receipts representing equity securities of non-U.S. companies. The fund's investments are selected by Dividend Assets Capital, LLC based on its proprietary "3D - Double Digits for a Decade or More screening process, which seeks to identify companies that increase their dividends by an average of at least 10% annually, with no dividend reductions or years without an increase, for a minimum of 10 consecutive years. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Dac 3D 股息成長 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入。該基金為一檔主動管理的ETF，投資於支付股利的美國上市公司以及代表非美國公司股本證券的存託憑證。該基金的投資由 Dividend Assets Capital, LLC 根據其專有的「3D - 十年或更長的兩位數」篩選流程進行選擇，該流程旨在識別股息每年平均增加至少 10%、且股息不減少或多年不增加、至少連續 10 年的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: US Treasury 3 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 3-Year US Treasury Index (GA03). Under normal market conditions, The adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The ICE BofA Current 3-Year US Treasury Index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 3-year U.S. treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國國債 3 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 3 年期美國國債指數 (GA03) 的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的指數的成分證券來實現基金的投資目標。 ICE 美银美林当前 3 年期美国国债指数是一种单一证券指数，由最近发行的 3 年期美国国债组成。

info.description: Salesforce, Inc. engages in the design and development of cloud-based enterprise software for customer relationship management. Its solutions include sales force automation, customer service and support, marketing automation, digital commerce, community management, collaboration, industry-specific solutions, and salesforce platform. The firm also provides guidance, support, training, and advisory services. The company was founded by Marc Russell Benioff and Parker Harris in 1999 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Salesforce, Inc. 從事用於客戶關係管理的基於雲端的企業軟體的設計和開發。其解決方案包括銷售團隊自動化、客戶服務和支援、行銷自動化、數位商務、社群管理、協作、行業特定解決方案和銷售團隊平台。該公司還提供指導、支援、培訓和諮詢服務。該公司由 Marc Russell Benioff 和 Parker Harris 於 1999 年創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: US Treasury 5 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 5-Year US Treasury Index (GA05). Under normal market conditions, The adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The ICE BofA Current 5-Year US Treasury Index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 5-year U.S. treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國財政部 5 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 5 年期美國國債指數 (GA05) 的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的指數的成分證券來實現基金的投資目標。 ICE BofA 目前 5 年期美國國債指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 5 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: iShares MSCI Global Sustainable Development Goals ETF seeks to track the performance of the MSCI ACWI Sustainable Impact Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is composed of companies that derive a majority of their revenue from products and services that address at least one of the world's major social and environmental challenges as identified by the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 全球永續發展目標 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI ACWI 永續影響指數的表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數由大部分收入來自產品和服務的公司組成，這些產品和服務至少解決了聯合國永續發展目標確定的世界主要社會和環境挑戰之一。

info.description: PDF Solutions, Inc. engages in the provision of an end-to-end analytics platform that empowers engineers and data scientists across the semiconductor ecosystem and data analytics for process-design optimization and yield enhancement. Its products, services, and platforms include proprietary software, physical intellectual property (IP) for integrated circuit (IC) designs, electrical measurement hardware tools, proven methodologies, and professional services. The company was founded by John Kachig Kibarian and Kimon W. Michaels in 1991 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: PDF Solutions, Inc. 致力於提供端到端分析平台，為整個半導體生態系統的工程師和資料科學家提供支持，並透過資料分析實現製程設計最佳化和產量提高。其產品、服務和平台包括專有軟體、積體電路（IC）設計的實體智慧財產權（IP）、電氣測量硬體工具、經過驗證的方法和專業服務。該公司由 John Kachig Kibarian 和 Kimon W. Michaels 於 1991 年創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Argent Large Cap ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in the equity securities of large-capitalization companies that Argent Capital Management LLC, the fund's sub-adviser (the "Sub-Adviser"), believes are high quality, enduring businesses. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Argent Large Cap ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資大型公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問（「副顧問」）Argent Capital Management LLC 認為這些公司是高品質、持久的企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Charles River Laboratories International, Inc. engages in providing products and services to help pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. It operates through the following segments: Research Models and Services (RMS), Discovery and Safety Assessment (DSA), and Manufacturing Solutions. The Research Models and Services segment includes its insourcing solutions business and Charles River accelerator and development lab footprint. The Discovery and Safety Assessment segment offers regulatory-required safety testing of potential new drugs, vaccines, industrial and agricultural chemicals, consumer products, veterinary medicines, and medical devices. The Manufacturing Solutions segment focuses on microbial solutions and biologics solutions. The company was founded by Henry L. Foster in 1947 and is headquartered in Wilmington, MA.
info.description_zh: Charles River Laboratories International, Inc. 致力於提供產品和服務來幫助製藥和生物技術公司。它透過以下部門運作：研究模型和服務（RMS）、發現和安全評估（DSA）以及製造解決方案。研究模型和服務部門包括其內包解決方案業務以及 Charles River 加速器和開發實驗室足跡。發現和安全評估部門為潛在的新藥、疫苗、工業和農業化學品、消費品、獸藥和醫療器材提供監管要求的安全測試。製造解決方案部門專注於微生物解決方案和生物製劑解決方案。該公司由 Henry L. Foster 於 1947 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州威爾明頓。

info.description: Fortrea Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of clinical development and commercialization services. It operates under the Clinical Services and Enabling Services Segments. The Clinical Services segment provides services across the clinical pharmacology, clinical development, and other clinical service spectrum utilizing enabling services and technology through multiple delivery models. The Enabling Services segment provides technology solutions directly to customers that streamline complex randomization and optimize the trial drug supply process, while minimizing operational costs and supporting timely and accurate patient dosing. The company was founded on January 31, 2023 and is headquartered in Durham, NC.
info.description_zh: Fortrea Holdings, Inc. 從事提供臨床開發和商業化服務。它在臨床服務和支援服務部門下運作。臨床服務部門透過多種交付模式利用支援服務和技術提供跨臨床藥理學、臨床開發和其他臨床服務範圍的服務。賦能服務部門直接向客戶提供技術解決方案，簡化複雜的隨機化並優化試驗藥物供應流程，同時最大限度地降低營運成本並支援及時、準確的患者給藥。該公司成立於2023年1月31日，總部位於北卡羅來納州達勒姆。

info.description: Kandi Technologies Group, Inc. engages in designing, developing, manufacturing, and commercializing electric vehicle (EV) products and its parts. The firm offers off-road vehicles including all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), pure electric utility vehicles (UTVs), go-karts, electric scooters, electric self-balancing scooters, and lithium-ion cells. The company was founded by Xiao Ming Hu in 2002 and is headquartered in Jinhua, China.
info.description_zh: Kandi Technologies Group, Inc. 从事电动汽车 (EV) 产品及其零部件的设计、开发、制造和商业化。該公司提供越野車，包括全地形車（ATV）、純電動多功能車（UTV）、卡丁車、電動滑板車、電動自平衡滑板車和鋰離子電池。该公司由胡晓明于2002年创立，总部位于中国金华。

info.description: Certara, Inc. engages in the provision of software and technology-enabled services for drug developers. It offers cell and gene therapy, clinical pharmacology, complex biologics, decision analytics and modeling, drug development and regulatory strategy, and model-based analysis services. The company was founded on June 27, 2017, and is headquartered in Radnor, PA.
info.description_zh: Certara, Inc. 致力於為藥物開發商提供軟體和技術支援的服務。它提供細胞和基因治療、臨床藥理學、複雜生物製劑、決策分析和建模、藥物開發和監管策略以及基於模型的分析服務。該公司成立於2017年6月27日，總部位於賓州拉德諾。

info.description: iShares Global Timber & Forestry ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Global Timber & Forestry IndexTM composed of global equities in or related to the timber and forestry industry. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 全球木材和林業 ETF 旨在追蹤由木材和林業行業或與之相關的全球股票組成的 S&P 全球木材和林業指數™ 的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數的組成證券以及具有與組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Small Cap Value AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Small Cap Value Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and real estate investment trusts that comprise the index. The index is designed to select value stocks from the NASDAQ US 700 Small Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 小型價值 AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 小型價值指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和房地產投資信託。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 700 小型股指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇價值股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: iShares ESG MSCI EM Leaders ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EM Extended ESG Leaders 5% Issuer Capped Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of emerging market companies with favorable environmental, social and governance ("ESG") characteristics.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG MSCI EM Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI EM Extended ESG Leaders 5% 發行人上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。基礎指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）特徵的新興市場公司的股票表現。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long CRM Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of CRM. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of CRM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 CRM 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 CRM 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。它將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 CRM 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Oriental Rise Holdings Ltd. engages in the cultivation, processing, and sale of tea leaves and tea products. It operates through the Primarily-Processes Teas and Refined Teas segments. The company was founded by Chun Sun Wong, Wai Kwong Fong and Deming Zhou on January 25, 2019 and is headquartered in Ningde, China.
info.description_zh: 東方崛起控股有限公司從事茶葉及茶產品的種植、加工及銷售。它透過初加工茶和精製茶部門運作。該公司由Chun Sun Wong、Wai Kwong Fong和Deming Zhou於2019年1月25日創立，總部位於中國寧德。

info.description: National Beverage Corp. engages in the development, manufacture, market, and sale of sparkling waters, juices, energy drinks, and carbonated soft drinks. Its brands include LaCroix, LaCroix Curate, LaCroix NiCola, Clear Fruit, Rip It, Everfresh, Everfresh Premier Varietals, Mr. Pure, Shasta, and Faygo. The company was founded by Nick A. Caporella on November 5, 1985 and is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL.
info.description_zh: National Beverage Corp. 從事氣泡水、果汁、能量飲料和碳酸軟性飲料的開發、製造、行銷和銷售。其品牌包括 LaCroix、LaCroix Curate、LaCroix NiCola、Clear Fruit、Rip It、Everfresh、Everfresh Premier Varietals、Mr. Pure、Shasta 和 Faygo。該公司由 Nick A. Caporella 於 1985 年 11 月 5 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州勞德代爾堡。

info.description: Motley Fool Value Factor ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the total return performance of the Motley Fool Value Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets will be invested in the component securities of the index. The Adviser expects that, over time, if it has sufficient assets, the correlation between the fund's performance and that of the index, before fees and expenses, will be 95% or better. The fund will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it generally will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Motley Fool Value Factor ETF 尋求與 Motley Fool Value Index 的總回報表現大致相符的投資結果。一般情況下，基金總資產至少80%會投資於指數成分證券。顧問預計，隨著時間的推移，如果擁有足夠的資產，在扣除費用和開支之前，基金績效與指數績效之間的相關性將達到 95% 或更高。該基金通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它通常會投資於該指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. serves the scientific community through a broad offering of innovative products and services. Thermo Fisher Scientific serves customers working in pharmaceutical and biotech companies, hospitals and clinical diagnostic labs, universities, research institutions and government agencies, as well as environmental, industrial, research and development, quality and process control settings. The company's global team delivers an unrivaled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through its brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD. The company continuously increases its depth of capabilities across its broad portfolio of innovative products and services and leverages its extensive global channels to address customers' needs. The company does this through organic investments in research and development, capacity and capabilities and through acquisitions. The company's goal is to enable its customers to be more productive in an increasingly competitive business environment, enable them to accelerate innovation, solve their challenges and advance their important work. The company's history roots back to the year 1956 when the business was first established. Thermo Fisher Scientific was formed in 2006 from the merger of Thermo Electron and Fisher Scientific and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. 透過提供廣泛的創新產品和服務為科學界提供服務。 Thermo Fisher Scientific 為製藥和生物技術公司、醫院和臨床診斷實驗室、大學、研究機構和政府機構以及環境、工業、研發、品質和製程控制機構的客戶提供服務。該公司的全球團隊透過其品牌（包括 Thermo Scientific、Applied Biosystems、Invitrogen、Fisher Scientific、Unity Lab Services、Patheon 和 PPD）提供無與倫比的創新技術、採購便利性和製藥服務組合。該公司不斷增強其廣泛的創新產品和服務組合的能力深度，並利用其廣泛的全球管道來滿足客戶的需求。該公司透過對研發、產能和能力的有機投資以及收購來實現這一目標。公司的目標是幫助客戶在競爭日益激烈的商業環境中提高生產力，加速創新，解決挑戰並推動重要工作。公司的歷史可以追溯到 1956 年公司成立之初。 Thermo Fisher Scientific 於 2006 年由 Thermo Electron 和 Fisher Scientific 合併而成，總部位於麻薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Equifax, Inc. engages in the provision of information solutions and human resources business process outsourcing services. It operates through the following business segments: U.S. Information Solutions, Workforce Solutions and International. The U.S. Information Solutions segment includes consumer and commercial information services, mortgage loan origination information, financial marketing services, and identity management. The Workforce Solutions segment covers employment, income, and social security number verification services as well as complementary payroll-based transaction and employment tax management services. The International segment offers information, technology, and services to support debt collections and recovery management in Canada, Europe, Latin America and Asia Pacific. The company was founded by Cator Woolford and Guy Woolford in 1899 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Equifax, Inc. 從事提供資訊解決方案和人力資源業務流程外包服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：美國資訊解決方案部門、勞動力解決方案部門和國際部門。美國資訊解決方案部門包括消費者和商業資訊服務、抵押貸款發放資訊、金融行銷服務和身分管理。勞動力解決方案部門涵蓋就業、收入和社會安全號碼驗證服務以及基於工資的補充交易和就業稅管理服務。國際部門提供資訊、技術和服務，以支援加拿大、歐洲、拉丁美洲和亞太地區的債務催收和追收管理。該公司由 Cator Woolford 和 Guy Woolford 於 1899 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: iShares MSCI Qatar ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI All Qatar Capped Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index that is designed to measure the equity market in Qatar. The underlying index uses a capping methodology that limits the weight of any single "group entity" to a maximum of 25% of the underlying index weight. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 卡達 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 全卡達上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整市值加權指數，旨在衡量卡達股市。標的指數使用上限方法，將任何單一「集團實體」的權重限制為標的指數權重的最大 25%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Seer, Inc. (California) engages in the development of proprietary engineered nanoparticles to provide access across the proteome. Its Proteograph product suite comprises automation instrument and software, which provides workflow to make proteomic profiling. The company was founded by Philip Ma, Robert S. Langer Jr. and Omid C. Farokhzad on March 16, 2017 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.description_zh: Seer, Inc.（加利福尼亞州）致力於開發專有的工程奈米粒子，以提供跨蛋白質組的訪問。其 Proteograph 產品套件包括自動化儀器和軟體，提供進行蛋白質體分析的工作流程。該公司由 Philip Ma、Robert S. Langer Jr. 和 Omid C. Farokhzad 於 2017 年 3 月 16 日創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: Ramaco Resources, Inc. engages in the operation and development of coal mining properties. The firm deals with metallurgical coal in central and southern West Virginia, southwestern Virginia and southwestern Pennsylvania. Its portfolio consists of Elk Creek, Berwind, RAM Mine, and Knox Creek. The company was founded by Randall W. Atkins in August 2015 and is headquartered in Lexington, KY.
info.description_zh: Ramaco Resources, Inc. 從事煤礦資產的營運和開發。該公司在西維吉尼亞州中部和南部、維吉尼亞州西南部和賓夕法尼亞州西南部經營冶金煤。其投資組合包括 Elk Creek、Berwind、RAM Mine 和 Knox Creek。該公司由 Randall W. Atkins 於 2015 年 8 月創立，總部位於肯塔基州列剋星敦。

info.description: Vyome Holdings, Inc. engages in the development of immuno-inflammatory assets. It focuses on therapeutic solutions that target formulations for site-targeted applications. The company was founded on January 2, 2008 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Vyome Holdings, Inc. 從事免疫發炎資產的開發。它專注於針對特定部位應用的製劑的治療解決方案。該公司成立於2008年1月2日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: LGI Homes, Inc. engages in the design, construction, marketing, and sale of new homes. It focuses on the residential land development business. It operates through the following geographical segments: Central, West, Southeast, Florida, Midwest, Mid-Atlantic, and Northwest. The company was founded by Eric Thomas Lipar in 2003 and is headquartered in The Woodlands, TX.
info.description_zh: LGI Homes, Inc. 從事新住宅的設計、建造、行銷和銷售。其專注於住宅土地開發業務。它透過以下地理區域運作：中部、西部、東南部、佛羅裡達州、中西部、大西洋中部和西北地區。該公司由 Eric Thomas Lipar 於 2003 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州伍德蘭茲。

info.description: VanEck Consumer Disc TruSector ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market circumstances, at least 80% of its total assets in equity securities of consumer discretionary-related companies or instruments that provide exposure to consumer discretionary-related companies as determined by the adviser. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Consumer Disc TruSector ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過在正常市場情況下將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於非必需消費品相關公司的股本證券或顧問確定的向非必需消費品相關公司提供投資的工具來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cresud SA engages in the production of basic agricultural commodities. It operates through the Agricultural Business, and Urban Properties and Investment Business segments. The Agricultural Business segment engages in the operation of crop production, cattle feeding, raising, fattening and slaughtering, milk production, sugarcane production, brokerage activities, and sale of supplies. The Urban and Investment Business segment comprises of Operation Center in Argentina, which includes shopping malls, offices, sales and development, hotels, international operations, entertainment activities, and corporate activities, and Operation Center in Israel, which consists of real estate, supermarkets, telecommunications, insurance, other diverse business, and holding companies activities. The company was founded on December 31, 1936 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
info.description_zh: Cresud SA 從事基本農產品的生產。它透過農業業務、城市房地產和投資業務部門運作。農業業務部門從事農作物生產、牛隻飼養、飼養、育肥及屠宰、牛奶生產、甘蔗生產、經紀活動及物資銷售等業務。城市與投資業務部門包括阿根廷營運中心（包括購物中心、辦公大樓、銷售和開發、酒店、國際營運、娛樂活動和企業活動）和以色列營運中心（包括房地產、超市、電信、保險、其他多元化業務和控股公司活動）。該公司成立於1936年12月31日，總部位於阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯。

info.description: Wingstop, Inc. is a franchisor and chicken wings-focused restaurant. The firm is engaged in the flavor business offering cooked-to-order, hand-sauced, and tossed classic and boneless wings, tenders and chicken sandwiches in flavors, with signature sides, such as its seasoned fries and house made ranch and bleu cheese dips. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Wingstop, Inc. 是一家以特許經營和雞翅為主的餐廳。該公司從事風味業務，提供按單烹製、手工醬料和拌製的經典無骨雞翅、嫩肉和雞肉三明治，並配有招牌配菜，例如調味薯條以及自製牧場和藍紋奶酪醬。該公司成立於 1994 年，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: Evolv Technologies Holdings, Inc. engages in the manufacture and development of security screening products. It also provides artificial intelligence-based security screening solutions for industries including casinos, industrial workplaces, schools, and ticketed venues. The company was founded by Anil R. Chitkara and Michael Philip Ellenbogen in July 2013 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.

info.description: Gravity Co., Ltd. engages in the development and publishing of online and mobile games, software, and other related services. It operates through the following business segments: Online Game, Mobile Game, and Others. The Online Game segment consists of Micro-transaction and subscription revenue, which is operated by the company, and royalties and license fee. The Mobile Game segment comprises of micro-transaction. The company was founded on April 4, 2000 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
info.description_zh: Gravity Co., Ltd.從事網路及手機遊戲、軟體及其他相關服務的開發與發行。它透過以下業務部門運作：網路遊戲、手機遊戲和其他。線上遊戲部門包括由公司經營的微交易和訂閱收入以及特許權使用費和許可費。手機遊戲部分包括微交易。該公司成立於2000年4月4日，總部位於韓國首爾。

info.description: Ten-League International Holdings Ltd. engages in selling, renting, and maintaining construction equipment and providing engineering consulting services. Its products include construction equipment, port equipment, and spare parts. The firm's services include project leasing, financing, technical support, and spare parts. It operates through the following segments: Sale of Heavy Equipment and Parts, Engineering Consultancy Service Income, and Rental Income. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: 十盟國際控股有限公司從事銷售、租賃和維護建築設備以及提供工程諮詢服務。其產品包括建築設備、港口設備和零配件。該公司的服務包括專案租賃、融資、技術支援和備件。它透過以下部門運作：重型設備和零件銷售、工程諮詢服務收入和租賃收入。該公司成立於1998年，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: ARS Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the development of a novel, potentially first-in-class product candidate, neffy, for the emergency treatment of Type I allergic reactions including anaphylaxis. Its product includes Epinephrine Nasal Spray. The company was founded by Richard Lowenthal, Robert Bell, and Sarina Tanimoto on August 5, 2015 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: ARS Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，專注於開發一種新型的、可能是一流的候選產品 neffy，用於緊急治療包括過敏反應在內的 I 型過敏反應。其產品包括腎上腺素鼻噴劑。該公司由 Richard Lowenthal、Robert Bell 和 Sarina Tanimoto 於 2015 年 8 月 5 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: AppFolio, Inc., provides industry-specific cloud-based business software solutions, services, and data analytics for the real estate industry. The firm offers AppFolio Property Manager, a property management solution designed to address the operational and business requirements of property management companies and their business ecosystems, and AppFolio Investment Management, a cloud-based software solution for real estate investment managers of various sizes that provides tools and services designed to streamline their real estate investment management businesses. It also provides services that are designed to enhance, automate, and streamline processes and workflows for property management businesses, such as artificial intelligence leasing assistant, tenant screening, electronic payment, utility management, maintenance contact center, tenant debt collection, and mailing services. The company was founded by Brian Donahoo, Klaus Schauser and Jonathan Walker in 2006 and is headquartered in Santa Barbara, CA.
info.description_zh: AppFolio, Inc. 為房地產行業提供特定行業的基於雲端的商業軟體解決方案、服務和數據分析。該公司提供AppFolio Property Manager和AppFolio Investment Management，前者是一種物業管理解決方案，旨在滿足物業管理公司及其業務生態系統的營運和業務需求，而AppFolio Investment Management是一種基於雲端的軟體解決方案，適用於各種規模的房地產投資經理，提供旨在簡化其房地產投資管理業務的工具和服務。它還提供旨在增強、自動化和簡化物業管理業務流程和工作流程的服務，例如人工智慧租賃助理、租戶篩選、電子支付、公用事業管理、維護聯絡中心、租戶追債和郵寄服務。該公司由 Brian Donahoo、Klaus Schauser 和 Jonathan Walker 於 2006 年創立，總部位於加州聖塔芭芭拉。

info.description: Global Payments, Inc. engages in the provision of payment technology and software solutions. It operates through the Merchant Solutions and Issuer Solutions segments. The Merchant Solutions segment offers payments technology and software solutions globally to primarily small- and-medium sized businesses and select mid-market and enterprise customers. The Issuer Solutions segment is involved in comprehensive commerce solutions supporting the payment ecosystem for issuers. The company was founded by George W. Thorpe in 1967 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Global Payments, Inc. 從事提供支付技術和軟體解決方案。它透過商家解決方案和發行人解決方案部門運作。商家解決方案部門主要向全球中小型企業以及精選的中階市場和企業客戶提供支付技術和軟體解決方案。發行人解決方案部門提供支援發行人支付生態系統的全面商務解決方案。該公司由 George W. Thorpe 於 1967 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: MannKind Corp. is a biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the development and commercialization of innovative therapeutic products and devices to address serious unmet medical needs for those living with endocrine and orphan lung diseases. Its products and pipeline include Afrezza, Pediatric Afrezza, V-Go, Tyvaso DPI, MNKD-101, MNKD-201, MNKD-301, and MNKD-501. The company was founded by Alfred E. Mann on February 14, 1991 and is headquartered in Danbury, CT.
info.description_zh: MannKind Corp. 是一家生物製藥公司，專注於創新治療產品和設備的開發和商業化，以滿足內分泌疾病和孤兒肺病患者嚴重未滿足的醫療需求。其產品和管道包括 Afrezza、兒科 Afrezza、V-Go、Tyvaso DPI、MNKD-101、MNKD-201、MNKD-301 和 MNKD-501。該公司由 Alfred E. Mann 於 1991 年 2 月 14 日創立，總部位於康乃狄克州丹伯里。

info.description: Intapp, Inc. engages in the provision of information technology services. It provides industry-specific, cloud-based software solutions for the professional and financial services industry globally. The company was founded by Thaddaus Jampol and Daniel Harsell in 2000 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Intapp, Inc. 從事提供資訊科技服務。它為全球專業和金融服務業提供特定行業、基於雲端的軟體解決方案。該公司由 Thaddaus Jampol 和 Daniel Harsell 於 2000 年創立，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Prospect Capital Corp., a traded business development company invests in middle market companies located in the United States. The fund targets companies operating across a broad range of sectors. It provides debt and equity financing for buyout, growth, development, and recapitalization. It acts as a co-investor and takes controlling interest. The company was founded on April 13, 2004 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Prospect Capital Corp. 是一家上市業務開發公司，投資於位於美國的中間市場公司。該基金的目標投資對象涉及多個行業的公司。它為收購、成長、發展和資本重組提供債務和股權融資。它作為共同投資者並擁有控股權。該公司成立於2004年4月13日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Fluence Energy, Inc. engages in energy storage products and services, and artificial intelligence-enabled digital applications for renewables and storage. Its storage includes Smartstack, Gridstack Pro, Grisdtack, and Ultrastack. The company was founded on June 21, 2021, and is headquartered in Arlington, VA.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 再生能源
info.description_zh: Fluence Energy, Inc.從事能源儲存產品和服務，以及用於再生能源和儲存的人工智慧數位應用。其儲存包括Smartstack、Gridstack Pro、Grisdtack和Ultrastack。該公司成立於2021年6月21日，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿靈頓。

info.description: Moleculin Biotech, Inc. is a clinical stage pharmaceutical company. It engages in the business of growing a pipeline including phase 2 clinical programs for hard-to-treat cancers and viruses. The company was founded by Walter V. Klemp, Donald H. Picker, and Waldemar Priebe in July 2015 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Moleculin Biotech, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的製藥公司。該公司從事開發管道業務，包括針對難治性癌症和病毒的二期臨床項目。該公司由 Walter V. Klemp、Donald H. Picker 和 Waldemar Priebe 於 2015 年 7 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Nayax Ltd. engages in the operation of a global commerce enablement and payments platform. It offers a complete solution including localized cashless payment acceptance, management suite, and consumer engagement tools, enabling merchants to conduct commerce anywhere, at any time. It operates through the following geographical segments: USA, Europe (excluding UK), UK, Australia, Israel, and Rest of the World. The company was founded by Yair Nechmad, Amir Nechmad, and David Ben Avi on January 16, 2005 and is headquartered in Herzliya, Israel.
info.description_zh: Nayax Ltd. 從事全球商業支援和支付平台的營運。它提供了完整的解決方案，包括本地化的無現金支付受理、管理套件和消費者參與工具，使商家能夠隨時隨地進行商業活動。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、歐洲（不包括英國）、英國、澳洲、以色列和世界其他地區。該公司由 Yair Nechmad、Amir Nechmad 和 David Ben Avi 於 2005 年 1 月 16 日創立，總部位於以色列荷茲利亞。

info.description: BioXcel Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of artificial intelligence solutions in neuroscience and immuno-oncology. It also focuses on utilizing technology and research to develop therapeutics solutions. The company was founded by Vimal D. Mehta on March 29, 2017 and is headquartered in New Haven, CT.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: BioXcel Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，從事神經科學和免疫腫瘤學領域人工智慧解決方案的開發。它還專注於利用技術和研究來開發治療解決方案。該公司由 Vimal D. Mehta 於 2017 年 3 月 29 日創立，總部位於康乃狄克州紐黑文。

info.description: BRBI BR Partners SA engages in the provision of banking services. It operates through the finance segment. The company was founded by Ricardo Fleury Cavalcanti de Albuquerque Lacerda in 2009 and is headquartered in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
info.description_zh: BRBI BR Partners SA 從事提供銀行服務。它透過金融部門運作。該公司由 Ricardo Fleury Cavalcanti de Albuquerque Lacerda 於 2009 年創立，總部位於巴西聖保羅。

info.description: Nkarta, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of natural killer cell therapies for the treatment of cancer. The firm's product include NKX101, which is in Phase I clinical trials for the treatment of relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia or higher risk myelodysplastic syndromes, and NKX019, a pre-clinical product, which is based on the ability to treat various B cell malignancies by targeting the CD19 antigen found on these types of cancerous cells. The company was founded by Dario Campana in 2005 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Nkarta, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於癌症治療的自然殺手細胞療法的發現、開發和商業化。該公司的產品包括NKX101和NKX019，NKX101處於I期臨床試驗中，用於治療復發/難治性急性髓性白血病或高風險骨髓增生異常綜合徵，NKX019是一種臨床前產品，其基於通過靶向這些類型的癌細胞上發現的CD19抗原來治療各種B細胞惡性腫瘤的能力。該公司由 Dario Campana 於 2005 年創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Gogo, Inc. engages in the provision of broadband connectivity services for the business aviation market. The company was founded by Jimmy Ray in 1991 and is headquartered in Broomfield, CO.
info.description_zh: Gogo, Inc. 致力於為公務航空市場提供寬頻連線服務。該公司由 Jimmy Ray 於 1991 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州布魯姆菲爾德。

info.description: Freight Technologies, Inc. engages in the development and operation of a cloud-based logistics management platform. It provides freight platforms for cross-border shipping. It offers the Fr8App for carriers, shippers, and all stakeholders in land-based logistics. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in The Woodlands, TX.
info.description_zh: Freight Technologies, Inc.從事基於雲端的物流管理平台的開發和營運。它為跨境運輸提供貨運平台。它為承運人、托運人和陸上物流的所有利益相關者提供 Fr8App。該公司成立於 2015 年，總部位於德克薩斯州伍德蘭茲。
